tei:div.tei:p: // skad rlung 'phrin brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i shes bya blo gsal mgul 607ri smo maspung/pasaḥba'i ba'ipa smo masaba'ingasaḥ56 ri smo maspu 55khyimasaspyomasaḥ077 bab ma ri smo0 ri 6smo ma'i/0ཿ rim/ 565/ngaḥsmo mas(
rin chen skyid kyis brtsams/go ga rlung phen bsnya 'khrin gyi gad mkhan dang 'go tswakron pa'i 5shes bya gho sal ma/layo/
༄khya/ /bod skad rlung 'phrin brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i shes bya blo gsal mgul rgyan/rin chen skyid kyis brtsams/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

gleng gzhi/bod skad rlung 'phrin tshugs nas lo ngo lnga bcu lhag 'gor zhing bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin tshugs nas kyang lo ngo nyi shu lhag 'das/ phran gyis bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las rigs su lo ngo sum cu lhag gi ring la bya ba bsgrubs pa'i dus yun nang / rgya yig gi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin shes bya'i thad kyi dpe cha gang mang zhig lta klog byas myong mod/ yin na yang / lo mang po'i ring la mtho skur sgur byas nas bye brag gi le tshan bsgrubs pa dang le tshan bshad pa'i rang 'khri'i bya bar gang nus ci lcogs kyis 'bad brtson byas pa las/ bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin shes bya'i rtsom 'bri'i thad bsam blo gtan nas btang ma myong la 'bad brtson de bas kyang byas ma myong /rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ rgya bod skad rigs gnyis kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin la sa cha'i khyab tshad dang / lta mkhan gyi mi grangs/ de'i sgrub mkhan gyi mang nyung /stobs kyi che chung la sogs phyogs gang thad nas bltas kyang glang chen dang grog ma bzhin bsdur thabs ye nas bral/ rang re'i bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin de yang bod khams kyi yul gru kun tu khyab nas rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i nang du yongs su 'thim 'dug mod kyang / bya ba de sgrub mkhan gyi cha nas bshad na mi grangs stong gcig gnyis tsam las med pa dang phal che bas rgya yig dang rgya skad shes pas/ gal te ched las thad kyi shes bya zhig shes 'dod na rgya yig la bltas pas chog cing / bod skad nang khul nas ched las bya ba so sor phyogs bsdoms rang bzhin gyi rgyu cha dang rtsom yig bsgrigs 1

dgos mod/ dpe cha zhig brtsams nas 'grem rgyur phyogs gang ci'i thad nas rin thang dang bkol sa de 'dra'i chen po med/ de bas bye brag gi le tshan dga' po 'dra bsgrub thub tshe/ bod rigs lta mkhan la mkho ba de yin la/ las ga'i rin thang yang de la yod bsams/yin na'ang / nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la rgyu rkyen mang po zhig gi dbang gis rang gi dang thog gi bsam mno der 'gyur ldog cig byung du bcug pa ste/ de yang bya rgod po zhig la ci tshang ba byi'u 'jol mo zhig la de tshang ba'i dpe ltar/bod rmed kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin yang mi grangs dang / gzhi khyon/ khyab tshad sogs kyi thad nas rgya skad dang bsdur thabs med na'ang / le tshan gyi sgrig gzhi3 kyi khog thad khyad par cher med pa dang nang sgos su las byed mi sna'i le sngon sgrub sa'i brtson sems dang dka' sdug sogs la de bas khyad par med/ de yang rgya skab kyi le tshan zhig dang bod skad kyi le tshan zhig gi spyi tshogs kyi phan nus la khyab che chung yod pa bzhin mtshan snyan la'ang che chung shor 'dug de ni lta mkhan mang nyung dang khyab tshad kyi nus pa sogs la khyad par shor ba ma gtogs/ le tshan la bzang ngan shor ba zhig gtan nas ma red/ de bzhin du rgya skad kyi le tshan bshad mkhan zhig dang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad cha'i le tshan bshad mkhan zhig gi spyi tshogs kyi go gnas thad dang mtshan snyan la khyad par shor ba de yang bya ba'i nus pa dang bya ba'i mang nyung / phyogs so so'i chu tshad sogs la khyad par shor ba ni min la/ bya bar phul ba'i brtse sems dang hur brtson la khyad par shor ba zhig de bas kyang yin mi srid/ mi rigs grangs nyung skad kyi le tshan sgrub pa la phyogs so so'i cha rkyen zhan pa'i rkyen gyis skabs 'gar rgya skad kyi le tshan sgrub pa las kyang dka' sdug gang mang myong dgos la/2

de ni rang gi sde tshan gyi nang khul du shes pa tsam ma gtogs gzhan gyis rtogs dka' phyir rang gi sdug lus 'di rnams su zhig la'ang brjod sa med pas/ thog mar rang gis rang la brtsi mthong dang rang gis rang nyid khas len dgos pa de ni bden don yin zhing / rang gi bya ba dang nus par khas len pa de yang rang nyid gcig pu'i ched du ma yin par phyogs la la'i thad nas rang mi rigs kyi skad cha'i las rigs 'di'i nus pa phran bu gzhan la ngom pa'i ched du'ang min nam snyam pa'i dran snang zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes pa'i mod la/ rin thang yod med dang bkol sa yod med kyi sdug lus brjod pa las tshugs ka med rung sdog pa zhig byas pas dga' snyam pa dang / de min sngon chad rang gis kyang phyogs gcig nas dge rgan rgan rabs pa'i nyams myong la slob pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mun nag tu lag nyob byed pa nang bzhin las zhor dang slob zhor zung 'brel byas nas mtshams lan rer 'khyog lam yang brgyud myong phyin/rjes rabs pa rnams la bya ba'i thad drang lam re ston e thub bas sa/sa pa'i kun slong bcangs nas rgya yig gi ched las dpe cha mang po las bya 'tshol byi'u 'tshol byas pa dang rang gi bya ba'i nyams myong rnams la bda' lung bda' byas nas/bod skad rlung 'phrin brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i shes bya blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes pa'i dpe cha 'di 'bri khul byas pa yin/dpe cha 'di par skrun byed par krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gi dbu khrid dang rtsom sgrig pas thugs khur dang mthun rkyen gang mang bskrun par ma zad/ dpe cha 'di'i 'bri stangs la sogs pa'i thad kyang sun snang med par do khur dang mdzub ston zhib phra gnang bar brten/ da gzod deb chung 'di legs par 'grub thub pa byung bas/ kho bos 'di ru lag zung thal mo snying khar 3

sbyar nas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas thugs rje che zhu ba lags/ de yang gcig nas rang nyid kyi rig gnas chu tshad dma' ba dang gnyis nas dpe cha 'bri ba'i nyams myong med la yig rtsal zhan pa dang / gsum nas dus yun thung ngu'i nang du 'grub dgos pas gra sgrig gis mi 'dang ba sogs kyis rkyen byas nor 'chug dang mi dag sa gang mang mchis nges pas/ las rigs gcig pa'i las grogs rnam pa dang rgya che'i gzigs mkhan rnam pas kha lag pas zum nas dgod zhor du zhe bsam pa'i gting nas mdzub ston dang das bcos gnang bar mkhyen mkhyen/zhes rtsom pa pos 2༷༷8lo'i bla 6pa'i tshes 15nyin/

dkar chagadang po/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi thog ma'i brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal gyi 'phel rim/ (1)gnyis pa/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim/ (12)gcig 'dzam gling gi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim mdor bsdus/ (13)gnyis/ krung go'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim mdor bsdus/ (20)gsum/ mi dmangs rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim (24)bzhi/ bod skad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi'aphel tshul mdor bsdus/ (30)gsum pa/ gsar 'god pa/ (42)gcig gsar 'god pa'i 'byung khungs/ (43)gnyis/ gsar 'god pa'i rigs/ (46)gsum/ gsar 'god pa'i blo sbyong chu tshad/ (49)bzhi/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i thabs rtsal (61)bzhi pa/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa/ (99)1

gcig bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i byed nus/ (104)gnyis/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rigs/ (108)gsum/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen/ (113)bzhi/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i sems khams kyi blo sbyong / (119)lnga/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad dang skad cha'i mtshon nus/ (133)drug bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i byed las/ (170)bdun/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan skor/ (261)lnga pa/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin thad kyi bsam gzhig 'thor bu/ (305)gcig las byed dpung sde'i spyi khog gi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa'i gal chen rang bzhin/ (307)gnyis/ le tshan gyi sgrig bkod 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang le tshan gyi spus tshad mthor 'degs byed dgos tshul/ (316)gsum/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan dgos tshul/ (326)2

dang po/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi thog ma'i brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal gyi 'phel rim skor/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ni dus rabs nyi shu ba'i mi'i rigs kyi ches rlabs che ba'i gsar gtod cig red/ glog rlabs gsar rnyed byas pa dang glog rdul lag rtsal gong du 'phel ba la brten nas rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin byung / der brten rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi 'phel rim gleng dus rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal gyis bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen snang med du 'dor mi rung / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin 'phel rgyas kyi gom pa re re tshang ma glog rdul lag rtsal gyi gsar gtod dang kha bral thabs med pas/ gal te glog rdul brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal gyi ram 'degs med tshe/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi 'phel rgyas kyang yod mi srid ces bshad chogadeng rabs spyi tshogs ni cha 'phrin gyi spyi tshogs shig yin pas/ mi rnams gyis tshegs med par rang khyim nas rgyang ring gi gnam gyi mtha' dang sa yi sne nas byung ba'i cha 'phrin sna tshogs shes thub/ cha 'phrin brje res byed pa ni dus rabs gang du'ang med du mi rung ba zhig red/ gna' nas bzung mi'i rigs kyis rgyang ring gi 'phrin skyel thabs shes 'tshol zhib byed mtshams bzhag ma myong / de snga spyi lo 968lor krung go pas thig skud kyis smyug sbug gnyis mthud de/ thig skud la brten nas sgra rlabs brgyud nas thag ring du 'phrin skyel byed pa'i tshod lta byas/ 'di ni da lta'i kha par gyi thog ma'i 'byung khungs yin par 1

snyam gyin yod/ dus rabs 18pa'i lo rabs 20bar lcags lam myur du gong 'phel byung ba dang bstun nas/ gnam gshis kyis shugs rkyen mi thebs pa dang dus tshod kyis tshod 'dzin mi thebs la/ me 'khor las mgyogs pa'i 'phrin skyel yo byad cig la brten nas lcags lam 'grim 'grul gyi dus rtags dang bde 'jags la khag theg byed pa'i dgos mkho byung / dus der glog g.yis dang zangs skud/ glog rdul tshor snang sogs snga mo nas gsar gtod byas zin pas glog 'phrin gsar gtod byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i lag rtsal cha rkyen yang 'dzoms pa red/1839lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 9nyin dbyin ji'i dmag khongs las phyir bud pa'i we len h+phu se jir khu'u khi dang lun tun mtho rim slob gling gi rang byung mtshan nyid rig pa'i dge rgan chen mo hos su tin gnyis kyis gsar bzo byas pa'i glog 'phrin 'phrul chas de lun kun gyi pa tin tun me 'khor 'bab tshigs nas we si thi ti lis tun me 'khor 'bab tshigs bar gyi lcags lam steng bkol ba dang bar thag spyi le 21yod/ phyis su kho tshos mu mthud du glog 'phrin 'phrul chas legs bcos byas pas/ glog 'phrin 'phrul chas 'di rigs dbyin ji'i lcags lam steng dus rabs 20ba'i dus mgo'i bar bkol spyod byas/ de dang mnyam du mor si zhes pa'i a me ri kha'i mi zhig gis kyang glog 'phrin la zhib 'jug lhod med byas/ 1844lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 24nyin mor si yis hwa hrin tun nas pa ar de mo'i bar mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus steng gi glog 'phrin dang po btang / glog 'phrin gyi nang don glog skud brgyud nas myur du bar thag spyi le bcu phrag 'ga' yod pa'i pa ar de mor brgyud gtong byas pa dang kho'i lag rogs pas glog 'phrin gyi nang don ma nor bar yi ger phab/ mor si'i 2

glog 'phrin legs 'grub byung ba des a me ri kha dang dbyin ji/ de min 'dzam gling bi rgyal khab so sor g.yo 'gul chen mo thebs shing / kho'i glog 'phrin de mgyogs por 'dzam gling yongs la khyab/ 1887lor dngos lugs rig pa ba ho tsis glog sdud rlabs shes rtogs byung / khos tshod lta las glog sdud rlabs ni glog rlabs dang sdud rlabs las grub pa shes par ma zad/ da dung glog sdud rlabs kyi ldog 'phro sogs gshis nus mang po shes rtogs byung / glog sdud rlabs shes pa des skud med glos bi 'phrin skyel la lam gsar gtod byas pa red/ gsar rnyed des u go'i tshan rig pa ya lis hran ta si ce phan no we chi po po h+phu yi spro ba bskyed/ khos glog sdud rlabs la brten nas bar thag sngar las ring ba'i 'phrin skyel mngon 'gyur bya rgyu'i spobs sems bcangs/ po po h+phu yis tshod lta byed skabs skud med glog brgyud bsgrags byed pa'i rgyu rkyen ches gal chen te gnam skud kyi nus pa shes/ 1896lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 24nyin po po h+phu yis rang gis bzos pa'i skud med glog gi glog 'phrin 'phrul chas bkol nas 'dzam gling gi skud med glog 'phrin dang po btang ba dang sdud len byas/ phal cher po po h+phu dang dus mtshungs su dbyi tha li rgyal khab kyi dngos lugs rig pa ba dang gsar gtod mkhas pa ku'u ki lir mo ma khi nyi zer ba zhig gis skud med glog 'phrin lag rtsal sngar las 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ khos sa ngos kyi gnam skud lag rtsal la gsar bcos byas te/ glog 'phrin gtong len gyi bar thag ji ltar je ring du gtong ba'i thad 'tshol zhib dang lag len yang yang byas shing / mor si'i glog 'phrin 'phrul chas dang skud med glog gi ma lag sbrel nas glog sdud rlabs kyi gtong len byed nus kyi bar thag je ring du btang / phyis ma khri nyi yis dbyin jir gnas spor 3

byas shing / dbyin ji srid gzhung gi rgyab skyor 'og khos mu mthud du zhib 'jug byas/ 1897lor kho dang kho'i lag rogs pas dbyin ji'i mtsho 'gram nas rgya mtsho las brgal ba'i 'phrin skyel tshod lta byas/ rjes kyi lo 'ga'i ring khos phyogs gcig nas 'phrin skyel sgrig chas legs bcos byas pa dang phyogs gcig nas 'phrin skyel gyi bar thag je ring du gtong ba'i thad zhib 'jug lhod med byas/ 1899lor ma khi nyi'i glog 'phrin gtong chas bsgrigs yod pa'i gru gzings shig gru gzhan zhig dang gdong gtug brgyab/ stabs legs pa la skud med glog 'phrin 'phrul chas bkol nas skyabs zhu brda rtags btang bas gru'i steng gi gru ba rnams myur du skyob thub song / don rkyen des 'dzam gling yongs la skud med glog gi 'phrin skyel gyi bkol spyod rin thang ngos zin du bcug de nas bzung rgyal khab mang pos rgya mtshor bskyod pa'i gru gzings yod tshad kyis nges par du skud med glog gi glog 'phrin 'phrul chas bsgrigs nas nyen khar 'phrad dus myur skyob zhu bar bkol dgos pa'i gtan khel bzos/1899lor ma khi nyi yis thog dang por dbyin ji'i mtsho 'gag 'gram gnyis kyi skud med glog gi 'phrin skyel mngon 'gyur byas/ yin yang kho rang de tsam gyis yid ma tshim par gong spel gyi mig rgyang de nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo'i pha rol tu gtad/ 1899lor ma khi nyi yis a me ri kha nas skud med glog gi 'phrin skyel kung zi ang dang po ste/ a me ri kha'i ma khi nyi skud med glog 'phrin kung zi btsugs/ lo gnyis kyi rjes su khos h+pho la'e men zer ba zhig dang mnyam du lo rgyus steng thengs dang por nub kyi rgya mtsho chen mo brgal ba'i skud med glog gtong ba'i tshod lta yongs 'grub byung / 1903lo nas bzung 'dzam gling steng gi rgyal khab mang pos snga gzhug tu skud med glog gtong ba'i sa tshigs btsugs 4

pa dang / skud med glog gi 'phrin skyel de yang yongs khyab tu mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i phyogs so sor bkol spyod byas/ de'i rkyen gyis ma khi nyi la 1909lo'i no per dngos lugs rig pa'i bya dga' thob/ dus rabs 19ba'i dus mjug la sleb dus mor si glog 'phrin de yongs khyab tu bkol spyod byed kyin yod/ yin yang mor si glog 'phrin la'ang glog 'phrin gtong ba dang glog 'phrin sdud len gnyis gas ched bkol glog grangs sgyur yig gis thengs gnyis la bsgyur tshe da gzod yang dag pa'i brda rtags brgyud gtong byed thub pas/ skud med glog gi 'phrin skyel de sngar bzhin de 'dra mgyogs shing stabs bde zhig ma red/ der brten mkhas pa mang pos snga gzhug brtsad de thad gar skad sgra brgyud gtong byed thub pa'i kha par 'phrul chas thad zhib 'jug byed mgo brtsams/ rgyal khongs a me ri kha yin pa'i su'u ki lan gyi ya lis hran ta ki li o mu pe ar gyis 1876lo'i zla 2tshes 14nyin kho dang wo sin gnyis gyis zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa'i sgrig chas te/ kha par gyi ched khe'i dbang cha'i re zhu bton nas kha par gyi gsar gtod dbang cha thob pe ar gyis gsar gtod byed 'dod pa ni thad kur mi'i skad sgra brgyud gtong byed pa'i sgrig chas las mis bshad pa'i skad cha sgra gdangs dang bcas skud med glog lam brgyud de thag ring du bsgrag rgyu de red/ zhib 'jug khrod du kho la bsam gzhig gsar ba zhig skyes/ skad thon par byed pa'i mkha' dbugs skul skyod de glog rgyun gyi bstud mur 'gyur ldog tu bsgyur pa dang de nas glog rgyun gyi 'gyur ldog la brten nas skad sgra'i 'gyur ldog gi rigs mtshungs lad bzo byas/ 'di ni kha par gyi thog ma'i rtsa ba'i rig gzhung zhig red/ yin na'ang /ji ltar skad sgra'i 'gyur ldog nas glog rgyun gyi 'gyur ldog dang slar yang glog 5

rgyun 'gyur ldog nas skad sgra'i 'gyur ldog la bsgyur ba'i 'gyur ldog bo rim mngon 'gyur bya rgyu'i thad la khos tshod lta yang yang byas/1876lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 10nyin pe ar gyis tshod lta khang du tshod lta byed dus sems chung ma byas par mu zi rang gi rkang mgor gtor/ na zug chen po'i khrod du khos rang dbang med par sku zhabs wo sin lags/ nga la rogs byos dang zhes skad brgyab/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni skad cha de tshod lta byed bzhin pa'i kha par brgyud de khang ba gzhan du bya ba sgrub bzhin pa'i las rogs pa wo sin gyis thos/ 'di ni mi'i rigs kyis thog dang por kha par nas brgyud pa'i skad sgra yin pas tshan rig gsar gtod kyi deb ther steng du bkod/kho tshos 'bad brtson lhod med byas mthar de 'dra zhib tshags min pa'i kha par gyi ma dbyibs gnyis bzos te/ glog sdud rlabs kyis skad rigs sgra rlabs brgyud gtong byed pa'i dmigs yul mngon 'gyur byas/ mi rnams kyis glog grangs cha 'phrin brgyud gtong byed pa'i skud med glog 'phrin gsar gtod byas rjes/ skad sgra brgyud gtong byed pa'i skud med kha par gsar gtod byas/ der brten nas bsam tshul 'di 'dra zhig skyes pa ste/ skud med glog gis skad sgra brgyud gtong byed thub tshe/ des rol dbyangs brgyud gtong byed thub la/ skud med glog gi brda rtags kyang mi mang pos dus mnyam du bsdu len byed thub pas skud med glog gi rgyang bsgrags sgrub kyang chog snyam/1906lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 24nyin ye shes 'khrungs skar gyi dgong mo'i chu tshod 8yas mas su a me ri kha'i h+pho ji nyi ya kro'u yi skud med glog 'phrin las glo bur du ma sa kru'u se kro'u gi pu lan thi lo khi yi skud med glog 'phrin las bsgrags 'ongs pa'i mi'i skad sgra dang rol dbyangs thos byung / de dang 6

mnyam du a me ri ku'i mtsho 'gram gyi mtsho gru'i steng gi skud med glog 'phrin las kyang skad de thos byung / de ni mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus steng thog dang por skud med glog gis btang ba'i tshod lta rang bzhin gyi rgyang bsgrags yin la/rgyal khongs kha na ta yin pa'i a me ri kha'i dngos lugs rig pa ba le cin na ti o pu lis chi h+phe sin tin gyis 'go 'dzin dang rtsa 'dzugs byas pa red/ h+phe sin tin gyis sngon la rol dbyangs btang ba dang de'i rjes khos rang gis pi wang dkrol zhor du ye shes 'khrungs skar dus chen gyi glu dbyangs grags can zhig blangs/ der mthud nas kho'i lcam mo dang drung yig gnyis kyis ye shes gsung rab nang gi tshan pa zhig gyer 'don byas/ yin yang kho mo gnyis ka shin tu 'tshab nas 'don ma thub/ der brten h+phe sin tin gyis thengs 'di'i rgyang bsgrags mtshams 'jog rgyu khyab bsgrags byas shing / khos nyan mkhan rnam par ye shes dus chen la rten 'brel zhu ba dang dus mtshungs su/ nyan mkhan rnams kyis kho la 'phrin yig 'bri rgyu ma zad/ kho tshos sa cha gang nas rgyang bsgrags thos pa gsal bshad bya rgyu'i re ba bton/ nyan mkhan rnams kyi 'phrin yig las h+phe sin tin gyis skud med glog gi rlung 'phrin gsar gtod byas pa de bden dpang byas/ h+phe sin tin la bsdoms pas ched khe 500thob pas 'dzam gling bi ang gnyis pa yin/1907lo'i zla 2par a ri'i nyi'u yo grong khyer gyi lis ti h+phu lis si thi skud med glog kha par kung zis 'dzam gling thog ches snga ba'i skud med glog gi rgyang bsgrags dus nges gtan ltar gtong ba'i tshod lta byas/ mi'i rigs kyi thog dang po'i skud med glog rlung 'phrin legs 'grub byung ba des deng rabs kyi skud med rlung 'phrin dang 'phrin skyel la mdun ljongs rgya chen po phye/7

1920lor dbyin ji'i che mo si h+phu ti rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ 1920lo'i zla 11par/ a me ri kha'i phis tsi po grong khyer nas tshong las skud med rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs/ 1921lo nas 1922lo'i bar/ rlung 'phrin las khungs mgyogs myur ngang je mang du song ba dang bstun nas sgra sdud 'phrul chas dang skud med glog gi rgyu cha'i 'tshong tshad kyang myur du 'phar/ 1922lo'i zla 11par a me ri kha rgyal yongs su tho 'god byas pa'i skud med glog gi rlung 'phrin las khungs 564yod/ skabs der krung gos kyang phyi rgyal gyi ma dngul btang ba'i skud med rlung 'phrin las khungs shig btsugs/ 1922lor a me ri kha'i nyi'u yo dang kri ca ko'i rlung 'phrin las khungs gnyis kyis rgyang ring kha par skud lam mthud nas rkang rtsed spo lo thengs shig brgyud gtong byas/ 1926lor a me ri kha'i rgyang bsgrags kung zis nyi'u yo nas rlung 'phrin las khungs shig bsdu rub byas shing / de lte ba byas nas skud med rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi rgyun 'dzugs dra rgya btsugs te/nyin re re'i le tshan bkod sgrig byas/ 1926lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 27nyin brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas dang po bzos/ su'u ki lan gyi yo han pe ar ti yis thog dang por skud med glog gis glog brnyan gtong ba'i 'phrul chas dpe ston byas/ lo der h+pha yin o sis legs 'grub ngang glog rdul lag rtsal la brten nas brnyan ris de brnyan phab 'phrul chas steng brgyud gtong byas/ de ni kun gyis khas len pa'i brnyan 'phrin byung ba'i rtags mtshan red/ phyis su h+pha yin wo si kho rang gi gsar gtod 'di la nga rgyal mi skyes par ma zad/ tshe smad la khos rang gi gsar gtod 'di ni mi rnams la 'tsho ba chud zos su gtong du 'jug pa'i thabs sheg bton pa red ces skyon brjod drag po byas shing / tha na 8

khyim mi tshos brnyan 'phrin blta bar yang bkag 'gog byas/ yin yang / deng skabs brnyan 'phrin ni khyim tshang re rer med du mi rung ba'i mkho chas shig tu gyur pa ni ldog tu med pa'i don dngos shig yin la/ h+pha yin wo si'ang dus rabs 20ba'i ches rlabs che ba'i gsar gtod pa zhig yin pa smos ma dgos so/ /rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud bsgrags byed stangs thad nas bshad na/ skud med glog rlabs kyis sa ngos nas brgyud pa'i brgyud bsgrags byed stangs 'di rigs la lag rtsal cha rkyen dang sa gshis cha rkyen gyis tshod 'dzin thebs phyin/ khyab khongs rgya chen por brda rtags kyis khebs dka'/1957lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 4nyin su'u len gyis mis bzos sa'i go la'i 'khor skar dang po mkha' dbyings su btang ste/ sa'i go la'i steng thog dang por mis bzos 'khor skar las btang ba'i glog rlabs sdud len byas/des mkha' 'grul dus rabs mgo brtsams pa mtshon par ma zad/ 'khor skar la brten nas 'phrin skyel byed pa'i dus rabs kyang mgo rtsom la khad yod pa mtshon/ 'phrin skyel 'khor skar byung ba dang bstun nas rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud bsgrags myur tshad kyang sngar las je mgyogs su song / yul dngos gnas tshul brgyud gtong byed pa brgyud de/ 'dzam gling rang bzhin gyi lus rtsal 'gran tshogs dang tshan rtsal cha 'phrin gal chen sna tshogs mig deb dbang tsam gyis 'dzam gling hril bor khyab cing / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi khyab rgya'ang sngar las je cher song / 1982lor rgyal khab 140lhag gi mi thengs dung phyur100lhag gis brnyan 'phrin las 'dzam gling bum pa'i rkang rtsed spo lo'i 'gran bsdur la bltas/ lta mkhan gyi mi grangs 'di 'dra mang ba ni sngar byung ma myong ba zhig yin la/ brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags kyi sa 9

mtshams yongs su gtor ba red/ 1965lo nas 1980lo'i bar rgyal spyi'i 'phrin skyel 'khor skar rtsa 'dzugs kyis bsdoms pas rgyal spyi'i 'phrin skyel 'khor skar 5bar snang du btang nas/ sa'i bo la hril bor 'phrin skyel mngon 'gyur byas shing / 'phrin skyel 'khor skar gyis mi dang mi'i bar gyi spyi tshogs 'brel 'dris dang phan tshun bar gyi rgyus lon la shugs snon yang byas/ 'phrin skyel 'khor skar byung ba des brgyud bsgrags 'dzam gling can du 'gyur bar skul 'ded byas te/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin la khyab khongs kyi tshod 'dzin med pa dang bar thag ring thung gi khyad par med par gyur/gal te 'khor skar brgyud bsgrags mngon 'gyur byung bas khyab khongs dang bar thag gi gnad don thag gcod byas pa red ces brjod na/ sang grangs brgyud bsgrags byung ba des mi rnams la rnam pa mang ba'i brje res byed stangs 'don sprod byas/ 'dra bzo las rtsal nas ang grangs lag rtsal du bsgyur pa ni brgyud bsgrags las rigs kyi bsgyur bcos gal chen zhig red/bsgyur bcos 'di rigs ni don dngos thog dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 70ba nas mgo brtsams pa red/ dbyibs gsar ba'i skad rigs rigs shig ste/ ang grangs can gyi skad rigs kyi 'phel rgyas gsar ba las byung ba'i smyan byed kyi rnam pa'i 'gyur ldog chen pos yang thengs shig la brgyud bsgrags dang shes rig gi 'phel rgyas la shugs rkyen bzos/ 'das pa'i lo la bzo las dus rabs dang cha 'phrin dus rabs kyi lag rtsal gyis mnyam 'brel sgos skad rigs 'di rigs kyi 'phel rgyas dang khyab tshul la byas rjes bzhag de ni glog klad dang sa'i go lar bskor ba'i 'phrin skyel dra rgya'i spyi bkod skad rigs shig red/ dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 90bar lag rtsal 'di thog mar yo rob 10

dang 'jar pan sogs dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab nas yongs khyab tu bkol spyod byas pa dang myur du gong 'phel byung / rang rgyal gyis lag rtsal 'di bkol ba cung 'phyi na'ang 'phel rgyas shin tu mgyogs/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ang grangs can du gyur pa des krung go'i da snga'i brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas dung phyur kha shas de spyi pa'i brgyud bsgrags dang cha 'phrin zhabs phyi/ ris gnas rol rtsed sogs gzhi gcig tu grub pa'i sna mang smyun gzugs kyi cha 'phrin sge'u khung zhig tu gyur te/ mang tshogs kyi ris gnas 'tsho ba phun tshogs su gtong ba dang dus mtshungs su krung go'i cha 'phrin can du 'gyur tshad ches cher je mgyogs su gtong nges/ mig sngar yongs khyab tu bkol bzhin pa'i 'dra mtshungs lad bzos brnyan 'phrin dang bsdur na/ ang grangs can gyi brnyan 'phrin gyis lta mkhan rnams kyis rgyu spus sngar las bzang ba'i brnyan 'phrin la lta thub par ma zad/ sna mang po'i zhabs phyi rnam grangs mang po zhig longs su spyod thub/ ang grangs can du 'gyur ba ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin byung ba'i tshun gyi ches che ba'i lag rtsal bsgyur bcos thengs shig yin pa dang / ches che ba'i gong spel go skabs thengs shig dang / ches che ba'i 'gran slong thengs shig kyang red/11

gnyis pa/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim skor/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin byung ba ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi yar thon chen po zhig red/ des tshan rig lag rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas chu tshad mtshon par ma zad/ spyi tshogs kyi yar thon la skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po'ang thon yod/ da lta rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi las don de rgyal khab gong 'phel dang spyi tshogs yar thon gyi rtags mtshan mngon mtshon can du gyur yod/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi lag rtsal gsar ba bkol spyod byas pas deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang 'tsho ba spyod stangs la shugs rkyen zab mo thebs/ 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so so'i mi dmangs kyis 'khor skar las brgyud pa'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin/ 'phrin skyel bcas brgyud nas phan tshun bar gyi rgyus lon dang mdza' brtse mnyam las sogs la shugs snon byas/ 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so so'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyis rang rang so so'i khyad chos kyis phyug pa'i 'phel rgyas bgrod lam ded nas bskyod pa yin mod/ yin na'ang bya gzhag de spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas las don gyi khag gal chen du mi brtsi mkhan phal cher gcig kyang med/12

gcig 'dzam gling gi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim mdor bsdus/dus rabs 20ba'i dus mjug la sleb dus 'dzam gling steng ha lam rgyal khab yod do cog bis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin btsugs/ brnyan 'phrin khang med pa'i rgyal khab khyon bsdoms 10las med de/ so sor zhi bde rgya mtsho chen mo sa khul du 6dang gling chen a h+phe ri ka ru 4yod/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin sdud len yo chas myur du khyab gdal du phyin te/ dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab tu dgos mkho'i kha bkang bas/ gang mgyogs sgos rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi zhabs phyi'i khyab khongs je cher btang ba dang byed sgo'i nang don je mang du btang / gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyal khab tu'ang rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin de mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i mkho chas su gyur te/'dzam gling gi khyab khongs nas bshad na rlung 'phrin la nyan pa dang brnyan 'phrin la lta ba ni mi mang po'i nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khag cig tu gyur 'dug mig sngar rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don de zhabs phyi khyab khongs sngar las rgya che ba dang zhabs phyi'i nang don sngar las phun sum tshogs par brten nas/spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i phyogs so so nas gting zab ngang gong du spel bzhin mchis/a me ri kha dang dbyin ji/ 'jar man/ h+pha ran si/ u go 'jar pan sogs rgyal khab ni 'dzam gling steng rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin btsugs pa ches snga ba'i rgyal khab yin la/ de snga dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 20ba'i dus nas bzung rlung 'phrin btsugs yod cing rang rang gi 'phel rgyas kyi khyad chos ldan/ 13

a me ri kha'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin de spyi tshogs kyi la sa don zhig yin pa'i cha nas skud med glog chas rgyu cha 'tshong ba nas byung ba red/'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po mjug rdzogs rjes 'tshong yul med pa'i dmag bkol skud med glos chas rgyu cha 'grem 'tshong byed ched tha na sna 'dzoms tshong khang gis kyang kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs/ 1920lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 2nyin zhi wo glog rlangs kung zi'i rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ rjes su 1926lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 15nyin rgyal yongs rlung 'phrin kung zis kyang rgyang bsgrags byas/ dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 30ba'i dpal 'byor 'phel med sor gnas kyi dus skabs ni a me ri kha'i rlung 'phrin dar rgyas ches che ba'i dus skabs yin phyir/ glog brnyan la tshags par dang 'dra ba'i go gnas thob/ a me ri kha'i brnyan 'phrin ni 1947lor mgo brtsams pa dang / 1948lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 15nyin dgong dro'i gsar 'gyur le tshan bsgrubs/ 1967lor/ a me ri khas spyi pa'i brnyan 'phrin ma lag btsugs te/ rlung 'phrin lo rgyus steng gi don chen zhig tu gyur/ des brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi mkho 'don sgrig lugs legs bcos byas te/ slob gso'i le tshan dang byis pa'i le tshan/ khyad bzo le tshan sogs kyis lta mkhan gyi dgos mkho bskangs/ kho tshos phab bskrun byas pa'i byis pa'i le tshan mang pos a me ri kha rgyal nang du shugs rkyen chen po bzos par ma zad/'dzam gling yongs la khyab nas/ byis pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi gong 'phel la skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon/ dus rabs gsar bar zhugs rjes/ a me ri kha'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyis sngar las gting zab pa'i bcos sgyur thengs shig brgyud kyin yod/ smyan gzugs gsar ba de a me ri kha nas myur du 14

'phel zhing khyab gdal du song ste/ srol rgyun gyi smyan gzugs dang smyan gzugs gsar ba mnyam du 'dres tshad je mgyogs su 'gro bzhin yod/ a me ri kha'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyis dus rabs 20bar 'od stong 'bar ba'i lo rgyus bskrun la/ lag rtsal gsar ba'i khrid ston 'og dus rabs gsar ba'i nang deng rabs rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi rnam pa gsar ba bskrun thub par gdon mi za/dbyin ji ni 'dzam gling steng skud med glog gi kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs pa ches snga ba'i rgyal khab gras kyi gcig yin par ma zad/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gong du 'phel ba snga zhing mgyogs pa red/1922lor dbyin ji'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang pos dngos su rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ 1927lor dbyin ji'i rlung 'phrin kung zi btsugs/ 1929lor dbyin jis legs 'grub ngang skad med brnyan ris tshod ltas ngang gtong 'go brtsams/ 1936lor dbyin ji'i spyi pa'i brnyan 'phrin khang dang po lun tun nas btsugs/ de ni kun gyis khas len pa'i 'dzam gling gi brnyan 'phrin khang dang po red/ 1955lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 10nyin/ dbyin jis tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin tshod ltas ngang gtong mgo brtsams/ 1962lor dbyin jis thog dang por 'phrin skyel 'khor skar brgyud nas brnyan 'phrin le tshan brgyud gtong byed mgo brtsams/ dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 90ba'i rjes su dbyin ji'i rlunga'aphrin dang brnyan 'phrin dra rgyas e sha ya gling dang me gling / a h+phe ri kha gling / yo rob gling gi skam sa chen mo bcas kyi dra rgyar khebs par byas par ma zad/ bar med du ang grangs dang skud yod/ 'khor skar bcas la brten nas brgyud gtong byas te/ brnyan 15

'phrin gyis khebs tshad gom gang sngon spos sgos rgya bskyed/h+pha ran si rgyal khab tu rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don thad rgyal khab kyis sger sdom nan mo byed pa'i do dam byed stangs lag len bstar gyin yod/ 'di ni nub phyogs ma rtsa ring lugs rgyal khab tu de kho na las med/h+pha ran si'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don yang dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 20bar dar ba zhig red/ 1921lor h+pha ran si'i sbrag srid pu'u yis rgyal gnyer kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang po ste/ a'e h+pher tha kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs/ phyi lor h+pha ran si'i skud med kha par kung zis kyang sgor gyis ma dngul btang bar brten nas sgor gnyer kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs te pa lis kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs/h+pha ran si rgyal khab kyi srid gzhung gis thog ma nyid nas rlung 'phrin de rgyal khab kyi dbang cha sra brtan du gtong ba'i stobs shugs snang med byed mi rung ba zhig tu brtsis/ 1923lo'i zla 6par h+pha ran si srid gzhung gis rlung 'phrin bca' khrims gtan la phab ste/ rlung 'phrin las don ni rgyal khab kyi ched khe yin phyir/ mi sger gyis rlung 'phrin las khungs 'dzugs mi chog pa khyab bsgrags byas/ bca' khrims 'di ni deng rabs kyi h+pha ran si'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las rigs la rgyal khab kyis sger sdom byed pa'i sgrig srol gyi mgo tshugs sar gyur/ dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 30bar h+pha ran si'i rlung 'phrin las don la gong 'phel chen po byung / skabs de ni h+pha ran si'i rlung 'phrin las rigs dar rgyas ches che ba'i dus rabs red/ 1928lor h+pha ran sis legs 'grub ngang brnyan 'phrin gzugs ris btang zhing / 1932 lor pa lis nas rgyal gnyer brnyan 'phrin khang dang po btsugs par ma zad/ dus 16

nges med ngang brnyan 'phrin le tshan btang / yin na'ang skabs de'i h+pha ran si'i brnyan 'phrin ni sngar bzhin tshod lta'i ngang gtong ba'i dus red/'jar man rgyal khab kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don/'jar man ni yo rob gling gi rlung 'phrin bsgrubs pa ches snga ba'i rgyal khab gras kyi gcig red/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i khrod du nub rgyud g.yul sa nas skud med rlung 'phrin tshod lta byas myong / dmag 'khrug pham rjes/ rlung 'phrin las don gong du 'phel mtshams bzhag 1923lo'i zla 10bar dpal 'byor dang skud med glog gi lag rtsal rim bzhin bskyar gso dang gong 'phel byung rjes/ kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang pos po lin nas dus nges gtan ngang rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ de'i phyi lor snga gzhug tu rlung 'phrin kung zi 9btsugs/ de nas bzung / 'jar man gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las khungs kyis rang gi lo rgyus gong 'phel gyi bgrod lam phye/don dngos thog 'jar man gyi brnyan 'phrin ni dbyin ji las kyang snga/1929lor 'gul med brnyan ris kyi brnyan 'phrin gtong ba'i tshod lta byas/1935 lo'i zla 3par 'jar man gyis brnyan 'phrin gtong rgyu'i tshod lta byas/'jar man gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don shin tu dar rgyas che ba ste/sngon thon gyi 'phrin skyel dang glog rdul lag rtsal gyis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don la rdzong stug pa'i rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod dang spus legs sgrig chas 'don sprod byas/ rigs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin shin tu mang pos rgyal yongs la khyab pa dang sdod dmangs khyim tshang kun tu khyab pa'i thabs lam mang ba'i brgyud bsgrags dra rgya chags/ 1996lo nas bzung ang grangs lag rtsal rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin thad bkol rgyu'i tshod 17

lta byas te/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rgyas la bgrod lam gsar ba dang mdun ljongs legs po btod/u go'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don/ u rgo ni skud med glog gi rlung 'phrin maso brtsams pa cung snga ba'i rgyal khab gras kyi gcig red/1917lor u go'i a h+phu lir rtags can gyi rgya mtshor bskor zhib gru gzings kyi skud med rlung 'phrin 'phrul chas las le nyin gyi u go spyi dmangs la springs pa'i yi ge zhes pa rgyang bsgrags byas/ de ni 'byor med gral rim gyis thengs dang por skud med glog la brten nas rgyang bsgrags byas pa yin/ 1918lo'i zla 8par chab srid rgyang bsgrags kyi dgos mkho'i ched du/ u gos ku'o ar ci grong khyer nas skud med glog tshod lta khang dang po btsugs te/ skud med glog gi rlung 'phrin la zhib 'jug byed 'go brtsams/ 1920lor tin tha kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs/ 1922lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 27nyin mo si kho krung dbyang skud med rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis tshod lta'i ngang rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ lo de'i zla 9ba'i tshes 17nyin rol mo dkrol tshogs rgya chen po legs 'grub ngang rgyang bsgrags byas pa des rgyal nang du shugs rkyen chen po bzos/ nyin de ni su'u len gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi 'khrungs skar du ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod/ lo de'i zla 11pa'i tshes 7nyin gyi zla bcu ba'i gsar brje dus chen steng / de la gung khran rgyal spyi'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes pa'i ming btags par ma zad/ dngos su rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ gsar brje'i slob dpon h+pho la je mus ar le nyin gyis de snga skud med glog gi rlung 'phrin gong du spel bar ha cang mthong chen gnang / su'u len gyi brnyan 'phrin ni dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 18

30bar maso brtsams pa yin/ 1931lor 'gul med brnyan ris gtong mtho brtsams/ 1936lor mo si kho dang le nyin ki li so so nas brnyan 'phrin lte gnas btsugs pa dang / 1939lo nas bzung dus nges gtan ngang le tshan gtong mgo brtsams/ dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 60bar su'u len gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin de las rtsal mthon po'i 'phel rgyas dus rim la bslebs/ 1962lor 'khor skar gyi brnyan 'phrin gtong mgo brtsams/1967lor dngos su tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin gtong mgo brtsams/'jar pan gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin/ 'jar pan gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don la rang gi khyad chos ldan/ 'jar pan gyis 1925lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 22nyin skud med glog sga rlung 'phrin tshod lta legs 'grub byung ste rlung 'phrin las don gsar gtod byas/ de'i rjes tung cin dang ta pan/ min ku'u wu'u so so nas rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs par ma zad/ lo der snga bzhug tu rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ 1926lor rlung 'phrin las khungs de gsum po mnyam du bsres nas 'jar pan rlung 'phrin mthun tshogs btsugs te/ 'jar pan gyi spyi pa'i rlung 'phrin sde khag gcig pu ste 'jar pan rlung 'phrin mthun tshogs btsugs/ da lta'i bar 'jar pan gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don ni 'jar pan rlung 'phrin mthun tshogs dang dmangs khrod rlung 'phrin gyi ma lag chen po gnyis mnyam du gnas pa'i sgrig srol zhig tu chags 'dug dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 70bar tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin khyab gdal byas pa dang lo rabs 80bar brnyan 'phrin thad gtong 'khor skar bar snang du btang bar legs 'grub byung bas/ 'jar pan ni 'dzam gling steng nyin mtshan med par chu tshod 24ring la 'khor skar gyis 19

brnyan 'phrin le tshan thad gtong byed pa'i rgyal khab dang por gyur/gnyis/ krung go'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim mdor bsdus/krung rgo ni 'dzam gling steng skud med glog gi 'phrin skyel bkol ba cung snga ba'i rgyal khab gras kyi gcig yin/ 'brel yod lo rgyus dpyad gzhi ltar na/1905lo'i ston dus skabs de'i pe dbyang blon chen yon hri kha'e yis then cin nas skud med glog gso sbyong 'dzin grwa bsgrubs nas skud med glog 'phrin mi sna gso sbyong byas pa dang / dus mtshungs su skud med glog 'phrin gtong len 'phrul chas nyos te/ so sor pe dbyang mtsho dmag gi mtsho gru'i steng bsgrigs pas/ rang rgyal gyis skud med glog 'phrin bkol mgo brtsams pa mtshon/ ma 'gyangs par dmag bkol sgrig chas 'di dag tshong don bya 'gul khrod du khyab gdal btang / yin na'ang skud med glog gi rlung 'phrin ni dus rabs 20ba'i dus mgo'i pe dbyang srid gzhung skabs su da gzod rim bzhin bkol spyod byed mgo brtsams/ dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 20bar krung go'i hrang ha'e nas phyi rgyal pas bsgrubs pa'i rlung 'phrin las khungs skor zhig byung /krung go'i rgyal nang gi ches snga ba'i rlung 'phrin las khungs ni ming la o si pang zer ba'i a me ri kha'i mi zhig gis 1922lo'i zla 12par hrang ha'e nas bsgrubs pa de red/ phyi lo'i zla 1pa'i tshes 23nyin gyi dgong mo'i chu tshod 8kyi steng rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ nyin der chu tshod 1dang skar ma 5yi rol mo btang ba dang/ a me ri kha dang yo rob gling sogs kyi rgyal spyi'i gsar 20

'gyur dang / krung go'i sa cha so so'i sa gnas gsar 'gyur brgyud gtong byas/sgra godangs mi legs pa dang sdud len byed tshul mi bzang bas/ zla gsum gyi rjes su rgyang bsgrags byed mtshams bzhag 1923lor a me ri kha'i tshong las gnyer ba'i kha'e h+phu dngul khang gis hrang ha'e nas rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs nas gtso bo rol dbyangs brgyud gtong byas/ des kyang lo phyed tsam gyi ring la rgyun 'khyongs byas/ 1924lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 15nyin a me ri kha'i tshong ba kha'e lo kung zi dang hrin po zhes pa'i tshags par khang zhig gis mnyam 'brel gyis kha'e lo rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs nas rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ rlung 'phrin las khungs 'di ni skabs der phyi rgyal pa'i tshong bas hrang ha'e nas bsgrubs pa'i rlung 'phrin las khungs khrod gzhi khyon ches che ba dang dus yun ches ring ba/ shugs rkyen ches zab pa zhig yin la/ lo lnga yas mas la rgyang bsgrags byas/ 1924lo'i zla 12par rgyal gces rig gnas mkhas pa grags can ye kung khro yis skabs de'i pe dbyang gnas skabs srid gzhung gi 'grim 'grul spyi gnyer gyi 'gan 'khur dus/ kha'e lo rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis btang ba'i rol dbyangs thos rjes/ blo rgya bskyed de sngon chad pe cin dang then cin gnyis kyi kha par cu'u nas bsgrigs pa'i skud med kha par 'phrul chas bcos bsgyur legs sgrig byas nas gsar 'gyur sogs rgyang bsgrags byas/1926lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 1nyin krung go pas rang nyid kyi gzhung phyogs kyis bsgrubs pa'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang po ste/ har pin skud med rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags las khungs btsugs/ nyin rer chu tshod 2ring la rgyang bsgrags byas/ nang don gtso bo dngul khang dang 'bru tshong 21

sogs kyi gnas tshul dang gsar 'gyur/ rol dbyangs sogs yin/1927lo'i zla 3tshes 18nyin rang rgyal gyi sger gnyer tshong las rlung 'phrin las khungs dang po ste/ hrang ha'e zhin zhin kung zi kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams nas/ nyin rer chu tshod 6ring la rgyang bsgrags byas/ 1941lo'i zla 11par me skyon thengs shig gi khrod brlags/ 1927lo'i zla 5ba nas 9ba'i bar zhin zhin kung zi kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rgyang bsgrags byas nas cang ma 'bor bar/ then cin dang pe cin sogs sa cha'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyang snga gzhug tu btsugs/ 'grim 'grul pu'u yi then cin skud med glog 'phrin cu'u yis bsgrubs pa'i then cin skud med rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags las khungs kyis zla 5bar rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams pa dang / pe cin glog 'phrin cu'u yis btsugs pa'i pe cin skud med rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags las khungs kyis zla 9bar rgyang bsgrags byas/ dus de nas bzung rlung 'phrin las don myur du 'phel rgyas byung /1928lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 1nyin go min tang gis bsgrubs pa'i krung dbyang kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dngos su btsugs shing / ming cha tshang la krung go go min tang krung dbyang lag bstar u yon lhan khang gi skud med kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zer/ nang don la rgyal nang gi gsar 'gyur/rgyal spyi'i gsar 'gyur/ dmag don gsar 'gyur/ ming grags mi sna'i gtam bshad/ srid jus skor gyi snyan zhu/ bka' rgya dang bka' khyab/ rol dbyangs sogs yod/ 1932lo'i zla 11par go min tang krung dbyang rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi glog rlabs je cher btang nas e sha ya'i ches che ba'i kun khyab rlung 22

'phrin las khungs su gyur/ rgyang bsgrags khyab khongs kyang je cher gyur nas rgyal yongs dang 'dzam gling bi sa khul mi nyung bar khyab/ 1936lo'i zla 1par sleb skabs go min tang gis bsgrubs pa'i spyi gnyer kun khyab rlung 'phrin khungs 76la bslebs/ dus mtshungs su sger gnyer kun khyab rlung 'phrin 'bor chen byung / skabs de'i rlung 'phrin las khungs mang shas kyis tshong las la zhabs phyi bsgrub pa dang / 'jar 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs su/dar rgyas 'byung bzhin pa'i rlung 'phrin las don so so la gnod skyon tshabs chen thebs nas/ go min tang krung dbyang rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis 1937lo'i zla 11pa'i tshes 23nyin gyi zhogs par rgyang bsgrags byed mtshams bzhag pa dang / phyi lo'i zla 3pa 'i tshes 10nyin da gzod khrong chin nas slar yang rgyang bsgrags byed maso brtsams/ 1939lo'i zla 3par go min tang srid gzhung gis 'jar 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs su btsugs pa'i rgyal spyi'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs la don snying shin tu che ste/ des dbyin ji'i skad dang u ri si'i skad/ h+pha ran si'i skad/ 'jar pa na gyi skad/ ho lan gyi skad/ tha'e go'i skad/ 'bar ma'i skad/ ma le zhi ya'i skad/ se phan gyi skad/'dzam gling skad sogs skad rigs mang pos nyin rer chu tshod 12ring rgyang bsgrags byas nas/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi h+pha shi sir ngo rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs mna' mthun sgrig par skul 'ded dang 'jar man dang dbyi tha li/'jar pan bcas h+pha shi si pham par rgyag par skul slong byed pa dang / 'dzam cigling gi zhi bder brtson len byed par dbe mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed/1946lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 5nyin go min tang krung dbyang kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs phyir nan cin la spos/23

gsum/ mi dmangs rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rim/1940lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 30nyin krung go gung khran tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i mi dmangs rlung 'phrin las don de yan an nas btsugs/ de nas bzung / mi dmangs rlung 'phrin las don gyis mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug gi dus skabs dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bar brgal dang 'tshol zhib dus skabs/ rig gnas gsar brje'i dus skabs/ spyi tshogs ring lugs bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed dus skabs brgyud de rim bzhin dar rgyas gong 'phel byung / 1940lo'i dpyid kur tang krung dbyang gis kro'u yin la'e gtso yin pa'i rlung 'phrin u yon lhan khang btsugs/ krung dbyang dmag u'i cu'u gsum pas 'brel yod sde khag nas mi 30lhag 'then te yan lag ru khas dgu ba btsugs nas rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi bzo skrun dang 'phrul chas sgrig pa'i 'gan khur/ lo de'i zla 12par mi dmangs rlung 'phrin las khungs dang po ste/yan an zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs nas rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ 'di ni rang rgyal gyi mi dmangs rlung 'phrin las don gyi mgo tshugs sa yin la/ krung go gung khran tang gi gsar 'gyur las don dus rim gsar ba zhig tu bslebs pa'i mtshon rtags kyang red/ de ni skabs der zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi grub cha zhig yin pas/ ming la'ang zhin hwa rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes zer la/ gsar 'gyur ma yig zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi rtsom sgrig tshan khag nas 'don sprod byed pa dang / nyin re'i snga dro dang 24

phyi dror thengs gnyis re dang thengs rer chu tshod gcig yas mas la rgyang bsgrags byas/ nang don gtso bo ni krung gung krung dbyang gi yig cha dang / zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi ched rtsom/ bcings 'grol dmag gza' 'khor dus deb kyi ched rtsom gal chen/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi gsar 'gyur sogs yin la/de min da dung 'jar 'gog yar thon glu dbyangs sogs rig rtsal le tshan yang yod/ tang krung dbyang gis rlung 'phrin dril bsgrags la ha cang gcigs chen byas/ 1941lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 25nyin krung gung krung dbyang dril bsgrags pu'u yis rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags skor gyi mdzub ston zhes pa'i nang rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags ni 'jar 'gog gnas gzhi sa khul so sos mig sngar phyi ru dril bsgrags byed pa'i ches stobs dang ldan pa'i mtshon cha red ces nan gyis bstan/ yan an zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis 1940lo'i lo mjug nas bzung rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams shing / glog shugs kyis mi 'dang ba'i rkyen gyis sgrig chas la rgyun du chag skyon byung ste rtag par rgyang bsgrags byed par bar chad 'byung gi yod/ 1943lo'i dpyid dus glog chas la chag skyon byung bas rgyang bsgrags byed mtshams bzhag1945lo'i zla 9ba'i tshes 5nyin nas slar yang rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsarmes/ bcings 'grol dmag 'khrug skabs su yan an zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyang dmag 'khrug gi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas snga phyir thengs gsum la spo bsdur byas/ thengs dang po ni 1947lo'i zla 3tshes 14nyin yan an rlung 'phrin las khungs gsang stabs kyis wa yo pu la bsnur nas rgyang bsgrags byas/ zla 3pa'i tshes 21nyin yan an zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi ming yang hra'an pa'e zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 25

'phrin las khungs zhes par bsgyur/ thengs gnyis par ri bo tha'e hang gi bcings 'grol sa khul gyis tang krung dbyang gi mdzub ston ltar kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs gsar ba zhig btsugs nas/ 1947lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 1nyin nas bzung dngos su pho'an pa'e rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi tshab byas/lo de'i zla 9ba'i tshes 11nyin dbyin ji'i skad kyi gsar 'gyur le tshan bsgrubs/ thengs gsum pa ni 1948lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 23nyin ri bo tha'e hang nas ho pe zhing chen gyi phan hran rdzong zhi pe pho sde ba'i nye 'dabs su spar nas rgyang bsgrags byas/ 1949lo'i zla 3pa'i tshes 25nyin pe phin la spos shing / ming yang pe yin zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes par bsgyur te/ krung dbyang rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi ngo bo ldan pa'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs su gyur/ lo de'i zla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin krung gung krung dbyang gis brda sbyor btang nas yar sngon zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang la gtogs pa'i rlung 'phrin khang de krung dbyang rlung 'phrin las don do dam khru'u la rgya bskyed de rgyal yongs kyi rgyang bsgrags las don la do dam dang 'go khrid bya rgyu thag bcad/1949lo'i zla 10bar krung dbyang rgyang bsgrags las don do dam khru'u de yang krung dbyang rgyang bsgrags las don do dam cu'u la rgya bskyed de/ sger tshugs kyi dril bsgrags sde khag cig tu gyur/ 1949lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 5nyin/ pe phin zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang po la dngos su krung dbyang mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes btags pa dang / rlung 'phrin las khungs gnyis pa'i ming bsgyur nas pe cin mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes btags/ 'jar 'gog dmag 'khrug la rgyal kha thob rjes/ bcings 'grol sa 26

khul gzhan du'ang snga phyir kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs/ rlung 'phrin las khungs 'di dag gis rang rang gis bsgrubs pa'i le tshan las gzhan/ da dung yan an kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs dang / hra'an pa'e zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs/ pe phin kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs bcas kyi le tshan brgyud gtong byed kyin yod/ 1949lo'izla 6pa'i tshes 5nyin krung gung krung dbyang gis brda sbyor btang nas/ krung dbyang rgyang bsgrags las don do dam khru'u 'dzugs rgyu dang de thad kur krung dbyang dril bsgrags pu'u la gtogs shing / rgyal yongs kyi rgyang bsgrags las don la gcig gyur gyis 'go khrid byed par ma zad/ thad kur pe yin zhin hwa kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs la 'go khrid bya rgyu thag bcad/ 1949lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 1nyin spung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes shing / des krung go mi dmangs kyi rlung 'phrin las don dus rabs gsar ba zhig tu bslebs pa mtshon/1949lo nas 1956lo ni krung go gung khran tang gis rgyal yongs mi dmangs skul slong dang rtsa 'dzugs byas nas rgyal dmangs dpal 'byor slar gso dang tang gi bar brgal dus skabs kyi spyi'i lam phyogs lag bstar byas te/gsar du btsugs pa'i mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab de dmangs gtso ring lugs gsar ba'i rgyal khab nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab tu bsgyur ba'i rlabs che ba'i lo rgyus dus skabs yin la/ krung go gung khran tang dang krung go mi dmangs srid gzhung gis krung go rnying ba'i kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs sgyur bkod byas nas/ rgyal yongs kyi khyab khongs nas krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i mi dmangs rlung 'phrin las don gong du spel bar rmang gzhi 27

'ding ba'i lo rgyus dus skabs kyang red/ bar brgal dus skabs 'di'i skabs su/ mi dmangs rlung 'phrin las don la 'phel rgyas cung chen po byung /1952lo'i zla 10ba'i bar rgyal yongs su mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs 71yod/ 1952lo'i rjes su rgyal yongs su zhing sde'i skud yod rgyang sgrog dra rgya 'dzugs mgo brtsams pa dang / 1954lo'i lo mjug tu rgyal yongs su bsdoms pas rdzong rgyang bsgrags sa tshigs 547yod la/ grong khyer dang grong rdal 'bring chung gi rgyang bsgrags sa tshigs705la bslebs te/ krung go'i rgyang bsgrags lo rgyus steng krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i rlung 'phrin las don 'dzugs skrun byed par mgo 'dzugs sa legs po bskrun/ 1956lo'i rjes su rang rgyal gyi rgyang bsgrags le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa sogs phyogs gang thad nas ches cher phun sum tshogs par gyur/ 1956lo'i dpyid kur krung go'i tshon med brnyan 'phrin rgyang bsgrags sgrig chas cha tshang dang po bzos nas legs 'grub byung / 1958lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 1nyin/ krung go'i brnyan 'phrin khang dang po ste/ pe cin brnyan 'phrin khang gis tshod lta'i ngang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gtong mgo brtsams shing / lo de'i zla 9ba'i tshes 2nyin nas bzung dngos su brnyan 'phrin gtong mgo brtsams/ pe cin brnyan 'phrin khang gi rjes su zhing chen dang grong khyer mang pos kyang snga gzhug tu brnyan 'phrin khang mang po btsugs/ 1959lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ dus de nas bzung rang rgyal gyi zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs/ thad gtogs grong khyer tshang mar kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs yod par gyur/rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su g.yon lhung bsam pa'i rlabs rgyun 28

gyi bar chad 'og rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rgyas la gnod skyon tshabs chen bzos/ rig gnas gsar brje mgo brtsams rjes rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod/ chab srid kyi nang don myur du je mang du song ba dang shes bya rang bzhin gyi nang don ldan pa'i le tshan ches cher je nyung du btang / 1973lo'izla 5tshes 1nyin phyis su krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang la bsgyur pa'i pe cin brnyan 'phrin khang gis rgyal sa'i lta mkhan rnams la tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin tshod lta byas te gtong mgo brtsams pa dang / de nas ma 'gyangs par hrang ha'e dang then cin brnyan 'phrin khang dang / khrin tu'u brnyan 'phrin khang sogs kyis kyang snga gzhug tu tshon ldan brnyan 'phrin bsgrubs/dus rabs 20ba'i lo rabs 80ba'i rjes su rgyal yongs su brnyan 'phrin tshon ldan can du bsgyur mgo brtsams/1983lo'i rjes su rang rgyal gyis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'bad brtson dmigs 'ben yang dag pa gtan khel byas nge/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas/ rgyal spyi'i go gnas sogs dang mthun pa'i deng rabs can gyi dril bsgrags dra rgya btsugs nas/rim bzhin rang rgyal gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don de gzhi khyon dang lag rtsal chu tshad tshang ma'i thad 'dzam gling gi sngon thon gras su bslebs/lo ngo 50lhag ring gi 'dzugs skrun brgyud pa dang khyad par du bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas pa'i tshun gyi 'phel rgyas brgyud nas rang rgyal du lag rtsal dang rim pa ches mang la/ 'dzam gling du khyab rgya ches che ba'i deng rabs can gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi dra rgya cha tshang ba zhig chags te/ dus rabs gsar ba'i nang rang rgyal gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyis sngar las 29

tshug par dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras blangs dang len mus su mchis/bzhi/ bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don 'phel tshul mdor bsdus/dus kyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas sngon byon rgan rabs pa mang pos gzhan gyis rtogs dka' ba'i dka' spyad kyi 'tshol zhib dang lhod med kyi brtson pa yang yang brgyud nas/ bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin de yang med pa nas yod pa dang chung ba nas che bar rim gyis gong du 'phel/ de yang rig gnas bya dngos gsar ba zhig yin pa'i cha nas mi rabs mang pos mi rigs kyi brtse sems slad med nyag cig la brten nas rang gi mi tshe hril po'i sems shugs dang rngul khrag ma lus pa phangs pa med par bya gzhag de'i thad la gtor bas/ bod skad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don yang yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel te da lta rang re'i bod mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba hril bor yongs su thim pa dang mi re re'i sems khong tu zhugs 'dugarlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ni phyi'i rnam pa dang tshan rtsal gyi grub cha dang lag thabs sogs kyi thad nas 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs so so gcig 'dra yin yang / mtshon bya dang mtshon byed sogs kyi nang don thad nas rgyal khab dang mi rigs so so'i rang rang gi rig gnas kyi grub cha'i cha shas su gyur pa nang bzhin/ bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin yang mi rigs rang gi rig gnas kyi chu klung chen mo las mched cing phyir mi rigs rang gi rig gnas kyi sa gshin la thim pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/ bod skad 30

rlung 'phrin btsugs nas lo ngo lnga bcu lhag 'das pa dang bod skad brnyan 'phrin btsugs nas kyang lo ngo nyi shu lhag 'gor/ dus rabs phyed ka lhag gi ring la/ mi rabs du mas dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas nas deng skabs bod khul gyi sa cha so sor zhing chen rim pa dang khul rim pa'i bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang mang po yod par ma zad/ zhing chen dang ljongs rim pa dang / khul rim pa la la'i bod skad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan da dung 'khor skar 'phrin lam las brgyud gtong byed bzhin yod/ krung dbyang mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi bod skad rlung 'phrin ni krung dbyang mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis bsgrubs pa'i grangs nyung mi rigs skad rigs kyi rgyang bsgrags ches thog ma yin pa dang / mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin dang bod ljongs bod skad rlung 'phrin/ si khron bod skad rlung 'phrin/ kun lho bod skad rlung 'phrin bcas ni bod khul du btsugs pa snga zhing gzhi khyon che ba dang khyab rgya'ang che ba'i rlung 'phrin las khungs red/1950lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 22nyin krung dbyang mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs skad rigs kyi rlung 'phrin ches thog ma ste/ bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis dngos su rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ 1950lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs 'dzugs dus/ mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa rje shes rab rgya mtsho lags kyis bod rigs mi dmangs la bod skad kyis rlung 'phrin gtam bshad spel/ de ni rlung 'phrin las bsgrags pa'i bod skad kyi rgyang bsgrags ches thog ma red/ 1952lo'i zla 7tshes22nyin 31

mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis bod skad rlung 'phrin sde khag gsar du btsugs te/ dngos su bod skad kyi rgyang bsgrags le tshan sgrub margo brtsams/ skabs der ming la bod skad le tshan zhes 'bod pa dang gza' 'khor rer thengs re dang thengs rer chu tshod skar ma nyi shu re yin la/ rgya skad kyi le tshan gyi bar du bsabs nas gtong ba yin zhing / le tshan gyi nang don gtso bo gsar 'gyur dang bod rigs kyi glu sogs yin/ 1954lo'i zla 3tshes 1nyin bod skad le tshan de gza' 'khor rer thengs gcig nas thengs drug la je mang du btang ba dang lo de'i zla 9bar gza' 'khor rer thengs drug nas thengs bcu gnyis la je mang du btang / 1958lo'izla 1tshes 1nyin mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin de yang sger tshugs kyi le tshan cha tshang zhig tu grub/ 2004lo'i rjes su nyin rer rgyang bsgrags byed yun chu tshod 17lhag la 'phar/ lo ngo lnga bcu lhag gi bzhud lam ring mo brgyud nas/da lta mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi bya ba sna tshogs dbyar mtsho rgyas pa bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel te/ le tshan gyi spus tshad dang las byed mi sna'i dpung sde'i chu tshad sogs phyogs gang ci thad nas mthor 'degs chen po byung ste/ deng gi dus 'dir mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin la rang gi sger tshugs kyi 'phrin lam yod pa dang / gsar 'gyur dang spyi tshogs slob gso/ ched sgrig le tshan/ rig rtsal/ zhabs phyi bcas phung po gcig tu gril zhing mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang sa gnas kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i cha tshang ba'i sgrig gzhi zhig tu grub nas deng rabs rlung 'phrin gyi gong 'phel dmigs 'ben phyogs su gom 'gros brtan pos mdun du bskyod mus su mchis/ de yang sgor tshugs kyi 'phrin lam dang le tshan cha tshang yod pa'i bod khul gyi zhing chen rim pa'i sa gnas rlung 32

'phrin zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi gong 'phel brgyud rim gyis bod skad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin hril bo'i brgyud rim mtshon thub ces bshad kyang chogamatsho sngon ni mi rigs mang po 'dus sdod kyi sa khul zhig yin/ bod rigs kyis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi spyi'i mi grangs kyi brgya cha'i 48lhag zin/der brten mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad rigs dang sgos su bod skad kyis rgyang bsgrags bya rgyur ha cang mthong chen byas te/ mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs thog mar btsugs pa nas bzung hur thag sgos byed thabs sna tshogs spyad de rgya che'i grangs nyung mi rigs la bod skad kyis rgyang bsgrags byas/ mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin dang yang na bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi 'phel rgyas gleng na/ de la rmang 'ding mkhan sngon byon rgan rabs pa rnam gnyis kyi mdzad rjes dang sku drin nam yang mi brjed gzungs su 'god dgos/ de snga dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs lnga bcu ba'i dus mgor bod kyi mkhas pa chen mo rje shes rab rgya mtsho lags kyis mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes skabs hur thag sgos mtsho sngon mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs la bod skad rlung 'phrin 'dzugs rgyu'i gros gzhi bton zhing rgyab skyor shugs chen gnang bar ma zad/ 1950lo'i lugs gsar gyi zla 1tshes 1nyin/ sku dngos kyis bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi gtam bshad spel ba dang rjes su da dung thengs mang la kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs su phebs nas bod skad kyis dril bsgrags spel te bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi bya gzhag thog ma'i dbu btsugs/ 1951lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes13nyin mtsho sngon zhing chen tang u dang 33

zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gis thugs khur dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo rje shes rab rgya mtsho lags kyis gos gzhi bton pa dang rgyab skyor gnang 'og zhing chen kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis bod skad rlung 'phrin u yon lhan khang btsugs nas bod skad rlung 'phrin gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i gra sgrig bya ba sna tshogs byed mgo brtsams shing / skabs der mtsho sngon zhing chen rig gnas slob gso thin gyi thin krang gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa gsung rab rgya mtsho lags kyis kru'u rin u yon gyi 'gan bzhes/'di'i sngon la khong gis lo gcig lhag ring la sku tshegs gang mang brgyud nas mtsho sngon bod yig tshags par gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang/ de mur yang bod skad rlung 'phrin gsar 'dzugs byed pa'i las 'gan dang du blangs/ khong gis yig sgyur dang zhu dag sogs kyi bya ba sgrub pa'i zhor du da dung dngos su bshad mkhan gyi las 'gan yang bzhes nas mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi ches thog ma'i bshad mkhan du'ang gyur/ khong rnam pa gnyis nas 'di ltar sku dngos kyis bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi bya ba che chung tshang ma'i 'gan khur du bzhes nas bya gzhag gsar ba 'di skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs yong bar rmang gzhi legs po btang /si khron bod skad rlung 'phrin ni 1955lo'i zla 10bar btsugs nas rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams pa dang / bod khul du btsugs pa ches snga ba'i bod skad rlung 'phrin gras kyi gcig yin zhing lo ngo lnga bcu lhag gi 'phel rim brgyud nas da lta gsar 'gyur dang ched sgrig le tshan/ rig rtsal le tshan/zhabs phyi le tshan sogs gzhi gcig tu grub pa'i le tshan gyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang zhig chags te/ bod rigs mang tshogs kyi rig gnas tshan rig shes bya'i chu 34

tshad mthor 'degs dang mi rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor song du spel ba/ mi rigs mthun sgril sra brtan du gtong ba/ spyi tshogs kyi yar rgyas la skul 'ded byed pa bcas la byas rjes mi dman pa bzhas nas/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs khrod du shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa dang grags pa'i ba dan bod khul yongs su khyab 'dug mig sngar si khron bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 10lhag la 'phar/bod ljongs bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis 1959lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin nas dngos su rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams/ dang thog lha sa mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes 'bod la/ lo de'i zla 3par bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs zhes par bsgyur/ thog ma'i dus su rgya skad dang bod skad kyi le tshan gnyis 'phrin lam gcig nas res mos ngang brgyud gtong byed ki yod/ nyin rer rgya bod gnyis ku'i le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 8yin/ 1961lo'i zla 6par bod ljongs mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs kyis rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang btsugs nas thengs dang por bod skad gtsos bod rgya skad rigs gnyis kyis sgrub cing / so sor gnad che sa yod pa bya dgos pa'i le tshan gyi dril bsgrags byed phyogs bton/1989lor bod ljongs bod skad rlung 'phrin 'khor skar las gtong mgo brtsams/ da lta bod ljongs bod skad rlung 'phrin de bod khul yongs su khyab nas bod skad rlung 'phrin khrod nus pa gal chen thon bzhin yod par ma zad/da dung a me ri kha dang 'jar man/ kha na ta/ 'jar pan/ rgya gar sogs rgyal khab mang po nas sdud len byed thub/ lo ngo bzhi bcu lhag gi bshul lam ring mo brgyud nas da lta bod ljongs bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis rang gi cha tshang zhing 35

spus legs pa'i le tshan la brten nas tang gi lam phyogs dang byed phyogs/srid jus bcas dril bsgrags byed pa dang bod ljongs kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 'dzugs skrun sogs la skul 'ded dang / tang dang bod ljongs mi dmangs bar gyi 'brel ba je dam du gtong ba/ mi rigs rang gi rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel du gtong ba/ bod ljongs mi dmangs la tshan rig rig gnas shes bya brgyud bsgrags byed pa dang rig gnas 'tsho ba phun tshogs su gtong ba bcas kyi thad la nus pa gal chen 'don bzhin yod/gan lho bod skad rlung 'phrin ni 1960lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin btsugs nas dngos su rgyang bsgrags byed mgo brtsams shing / kun su'u zhing chen du btsugs pa ches snga ba'i mi rigs rlung 'phrin las khungs red/ kun lho mi dmangs kun khyab rlung 'phrin las khungs btsugs pa nas bzung / mi rigs skad rigs kyi rlung 'phrin legs par bsgrubs nas bod rigs mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu dmigs yul du bcangs te/ kun lho'i gnas tshul dngos dang dam por sbrel nas rlung 'phrin dril bsgrags spel/ le tshan gyi sgrig bkod thad sa gnas kyi khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa bya rgyur gcigs mthong byas shing / le tshan gyi nang don gtso bo ni rgyal yongs dang rgyal spyi'i gsar 'gyur dang kun lho gsar 'gyur sogs gtso byas pa'i gsar 'gyur le tshan dang slob gso rang bzhin dang shes bya'i rang bzhin gyi nang don ldan pa'i zhing sde dang rong 'brog ched sgrig le tshan/tshan rig rgyun shes sogs khyab spel byed pa'i zhabs phyi le tshan/ de min bod kyi rol dbyangs dang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ bod kyi dmangs khrod rig rtsal/ bod kyi zlos gar dang rdung len sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i rig rtsal le tshan sogs yod/36

1973lor bod skad kyi le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 6lhag la 'phar/2008lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin/ kun lho bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa'i thad nas legs sgrig dang kha snon gsar ba byas nas nyin rer bod skad kho nas rgyang bsgrags byed yun chu tshod 7dang skar ma 30lhag la 'phar ba dang / de'i nang krung dbyang bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi le tshan chu tshod 1brgyud gtong byed pa dang / kun lho bod skad rlung 'phrin rang gis bsgrubs pa'i le tshan chu tshod 6dang skar ma30yin/ kun lho bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis lo mang ring la kun lho sa cha'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar zhabs phyi bsgrubs pa dang kun lho'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas 'dzugs skrun la skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon par ma zad/ da dung rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sa gnas kyi khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos la brten nas/ mtsho sngon sogs bod khul yongs su shugs rkyen zab mo thebs nas rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog bar med du 'thor/gong du bgrangs pa de dag ni bod khul du btsugs pa cung snga ba'i bod skad rlung 'phrin red/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i rjes su bod khul gyi sa cha so so nas bod skad rlung 'phrin las khungs dang yang na bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin sa tshigs gang mang btsugs yod/ de dag gis bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi gong 'phel la bsub tu med pa'i byas rjes bskrun/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i lo mgo nas bzung mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin khang dang bod ljongs brnyan 'phrin khang nas snga gzhug tu bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgrub mgo brtsams/37

mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin khang gis 1984lo'i lo stod la bod skad brnyan 'phrin gsar 'dzugs byas nas 1984lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 1nyin gyi chu tshod 22dang skar ma 30steng thog dang por bod skad kyi gsar 'gyur le tshan btang / skabs der ming la bod skad rtsom sgyur khang zer la/ mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin las khungs nas mi gsum skong 'then byas shing de'i steng du mtsho lho mi rigs dge thon slob grwa nas mthar phyin slob ma lnga sdud len byas te bsdoms pas las byed mi sna brgyad yod/ le tshan gtso bo krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang gi gsar 'gyur mnyam bsgrags dang mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin khang gi rgya skad kyi gsar 'gyur las bdams sgyur byas nas bsgrigs pa yin/ gza' 'khor rer le tshan thengs gsum rer gtong ba dang thengs rer skar ma 15re yin/ rjes su rim bzhin gsar 'gyur gyi 'phror bod kyi glu dang glu dbyangs/yang na zhabs bro re gnyis tsam btang / 1986lor gza' 'khor rer sngar bzhin gtong thengs gsum re yin mod/ gtong yun je ring du btang nas krung dbyang dang mtsho sngon gyi rgya skad kyi gsar 'gyur bsgyur pa las gzhan/ da dung rgya skad kyi rig rtsal sde khag dang de cho'i sgrig chas zhus nas bod kyi rig rtsal nyung shas dang krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang gis btang ba'i bod kyi rig rtsal le tshan kha shas brnyan gzugs su phab pa las sgrig sbyor byas pa'i rig rtsal thung ngu re'ang yod/ cang ma 'gor bar le tshan gtong yun gza' 'khor rer thengs drug re dang thengs rer skar ma 15re yin/1989 lor mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la sgor tshugs kyi sa ngos 'phrin lam yod par gyur pa dang / le tshan yang gsar 'gyur las gzhan da dung ched sgrig le tshan dang rig rtsal le tshan/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar sogs 38

yod/ 1991lor bod skad le tshan nyin re rer gtong mgo brtsams/1997lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin khang gi le tshan 'khor skur las gtong mgo brtsams pa dang de'i nang du bod skad le tshan chu tshod skar ma 85ring yod/ 2005lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 28nyin mtsho sngon sna 'dzoms 'khor skar 'phrin lam ste/ bod skad 'khor skar 'phrin lam gyis tshod lta'i le tshan gtong mgo brtsams pa dang / 2006lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 28nyin mtsho sngon bod skad 'phrin lam nas dngos su gtong mgo brtsams shing nyin rer le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 7 la slebs/ 2008lo'i zla 4ba'i tshes 25nyin nas bzung nyin rer le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 1je ring du btang nas nyin hril bo'i le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 8la bslebs/lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyis lo rgyus kyi khur po phrag tu blangs te dka' sdug gi 'tshol zhib dang 'bad 'bungs lhod med byas pa brgyud/ da lta rim gyis 'phel rgyas byung ste/ rgya che ba'i bod rigs sa khul gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas sogs spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so so'i gong 'phel khrod dang / rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i khrod du gal 'gangs shin tu che zhing gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i nus pa gal chen thon gyin yod/bod ljongs brnyan 'phrin khang gi bod skad brnyan 'phrin ni 1985lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 20nyin nas dngos su gtong mgo brtsams pa dang dang thog rgya skad dang 'phrin lam gcig nas le tshan gtong gin yod pa dang /1999lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 1nyin bod ljongs brnyan 'phrin khang gi bod skad le tshan dngos su 'khor skar 'phrin lam nas gtong mgo rbertsams te/ bod 39

skad dang rgya skad kyi le tshan gnyis ka 'phrin lam gcig nas gtong ba'i lo rgyus mjug rdzogs shing / nyin rer le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 11la bslebs/2002lo'i zla 9bar ne pa la'i bar snang dus rabs dra rgya kung zi brgyud nas ne pa la nas sa ngos su sdud len byas te rgya gar dang ne pa la rgyal khab gnyis nas lta thub par gyur/ 2003lo'i zla 4bar le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 16la bslebs/ lo de'i zla 10bar chu tshod 18la bslebs/ 2006lor le tshan gtong yun chu tshod 21la je ring du btang ba dang / 2007lo'i zla 10ba'i tshes 1nyin nas bzung chu tshod 24ring nyin mtshan bstud mur gtong mgo brtsams/ bod ljongs bod skad brnyan 'phrin ni mig sngar bod khul gyi bod skad brnyan 'phrin khrod rang gi sgor tshugs kyi 'khor skar 'phrin lam yod pa dang / phyogs so so'i cha rkyen cung 'dzoms la le tshan sgrub pa'i stobs shugs cung che bar ma zad/ gsar 'gyur dang spyi tshogs slob gso/ phyogs bsdus rig rtsal/ zhabs phyi/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar sogs le tshan gyi nang don cung cha tshang zhing le tshan gtong yun ches ring ba'i bod skad kyi stobs shugs che ba'i brnyan 'phrin khang zhig red/kun lho brnyan 'phrin khang ni 1992lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin btsugs pa dang / 2006lo'i bar du bod khul gyi brnyan 'phrin khang mang che shos dang 'dra bar bod skad dang rgya skad kyi le tshan gnyis res mos ngang 'phrin lam gcig nas gtong bzhin yod/ dang thog le tshan thad gsar 'gyur dang gnam gshis sngon brda/ brnyan 'phrin smos gar sogs las med cing / gza' 'khor rer thengs gcig re las med/ rjes su rim bzhin je mang du btang zhing /2004lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin nas bzung nyin rer thengs re gtong ba dang le 40

tshan yang brnyan 'phrin zlos gar dang ched sgrig le tshan/ rig rtsal le tshan sogs su je mang du btang / 2006lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 1nyin rgyal khab rlung 'phrin brnyan 'phrin spyi khyab cu'u yis mchog mchan bkod de/ dngos su bod skad 'phrin lam btsugs te rgya skad dang bod skad le tshan 'phrin lam gcig nas bsgrub pa'i lo rgyus mjug rdzogs par ma zad/ le tshan gyi sna kha je mang du btang ba dang le tshan gtong yun je ring du btang / da lta bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon/ si khron/ kun su'u/ yun nan bcas bod khul gyi khul rim pa sogs sa cha so so ru bod skad brnyan 'phrin las khungs chung 'bring shin tu mang la/ de tshos rang rang gi rnam pa dang khyad chos/ dka' spyad 'bad 'bungs bcas la brten nas bod skad brnyan 'phrin las don gyi gong 'phel la skul 'ded gtong ba dang / brnyan 'phrin gyi thabs lam la brten nas gangs can bod kyi rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel gtong ba/ bod rigs mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba phun tshogs su gtong ba bcas kyi phyogs su byas rjes bla na med pa bskrun dang skrun bzhin mchis/41

gsum pa/ gsar 'god pa/gsar 'god pa zhes pa ni gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan zhes pa'i ming bsdus pa yin la/ da lta tshags par dang brnyan 'phrin/ rlung 'phrin sogs gsar 'gyur las rigs su yongs khyab tu gsar 'god pa zhes 'bod kyin yod/ gsar 'god pa zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di'i nang don yang che phyogs dang chung phyogs gnyis nas go ba len dgos/ spyi yongs nas gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi las byed yongs la bstan pa ste/ tshags par dang gsar 'gyur khang /rlung 'phrin khang / brnyan 'phrin khang / gsar 'gyur dra tshigs sogs gsar 'gyur sde khag tu gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'bri/ rtsom sgrig sgrig sbyor sogs bya ba gnyer mkhan yod do cog la bstan pa dang / bye brag tu gsar 'gyur sde khag gi ched du gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri bya ba gnyer ba'i ched las mi snar bstan pa red/ de yang spyi yongs dang bye brag gang yin yang rung / gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi go don de gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri bsgrags spel dang 'brel ba dam po yod/ mi'i rigs shes rig spyi tshogs su zhugs pa nas bzung /cha 'phrin bsdu len dang las snon/ brgyud bsgrags sogs kyi bya 'gul rgyun chad ma myong / yin na'ang rig gzhung las rigs kyis bltas na gsar 'god pa de spyi tshogs kyi las rigs shig yin pa'i cha nas dus rabs 16par yo rob gling gi we nyis si nas mgo brtsams pa yin snyam/42

gcig gsar 'god pa'i 'byung khungs/rang rgyal gyi lo rgyus 'phel rgyas la bltas na/ dbyin kro'u dus skabs su kro'u gong mas lo rer dmangs khrod du dpon rigs mngags nas dmangs glu sogs 'tshol sdud phyogs bsgrigs dang / spyi tshogs dang dmangs khrod kyi cha 'phrin sna tshogs la rgyus lon byed pa'i srol yod/ dmangs glu dang snyan ngag sdud pa'i bya 'gul de rigs kyis dmangs srol la rtog dpyod kyi nus pa thon na yang / mthar gtugs na tshags par sogs la 'brel ba med pa dang dmangs glu sogs 'tshol sdud byed mkhan dpon rigs de yang gsar 'god pa dang gtan nas mi 'dra ste/ dpon rigs de dag gis 'tshol sdud byas pa tshang ma gsar 'gyur yin pa'i nges pa med la/ byed thabs de rigs kyang gsar 'gyur smyan byed dang 'brel ba med/ tshags par ni ches snga mor byung ba'i gsar 'gyur spyan byed red/ gsar 'god pa'i 'byung khungs gleng tshe/ tshags par gyi 'phel rim dang 'bral thabs med/ rang rgyal du ches snga ba'i tshags par ni gzhung phyogs kyi brda khyab tshags par yin la/ nang don gtso bo ni gong ma dang rgyal khab gzhung phyogs kyi bka' rgya srid don sogs dmangs khrod du bsgrags pa de red/ thang rgyal rabs rjes su sung dang yon/ min/ chin sogs rgyal rabs so sos dpon gzhung gi tshags par 'di rigs bsgrubs myong /dpon gzhung gi srid don tshags par 'di rigs la deng rabs tshags par gyi cha 'phrin bsgod bsgrags dang gsar 'gyur khyab bsgrags kyi nus pa yod na'ang / de la da dung gsar 'gyur tshags par gyi nus pa yongs rdzogs mi 'dzom par/ deng rabs spyi tshogs khrod srid gzhung gis khyab bsgrags byed pa'i 43

srid don spyi bsgrags dang mtshungs pa red/ der brten mi la las gsar 'god pa ni dpon phyogs tshogs par de rigs dang dus mnyam du byung ba zhig yin par 'dod mod/ 'on kyang 'dod tshul 'di rigs kyi khungs de 'dra mi btsan pa red/ rgyu mtshan ni dpon phyogs kyi srid don tshags par 'di rigs sgrub mkhan rgyal khab kyi dpon rigs yin pa dang de'i bya ba gtso bo ni rgyal khab dpon gzhung gi bka' rgya dang yig cha/ blon po sogs kyi srid don zhu 'bul sogs bshus nas sa cha so so'i 'brel yod dpon rigs la 'grem rgyu de yin/ kho tshos kyang da lta'i gsar 'god pa nang bzhin bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'bri bya ba kha shas bsgrubs kyang de ni kho tsho'i dpon rigs kyi 'gan 'khri'i bya ba sna tshogs gras su gtogs phyir/ bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'bri las rigs shig tu grub med/dus rabs 16pa'i dus dkyil la min rgyal rabs srid gzhung gis dmangs khrod du tshags par khang btsugs nas dpon gzhung gi srid don tshags par khag cig par skrun byas te 'tshong chog par byas/ de'i rkyen byas min chin rgyal rabs gnyis kyi ring la rgyun bskyangs pa'i tshags par gal chen gzhan zhig ste/ cin po zhes pa'i tshags par zhig byung / tshags par 'dis bcar 'dri'i rtsom yig 'ga' re'ang bkod mod/ yin yang tshags par khang gi las 'gan gtso bo ni sngar bzhin srid gzhung gis chog mchan bkod pa'i bka' rgya dang srid don bsgrags yig sogs yin/ tshags par sgrub mkhan gyi rang 'gul gyi bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'bri bya 'gul khrod/ deng rabs kyi gsar 'god pa'i grib gzugs re mthong thub kyang las rigs gsar 'god par brtsi mi 'os/gsar 'god pa de ched las can gyi spyi tshogs las rigs shig tu grub pa ni nye 44

rabs 'byor ldan gral rim gyi tshags par thog mar grub dus yin/ spyir btang du bltas na dbyi tha li'i we nye si ni nye rabs tshags par gyi 'byung yul yin pa dang las rigs gsar 'god pa'i 'khrungs yul yang yin par snyam/dus rabs dkyil ma'i tshun la ya ti lis ya mtsho 'gram gyi gru kha grong khyer gal chen yin pa'i we nye si ni dbus shar dang yo rob gling 'brel ba'i nyo tshong lte gnas red/dus rabs 16par we nye si ni yo rob gling gi dpal 'byor lte gnas su gyur rjes/ rgyal khab so so'i tshong ba dang 'grim 'grul ba mang po 'di ru 'dus/ dar che ba'i tshong las dang mtsho 'grul gyis rgyal khab so so'i tshong gnyer ba rnams la dus dang rnam pa kun tu sa cha so so'i tshong ra'i gnas tshul dang tshong gru bskyod dus dang sleb dus kyi gnas tshul sogs cha 'phrin sna tshogs shes pa'i dgos mkho byung / der brten deng rabs tshags par yang dgos mkho de dang bstun nas byung ba dang / dus mtshungs su ched du tshags par gnyer ba las rigs su byed pa'i mi'ang byung ba red/ de'i nang tshags par las rigs kyi mi sna gtso bo ste/ las rigs gsar 'god pa'ang ngang ngam shugs kyis byung ba smos ma dgos/ skabs de'i we nye si ru gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyis las rigs der brten nas 'tsho ba skyel ba dang mi grangs kyang shin tu mang / gsar 'god pa 'di rigs kyis 'brel yod kyi chab srid don rkyen dang dngos po'i rin gong / tshong gru phar bskyod tshur 'ong gi dus tho/ nyo tshong gnas tshul sogs cha 'phrin sna tshogs bcar 'dri byed par ma zad/ cha 'phrin 'di rigs rtsom sgrig dang brgyud bsgrags byas nas khe phan len pa yin/gsar 'god pa 'di rigs kyis gsar 'gyur gyi bcar 'dri dang rtsom sgrig 45

brgyud bsgrags sogs kho na gnyer ba yin stabs/ de nas bzung gsar 'god pa'ang spyi tshogs kyi las rigs shig tu grub pa red/gnyis/ gsar 'god pa'i rigs/thog ma'i dus su tshags par khang gi gzhi khyon da dung shin tu chung /tshags par khang mang che bar mi gcig gnyis las med la/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan dang rtsom sgrig pa zhes las bgos kyang byas med/ nye rabs tshags par gyi thog ma'i sgrub pa po mang che ba dpe cha 'tshong ba'i tshong ba dang par skrun tshong ba red/ tshags par sgrub pa po de dag rtag par gsar 'god pa yin la/ rtsom sgrig pa dang dpar mkhan yang yin/ tshags par las rigs gong 'phel byung ba dang bstun nas/ tshags par khang nang khul du bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'bri/ rtsom sgrig 'grem spel sogs las bgos byung bar ma zad/ bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'dri bya ba gnyer ba'i gsar 'god pa'i gras su'ang las bgos byung nas/ rigs mi 'dra ba'i gsar 'god pa byung ba red/ de yang rigs bgar stangs mi 'dra ba ltar gsar 'god pa'i rigs kyang mi 'dra ba byung ste/bya ba'i byed stangs ltar na gsar 'god pa'ang yig rigs gsar 'god pa dang / par brnyan gsar 'god pa/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa/ rlung 'phrin gsar 'god pa sogs su bgar dgos/ bgar stangs 'di rigs spyan byed rigs mi 'dra ba ste/ dper na/ tshags par dang dus deb/ brnyan 'phrin/rlung 'phrin sogs kyi khyad chos kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa red/nye ba'i lo la/ 'phrin skyel sgrig chas la legs bcos byung ba dang /'phrin skyel lag rtsal mgyogs myur ngang gong du 'phel ba dang bstun nas/46
