gsar 'god pa'i bya ba'i byed stangs la'ang 'gyur ldog ha cang chen po byung /dper na/ nga tshos rtag par tshags par steng gsar 'god pa gcig gis spel ba'i yig rigs gsar 'gyur dang yig rigs gsar 'gyur der ram 'degs byed pa'i 'dra par gnyis ka mthong thub pa dang / brnyan 'phrin nang brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pas brnyan phab 'phrul chas kyis yul dngos kyi gnas tshul brnyan phab byas nas gtong zhor du gsar 'god pa rang nyid kyis yul dngos nas skabs de'i gnas tshul la 'grel bshad byed pa dang dpyad gtam brjod kyin yod pa rtag tu mthong / bshad pa dang 'bri ba/ par len/ brnyan phab sogs gzhi rtsa'i thabs rtsal la byang chub pa dang de rnams phyogs bsdus ngang rang gi gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri khrod bkol ba de ni/ da lta'i gsar 'god par mtshon na dngos yod kyi blang bya zhig red/ phyogs 'di nas gsar 'god pa de yig rigs gsar 'god pa dang par brnyan gsar 'god pa/ brnyan phab gsar 'god pa zhes bgar na da lta'i gnas tshul dang de 'dra mi mthun/sgrub pa'i las 'gan dang mngags pa'i sa khul ltar bgar na gsar 'god pa de yang khyad mngags gsar 'god pa dang ched zhu gsar 'god pa/ sa gnas gsar 'god pa/ phyi sdod gsar 'god pa/ bab bstun gsar 'grod pa sogs su bgar chog mthar gtugs na ched mngags gsar 'god pa ni las 'gan khyad par can gyi don du rtsom sgrig khang gis ched du mngags pa'i bcar 'dri gsar 'god par zer/ ched mngags gsar 'god pa'i go gnas dang bcar 'dri las 'gan gyi dmigs bsal rang bzhin gyis gsar 'gyur sde khag gis kho tshos bcar 'dri byas pa'i gsar 'gyur spel skabs/ rgyun du ming gi sngon la ched mngags gsar 'god pa zhes sbyar nas de'i gal chen rang bzhin mtshon 47

par byas/ ched zhu gsar 'god pa ni gdan zhu ltar gsar 'gyur sde khag la gsar 'gyur mkho sprod byed mkhan la bstan pa red/spyir btang du/ dus ltar gsar 'gyur dang gsar 'gyur gyi khungs sne sna tshogs 'thob pa dang dus mtshungs su gsar 'bod pa'i mi grangs tshad dang mthun par tshod 'dzin byed ched gsar 'gyur sde khag mang che bas byed thabs sna tshogs la brten nas rang gi 'phrin skyel pa'i dpung sde skyed sring byed kyin yod/ ched zhu gsar 'god pa ni spyir btang gi 'phrin skyel pa dang mi 'dra bar kho tsho'i go gnas cung dmigs bsal yin pa dang / bcar 'dri las 'gan yang 'phrin skyel pa las lhag par gal che ba dang lhag par khyad chos ldan pa red/ sa gnas gsar 'god pa ni gsar 'gyur sde khag gi rtsom sgrig khang gis sa cha ga ge mor mngags nas rgyun 'dug byed pa'i gsar 'god par zer/de'i nus pa ni gsar 'god pa mngags pa'i sa cha'i bar gyi 'brel gtugs la shugs snon byas nas sa de'i gnas tshul dus ltar 'god pa de red/ bab bstun gsar 'god pa ni sa gnas gsar 'god pa dang mi mtshungs/ kho tsho gnas gcig tu rgyun 'dug byed pa min la bcar 'dri rtsom 'bri'i las 'gan yang gtan 'jags min par spyir btang du gang la mkho na der 'gro ba ste/ched mngags gsar 'god pa dang cung 'dra bar rtag par bcar 'dri las 'gan zhig yongs 'grub byed pa dang yang na glo bur du byung ba'i don rkyen kha shas la bcar 'dri byed ched thad kur rtsom sgrig khang gis mngags pa zhig red/de min da dung bcar 'dri bya yul gyi ched las dang sde khag ltar bgar tshe/gsar 'god pa rnams bzo las gsar 'god pa dang lus rtsal gsar 'god pa/ rol rtsed gsar 'god pa/ zhing las gsar 'god pa zhes bgar chog48

bgar tshul 'di rigs ni gsar 'gyur las rigs shin tu dar che ba ste/dper na/ rgyal khab rim pa dang yang na gzhi khyon cung che ba'i gsar 'gyur sde khag tu dbye ba shin tu gsal ba las/ mig sngar rang re'i bod skad 'dus pa'i rang rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs skad kyi gsar 'gyur sde khag mang che ba da dung de lta bu'i gzhi khyon la sleb med/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri bya yul yang las rigs so sor khyab pas/ gsar 'god pa'i byed sgo'i chu tshad la blang bya sngar las mthon po bton/ gsar 'god pa'i las ma'i thob thang ltar bgar na gsar 'god pa de las rogs gsar 'god pa dang gsar 'god pa/kru'u rin gsar 'god pa/ mtho rim gsar 'god pa zhes bgar ba red/gsum/ gsar 'god pa'i blo sbyong chu tshad/las rigs kyi khyad chos ltar na gsar 'gyur gyi khungs sne 'dzin mkhas pa dang skad cha'i bshad rtsal dang yi ge'i 'bri rtsal legs po ldan pa ni gsar 'god pa'i gzhi rtsa'i tshad thig yin/ yin yang / 'bri rtsal la mkhas pa las gzhan/ phyogs gzhan gyi chu tshad kyang gsar 'god pa zhig la mtshon na med du mi rung ba zhig red/1 gsar 'god pa'i chab srid bsam blo'i blo spyong chu tshad/mtha' mjug gi 'bras bu ltar na/ gsar 'gyur spel ba ni gsar 'god pas klog mkhan dang lta mkhan la phul ba'i brtsams chos red/ gsar 'god pas spyi tshogs gnas tshul gsar 'gyur gyi rnam pa nas spel ba ni mig dang lag pa kho nar brten nas yongs 'grub byed thub pa zhig min par/ rnyog 49

'dzing che zhing 'gyur ldog mang ba'i spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul mang po'i mdun du gsar 'god pa'i klad pa ni lhag par gnad 'gag yin zhing lhag par gal che ba red/ khor yug gcig 'dra'i 'og gsar 'bod pa la las gsar 'gyur legs po spel thub pa dang gsar 'bod pa la las mig 'og tu rgyu yang mi mthong ba dang / rgyu cha gcig 'dra yin yang / gsar 'gyur la la gnad la 'khel zhing gson nyams ldan pa dang / gsar 'gyur la la nya nyog che zhing 'gugs shugs med pa'i khyad par yod/ de ni 'bri rtsal kho nar rag las pa zhig ma red/ chab srid blo sbyong la bye brag gi nang don shin tu mang / rang rgyal du gsar 'gyur sde khag dang 'dra bar gsar 'god pa'i go gnas dang nus pa'ang shin tu dmigs bsal red/ kho tsho ni tang dang srid gzhung gi mgrin pa lta bu yin la/ tang dang srid gzhung dang mi dmangs mang tshogs bar gyi zam pa lta bu'ang red/ rgyu mtshan ni tshags par dang rlung 'phrin/ brnyan 'phrin sogs gsar 'gyur sde khag ni nga tsho'i tang gi dril bsgrags sde khag yin pa dang tang gis dril bsgrags la thad kur 'go khrid byed pa ni nga tsho'i tang gi dus yun ring po'i nyams myong khrod du grub pa'i rtsa don dang lam lugs gal chen red/dril bsgrags bya ba'i nang don gal chen yin pa'i cha nas gsar 'gyur bya ba'i khrod/ gsar 'god pa'i chab srid rang bzhin dang kha phyogs rang bzhin/ rtsa don rang bzhin la shugs snon par da yod kyi don snying gal chen ldan/ gsar 'god pas spel ba'i gsar 'gyur re re tshang mar tang dang mi dmangs bar 'brel 'dris byed pa'i nus pa thon pa min mod/ yin yang gsar 'god pa'i dmigs bsal rang bzhin dang gsar 'gyur bsgrags spel gyi dmigs bsal rang bzhin gyis tang dang srid gzhung dang gcig gyur yong ba dang chab srid kyi 50

go rtogs mthon po ldan pa/ chab srid sgrig khrims nan srung byed pa bcas ni sngar bzhin rang rgyal gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan gyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i chab srid kyi blo sbyong thad kyi blang bya red/2 shes bya'i blo smyong chu tshad/cha 'phrin dus rabs kyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni shes bya sna tshogs sngar med ngang myur du byung ba de red/ phyogs gcig nas shes bya'i tshan khag sna tshogs phan tshun sbrel zhing 'dres pa dang phyogs gzhan zhig nas tshan rig lag rtsal gyis spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so sor thebs pa'i shugs rkyen nyin rer je che red/lo rgyus gong du 'phel ba'i zin bris pa dang shes bya gsar ba'i brgyud bsgrags mkhan yin pa'i cha nas/ shes bya'i chu tshad legs po zhig ldan pa ni gsar 'god pas rang gi bya ba byang chub pa'i rmang gzhi red/ nub phyogs rgyal khab tu gsar 'god pa skyed sring byed thabs ha lam rigs gnyis yod/ rigs gcig ni ched las slob grwa nas ched du sbyong ba dang rigs gzhan zhig ni ched las mi gcig pa'i shes yon can bsdus te/ gsar 'gyur las rigs su zhugs rjes las rigs gso sbyong byed pa de red/ rang rgyal gyi rgya skad kyi gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan la mtshon na/ rgyal yongs dang zhing chen sogs rim pa so so na gsar 'gyur skor gyi ched las slob grwa dang ched las tshan khag sna 'dzoms yod phyir/ gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan mang pos slob grwa nas lo 'ga'i ring ched las shes bya'i gzhung lugs mang po sbyangs nas las gnas steng sleb tshe bya ba dngos kyi lag len khrod lam khrid sgron me lta bu yod pas/ mun 'thoms rang bzhin med cing yar thon cung mgyogs pa red/ rang re'i bod la gsar 'gyur skor gyi ched las slob grwa dang ched las tshan khag med pas/ bod skad kyi 51

gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan mang che ba las gnas steng bslebs rjes da gzod sngon mas rjes mar khrid pa dang bya ba'i lag len khrod rang gi 'tshol zhib byas nas sbyang dbos/ der brten thog ma nyid nas bya ba'i lam la drang ka drang thad ngang 'jug dka' ba'am yang na 'jug tshad dal zhing / zhugs pa'i dbang du btang na'ang rang gis bya ba dngos kyi khrod ched las de'i gzhung lusas shes bya'i lag cha'i cha shas tsam las yongs su bkol mi mkhas pa dang /yang na don dam pas lag len du 'debs bzhin pa dang lag byang la song ba'i bya ba'i khrod kyi shes bya de yang ched las kyi gzhung lugs dngos dang sbyor mi shes pa red/ don dngos su ched las shes bya'i spyi gzhung dang phyi'i rnam pa'i mtshon stangs ni 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so so phal cher 'dra bas/ nga tshos kyang rgya skad kyi ched las slob grwa dang ched las tshan khag nas gso sbyong byas chog chog red/ gang ltar yang gsar 'god pa'i shes bya'i rgya yangs dgos pa dang shes bya sna tshogs kyis phyug dgos pa ni dus kyi 'phel phyogs red/ shes bya sna tshogs la mkhas tshe/ gsar 'god pa'i gsar 'gyur spel ba'i bya ba'i khrod ma mtha' yang rgyun shes rang bzhin gyi nor 'chug mi bzo ba dang yang na nor 'chug je nyung du gtong thub/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri bya yul spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so sor 'brel ba yod stabs/ gsar 'god pas las rigs so so'i ched las shes bya shes dgos she na/ de ni don dngos dang mi mthun pa dang don dngos su sgrub thub pa zhig kyang ma red/ yin na'ang gsar 'god pa'i shes rgya nges par du yangs dgos/ shes yon gyis phyug tshe/ mi dang bya dngos la brtag pa dang shan 'byed pa'i nus pa mthor 'degs byas nas/ gcig la mkhas pas kun la mi rmongs pa dang bya brgya 'ur rdo gcig lta bu'i nus pa thon 52

thub pas/ bya ba'i khrod rgyun shes rang bzhin gyi nor 'khrul bzo mi srid la/tshad nges can zhig nas gsar 'gyur gyibaden drang rang bzhin dang yang dag rang bzhin la khag theg byed thub/ mig snga'i spyi tshogs dang gsar 'gyur smyan byed las rigs kyi dgos mkho la brtags na/ rig gnas mkhas pa dang ched mkhas pa'i rigs kyi gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa rnams la phyis su bya ba'i khrod mdun lam chen po ldan srid/ rig gnas mkhas pa dang ched las mkhas pa'i rigs kyi gsar 'god pa dag gis gsar 'gyur nang don gyi gting zab tshad dang ched don rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur spel ba'i thad thun mong ma yin pa'i dge mtshan mngon thub par ma zad/ gsar 'god pa spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so sor zab 'jug byed pa dang spyi tshogs kyi da yod gnas tshul la rgyus lon zab mo byed thub pas/ gal te phyogs ga ge mo'i ched las mkhas par gyur tshe/de'i nus pa ni dpag tu med pa zhig red/ 3 byed sgo'i nus rtsal gyi blo sbyong chu tshad/las rigs gang dang gang yin yang / de'i las byed mi snar byed sgo'i nus rtsal byang chub pa yod dgos pa'i blang bya yod/ gsar 'god pa'i byed sgo'i nus rtsal la phyogs so so'i nang don 'dus/ bcar 'dri dang rtsom 'bri kho na'i thad nas bshad na gsar 'god pa'i byed sgo'i nus rtsal la'ang gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' yod de/dang po skad rigs thad kyi nus pa 'dzoms dgos/ gsar 'god pa'i skad rigs kyi nus rtsal de gtso bo phyogs gnyis nas mtshon te/ gcig ni rang mi rigs kyi skad rigs dang cig shos ni mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khab gzhan pa'i skad rigs red/ bcar 'dri ni mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel 'dris khyad 53

par ba zhig yin la 'brel 'dris 'di rigs skad rigs la brten nas bya dgos/ gal te gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i khrod bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad rigs mi bo tshe/ de tsho dang phan tshun kha brda byed mi thub la/ 'brel 'dris kyang byed mi thub pas/ gsar 'bod pa'i bya bar dka' khag chen po bzo srid/de'i phyir rgya skad kyi gsar 'god pa zhig la mtshon na/ rang rgyal gyi mnga' khongs rgya che ba dang grangs nyung mi rigs mang ba ma zad/ rgya mi rigs nang khul du'ang sa cha mi gcig par yul skad mi 'dra ba yod pas/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis sa de'i grangs nyung mi rigs kyi skad rigs dang yul skad la cha rgyus yod 'os/ rang re'i bod skad la rgya skad kyi kong tung dang h+phu can/ hrang ha'e sogs kyi yul skad nang bzhin yi be gcig gi sgra yong stangs kyang yongs su mi 'dra bar skad rigs gnyis smra ba lta bu'i khyad par chen po med mod/ yin na'ang rang re'i bod skad kyi dbus skad dang khams skad/ a mdo'i skad bcas la'ang khyad par cung zad 'dug khyad par de rigs bod yig mi shes pa dang yang na bod yig gi chu tshad cung zhan la/ nam rgyun phan tshun 'brel 'dris byed pa'i go skabs med mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ phan tshun gyi skad rigs go bar dka' khag cung tsam yod mod/ yin na'ang bod yig gi chu tshad nges can ldan mkhan zhig la de 'dra'i dka' khag yod mi srid/ de bas bod skad kyi gsar 'god pa zhig la mtshon na/ rang mi rigs kyi skad la byang dgos pa ste/ dper na/ mtsho sngon brnyan 'phrin khang gi gsar 'god pa zhig yin tshe/a mdo'i skad kho na shes pas mi chog par da dung dbus skad dang khams skad kyang shes dgos/ de min mi rigs gzhan dang phyi rgyal gyi skad la'ang cha rgyus yod na shin tu legs/ nang sgos su rgya skad dang rgya yig cung byang dgos/ rang 54

rgyal gyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi gsar 'gyur las don la rang rang gi dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos ldan/ rang re'i bod skad kyi gsar 'gyur las don yang de ltar red/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed dang tshan rtsal rig gnas myur du dar ba'i da lta'i dus 'dir gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi bya ba byed mkhan la blang bya sngar las mthon po bton/ gsar 'god pa'i 'brel 'dris byed yul khyab che ba dang bcar 'dri'i khrod las rigs so so dang gnas tshul sna tshogs la 'phrad srid la/ bcar 'dri dang gsar 'gyur spel ba'i khrod rang mi rigs la ma dar ba dang rang gi skad rigs la ma bsgyur pa'i bya dngos gsar ba dang tha snyad gsar ba/ ming tshig gsar ba bcas la 'phrad srid/ der brten phyi rgyal gyi skad dang lhag par du rgya skad dang rgya yig la cung byang na rang gi bya bar stabs bde chen po yong thub/gnyis pa yig thog gi 'bri rtsal la mkhas dgos/ yig thog gi 'bri rtsal ni gsar 'god pa'i rmang gzhi'i nus rtsal red/ tshan rtsal dar che ba dang bstun nas gsar 'gyur brgyud bsgrags kyi thabs lam je mang je rgyas yin na'ang / yi ge la brten nas gsar 'gyur ma yig sna tshogs 'bri ba ni sngar bzhin gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur spel skabs rgyun du bkol ba'i byed thabs rigs shig red/ yig thog gi 'bri rtsal la mkhas dgos pa'i gal chen rang bzhin de tshags par dang dus deb kyi yig thog gi gsar 'god par mtshon na smos ma dgos pa zhig red la/ tshags par gyi par brnyan gsar 'god pa dang / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi gsar 'god par mtshon na'ang de bzhin yig thog gi 'bri rtsal byang tshe/ da gzod rnyog 'dzing che zhing dza drag ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur bya ba legs sgrub byed thub/ gsar 'god pa zhig 55

yin tshe bris na legs dgos par ma zad/ da dung bris na'ang mgyogs dgos te/ bya ba'i khor lug mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kyi khrod du dus yun ches thung ngu'i nang gsar 'gyur ma yig 'bri thub dgos/ skabs 'gar don rkyen byung rjes kyi chu tshod 'ga' dang skar ma 'ga'i nang ma yig bris tshar dgos/ dmigs bsal gyi don rkyen dang 'phrad tshe/ gsar 'god pas tha na bcar 'dri byed zhor dang ma yig 'bri dgos pas/ ma yig la zhib lta dang dag bcos byed long med la/ bcar 'dri dang ma yig 'bri ba/ gsar 'gyur spel ba bcas dbugs thengs gcig gis tshar dgos pas/ gsar 'god par nges par du rig gnas chu tshad mthon po dang 'bri rtsal legs po zhig ldan dgos/gsum pa par len dang brnyan phab nus rtsal la byang dgos/ sngon chad sgrig chas kyi cha rkyen zhan pa sogs kyis tshod 'dzin thebs pas/ tshags par sogs kyi gsar 'god pas gtso bo smyu gu la brten pa dang / gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la ram 'degs byed par mkho ba'i 'dra par rtag tu par brnyan gsar 'god pas 'don sprod bya dgos/ da lta ang grangs lag rtsal gyis skul spel 'og par len rgyu de yang shin tu stabs bde zhig tu gyur pas/ bris na mkhas pa dang par len dang brnyan phab la'ang byang ba'i gsar 'god pa zhig byed par tshegs chen po med/ yig thog 'bri rtsal la mkhas pa'i gsar 'god pas kyang rtsis 'khor dang dra rgya sogs sgrig chas la brten nas rang gis spel ba'i gsar 'gyur de yig brnyan gnyis 'dzoms yin zhing gson nyams ldan par byed thub/ par len dang brnyan phab las gzhan/ lag rtsal gsar ba'i rgyab skyor 'og sngon chad shin tu ched las can du gyur pa'i lag rtsal te/ dper na/ yul dngos sgra brnyan phab pa dang 'gul ris brnyan gzugs bzo ba 56

sogs kyang nyin re las nyin rer khong du chud sla bar gyur/ deng rabs can gyi lag rtsal gsar ba dang thon rdzas gsar bas gsar 'god pa rnams kun la mkhas pa zhig tu 'gyur bar phyi'i cha rkyen bzang bo gsar skrun byas te/ kho tshos yig thog nas 'bri ba las gzhan/ rang gi gsar 'gyur la brnyan ris dang sgra snyan sogs kyis phyug par byas/4 kun spyod kyi blo spyong chu tshad/gsar 'god pa dang gsar 'gyur las rigs kyis spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod nus pa gal chen thon bzhin yod/ gsar 'god pa'i las bkur snying stobs la mi rnams kyis yongs khyab tu bsngags brjod dang brtsi bkur thob/rang rgyal du tang dang mi dmangs kyis gsar 'god pa'i dka' spyad kyi ngal rtsol la gtsigs chen dang gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang gin yod/ der brten bla med gshis rgyud gso skyong dang kun spyod tshad gzhi mthor 'degs bya rgyu de gsar 'god pa zhig la mtshon na lhag par gal che ba zhig red/ spyir btang du gsar 'god pa'i kun spyod thad kyi blo sbyong de yang gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' nas mtshon pa ste/gcig ni las rigs kyi snying stobs thad nas mtshon pa yin/ krung go'i gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan gyi las rigs kun spyod tshad gzhi zhes pa'i nang du/ rang rgyal gyi gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan rnams la nges par du blo gcig sems gcig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i snying stobs ldan dgos pa'i blang bya bton yod de/ mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba ni spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi kun spyod 'dzugs skrun gyi srog shing yin pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi kun spyod kyi gcig bsdus kyi mtshon rtags kyang yin la/ rang rgyal gyi — 57

gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan tsho'i rtsa ba'i dmigs yul yang yin zhes btan khel gsal bo byas/ de dang bstun nas rang rgyal gyi gsar 'gyur sde khag mang po zhig gis kyang mi dmangs la zhabs 'debs zhu ba de rang gi las rigs kyi ches gal che ba'i snying stobs shig tu brtsis te rtsom sgrig pa dang gsar 'god pa tshang mar tang gi 'go khrid 'og yang dag pa'i gleng phyogs kyi khrid ston kha phyogs rgyun 'khyongs dang tang dang srid gzhung gis mi dmangs mang tshogs la 'brel 'dris byed pa'i zam pa dang sbrel thag lta bu'i nus pa gang legs kyis spyad de/spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'dzugs skrun las don hur thag sgos mdun du bskul dgos pa'i blang bya bton/gnyis ni las rigs kun spyod thad nas mtshon pa yin/ don dngos ji ma ji bzhin dang yo gzur med pa/ drang bden yin pa bcas ni gsar 'bod pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i las rigs kun spyod red/ krung go'i gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan gyi las rigs kun spyod tshad bzhi'i nang gsar 'gyur spel skabs/don dngos dang mthun pa dang drang bden yin dgos la/ rang nyid dang thun mong chung ngu'i khe phan gyi ched du rang gi kha lo bsgyur chog pa'i gleng phyogs yo byad spyad de sger don gnyer ba dang drang bden min pa'i gsar 'gyur spel ba bcas gtan nas byed mi rung zhes gtan khel gsal bo byas yod/ gsar 'god pa'i las rigs kun spyod thad nas rang rgyal du ma zad/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs dang rgyal spyi'i gsar 'gyur gsar 'god pa'i mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs sogs kyis kyang gtan khel gsal po byas yod/ mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis bzos pa'i rgyal spyi'i gsar 'gyur kun spyod tshad thig 'char zin gyi don tshan dang po'i nang bkod don/ tshags par dang de min gsar 'gyur 58

smyan byed sde khag gzhan dag gi bya ba byed mkhan tshos shed shugs yod rgu bton te/ spyi 'bangs kyis thos pa'i gsar 'gyur de nges par du yang dag pa yin par khag theg bya dgos/ rgyal spyi'i gsar 'gyur gsar 'god pa'i mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyis 1954lor gros 'cham byung ba'i gsar 'bod pa'i bya spyod rtsa don bsgrags gtam gyi don tshan dang po'i nang du'ang bden don la gces 'dzin dang gsar 'gyur ji ma ji bzhin 'thob par re ba'i spyi 'bangs kyi dbang char brtsi 'jog byed pa ni gsar 'god pa'i 'gan khur thog ma yin zhes 'khod yod/gsum ni las rigs sgrig khrims thad nas mtshon pa yin/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri'i khyab rgya shin tu che/ bcar 'dri byed skabs rtag par rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan gal chen la rag las pa'i gnad don la 'phrad srid/ gsar 'gyur gyi sgrig khrims brtsi srung nan mo bya rgyu ni rang rgyal gsar 'god pa'i las rigs blo sbyong thad kyi nang don gal chen red/ krung go'i gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan kyi las rigs kun spyod tshad gzhi'i don tshan gsum pa las gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan gyis nges par du rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims kyi khyab khongs nang bya ba sgrub dgos pa dang / rang rtogs ngang rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims/ dril bsgrags sgrig khrims bcas brtsi srung bya dbos/ tang gi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang lam phyogs/ byed phyogs/ srid jus bcas rbad chod sgos dril bsgrags dang lag bstar bya dgos/ rang gi dbang du yod pa'i gleng phyogs yo byad spyad de/ tang krung dbyang gi chod don dang rgyab 'gal yin pa'i nang don dril bsgrags byed mi rung zhes gtan khel byas yod/ zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi bcar 'dri dang rtsom sgrig mi sna'i 59

gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi kun spyod skor gyi gtan khel 'ga' zhes pa'i don tshan gsum pa'i nang du'ang bcar 'dri dang rtsom sgrig mi snas rang rtogs sgos rtsa khrims dang bca' khrims/ tang gi chab srid sgrig khrims dang dril bsgrags sgrig khrims/ gsang srung sgrig khrims brtsi srung bya dgos pa dang / rang rtogs sgos tang dang rgyal khab kyi khe phan srung skyong byed pa dang tang dang rgyal khab kyi gsang ba brtol mi rung zhes gtan khel byas yod/ gsar 'gyur sde khag la las rang gi dmigs bsal rang bzhin la dmigs nas/ gsar 'god pa'i sgrig khrims gtan khel byas pa shin tu zhib cing nan mo red/ dper na/bcings 'grol dmag tshags par khang gi gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi kun spyod brtsi srung gtan khel nang rang sgor gyis sa gnas kyi tshags par dang dus deb la dmag dpung gi gnas tshul mtshon pa'i rtsom yig 'bri mi rung ba dang / rang sger gyis phyi rgyal gyi tshags par dang dus deb/ rlung 'phrin las khungs/ brnyan 'phrin khang bcas la rtsom yig 'bri mi rung la/ rang sger gyis chog mchan ma thob pa'i tang dang rgyal khab/ dmag dpung bcas kyi 'go khrid par 'brel ba yod pa'i gsar 'gyur spel mi rung zhes gtan khel nan mo byas yod/ de yang shes dgos pa zhig la/ gsar 'god pa'i las rigs sgrig khrims thad kyi blang bya ni rang re'i rgyal khab kho nar yod pa zhig min par/ rgyal spyi'i steng gi gsar 'gyur sde khag mang che bas gsar 'god par sgrig khrims thad kyi blang bya nan mo bton yod de/ mi 'dra sa ni blang bya 'di dag gi gnad che sa dang rnam pa mi mtshungs pa tsam red/bzhi ni las rigs spyod stangs thad nas mtshon pa yin/ gsar 'god pa'i las rigs spyod stangs ni kho tshos las rigs bya ba yongs 'grub byed pa'i 60

'gan srung gal chen yin zhing / gzab nan dang zhib tshags/ rnal mo/ nan tan/ hur brtson bcas ni gsar 'gyur gsar 'god pa'i gzhi rtsa'i spyod stangs red/ rang rgyal gyi gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi dmigs bsal rang bzhin kyi dbang gis gsar 'god par bya ba'i spyod stangs lhag par bzang po zhig dgos/ gsar 'gyur lo rgyus las shes pa ltar na/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi ming du grags pa'i gsar 'grod pa mang che ba gsar 'gyur spel ched phyogs phyogs su bcar 'dri la brgyugs nas da gzod legs 'grub byung ba zhig red/gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ spyod stangs kyi gnad don ni don dag gal chen zhig red/ gsar 'god pa la la bya ba'i khrod le lor g.yengs nas bcar 'dri byed mi 'dod pa dang rtsom 'bri rgyur yang sgyid lugs byas nas gzhi rim sde khag gi yig cha'i rgyu cha dang 'phrin skyel pa'i ma yig kho nar brten bzhin yod/ gsar 'god pa la las las khungs dang las rigs kyi dmigs bsal rang bzhin de rang nyid ngom pa dang nga che nga rgyal gyi ma rtsa lta bur brtsis nas rang nyid kyi ming grags dang gsar 'gyur lang/ bsku gas kyi mtshan snyan la gnod pa tshabs chen bzo bzhin yod/bzhi/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i thabs rtsal/bcar 'dri ni gsar 'gyur 'thob par bya ched/ don rkyen dang bya dngos la lta zhib dang 'dri brtsad/ bsam gzhig gtong ba/ zin thor 'god pa sogs kyi bya ba la zer zhing / de ni gsar 'gyur 'god pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin la/ brtag dpyad zhib 'jug khyad par can zhig kyang red/61

1 gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i khyad chos/spyir gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i khyad chos de dmigs yul rang bzhin dang dmigs bsal rang bzhin/ dka' tshegs rang bzhin/ dus thog rang bzhin bcas phyogs bzhir dbye chog dmigs yul rang bzhin ni spyir mi rnams kyi bya 'gul ci byed tshang mar dmigs yul yod pa bzhin gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri yang de ltar yin/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i dmigs yul ni gsar 'gyur gyi rin thang ldan pa'i don dngos dang khungs sne 'thob par bya rgyu de red/ zhib tu bshad na/ gsar 'god pas spyi tshogs kyi spyi 'bangs kyi ched du gsar 'gyur 'god pa yin la/ deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi las bgos nyin rer je zhib nas je zhib yin pa dang cha 'phrin yang nyin re las nyin rer phun sum tshogs pas/ spyi 'bangs kyis spyi tshogs khrod kyi cha 'phrin shes 'dod na/tha na kho tsho'i gam du byung ba'i don dag yin yang / gsar 'god pas spel ba'i gsar 'gyur la brten nas shes par bya rgyur goms yod/ gsar 'god pas spyi 'bangs la kho tsho'i bya ba dang 'tsho bar shugs rkyen bzo ba'i spyi tshogs don rkyen gsal por rtsad bcad de spel dgos pa yin/ dmigs bsal rang bzhin ni/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri de gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur rgyu cha 'thob ched byed pa'i dmigs bsal gyi spyi tshogs brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gi bya 'gul zhig kyang yin te/ de la dmigs bsal zhes bshad don yang lag len dang bsam blo gtong stangs phyogs gnyis nas mtshon pa ste/ lag len gyi thad nas bshad na/ gsar 'god pa'i brtag dpyad de srid khrims dang tshong don/ dmangs kyi 'dod blo thad kyi brtag dpyad zhib 'jug dang mi mtshungs par de dag dang khyad par mngon gsal yod/ gsar 'god pas brtag dpyad 62

zhib 'jug byed don ni don dngos la rgyus lon byas nas gsar 'gyur spel te/nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur gyi don dngos shes 'dod pa'i re ba skong ba'i ched du yin pa las/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang sdom tshig bi dgos mkho zhig gi ched du min/ bsam blo gtong phyogs kyi thad nas bshad na gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri khrod kyi bsam blo gtong stangs de yang snyan ngag pa dang rig gnas mkhas pa rnams dang mi mtshungs/ gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri bya rim khrod/ hur brtson dang dza drag ldan pa/ tha na skabs la lar sdug bsngal dang bcas pa'i bsam gzhig gtong dgos mod/ yin yang gsar 'god pa'i bsam gzhig de sgyu rtsal pas rang ngo'i brtse sems ston pa dang /mtshan nyid rig pa bas khungs gtugs rig 'ded byed pa/ tshan rig pas tshod ltas bden dpang drangs pa bcas dang mi 'dra/ gsar 'god pas lta zhib dang dogs 'dri/ thos bsam/ bsam gzhig bcas kyi byed thabs la brten zhing / dmigs yul ni gsar 'gyur gyi don dngos gsal por shes pa dang bsgrags pa'i ched du red/ bcar 'dri'i go rim ni rang gi brtse sems ston pa dang shes stobs ngom pa'i go rim min la/ rgyas bshad dang gzhung lugs la bden dpang byed pa'i go rim yang min par/ don dngos la rgyus lon byed pa'i go rim yin/ lag len las bden dpang byung ba ni phul du byung ba'i gsar 'god pa zhig gis dus dang rnam pa kun tu don dngos la brtsi 'jog dang dang dod byed pa dang / phul du byung ba'i gsar 'gyur brtsams chos shig ni nam yang drang dngos kyi mig zung las thon pa yin/dka' tshegs rang bzhin ni gsar 'god pa'i bya ba de yang nyen kha che ba'i las rigs shig yin pa bstan pa ste/ bcar 'dri byed pa'i go rim nam 63

yang dka' tshegs dang nyen khas khengs yod phyir/ gsar 'god pa zhig yin tshe/ nges par du dka' sdug sna tshogs khyad du sel ba dang nyen khar mi 'dzem pa'i snying stobs ldan tshe da gzod bcar 'dri bya 'gul sna tshogs yongs 'grub byed thub/ nyen kha zhes brjod na/ mi rnams kyis rtag par bo'u mde'u char ltar 'bab cing mi srog 'ben la 'dzugs pa'i g.yul sar ngos 'dzin bzhin yod/ yin na'ang gsar 'god par mtshon na deng rabs spyi tshogs khrod nyen kha'i khyab khongs rgya bskyed kyin yod de/ rang byung gnod 'tshe tshabs chen byung yul dang nad yams tshabs chen mched sa/ 'bag btsog tshabs chen bzo sa/me chus gnod skyon tshabs chen byung sa/ de min nyes don nyes bzos don rkyen tshabs chen bzo sa bcas ni gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri bya yul yin zhing /bcar 'dri bya ba'i khrod rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis gsar 'god pa'i rang srog shor ba de yang gsar 'gyur zhig ma red/ der brten deng rabs spyi tshogs khrod/ srog gi nyen kha yod mkhan de yang g.yul sa'i gsar 'god pa kho na min/ da yod 'tsho ba'i khrod/ spyi 'bangs rnams nyen kha byung sa'i nyen yul las phyir 'ben byed dus/ gsar 'god pa mang po rtag par nyen yul dngos la song nas gsar 'gyur spel gyin yod/ gsar 'god pa'i las rigs la mtshon na nyen yul la la ni mig gis bltas na mthong ba zhig min par rtag par brjod yul las 'das pa zhig red/ dus thog rang bzhin ni gsar 'gyur la mtshon na dus tshod kyis rin thang ji lta bu mtshon pa ni gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan tshang mas gsal por shes nges/ rin thang gal chen ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur don rkyen zhig gal te khyod kyis dus thog tu spel ma thub par gsar 'gyur sde khag gzhan gyis sngon la spel tshe/ khyod kyi gsar 'gyur de'i 64

rin thang chung ba dang yang na rin thang ci yang med par 'gyur yang srid/gsar 'gyur mang po zhig ni snga gzhug brtsad de spel dgos/ gsar 'gyur sde khag gis gsar 'gyur spel snga ba'i rmang gzhi ni gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri byed mgyogs pa dang bris mgyogs pa de red/ da lta'i spyan gzugs sne mang can gyi dus rabs 'di'i skabs su/ 'bri ba'i rnam pa zer ba tag tag smyu gu dang shog gu yin dgos pa'i nges pa med par kha par las bshad pa dang / lag khyer kha par las 'phrin thung bskur ba sogs rnam pa mang po spyad chog phyogs 'di nas bshad na gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri byed skabs/ skabs thog gi blo sna myur ba ni lhag par gnad 'gag red/ tshor ba rnon po dang / bya spyod myur mo/ bab bstun nus pa/ 'gan sems drag po/ go skabs dmigs bsal sogs ni gsar 'god pas thog ma'i dus tshod nang gsar 'gyur spel bar legs 'grub 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gal chen red/1999lo'i zla 5ba'i tshes 8nyin gyi pe cin dus tshod chu tshod 5dang skar ma 45steng / a me ri kha gtso byas pa'i byang chings rtsa 'dzugs kyis me shugs 'phur mda' bkol nas nan si la h+phur sdod pa'i krung go'i gzhung tshab khang la 'jab rgol byas/ skabs der mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par gyi gsar 'god pa los yan sung phyi rol nas phyir gzhung tshab khang gi sum thog gi 'dug sar phyir log ma thag ldir sgra chen po zhig grags pa dang mnyam du khang ba brdibs pa dang / der mthud de ldir sgra thengs gnyis pa grags shing / de ma thag gzhung tshab khang hril po du nag gis khengs pa dang gang sar me lce dgung du 'phyur/ gas 'bar gyi ldir sgras thog mar sad par byas pa ni kho'i las rigs kyi dran shes red/ kho rang de ma thag myur du kog ma langs kyis par 65

chas dang lag khyer kha par bzung nas phyi ru brgyugs/ kho phyir thon ma thag myur du mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par gyi yan lag tshags par te/ sa'i go la bskor ba'i dus thog tshags par zhes pa'i gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa hu'u zhi cin la kha par btang nas/ nan si la chur sdod pa'i krung go'i gzhung tshab khang la gas gtor thebs pa'i gnas tshul yar zhu byas/ hu'u zhi cin gyis dus der chu tshod la bltas pa na/ tag tag chu tshod 6 yin la/ gas gtor byung nas skar ma 15ma gtogs 'gor med/ khos de ma thag mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par gyi 'go khrid la yar zhu byas pa dang mi dmangs nyin re'i tshags par gyis myur du krung dbyang la yar zhu byas/ skabs der rgyal khab phyi 'brel pu'u la da dung nan si la chur sdod pa'i gzhung tshab khang gi snyan zhu 'byor med/ gas gtor byung rjes los yan sung ni krung go'i gzhung tshab khang la gas gtor thebs pa'i khrod nas gson pa'i gsar 'god pa gcig pu red/ kho'i dpa' stobs dang brtan brling gis kho rang 'dzam gling la ha las par byed pa'i gsar 'gyur 'di spel mkhan gyi thog mar gyur par ma zad/ rang rgyal srid gzhung gis phyi 'brel bya ba thag gcod byed pa'i rtsa che ba'i dus tshod kyang 'thob par byas/2 bcar 'dri'i gra sgrigabacar 'dri'i gra sgrig ces pa ni/ gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri byed ched bsgrubs pa'i gra sgrig bya ba sna tshogs la zer/ bya ba ci bsgrub kyang sngon na dgos nges kyi gra sgrig bya ba bsgrubs tshe/ da gzod bya ba de bde blag ngang 'grub par khag theg byed thub/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'drir mtshon na lhag par du de 'dra red/ bcar 'dri gra sgrig bya ba bsgrubs pa bzang min de rtag par gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri legs 'grub yong min gyi gnad 66

'gag red/ nyams myong can gyi gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri bde blag yong ched/ rtag par bcar 'dri'i sngon la sems zhib mos gra sgrig bya ba sna tshogs legs por bsgrub nges/ chu tshod skar ma gcig ring gi bcar 'dri de ma mtha' yang skar ma bcu ltar gra sgrig byed pa ni nyams myong dang ldan pa'i gsar 'god pa mang po'i gcig mthun gyi lta tshul red/ don dam pas bshad na/ gsar 'god pa ni shes bya'i dka' gnad sel ba'i tshig mdzod dang shes bya sna mang 'dzoms pa'i glegs bam lta bu ma yin par/ ji 'dra'i yon tan can zhig yin yang / gna' deng shes byar thogs pa mi mnga' bar mi sna sna tshogs dang don rkyen sna tshogs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu tshegs med ngang kha ya byed thub la/bcar 'dri thengs re rer gra sgrig ci yang byed mi dgos mkhan zhig gtan nas yod mi srid/ gra sgrig gang legs byas tshe/ gsar 'god pa dang bcar 'dri bya yul bar gyi bar thag je nyer btang nas bcar 'dri bya yul dang 'dris sla bar ma zad/ da dung gsar 'god pas 'brel yod dpyad gzhir zhib 'jug byed pa'i go rim khrod/ rim bzhin bcar 'dri'i bsam gzhig gsal por nges par byas nas bcar 'dri dmigs yul gsal por gtan khel byed par rogs byed thub/ 'di ltar byas na bcar 'dre'i nang don je zab tu gtong thub par ma zad/ bcar 'dri'i las chod kyang je mthor gtong thub/ bcar 'dri'i sngon la gra sgrig gang legs byas na bcar 'dri bya ba'i phyed ka legs 'grub byung ba dang gnyis su ma mchis/ 'o na ji ltar gra sgrig bya dgos she na/ gtso bo rgyu cha'i gra sgrig dang bcar 'dri bya yul la rgyus lon byed pa/ 'dri tshig gi gra sgrig bcas phyogs gsum nas gra sgrig byas chog rgyu cha 'tshol sdud byed pa ni bcar 'dri'i gra sgrig gi thog ma'i bya ba yin/ rgyu cha gra sgrig byed pa de don dngos kyi gsar 67

'gyur rin thang 'tshol ba dang bcar 'dri'i gnad sa khong du chud pa/ bcar 'dri'i las chod mthor 'degs bcas byed par nus pa gal chen thon par ma zad/ gsar 'gyur ma yig 'bri bar rgyab ljongs kyi rgyu cha phun sum tshogs pa dang gson nyams ldan zhing spro bag gis khengs pa'i gtam rgyud/ khungs btsan pa'i gzhung lugs bden dpang sogs 'don sprod byas te/ gsar 'gyur gyi brjod bya 'bur du dod pa dang gsar 'gyur brtsams chos kyi 'gugs shugs je drag tu gtong bar phan pa shin tu che/ der brten rgyal khab phyi nang gi phul du byung ba'i gsar 'god pa tshang mas rgyu cha 'tshol sdud la ha cang mthong chen byed pa red/ gsar 'god pa mang pos skabs la lar rgyu cha 'tshol sdud byed par bkol ba'i dus tshod dang sems shugs de bcar 'dri dngos las yongs su brgal nges/ rgyu cha gra sgrig byed pa de yang nam rgyun gra sgrig byed pa dang gnas skabs su gra sgrig byed pa zhes phyogs gnyis 'dus/ nam rgyun gyi gra sgrig zer ba ni gsar 'god pa'i nam rgyun gyi bya ba'i khrod kyi sdud gsog la bstan cing / de ni rmang gzhi rang bzhin gyi gra sgrig red/ nam rgyun gyi gra sgrig de yang bye brag gi bcar 'dri bya ba thengs ga ge mo zhig la bstan pa min la/ des bcar 'dri khrod thon pa'i nus pa ni gzhal du med pa ste/ rgyu mtshan ni shes bya sdud gsog byed pa de ni chu thigs bsags na rgya mtsho nang bzhin nyin gcig gnyis dang thengs gnyis gsum re'i nang yongs 'grub byed thub pa zhig ma yin par yun ring gi go rim ring mo zhig brgyud dgos/ gsar 'god pas dus yun ring por bya mos rgyan 'bu 'thu ba nang bzhin thengs re re dang nyin re re/ zla re re/ lo re re bzhin tsag cig gi nyams myong rnams btus nas bsags na/ da gzod rang gi rgyu cha'i mdzod khang bskrun thub la/ bye brag gi 68

bcar 'dri khrod du rang gi rgyu cha'i mdzod khang las 'brel yod rgyu cha len pa dang de'i khar dmigs gtad yod pa'i ngang rgyu cha gra sgrig byas tshe/ bcar 'drir grub 'bras bzang po thon nges/ bcar 'dri ji lta bu zhig yin yang nangs g.yul la 'jug na mtshan gri kha brdar ba lta bus mi chog la/ nangs g.yul la 'jug dgos kyang mtshan da dung gri mi brdar na de bas kyang mi rung ba red/nam rgyun gyi gra sgrig der gtso bo gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' 'dus/ gcig nas nam rgyun gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang dus thog srid jus kyi slob sbyong la do snang bya dgos/ gsar 'god pas tang dang srid gzhung gi byed phyogs srid jus dang rgyal khab kyi bca' khrims sgrig srol/ de min bcar 'dri bya ba'i khyab khongs kyi bye brag gi srid jus dang sgrig khrims srol yig sogs la byang chub par bya dgos par ma zad/ da dung rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi slob sbyong la do snang byas te rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs bya dgos/gsar 'god par rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad cung mthon po ldan tshe/bcar 'dri khrod du rtsod sgrub kyi rnam dpyod la brten nas gnad don la lta zhib dang dbye zhib byed thub cing / phyogs mang po'i thad nas rtog 'dzing gi spyi tshogs rnam pa'i gting dpog par byed thub la/ 'bri rtsom khrod bsam blo'i 'char sgo sngar las yangs pa nas don dngos kyi mthil rtogs par byas te/gsar 'gyur brtsams chos la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad cung mthon po dang bsam blo'i nang don cung zab mo ldan par byed thub/ gnyis nas shes bya rang bzhin gyi rgyu cha'i sdud gsog la do snang bya dgos/ rtag par mi mang pos gsar 'god pa ni ched mkhas min yang kun shes yin dgos zer/ de 69

yang gtso bo shes bya'i rgya yangs dgos par bstan pa red/ gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan zhig yin tshe/ dga' phyogs mang po yod dgos pa dang shes bya mang po shes dgos/ shes bya'i rgya yangs pa de yang nyin rgyun gyi bya ba dang 'tsho ba'i khrod du dus dang rnam pa kun tu sdud gsog bya rgyur brten dbos te/ rig gnas sgyu rtsal dang lo rgyus/ sa rgyus/ chab srid khrims lugs/ zhing phyugs/gso rig rang byung tshan rig sogs shes bya mang por cha rgyus yod par bya dgos la/ kun shes pa tsam gyis kyang mi chog par/ da dung phyogs re gnyis la mkhas na lhag par bzang / gsar 'gyur bya ba 'phel rgyas byung ba dang bstun nas/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri'i las bgos kyang cung zhib pas/ rang rang gi las bgos bcar 'dri'i khyab khongs kyi ched las shes byar cung byang chub par bya dgos shing / nyin rgyun gyi bya ba'i khrod nges par du de'i phyogs kyi shes bya dang rgyu cha sdud gsog byed par do snang bya dgos/ de las gzhan nyin rgyun gyi gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i khrod du bye brag gi bcar 'dri thengs der 'brel ba med kyang / song sa bsdad sa nas sa de ga'i yul ljongs dang ri chu grags can/ dgon pa/ mi sna sogs kyi lo rgyus bshad rgyun dang / sa gnas kyi goms srol sna tshogs/ dmangs khrod gtam rgyud/ tha na gtam dpe la sogs pa 'tshol sdud bya rgyu de yang rang gi shes rgya yangs par byed pa dang rang gi rgyu cha'i mdzod khang je phyug tu gtong ba'i thabs dam pa red/ gsum nas byed sgo'i rang bzhin gyi rgyu cha sdud gsog byed par do snang bya dgos/ byed sgo rang bzhin gyi rgyu cha zhes pa ni/ gsar 'god pas byed sgo'i thad zur lta byas na rang gi byed sgo'i chu tshad mthor 'degs byed thub pa'i rgyu cha'i rigs la bstan pa yin/dper na/ gsar 'god pa grags can dang gsar 'god pa phul byung can gyi 70

rtsom yig phul byung dang / ched mkhas pas rtsom yig phul byung can la mdzad pa'i gdeng 'jog dang brjod pa'i dpyad gtam/ sngon byon gsar 'god pa rnams kyi gsar 'gyur bris rtsom thad kyi myong tshor dang nyams myong sogs lta bu red/ rgyu cha 'di rigs la do snang dang de dag sdud gsog bya rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas na/ gsar 'god pa'i byed sgo'i chu tshad mthor 'dregs byed par shin tu phan/rang re'i bod skad kyi gsar 'god pa mang che bar mtshon na/ gsar 'gyur sogs rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi ched las slob grwa dang ched las tshan khag med pas/ las gnas steng du ma zhugs pa'i sngon la/ gsar 'gyur sogs ched las byed sgo'i shes byar byang chub pa par zhog ched las shes bya rags tsam shes mkhan yang shin tu nyung / las gnas steng zhugs rjes/ gcig nas las grogs rgan pa tsho'i gam nas nyams myong tsam slob dgos pa dang /gnyis nas rang nyid kyis bya ba dngos kyi khrod 'tshol zhib byas nas slob dgos/las grogs rgan pa rnams kyis kyang las zhor du rang gi nyams myong la brten nas zur ston re byed pa tsam las rgyud rim ldan pa'i byed sgo'i thad kyi gzhung lugs dang shes bya 'khrid thub mkhan shin tu nyung zhing / bod rang la rang gi yi ge'i byed sgo'i shes bya skor gyi dpe cha ni lhag par ri bong gi rwa ltar dkon phyir/ las gsar ba rnams la dka' khag chen po bzos/ spyir gsar 'gyur dang de min rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi byed sgo'i rmang gzhi'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i thabs rtsal rang bzhin gyi shes bya sogs ni mi rigs so sor khyad par cher med pas/ nga tshos rgya yig dang rgya skad kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang rmang gzhi'i shes byar slob sbyong byed pa 71

dang rgya yig dang rgya skad kyi dpe mtshon rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos phul byung la slob sbyong dang zur lta bya rgyu de ni rang gi byed sgo'i chu tshad mthor 'degs dang byed sgo'i shes bya sdud gsog byed pa'i thabs lam gal chen zhig red/ nam rgyun rgyu cha sdud gsog byed pa la tshags par 'bri ba dang byang bu bzo ba/ dpe klog gnad btus 'bri ba sogs byed stangs shin tu mang / mi re res rang gi goms phyogs ltar byed thabs 'dra min sna tshogs spyod chog cing / da lta lhag par du deng rabs kyi lag cha rtsis 'khor la brten nas rgyu cha sdud gsog byas chog chog red/ yin yang byed thabs ci zhig spyad kyang gal che ba zhig ni/ sdud gsog byas pa'i rgyu cha rnams dus thog tu lugs mthun sgos rigs bgar nas/phyis 'tshol bde ba dang bkol bde bar bya rgyu de red/ skabs thog gi rgyu cha gra sgrig ces pa ni bye brag gi bcar 'dri bya ba thengs shig la dmigs nas byas pa'i gra sgrig bya ba la zer/ bye brag gi bcar 'dri thengs shig la mtshon na/skabs thog rang bzhin gyi gra sgrig gi shugs rkyen dang grub 'bras ni lhag par mgyogs shing lhag par mngon gsal red/ glo bur rang bzhin gyi don rkyen las gzhan/ skabs thog rang bzhin gyi rgyu cha gra sgrig bya rgyu ni bcar 'dri thengs re rer med du mi rung ba zhig red/ skabs thog rang bzhin gyi rgyu cha gra sgrig byed skabs gsham gyi phyogs 'ga'i nang don la dang dod bya dgos/ gcig nas bcar 'dri gnad don dang 'brel ba'i srid jus dang khrims srol gyi skor la dang dod bya dgos/ srid jus dang rigs pa'i gzhung lugs phyogs kyi gra sgrig la dang dod byas na/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri byas nas thob pa'i rgyu char dbye zhib dang shan 'byed byed pa'i nus pa mthor 'degs byed thub/skabs la lar bca' khrims dang khrims srol dang 'brel ba'i don rkyen bcar 72

'dri bya dgos tshe/ nges par du 'brel yod khrims lugs khrims srol gsal por khong du chud rjes da gzod bcar 'dri byed chog yin na'ang don rkyen glo bur ba byung nas myur du bcar 'dri bya dgos tshe/ gra sgrig gi dus yun 'dang tshim pa zhig med kyang / gra sgrig 'di rigs ni dmigs gtad rang bzhin cung drag pa dang 'brel yod srid jus dang khrims srol yang rtag par cung gcig 'dus yin phyir/ 'tshol sdud byed sla zhing khong du chud sla bas/ myur du bkol spyod byed bde ba red/ der brten gra sgrig 'di rigs kyis dus rgyun shes bya sdud gsog byas pa mi 'dang bar kha gsab byed thub/ gnyis nas bcar 'dri'i nang don dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnas tshul bsgrags spel skor gyi rgyu cha sdud gsog bya rgyur dang dod bya dgos/ dngos su bcar 'dri ma byas sngon la/yar sngon rigs 'dra'i gsar 'gyur spel mkhan dang yang na de dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gsar 'gyur spel mkhan yod med dang / gal te yod tshe gsar 'gyur de dag ji ltar spel yod pa dang / phyogs gang thad nas bcar 'dri byas yod pa/ phyogs gang dag da dung gom gang sngon spos sgos bcar 'dri byed chog pa/ tha na phyogs gang dag spel ba mi 'tsham pa bcas la rgyus lon gsal bo bya dgos/ gra sgrig 'di lta bus gsar 'god par gsar 'gyur spel ba'i gnad sa legs shing 'os 'tsham zhig gdam ste/ bcar 'dri'i nang don de kun las gsar zhing sngar las gting zab par byas nas/ gzhan gyis spel ba'i rjes 'brangs mi dgos par rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan par byed pa la rogs byed thub/ gnad don 'di ni rang re'i bod skad kyi gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi gsar 'grod par mtshon na lhag par dang dod bya dgos pa zhig red/ nam rgyun gsar 'gyur don rkyen chen po dang yang na yongs khyab tu 73

grags che ba'i mi sna'i byas rjes sogs gsar 'gyur brjod don 'dra byung dus rtag par rgya skad kyis sngon na bsgrags rjes bod skad kyis da gzod bcar 'dri byed kyin yod/ des na ji ltar gzhan gyi rkang rjes kho nar spos nas mi 'gro ba dang rgya skad dang rgya yig la zur lta byed pa'i mod la/ rang bi bod skad dang bod yig gi gsar 'gyur spel yul dang bstun nas rang gi khyad chos ldan par bya rgyu ni bod kyi gsar 'god pa rnams kyis bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i gnad don gal che zhing spyir btang ba zhig red/ gsum nas bcar 'dri'i sngon gyi shes bya'i gra sgrig la dang dod bya dgos/ 'brel yod ched las shes bya'i gra sgrig de shes bya'i blang bya cung mtho ba'i bcar 'dri'i rigs la mtshon na lhag par gal che/ gsar 'god pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas ched las shes bya yod do cog la byang chub pa dpe mi srid/ yin na'ang bcar 'dri las 'gan dang len byas rjes/ nges par du 'brel yod dpyad gzhi'i dpe cha bklags nas rmang gzhi'i shes bya kha shas khong du chud pa bya dgos/ gal te ched las shes bya'i gra sgrig nges can zhig med tshe/ bcar 'dri'i skabs su 'ben yod sar mda' 'phen pa lta bu'i 'dri tshig 'don mi thub par ma zad/ da dung rgyun shes rang bzhin gyi nor 'chug bzos nas gzhan gyis 'phya smod bya yul du 'gyur zhing / bcar 'dri bya yul yang khyod kyi shes rmongs kyis khyod dang kha brda byed 'dod kyi spro ba med pa dang yang na khyod dang kha brda bshad rgyu med par 'gyur nges/ de las ldog ste/ gal te gsar 'god pas 'brel yod ched las shes byar cung cha rgyus yod tshe/ bcar 'dri skabs su gnad la khel ba dang ngo bo mtshon nus la/ khyad chos dang ldan pa'i gnad don bton nas/ seng ge'i kha nas gser len pa ji bzhin bcar 'dri bya yul gyi kha nas rang gi bcar 'drir mkho ba'i rgyu cha dog 74

rdog lon nges/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i bya ba ni nam yang phyogs gcig dang gnyis min par/ spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so so dang las rigs rnam pa sna tshogs dang 'brel dgos pas/ bcar 'dri thengs re rer mkho ba'i ched las shes bya'ang rnam pa sna tshogs yin srid/ shes bya de dag khrod khyod la cha rgyus yod cing spro ba yod pa'i shes bya yod la/ khyod la cha rgyus med cing spro ba med pa'i shes bya yang yod nges/ yin yang bcar 'dri'i sngon la ched las shes bya klog pa ni rang la spro ba yod med kyi 'dod blor bstun pa min par bcar 'dri'i dgos dbang yin phyir/ gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri'i las 'gan dang du blangs rjes/ bcar 'dri thengs de'i nang don thad kyi ched las shes bya der rang la cha rgyus yod med dang spro ba yod med la mi lta bar nges par du nan tan gyis bklags nas khong du chud par bya dgos la/ rang la cha rgyus med cing spro ba med pa'i shes bya de dag kyang btsan gyis bklags nas dgos nges kyi rgyun shes khong du chud par bya dgos par ma zad/ rang la cha rgyus yod cing spro ba ldan pa'i shes bya'i rigs yin yang / bcar 'dri'i sngon la dmigs gtad yod pa'i ngang bskyar klog re byed pa'i dgos pa yod de/ nam rgyun rang gi shes par snyems pa'i shes bya mang po'i khrod du zhib lta ma 'dang ba'i skyon gyis rtag par mkho ba'i dus su mgo shes na rnga ma mi shes par tshad nges can gyi steng nas bcar 'dri bya ba legs 'grub 'byung bar gnod pa bzo srid/ rgyu cha gra sgrig bya rgyu ni bcar 'dri'i gra sgrig gi gom pa dang po red/ gsar 'god pa zhig gis rgyu cha 'tshol sdud dang gsog nyar bya rgyur do snang mi byed pa dang / yang na rgyu cha sdud gsog byed mi mkhas na/ gsar 'god pa de phul du byung ba'i gsar 'god pa zhig tu 'gyur mi srid/ bcar 'dri bya yul la rgyus lon bya rgyu ni 75

bcar 'dri'i gra sgrig gi nang don gal chen zhig red/ bcar 'drir legs 'grub 'byung min de mthar gtugs na gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri bya yul la bcar 'dri bya rgyur rag las pa red/ gal te gsar 'god pas thos shing 'tsham par bcar 'dri bya yul spro ba ldan zhing gleng mol byed 'dod pa dang rang gi bcar 'dri'i nang don dang 'brel ba'i gnad don bton tshe/ phyogs gnyis mas bde blag ngang gleng mol byed thub pa dang / gsar 'god pas kyang legs 'grub ngang rang la mkho ba'i gnas tshul rgyus lon byed thub/ gsar 'god pa rgan pa mang po'i nyams myong ltar na/ bcar 'dri'i sngon la nges par du bcar 'dri'i gleng gzhi dang bcar 'dri bya yul la sems zhib mos zhib 'jug bya dgos/ de ltar byas na/ da gzod khyod kyis 'os shing 'tsham pa'i dri ba 'don thub par ma zad/ pha rol pas khyod kyi dri ba'i don ha go ba dang / de min bcar 'dri bya yul la khyod ni ci yang mi shes par mgo g.yog thub pa zhig min pa ngang ngam shugs kyis shes su 'jug thub/ bcar 'drir legs 'grub 'byung dgos na/ ches gal che ba ni bcar 'dri gnad la khel min de yin pa dang /gnad la khel min de yang gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul la rgyus lon dang khong du chud pa'i tshad la thad kur rag las pa red/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul la pho mo dang lo tshod/ las rigs/ brgyud rim/ slob grwa'i brgyud rim/ ched las kyi khyad chos/ dga' phyogs/ gshis ga'i khyad chos/ de min bcar 'dri bya yul dang 'brel ba yod pa'i dpyad gzhi yig rigs sna tshogs bcas 'dus/ gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul 'di rigs la rgyus lon byas tshe/ da gzod bcar 'dri bya yul gyi sems khams sogs kyi khyad chos shes par byas te/ gang mgyogs sgos bcar 'dri bya yul 76

dang 'dris par byed thub/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri bya yul gyi mi sna'ang dpon po dang mkhas pa/ spyir btang gi mang tshogs bcas rnam pa sna tshogs yin pas gsar 'god pas nges par du de dag so so'i khams dang bstun nas bcar 'dri byed dgos/ bcar 'dri'i sngon la bcar 'dri bya yul gyi mi dang yang na bya dngos la rgyus lon nges can zhig bya dgos/ sgyu rtsal pa dang / rtsom pa po/ rig gnas mkhas pa sogs gang yin yang kho tsho'i ched las skor la cha rgyus ci yang med mkhan zhig la gleng mol bya dgos na/ de ni shin tu sun snang skye ba zhig yin pa smos ma dgos/ gal te bcar 'dri'i khrod/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis gsar 'god par kho tsho'i las rigs thad la cha rgyus yod pa shes na/kho tshor da gzod gsar 'god par gleng mol byed pa'i 'dun pa skye nges/ gal te ming grags mi sna zhig dang yang na dgung lo cung mtho ba'i rgan pa zhig la bcar 'dri byed skabs/ thog ma nyid nas khyed rang dgong lo du yin/ sa gang gi mi yin zhes pa sogs don dag tsag cig skor gcig gcig gnyis gnyis byas nas dris tshe/ bcar 'dri bya yul la sun snang bzos nas bde blag ngang bcar 'dri'i mjug skyong dka'/ de bas bcar 'dri'i sngon la bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gnas tshul la rgyus lon byas te/ sngon na 'dri gzhi gra sgrig gang legs bya dgos la/ 'dri gzhi'ang gnad la khel zhing mdor bsdus yin dgos/ de ltar byas na/ da gzod bcar 'dri bde blag ngang yongs 'grub byed thub/ der brten bcar 'dri'i sngon la bcar 'dri bya yul la rgyus lon gang legs byas tshe/nyung mtha' yang bzang cha gsum ldan pa ste/ gcig nas bcar 'dri'i dus yun je thung du btang nas bcar 'dri'i las chod mthor 'degs byed thub/gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri'i sngon la dus tshod mang po spyad de bcar 'dri bya 77

yul gyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul la rgyus lon gang legs byas tshe/ bcar 'dri byed skabs nges par du bcar 'dri bya yul rang nyid kyis bshad dgos pa'i gnas tshul dag dris na chog pa/sa/ bcar 'dri'i dus yun je thung du gtong thub pa dang / bcar 'dri'i las chod mthor 'degs byed thub/ gnyis nas bcar 'dri bya yul dang 'dris sla/ gal te gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri bya yul gyi rgyab ljongs gnas tshul shes na/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gshis ka dang dga' phyogs ltar 'dri gzhi bkod sgrig byas chog nang sgos su 'dri gzhi dang po shin tu gal che ba ste/ khyod kyi thog ma'i 'dri gzhis bcar 'dri bya yul la snying nye ba dang yang na ya mtshar ba sogs kyi tshor ba bskyed nas khyod dang mu mthud du gleng mol byed pa'i spro ba bskyed dgos/ gsum nas sems su gdeng tshod yod dgos/ sngon na khong du chud pa'i gnas tshul ji ltar mang na de ltar 'dri gzhi legs po 'don thub/ gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri'i sngon la rgyus lon byas pa bzang na/ snga mo nas bcar 'dri'i gnad sa gtan khel byas te/ 'ben yod sar mda' 'phen pa lta bu'i 'dri gzhi bton chog 'dri tshig gra sgrig bya rgyu ni bcar 'dri'i gra sgrig gi ches gnad 'gag red/gong du bshad pa'i gra sgrig de thams cad mthar gtugs na 'dri gzhi la gra sgrig byas pa zhig red/ 'dri gzhi'i gra sgrig zer ba de yang gsal por bshad na bcar 'dri'i sngon la gra sgrig byas pa'i bcar 'dri'i brjod bya hril bo'i dkar chag lta bu yin zhing / de ni bcar 'dri'i gra sgrig khrod snang med byed mi rung ba'i ches mtha' ma'i lhu tshigs red/ gsar 'god pa grags can mang pos sngon na 'dri gzhi mang po gra sgrig byas nas bcar 'dri dngos kyi khrod 'dri gzhi bcu re bkol tshe/ sngon na ma mtha' yang 'dri gzhi sum cu gra sgrig 78

byed srid/ 'dri tshig gra sgrig legs po byas na/ bcar 'dri'i khrod gsham gyi gnas tshul mi 'byung ba byed thub pa ste/ bcar 'dri byed skabs/ bcar 'dri bya yul la rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis bcar 'dri'i gleng mor spro ba skyes pa dang yang na rang 'gul gyis bcar 'dri'i dus yun je ring du gtong ba/gsar 'god par rgyus lon byed 'dod pa'i gnas tshul sngar las mang po 'don sprod byed 'dod pa sogs kyi gnas tshul dang 'phrad srid/ gal te gsar 'bod pas sngon la 'dri gzhi gra sgrig gang legs byas yod tshe/ go skabs der bstun nas gting zab ngang bcar 'dri byas te/ sngar las mang zhing sngar las rin thang ldan pa'i don dngos shes thub/ yin na'ang gsar 'god pas gra sgrig gang legs byas med tshe/ 'dri tshig sngar las mang po 'dri ba'i go skabs thob kyang gra sgrig gang legs ma byas pa'i rkyen gyis 'dri rgyu med pa dang 'dri mi shes par go skabs bzang bo kha nas thob kyang sna nas shor te/ 'gyod pa'i gzhi mar 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul mi 'byung ba dang gcig spyir btang gi 'dri tshig zhig la lan yang spyir btang ba zhig las mi 'ong / gal te gsar 'god pas dri ba mdor spyi tsam zhig bton tshe/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis kyang lan mdor tsam las 'debs mi srid cing / bcar 'dri'ang gting zab par spel mi thub/gal te sngon na bsam blo zhib mo btang ste gang gang 'dri dgos pa de re re bzhin 'dri tshig nges gtan byas nas gra sgrig legs po byas tshe/ las sla mor bcar 'dri'i gnad la 'khel bar byas nas dri ba 'dom gang la 'bras bu mtho gang las mi thob pa'i gnad don mi 'byung ba dang gnyis/ gal te sngon la bsam blo zhib mo btang ste/ 'dri tshig gang dag ni gnad 'gag yin phyir/nges par du bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lan 'debs dgos pa dang 'dri tshig gang 79

dag ni phal ba yin pa gsal po ma byas tshe/ bcar 'dri byed skabs gtso phal gyi dbye ba mi gsal bar bcar 'dri mang po byas kyang / don med chu zos su 'gro nges pas bcar 'dri byed thengs rer sngon na 'dri tshig gtan khel gsal po byas na/ bcar 'dri'i dmigs gtad rang bzhin je drag tu btang nas bcar 'dri'i las chod je mthor gtong thub/ dus mtshungs su bcar 'dri byed skabs dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'dri tshig la bltas te gnad don gal chen gyi skor chad lhag byung yod med la lta zhib byas nas sa stong la bo'u stong 'phen pa'i gnad don mi 'byung ba dang gsum/ bcar 'dri byed skabs gnas tshul gang dang ji lta bu 'byung ba ni/ gsar 'god pas sngon dpag byed dka'/yin na'ang nyams myong yod pa'i gsar 'god pas rtag par bcar 'dri khrod 'byung srid pa'i dka' ngal dang dka' ngal de dag sel thabs la bsam blo gtong nges/ dper na/ gnad don gcig la 'dri tshig 'dri stangs mi 'dra ba 'ga' re gra sgrig byas tshe/ bcar 'dri'i skabs su bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lan 'debs mi 'dod pa dang lan 'debs mi nus pa dang 'phrad dus/ 'dri stangs gzhan bkol te bskor nas dmigs yul 'grub par byed chog gal te sngon la gra sgrig gang legs byas med tshe/ gnas tshul 'di rigs la 'phrad dus ci bya gtol med du gyur nas/ bcar 'dri'i mjug skyong mi thub/ skabs 'gar bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lan btab pa des gsar 'god pa sngar las nang don ldan pa'i phyogs su khrid kyang srid/ de dus gsar 'god pas myur du de dang mthun pa'i 'dri tshig 'don thub dgos/ yin na'ang sngon na gra sgrig gang legs byas med tshe/ de ma thag nas 'dri gzhi legs po 'don mi thub/ skabs 'gar bcar 'dri bya yul bshad mkhas po zhig dang phrad tshe/ khyod kyi 'dri tshig 80

gcig la lan gang mang mang 'debs pa dang tha na khyod kyi 'dri gzhi las brgal srid/ skabs der gsar 'bod pas thabs mkhas ngang dus thog tu bcar 'dri bya yul gyi tshig sne 'dri gzhi'i steng khrid nas bcar 'dri hril bor tshod 'dzin byed mkhas po byed dgos/ gsar 'god pas gra sgrig byas pa mi 'dang ba dang sems su gdeng tshod med tshe/ rtag par bcar 'dri bya yul gyis chu bzhur ba bzhin bshad dus ji ltar mtshams gcod dgos pa mi shes pa dang / yang na tshig sne phyir 'gug mi mkhas par yongs su bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha'i rjes 'brangs nas blun po chu sna gar khrid kyi rnam thar skyong ba sogs tshod 'dzin byed mi thub pa'i gnad don mi 'byung ba dang bzhi bcas red/ 'dri tshig la gra sgrig byed pa de bcar 'dri bde blag yong ba shin du gal che bar ma zad/ ha cang dgos nges zhig kyang yin/ nga tshos rtag par gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'drir legs 'grub byung ba'i skabs thung ngu de tsam mthong ba las/ bcar 'dri'i phugs kyi brtson pa thams cad mthong mi thub/ don dam pas bcar 'dri dngos ni rtag par dus thung ngu tsam gyi ring yin mod/ dus yun thung ngu 'di'i ched du bkol ba'i dus tshod dang sems shugs ni nyung nyung zhig gtan nas yin mi srid/ 'di ni gsar 'god pa yod do cog gis sems la 'dzin 'os/3 'dri tshig gi rtsa ba'i blang bya/bcar 'dri ni gsar 'gyur sde khag gi gsar 'gyur sogs le tshan 'god thabs gal chen yin la/ dri ba 'don pa ni bcar 'dri'i thabs rtsal gtso gal che ba zhig red/ de yang bye brag tu bshad na/ dri ba 'don pa ni gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyis gnad don 'dri ba'i rnam pa la brten nas rgyu cha 'tshol ba dang don dngos kyi brdar sha gcod pa'i bcar 'dri byed stangs 81

rigs shig yin pa dang / gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri'i rnam pa gtso bo yin la/ bcar 'dri hril bo legs 'grub 'byung min gyi gnad 'gag kyang yin/gsar 'god pa mang po'i lta tshul la gsar 'god pa ni gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan zhig red ces brjod pa las/ gsar 'gyur 'dri mkhan zhig red ces brjod na 'os/ mi la las bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na/ gsar 'god pa'i brtsams chos kyi brgya cha'i brgyad cu yan gyi rgyu cha ni bcar 'dri bya yul la dris nas thob pa red/ de las dri ba 'don pa yis bcar 'dri'i khrod go gnas ga 'dra bzung yod pa rtogs thub/ bcar 'dri bya yul ni rnam pa sna tshogs red/bshad 'dod mkhan yod la bshad mi 'dod mkhan yang yod pa dang / bshad mkhas pa yod la bshad mi mkhas pa yang yod cing / bshad thub kyang gnad la mi 'khel ba dang bshad 'dod kyang bden rdzun 'dres pa/ bshad 'dod kyang skrag nas bshad mi phod pa sogs rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ rtog 'dzing che ba'i gnas tshul mdun du gsar 'god pas zwa re la lde mig re gra sgrig bya rgyu de las sla mo zhig ga la yin/ dri ba 'don pa ni gsar 'god pa'i dbye 'byed nus pa dang bsam gzhig nus pa/ skad cha'i bshad rtsal/ bab bstun nus pa sogs 'jal byed kyi rgya ma lta bu yin zhing / gsar 'god pa'i rtsa ba'i mthu nus gas kyi gcig red/ phul du byung ba'i gsar 'god pa zhig yin tshe/ nges par du 'dri mkhas po zhig yin dgos te/ dri ba 'phen pa'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas/bcar 'dri bya yul gyi kha nas 'brel yod rgyu cha gser len pa bzhin ma lus par phyir len thub/ thog mar gsar 'gyur las rigs la zhugs mkhan zhig yin na/ bcar 'dri bde blag ngang 'grub par khag theg byed ched/ nges par du dri ba 'don pa'i rtsa ba'i blang bya kha shas la rgyus lon dang gzhi rtsa'i mthu rtsal 82

kha shas khong du chud pa bya dgos/'dri tshig 'os 'tsham yin dgos pa dang 'dri stangs bag lhod yin dgos pa dang gcig dri ba 'don pa'i dmigs yul ni cig shos kyi ram 'degs thob nas rgyu cha 'thob pa'i ched du yin/ de ni dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du phyogs gnyis ku'i gleng mol gyi rnam pa zhig yin phyir/ bag lhod kyi kha brda'i khor yug cig bskrun dgos/ des na gsar 'god pa'i rnam 'gyur ni shin tu gal che ba red/ dri ba 'phen dus/ thog ma nyid nas dza drag gi gnad don thad kur dris na/ bcar 'dri rnam pa yang dza drag can du gyur nas bcar 'dri bde blag ngang byed dka' ba dang yang na bcar 'dri bya yul la dogs snang dang 'tshub snang sbyin nas bcar 'dri'i rgyun skyong dka'/ spyir btang du 'dri tshig 'dri dus ngo shes shig la kha brda dang gleng mol byed pa'i tshul gyis dri ba dris lan byas nas rang gis 'dri 'dod pa'i 'dri gzhi de phan tshun gleng mol khrod du bshad zhor dang 'dri zhor byas na/ bcar 'dri bya yul la dogs snang dang 'tshub snang med par lhug por brjod thub la/ bcar 'dri'ang bag lhod kyi rnam pa'i khrod du gting zab tu phyin nas phan 'bras bzang po len thub/ do snang bya dgos pa ni/ dri ba 'phen dus dpon nyams dang che tshugs btod pa dang yang na dge rgan gyis slob mar 'dri tshig 'don pa lta bu gtan nas byed mi rung / de ltar byas tshe bcar 'dri bya yul la 'tshub snang ngam sun snang bzos nas lan 'debs mi 'dod pa'am yang na lan 'debs mi nus/'dri tshig gi nang don che mi 'os pa dang gnyis/ bcar 'dri byed skabs gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan mang pos 'dri tshig 'dri dus/ 'dri tshig gi nang don khyab che drags pa ste/ dper na/ bod kyi rig gnas mkhas pa zhig la 83

bcar 'dri byed par mtshon na/ 'dri tshig la bye brag gi nang don rdog dog cig 'dri rgyu med par/ rtag par khyod kyis bod kyi rig gnas skor rags tsam brjod na ji 'dra red ces dang / yang na khyod la bod kyi rig gnas thad la tshor ba ga 'dra yod ces spyi bshad tsam gyi 'dri tshig 'di 'dra dris na mkhas pa chen mo yin yang / re zhig la gang nas brjod dgos pa mi shes pa dang kha gdangs pa tsam gyis bod kyi rig gnas ni 'di'o zhes tshig 'ga' res rdog rdog cig ston nus mkhan ni su yod/ de bzhin bcar 'dri'i nang don dang bya 'gul gang dang gang yin yang spyi bshad tsam gyi 'dri tshig dris tshe/ de la lan yang spyi tsam las mi thebs phyir/ 'dri gzhi ji 'dra chen po zhig yin yang / de bye brag tu dbye nas nang don phran bu dang bye brag nas dris na/ lan 'debs mkhan la'ang bye brag gi lan 'debs rgyu yod pas bcar 'drir nang don dang khyad chos ldan pa red/'dri tshig gsal zhing tshig nyog yod mi 'os pa dang gsum/ gsar 'god pas 'dri tshig la bsam blo gtong dus ci nus kyis 'dri tshig gsal zhing mdor bsdus pa bya dgos/ gal te 'dri tshig ring zhing tshig nyog mang tshe/bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lan 'debs par gnod pa yod/ rgyu mtshan ni mi'i yid 'dzin la tshad yod pa dang nang sgos su bcar 'dri bya yul la mtshon na/ji 'dra'i gdeng tshod yod pa dang ji 'dra'i bag lhod yin yang / kho tsho'i sems su gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri ni mthar gtugs na spyir btang gi kha brda dang yongs su mtshungs pa zhig gtan nas min par su dang su yin yang 'tshub snang dang dza drag gi tshor ba zhig dbang med du skye nges/ lhag par du rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyis bcar 'dri byed skabs/ brnyan len 'phrul chas dang 84

skad dung sogs bcar 'dri yo byad sna tshogs nag mdongs se mdun nas gdong la gtad tshe/ 'tshub snang mi skye mkhan shin tu nyung / de dus gsar 'god pa'i 'dri tshig ring drags na/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis rtag par tshig rnga bzung na tshig mgo brjed nas khyod kyis yang snying ci zhig 'dri 'dod pa mi shes la/ lan ji ltar 'debs dgos pa'ang mi shes/ 'dri tshig ring drags pas bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lan gnad la mi 'khel ba'i gnas tshul ni nga tsho'i gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri khrod rgyun du mthong thub pa zhig red/ der brten gsar 'god pa'i 'dri tshig thung zhing mdor bsdus yin dgos shing / 'dri tshig gcig tshig gcig gis tshar ba dang tshig gcig re gcig re bzhin dris na rab yin/'dri tshig la nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyi 'du shes yod dgos pa dang bzhi/ bcar 'dri'i mthar thug gi dmigs yul ni/ gsar 'gyur bya dngos kyi don ngo ma nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la brgyud bsgrags bya rgyu de red/ gsar 'god pas 'dri tshig 'dri dus/ nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la bsam blo btang ste/ gang dag ni kho tshos do khur byed pa dang shes 'dod pa/ shes dgos pa bcas kyi gnad don yin par bsam gzhig gtong dgos/ gsar 'grod pa ni phyogs gcig nas dril bsgrags sde khag gi tshab byed yin la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas lta mkhan dang nyan mkhan gyi tshab byed yin pas/ dri ba 'don dus lta mkhan dang nyan mkhan gyi dang len nus pa dang goms srol sogs la bsam blo btang nas kho tshos dang len byed sla zhing go sla ba'i skad cha dang byed stangs bkol dgos/'dri tshig la go rim ldan dgos pa dang lnga/ spyir btang gi bcar 'dri 85

bya yul la mtshon na/ thos ma nyid nas 'dri tshig nan mo dris na/ 'tshub snang skyes srid/ de bas 'dri tshig gi go rim la bkod sgrig zhib mo byas te/ thog mar phyogs gnyis kur cha rgyus yod pa'i spyir btang gi kha brda byas nas rim gyis gnad don ngo ma dang dri bya'i nang don skor dris tshe/ lan ngo ma dang lan bzang po lhugs por 'thob srid/ nga tsho bod skad rlung 'phrin dang bod skad brnyan 'phrin/ bod yig tshags par sogs gang yin yang gsar 'gyur sogs le tshan gyi yong khungs mang che ba ni gzhi rim gyi zhing phyugs las sa khul yin la/bcar 'dri bya yul mang che ba'ang las rigs so so'i rgya che'i bod rigs mi sna red/ bcar 'dri'i khrod du gnas tshul rnam pa sna tshogs la 'phrad srid pas gsar 'god pa dag gis bcar 'dri'i khrod thabs rtsal sna tshogs la byang bar bya dgos/ nam rgyun nga tsho rgyun du 'phrad pa ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bcar 'dri yo byad mdun nas gtad dus bcar 'dri bya yul la spobs pa med pa dang 'tshub snang skyes nas bshad mi thub pa dang nang sgos su lan maso ma 'debs dus 'tshub cha langs nas lhod la 'bab mi thub pa de red/ dper na/nga tshos thengs shig la gzhi rim gyi ri sde chung chung zhig tu rgyang bsgrags brnyan 'phrin sde ba re rer slebs pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul brnyan phab byed skabs/ le tshan gyis dgos dbang gis khyim tshang cung dbul bo zhig gi bu mor bcar 'dri byas/ dngos su bcar 'dri ma byas gong gsar 'god pa'ang bud med cig yin pa'i rkyen gyis bu mo der myur mor 'dris nas yar mar kha brda lhug por byas byung / yin yang brnyan len 'phrul chas gtad de dngos su 'dri dus kho mo shin tu 'tshub nas tshig gcig kyang bshad ma thub/ de nas gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri mtshams bzhag khul byas te/ mo tshang gi khang bar lta bzhin khyod 86

tshang gi khang ba shin tu yag gi nam tshod las pa yin/ khyod cho'i sde ba'i khyim tshang phal che ba'i khang ba gsar ba las yo da dam zhes dal mor kha brda byas pa na/ kho mos kyang lhod sha ldan pa dang spyir btang gi kha brda byed pa'i gsar 'god pa ra ce rer bltas pa dang rang tshang gi khang bar ce rer bltas rjes 'tshub cha las bkrol nas gsar 'god par lan btab byung / de mur gsar 'god pas tshig sne 'dri gzhi'i steng khrid nas dris pa na/ kho mos kyang 'tshub snang med par re re bzhin lan 'debs thub song / brnyan len 'phrul chas khur ba'i gsar 'god pas kyang snga mo nas kho mo dang gsar 'god pa'i kha brda byed tshul brnyan len byas zin/ 'di ni las ku'i khrod du chags pa'i las grogs bar gyi 'dris cha zhig yin la/ 'dris cha 'di lta bu ni bcar 'dri bya ba'i khrod shin tu gal che ba ste/ 'dris cha 'di lta bu yod tshe/ nam rgyun bcar 'dri'i khrod las grogs phan tshun bar skad cha bshad mi dgos par rnam 'gyur zhig dang mig ltos tsam/ lag brda zhig gis phan tshun gyi bsam tshul shes nas ram 'degs legs po byas te/ bcar 'dri bde blag ngang byed thub/ de yang nang don sogs phyogs gang nas bshad na'ang 'di ni shin tu gal che zhing dpe mtshon rang bzhin gyi bcar 'dri zhig tu brtsi mi rung mod/ yin yang 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul ni bcar 'dri bya 'gul che chung gang du'ang rgyun du 'byung bas na/ gsar 'god pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas gnas tshul 'di rigs la kha ya byed pa'i thabs rtsal la byang dgos/4 gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i zin bris dang rgyu cha sdud gsog gi skor/tshan rtsal dar rgyas song ba dang bstun nas zin bris 'debs pa'i 87

thabs kyang nyin re las nyin rer deng rabs can du 'gyur bzhin yod/ yin na'ang yig thor 'god pa ni sngar bzhin bcar 'dri bya ba'i khrod kyi stabs bde zhing phan 'bras ldan pa'i byed thabs shig red/ bcar 'dri'i yig tho ni gsar 'god pa'i rgyu nor rtsa chen yin zhes bshad chog gsar 'god pa'i yig tho ni gtso bo bcar 'dri bya ba'i zin bris dngos ma yin te/ spyir btang du bcar 'dri bya yul gyi ming dang las rigs/ bya 'gul/ skad rigs/ don rkyen byung ba'i sa cha dang khor yug rgyab ljongs sogs zin bris 'debs pa yin/bcar 'dri yig tho de spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og ha cang cha tshang ba dang go rim can zhig yin mi srid/ de bas bcar 'dri mjug rdzogs rjes legs sgrig dang rigs bgar/ kha snon bcas bya dgos te/ dper na/ bcar 'dri'i khrod cung gal che bar snyam pa dang gal mi che ba dang nor 'khrul yin pa/ brdar sha mi chod pa dang dogs gzhi yod pa rnams la so sor rtags mi 'dra ba re rgyag pa dang kha snon bya dgos pa rnams la kha snon bcas bya dgos/ 'di ltar bsam gzhig btang ba dang las snon byas na/ rgyu cha rnams rim bzhin legs sgrig byas nas thog ma'i ma yig tu 'gyur thub/ der brten bcar 'dri yig tho legs sgrig byed pa ni bcar 'dri dang brtsams chos 'bri ba'i bar gyi go rim zhig yin la/ bcar 'dri cha tshang bar byed pa dang gsar 'gyur ma yig 'bri ba'i gra sgrig yin zhing / gsar 'gyur 'god pa'i rmang gzhi dang sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yang red/bcar 'dri yig tho legs sgrig byed pa'i gal chen rang bzhin/ gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri dang yig tho 'debs skabs/ dus tshod kyis dbang gis rtag par yi ge rgyug bris 'bri ba'i mi tshad/ skong yig dang tshig skong yang shin 88

tu mang la/ tha na rang kho nas ma gtogs mi shes pa'i rtags sna tshogs kyang yod srid/ de min da dung bris pa nor ba dang nang don rab rib kyi tshig kyang yod phyir/ zin bris btab pa'i rgyu cha yod do cog la dus thog tu legs sgrig dang dpyad zhib dag bcos byed pa ni shin tu dgos gal che ba'i bya ba zhig red/ mi su zhig yin yang / don dag brjed pa'i gnas tshul 'byung nges/ de yang bcar 'dri byas rjes myur du yig tho legs sgrig byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo red/ bcar 'dri byed skabs dus tshod sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis gtso bo dag yig thor 'god pa dang don dag la la yid la 'dzin dbos/ mi yi yid 'dzin ni dus yun dang grangs tshad sogs kyi thad la tshad med pa zhig min par brjed nges kyi sems khams chos nyid ni ri yi la thur nang bzhin thog ma'i skabs su shin tu mgyogs pa ste/ sems la bzung ba'i don dag dang ngos bzung ba'i bya dngos dag dus yun thung ngu'i nang myur du brjed pa'i snang tshul 'byung nges/ skabs der sngon la yid 'dzin byas pa'i bya dngos mang po brjed pa dang yid 'dzin gyi grangs la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po 'byung srid/ dper na/bcar 'dri byed skabs yid la bzung ba rnams mang shas yongs su brjed pa dang yang na kha shas brjed 'gro/ rang gis bris pa'i yig tho yang la la rgyug bris byas drags pas rang gis kyang ngos mi zin pa dang la la zhig ci la bstan pa mi shes pa dang yang na bcar 'dri byed skabs cha tshang du shes kyang rabs 'bri byas drags pas dus yun zhig 'gor rjes sems la bzung ba rnams brjed nas cha tshang zhig mi shes pa sogs kyi gnas tshul 'byung / de bas bcar 'dri'i khrod/ gsar 'god pas yig thor bris pa rnams las gzhan/ da dung yid 'dzin byas pa dang yang na yig bris dang yid 'dzin ma byas par lus pa'i 89

rgyu cha'ang yod pas na/ bcar 'dri'i rjes su dus thog tu kha gsab bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che/ dus yun 'gor na yid 'dzin nyams nas legs sgrig dang kha gsab bya 'dod kyang byed dka' ba red/ de min da dung mnyam 'jog dgos pa zhig ni/ mi yi yid 'dzin gyi grangs tshad la 'gyur ldog 'byung ba'i dus mtshungs su yid 'dzin gyi ngo bor yang 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin yod la/ yid 'dzin gyi ngo bor 'gyur ldog 'byung ba de ni brjed nges kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo red/spyir btang du bshad na mi yis gsar du nges shes byas pa'i bya dngos de yid 'dzin gyi thad nas bshad na cha tshang hril bo zhig yin/ yin na'ang dus 'gor 'gyangs byas pa dang bstun nas yid 'dzin gyi nang don rim bzhin chad lhag byung nas kha thor du 'gyur/ gal te kha thor gyur pa de dag gi chad lhag yang bskyar yid 'dzin la brten nas kha skong dgos tshe/ nges par du klad pa'i nang bi sngon chad kyi nyams myong la brten dgos/ de ltar kha skong byas pa'i bya dngos kyi ngo bor tshad mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog 'byung ba ste/ gzhi nas yod pa'i bya dngos ngo ma de dang 'dra mtshungs shig gtan nas yin mi srid/ de yang dpe zhig bzhag na/ mi zhig la khos sngon chad thos pa'i gtam rgyud cig yang bskyar gzhan la bshad du bcug tshe/ gtam rgyud kyi brgyud rim dang nang don gtso bo kho'i yid du yod cing / gzhan la bshad dus zhib phra'i steng nas khos rang la sgoms pa'i nyams myong la brten nas yid du 'dzin ma thub pa'i gtam rgyud kyi chad lhag la kha skong byed pa ni ldog tu med pa zhig red/ der brten khos bskyar bshad byas pa'i gtam rgyud de ring thung dang mi yi ming dang sa ming sogs kyi thad 'gyur ldog dang chad lhag byung ba dang gtam rgyud khrod kyi sngar gyi skad cha yang kho'i kha lce bde min ltar 'gyur ldog 'byung srid/ gsar 'god 90

nga sa bcar 'dri byed mtshams 'jog thengs rer de ma thag yig thor bkod pa dang yid du bzung ba'i rgyu cha thams cad yig thog nas kha byang bsgrigs pa dang rigs bsar nas legs sgrig bya dgos/ de ltar byas tshe bcar 'dri yig tho'i steng nas bcar 'dri'i bya dngos dang bcar 'dri'i bya 'gul hril bo yang dag pa dang cha tshang la ji ma ji bzhin du mtshon thub/ dus yun cung 'gor 'gyangs byas rjes brjed nas cha mi tshang bar 'gyur srid/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri byas pa'i nang don legs sgrig dang kha gsab byas rjes/ skabs de'i gsar 'gyur khrod du bkol thub par ma zad/ gsar 'god pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i gsog nyar du gyur nas rjes phyogs su gsar 'gyur sogs le tshan spel skabs nang don dang bsam gzhig phun tshogs su gtong bar dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed nges/ phyogs so so dang thengs re rer btus pa'i gsar 'gyur rgyu cha'i thigs pa 'di rigs phyogs bsdus byas tshe/ tha na rtsom dang dpe cha 'bri ba'i rgyu cha gal chen du 'gyur yang srid/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi sasar 'god pa grags can mang pos rang gi lo mang ring gi bcar 'dri yig tho legs sgrig byas nas brtsams chos dpe cha grags can gang mang bris/bcar 'dri yig tho ji ltar legs sgrig bya dgos she na/ gcig nas rang gis bcar 'dri khrod bris pa'i yig tho mgo nas mjug bar zhib tu lta ba dang bcar 'dri'i go rim hril bor phyir 'dang brgyab nas yid la bzung ba'i nang don thams cad myur du de dang 'brel ba'i rgyu cha'i bar du kha gsab byas nas 'bri dgos par ma zad/ yig thor bkod pa'i yi ge mi gsal ba dang nang don cha mi tshang ba rnams dag bcos byas nas phyis su nam bltas kyang klog bde zhing go sla ba/ cha tshang ba zhig tu gtong dgos/ gnyis nas rgyu cha'i cha 'phrin gyi 91

bden rdzun la dbye zhib byas nas bkol sa med pa'i rgyu cha rnams 'dor dgos/bcar 'dri skabs su brel ba che ba dang dus tshod thung phyir/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis rang dgar ngang bshad pa thams cad bden pa bden drang yin pa'i nges pa med pa dang / gsar 'god pa'i skabs der gnad don la brtags pa thams cad kyang ha cang yang dag pa'i nges pa med/ der brten bcar 'dri'i rjes su sems zhib mos phyir dran dang nan tan gyis brtag dpyad btang nas/dogs gzhi yod pa'i rgyu char rtags brgyab nas stabs 'grig pa'i dus su tho gtug pa dang / gong 'og la 'gal ba yod pa'i nor 'khrul dang yi ge'i nor 'chug rnams dag bcos bya dgos/ zhib dag nan mo byas rjes bden pa bden drang min pa dang bkol sa dang rin thang ci yang med pa rnams 'dor ba dang / bkol rin yod pa'i rgyu cha'i 'gram du rtags gsal po zhig brgyab na legs/ gsum nas rgyab ljongs skor gyi gnas tshul dang gsar 'gyur don dngos gnyis bgar dgos/ bshad mkhan gyi goms phyogs kyis mi mang pos rtag par don dngos dang don gyi rgyab ljongs gnyis mnyam du bsres nas bshad pa yin/ gal te rgyab ljongs skor gyi gnas tshul logs su bkar tshe/bsam gzhig gtong ba dang gsar 'gyur 'bri dus 'dor len byed par phan pa yod/ bzhi nas gsar 'gyur gyi brjod bya gtso bo'i dgos dbang ltar rgyu cha'i rigs bgar nas/ nang don dang mtshon bya mi mtshungs pa ltar rigs dbye na gsar 'gyur 'bri dus nang don phan tshun mi nyog par phan pa red/brtag dpyad bcar 'dri che ba'i rigs kyi skabs su bcar 'dri'i rgyu cha rnam pa sna tshogs yin pa dang nang don mang po 'dus phyir/ rigs bgar rgyu de lhag par gal che/ dper na/ sa cha zhig nas phyogs bsdus gsar 'gyur spel dus 92

dpal 'byor gyi skor rigs gcig tu bgar ba dang slob gso dang tshan rig rig gnas kyi skor rigs gcig tu bgar ba/ 'go khrid tshan khag gi srog shing nus pa'i skor rigs gcig du bgar nas yig thor bkod na/ bcar 'dri'i rjes nas gsar gyur dngos su spel dus go rim gsal ba dang bsam gzhig gtong ba dang go rim la phyir dran byed par stabs bde la 'bri sla/ lnga nas go rim sgrib dgos/ bcar 'dri'i yig tho khrod brjod bya gcig gi rgyu cha shin tu mang na/ go rim bsgrigs nas bkol bar stabs bde bzo dgos/ bo rim sgrig rgyu de yang gsar 'gyur don dngos kyi gal che chung ltar sgrig chog cing / rgyab ljongs gnas tshul 'dus pa'i rgyu cha yod do cog dang gsar 'gyur don dngos tshang ma dus yun gyi go rim nges can ltar sgrig na'ang chog byed thabs 'di rigs gsar 'gyur rgyu cha gdam gses byed par shin tu phan no/ /rgyu cha lhag ma'i rigs nyar tshags byed pa/ gsar 'gyur ni rtag par brjod bya gcig las ma 'dus par bcar 'dri dang rgyu cha sdud pa ngang 'tshol ba tshang ma brjod bya gtso bo gcig btso sbyang byed pa'i ched du yin pas na/ bcar 'dri'i khrod bsdus pa'i rgyu cha kha shas gnas skabs su bkol mi thub/ dus der gsar 'god pas rgyu cha 'di rigs sdud gsog dang nyar tshags byed shes pa dang byed mkhas par byas nas/ phyis su bkol bar gra sgrig dang stabs bde bzo dgos/ gsar 'gyur rgyu cha sdud gsog byas na/ gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri dang gsar 'gyur spel bar rgyab ljongs skor gyi rgyu cha 'don sprod byas nas gsar 'god par 'das song la rgyus lon dang mig snga'i gnas tshul rtogs pa/ma 'ongs par sngon dpag bcas byed par rogs byed thub la/ gsar 'god pas sdud gsog byas pa'i rgyu cha'i khrod nas gsar 'gyur gyi khungs sne rnyed pa 93

dang bcar 'dri'i nang don phun tshogs su gtong bar phan la/ gsar 'gyur gyi nang don gsar zhing gting zab par dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed thub/ de yang rgyu cha sdud gsog bya rgyu de yang rgyu cha sdud gsog gi gal chen rang bzhin dang rgyu cha sdud gsog byed thabs te phyogs gnyis nas bshad 'os/ rgyu cha sdud gsog byed pa'i gal chen rang bzhin nas bshad na/ nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i gsar 'god pa rgan pa mang po gnas tshul gang mang la cha rgyus yod cing / gsar 'gyur khungs sne mang la/ shes bya'i rgya yangs/ de ni kho tshos dus rgyun bya ba'i khrod du rgyu cha sdud gsog bya rgyur do snang byas pa legs par rag las pa smos ma dgos/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi gsar 'god pa grags can mang po'i nyams myong las bltas na/ rgyu cha sdud gsog byed pa'i gnad 'gag ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyun 'khyongs bya rgyu de red/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyun 'khyongs bya rgyu de yang las sla mo zhig min/ don dag che chung ci zhig bsgrub kyang thengs gcig thengs gnyis dang nyin gcig nyin gnyis la bsgrub rgyu cung sla mod/ dus yun ring bor rgyun 'khyongs bya rgyu ni shin tu dka' bas/nges par du snying rus chen por brten dgos/ nang sgos su da lta'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las rigs la mtshon na/ sgra dang brnyan gzugs phab pa'i deng rabs can gyi 'phrul chas kyis gsar 'gyur spel ba dang gsar 'gyur spel mkhan la shin tu stabs bde bzos pa'i dus mtshungs su gsar 'god pa rnams kyi le lo'ang sngar las lhag par bskyed sring byas nas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu rgyu cha sdud gsog byed pa phar zhog tha na thengs re'i bcar 'dri'i rgyu cha yig thor mi 'god mkhan yang yod pa red/ der brten shin tu stabs bde ba'i deng rabs can gyi bcar 'dri yo byad bkol ba'i dus su yig thog gi rgyu 94

cha sdud gsog bya rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byed par nges par du sngar las lhag pa'i snying rus chen po bskyed dgos/ rgyu cha sdud gsog byed dus/ skabs la lar rgyu cha thor bu rnams kyis de 'dra go mi chod pa 'dra mod/ yin yang de'i rigs kyi rgyu cha mang po dus yun ring bor sdud gsog byas na/ dus nam zhig la bkol sa chen po yod nges/ gal te khyod kyis rgyu cha thor bu rnams mnyam gcig tu nyar tshags byed mi mkhas par mkho med du dor nas gsog 'jog ci yang ma byas na/dus nam zhig gi tshe khyod la rgyu cha de'i rigs mkho skabs sems la 'gyod pa dang yid phangs pa las mi 'ong / gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan zhig la mtshon na/rgyu cha nyar tshags dang sdud gsog byed pa'i 'du shes ni shin tu rtsa che ba zhig red/ 'o na rgyu cha ji ltar sdud gsog bya dgos pa dang rgyu cha sdud gsog byed thabs gang dag yod ce na/ bcar 'dri'i nyin tho 'bri ba dang bcar 'dri'i yig tho 'god pa ni rgyu cha sdud gsog byed pa'i byed thabs ches gal chen zhig red/ gsar 'god pa'i bcar 'dri la da lta sgra phab pa dang brnyan ris len pa sogs deng rabs can gyi yo byad mang po yod mod/ yin yang 'bri deb ni sngar bzhin rgyu cha sdud gsog byed pa'i yo byad ches stabs bde zhing ches go chod pa zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan ni de 'khyer bde bas/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'tsho ba'i khrod byung ba'i rin thang ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur yod tshad zin bris su btab chog zin bris 'debs pa'i 'bri deb kyang rigs bgar na legs/ dper na/bcar 'dri brgyud nas thob pa dang rgyab ljongs skor gyi rgyu cha/ skabs re re'i dril bsgrags kha phyogs skor/ de min 'tsho ba'i thad kyi rgyu cha bcas so sor zin bris 'debs pa'i 'bri deb dgos pa red/ rgya yig dang rgya skad kyi gsar 'god pa rgan pa mang pos zin bris 'di rigs btab pa legs shing / dus 95
