skabs so so'i zin bris 'bri deb tshang ma nyar tshags byas pa ha cang legs te/lo ngo bcu phrag 'ga'i yar sngon gyi don dag yin yang zin bris kyi kha phye ba na/'das pa'i don bya thams cad re re bzhin mig lam du 'char 'ong / rgya'i gsar 'god pa grags can mang pos dus yun ring bo'i bcar 'dri'i khrod/thengs re re'i gsar 'gyur brjod bya kho nas ma tshad/ song sa bsdad sa nas tshor snang bag chags dang ri lung yul ljongs/ gtam sgrung ngag rgyun/ mi sna dang sa gnas kyi goms srol/ skabs thog gi byung ba sna tshogs sogs mig gis mthong tshad dang rna ba'i thos tshad tshang ma ma lus par zin bris su btab pas/phyis shes bya'i dpe cha sna tshogs rtsom mkhan mang du byung / de ni rjes 'jug pa rnams dang nga tsho bod kyi gsar 'gyur las rigs kyi gsar 'god pa tshang mas slob sbyong byed sa'i mig dpe red/zhin hwa gsar 'gyur khang gi gsar 'god pa rgan pa ku'o khra'o rin zhes pas lo ngo nyi shu'i ring gi bcar 'dri bya ba'i khrod/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu zin bris 'bri deb rigs gsum bzung ste/ rigs gcig ni bcar 'dri'i zin bris dang / rigs gcig ni bsam gzhig gnad btus kyi skor yin la/rigs gcig ni 'tsho ba'i phyogs btus kyi skor yin/ 'tsho ba'i phyogs btus skor gyi nang don phun sum tshogs po yod/ rang byung khams kyi ri lung mdzes ljongs dang dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun/ mi sna mtshar can/ gson nyams ldan zhing bag 'tsher ba'i lam bar gyi mthong thos sogs mdor na khos mthong lam dang thos lam du gyur pa thams cad rgyun mi chad par zin bris su btab/1958lor kho rang bod ljongs bzo u'i bya ba'i ru khag dang bsdebs nas bod byang thang nas mnga' ris su bgrod skabs/ lam bar du mi khyim shin tu 96

nyung bas/ bcar 'dri bya yul zhig la 'phrad rgyu'ang shin tu dka'/ de bas khos nyin re rer 'tsho ba'i phyogs btus bris/ phyis su khos 'tsho ba'i phyogs btus de legs sgris byas nas ming la le bar nyis stong gi bod byang thang zhes pa'i rtsom ring bris nas spel/ 1960lor kho rang jo mo bla rir 'dzeg pa'i bcar 'dri bya bar zhugs skabs/ thengs gnyis la mtho sgang sga nam zlar 'phrod pa'i sbyong brdar chen mor zhugs pa dang / de'i khar rgyun ldan gyi bcar 'dri bya ba yod pas/ bya bar brel ba che zhing ngal dub shin tu che/ yin na'ang khos sngar bzhin 'tsho ba'i phyogs btus 'bri rgyu rgyun 'khyongs byas/1982lor zhin hwa dpe skrun khang gis khos spel ba'i jo mo bla rir 'dzegs pa'i gsar 'gyur skor gyi dpe deb cig par skrun byas/ de ni tshang ma kho'i 'tsho ba'i phyogs btus de dag las bdams pa red/ rgyu cha rnams nyar tshags byed bde ba dang bkol bde ba'i ched du dus nges gtan med par legs sgrig byed pa dang rigs bgar dgos/ dus yun ring bo 'gor ba dang bstun nas rgyu cha'ang je mang yin phyir/ go rim nyog sla/ de bas rtag par legs sgrig bya rgyu gal che/ rgyu cha la la dus kyi dgos mkho dang mi mthun na 'dor dgos pa dang /rgyu cha la la sngon chad zin bris btab pa kha mi tshang na dus thog tu cha tshang du gtong dgos shing / rgyu cha la la yang dag min tshe/ gang mgyogs sgos dag bcos bya dgos/ 'bri deb las gzhan/ gsar 'god pas da dung byang bu bzos nas tshags par dus deb sna tshogs steng gi rang la mkho ba dang rang nyid spro ba ldan pa'i rtsom yig sogs bres nas go rim ltar sbyar te kha byang 'bri ba dang rigs bgar nas nyar tshags byed chog 'di ltar nyar tshags byas na rjes su lta bde ba dang bkol bde ba red/ de min da dung par len pa dang brnyan 97

ris phab pa sogs byed thabs spyad de rgyu cha nyar tshags byas na'ang chog de ltar byas na yul dngos kyi rnam pa sor 'jog nyar tshags byas nas/ lo mang po'i rjes su da dung skabs de'i rnam pa lhang nger yid la dran thub pa dang gna' deng dpyad bsdur byed par shin tu phan pa red/ rgyu cha sdud gsog dang nyar tshags byed skabs nang don mi gcig pa ltar so sor rigs bgar nas nyar tshags bya dgos/ rigs bgar stangs la rnam pa sna tshogs yod kyang /gtso bo rang nyid kyi gnas tshul dngos dang bya ba'i dgos mkho/ goms phyogs ltar byas chog gsar 'grod pas thengs re'i bcar 'dri khrod kyi rgyu cha lhag ma rnams sdud gsog byed pa las gzhan/ da dung dus rgyun dpe cha lta ba dang slob sbyong byed pa/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'brel 'dris sna tshogs khrod/ gsar 'god pa'i bya bar mkho ba'i rgyu cha dang gnas tshul la do snang byed rgyu ma zad/ mthong ma thag yig thor 'god pa'i goms srol yang chags par bya dgos/98

bzhi pa/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa/de yang rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan zhes pa'i ming gi skor la da lta nga tsho'i bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las rigs khrod/dngos gzhi ma yin pa'i spyir btang gi dus su rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan 'dus pa'i mi phal che ba ched las ming tshig gzhan pa dang mtshungs par rgya skad kyi ming gi sgra g.yar ma zhig la goms 'dug nye ba'i lo la de la snyan sgron pa zhes brjod pa'ang yod mod/ yin yang kun gyi kha la byang zhing gcig gyur gyi ming gtan khel zhig tu chags med pa 'dra/ snyan sgron pa zhes pa de yang snyan du sgron zhes gong la zhu ba'i don la 'jug cing / snyan du zhu ba de yang mthar gtugs na bshad pa las ma 'das pas/ bshad mkhan gyi nang don ldan pa red/ des na 'di ru bshad mkhan zhes pa'i ming bkol dgos don ci zhe na/ de snga 1979lo'i lo mgor rlung 'phrin las rigs su le tshan rjes su bshad mkhan gyi ming bshad dus/ mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis dang thog le tshan rjes su bshad mkhan klu mo dang phur ba yin zhes sbyar pa yin/ de yang mang tshogs kyi skad cha'i khrod du mi de bshad mkhan zhig red ces brjod na/ kha lce bde ba dang skad cha bshad mkhas po zhig la ston pas/ nga tshos le tshan khrod du bshad mkhan zhes brjod tshe/ rgya che'i nyan mkhan rnams la nga tshos rang nyid bshad mkhas po zhig tu brtsis nas khengs skyung mi byed pa'i go 99

log bzo bar dogs nas rjes su klu mo dang phur ba gnyis kyis bshad ni yin zhes par bsgyur/1982lor phran la krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas bod kyi rig gnas mkhas dbang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan lags kyi zhal khrid la nyan pa'i skal ba ldan zhing / dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo nyid kyis zhal khrid thengs shig gi skabs su rlung 'phrin gyi le tshan rjes su bshad pa po'i ming sbyor ba'i skor gsung dus/ dang thog bshad mkhan zhes brjod pa shin tu legs mod kyang / phyis bshad ni yin zhes bsgyur 'dug ces gsungs nas rlung 'phrin gyi le tshan bshad mkhan gyi ming la bshad mkhan zhes brjod na yi ge'i 'jug stangs dang mthun pa dang byed las kyi go don mtshon nus pas 'os shing legs pa bstan/ de min nam rgyun nga tshos kyang bya ba'i khrod du ngas de ring gsar 'gyur bshad dgos/ nga la da dung rig rtsal le tshan zhig bshad rgyu yod/ de ring ched sgrig le tshan bshad mkhan khyod red ces ched las 'di la bshad yig bkol ba shin tu mang ba dang / bkol bar goms yod cing bkol na'ang shin tu bde bar snang la/ mang tshogs kyi skad cha'i khrod du'ang kho rang bod ljongs brnyan 'phrin khang gi bshad mkhan red/ des bshad pa shin tu legs zhes pa sogs rgyun du 'byung zhing de la ha cang goms 'dug pas/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin khrod kyi las rigs 'di'i ming la bshad mkhan zhes brjod tshe/ las rigs 'di'i byed las kyi go don mtshon thub pa dang yi ge'i 'jug stangs dang mthun la/ nam rgyun bya ba'i khrod du bkol bde zhing go sla ba/ lhag par du rim pa so so'i rgya che'i bod rigs lta mkhan mang tshogs kyi skad cha dang yang yongs su mthun pas yongs khyab rang bzhin ldan 100

zhing khyab gdal byed sla/ de dang bsdur na snyan sgron pa zhes par yi ge'i 'jug stangs dang nang don la 'gal zla med mod/ yin na'ang skad cha'i khrod du bkol mi bde ba ste/ snyan sgron pa zhes ming tshig hril bo bkol ba las bye brag bi skad cha'i khrod du ngas gsar 'gyur sgron dgos/ de'i le tshan sgron rtsal legs zhes bkol mi bde ba dang nang sgos su yig skad shas che bas mang tshogs khrod du khyab gdal byed dka' bar snyam/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ni mang tshogs rang bzhin ldan pa'i dril bsgrags yo byad cig yin pa'i cha nas de la'ang bsam blo gtong dgos pa ni smos ma dgos pa red/ de yang skad cha'i khrod du bshad mkhan zhes pa de rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan kho nar 'jug pa zhig min pas/ ched las kyi ming tshig dang yang na ched ming kho nar brtsi mi rung zhe na/ nga tshos bshad mkhan zhes brjod dus skad cha'i khor yug nges can zhig yod pa dang bye brag gi skad cha'i khor yug khrod du de'i go don la go log 'byung mi srid la/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan zhes brjod tshe gzhan dang 'gal zla'ang med par snyam nas 'di ru bshad mkhan zhes bkol ba yin/ yin na'ang 'di las lhag par 'os shing 'tsham pa re yod na rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan zhes pa'i ched las ming tshig 'di yang ched las ming tshig gzhan pa dang 'dra bar zhib 'jug byas nas gtan khel byas chogarlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan ni/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin khrod kyi sgra med kyi cha 'phrin rnams skad sgra yod pa dang shes tshor bskyed thub pa'i skad sgra'i cha 'phrin du bsgyur ba dang skad cha ma yin pa'i cha 'phrin de skad cha'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas yang bskyar gsar gtod byed mkhan 101

yin zhing / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin khrod thad kur lta mkhan dang nyan mkhan la gdong phyogs nas skad rigs kyi brgyud bsgrags byed mkhan yin la/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud bsgrags bya 'gul ni cha 'phrin gsar rnyed dang / cha 'phrin gdam gses/ cha 'phrin las snon/ cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags bcas byed pa'i go rim zhig red/ go rim 'di gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa/ bshad mkhan sogs kyis mthun sbyor ngang mnyam las byas na/ da gzod legs 'grub 'byung thub/ bshad mkhan gyis gtso bo cha 'phrin las snon dang cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags te mjug gi lhu tshigs 'di gnyis ga'i 'gan 'khur dgos/ bshad mkhan gyi bshad pa legs min gyis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin brtsams chos kyi cha tshang rang bzhin thag gcod par ma zad/ tshad nges can zhig gi thad nas bshad na brtsams chos kyi 'thus tshang rang bzhin dang rgyu spus chu tshad kyang thag gcod kyin yod/ bshad rtsom sna gcig bshad mkhan mi 'dra bar bshad du bcug na/ le tshan gyi rgyu spus dang le tshan brgyud gtong gi phan 'bras mi 'dra ba 'thob nges/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin tshang ma glog rdul 'phrin skyel lag rtsal la brten nas brgyud bsgrags byed pa'i spyi byings kyi smyan byed yin zhing / rlung 'phrin gyis skad la brten nas le tshan brgyud bsgrags byed pa dang brnyan 'phrin gyis brnyan ris dang skad gnyis kur brten nas nang don mtshon par byed pa red/ rlung 'phrin gyi skad sgra yin na 'dra/ brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris yin na'ang 'dra tshang ma bshad mkhan brgyud nas mtshon dgos/ bshad rtsal ga 'dra yin pa dang bshad nus ji 'dra ldan pa ni bshad mkhan gyi chu tshad mtho 102

dma' la brtag pa'i tshad thig gal chen zhig red/ rgyu mtshan ni bshad rtsal dang bshad nus bzang min gyis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud bsgrags phan 'bras bzang ngan thag gcod kyin yod pa de red/ de las bshad mkhan gyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi gsar gtod nus pa'i gal chen rang bzhin lhag par mtshon pa red/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gang mang tshang ma gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa sogs kyis bcar 'dri rtsom sgrig byas nas bshad rtsom ma yig grub rjes bshad mkhan gyis bshad pa brgyud nas yig rigs skad cha de skad sgra'i skad char bsgyur bar ma zad/ skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi yang bskyar gsar rtsom la brten nas nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi cha 'phrin shes tshor byed pa'i dgos mkho skong ba zhig red/ gal te bshad mkhan gyi skad sgra'i brgyud bsgrags med tshe/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gang yin rung tshang mas brgyud gtong brtsams chos cha tshang ba zhig 'grub mi srid/ der brten bshad mkhan gyi bya ba'i bzang ngan de thad kur rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rgyu spus dang de'i brgyud bsgrags phan 'bras mngon 'gyur byed thub min la shugs rkyen thebs kyin yod/'go 'dzin pa'i go don la gtan khel gsal po med de/ spyi don tsam brjod na/ 'go 'dzin pa ni le tshan gyi tshab byed pa dang le tshan la kha lo bsgyur mkhan yin zhing le tshan bsgrigs pa'i go rim yongs dang yang na go rim kha shas la zhugs pa dang / le tshan khrod phan tshun kha brda'i rnam pa la brten nas le tshan gyi rgyu cha sna tshogs sgrig sbyor dang mthud sbrel byas te le tshan hril bo yongs 'grub byed mkhan yin/ mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ 'go 'dzin pa ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod phyir bud de gleng mol gyi tshul gyis le tshan 103

la kha lo bsgyur ba'i brgyud bsgrags pa red/ bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa gnyis ka le tshan la kha lo bsgyur mkhan yin mod/ yin na'ang kha lo bsgyur stangs mi 'dra ba red/ bshad mkhan gyis phan tshun thad kur kha brda byed pa ma yin pa'i tshul gyis le tshan la kha lo bsgyur ba dang / 'go 'dzin pas phan tshun thad kur kha brda byed pa'i tshul gyis le tshan la kha lo bsgyur ba yin/gcig bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i byed nus/rlung 'phrin las khungs dang brnyan 'phrin khang gi nang khul dang yang na nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan kyi mthong thos khrod gang yin rung / bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni nam yang kun gyi do snang bya yul red/ kho tshor kun gyis do snang byed pa yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi le tshan khrod bskyed pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa dang 'bral thabs med/ de snga rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin byung ba nas bzung rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan ni de'i 'bral thabs med pa'i grub cha gal chen zhig tu gyur/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyi 'phel rim las bltas na/ las rigs 'di yang gsar 'gyur le tshan sogs sgrog 'don byed pa nas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed pa'i bar sna rkyang nas sna mang can du 'gyur ba'i 'phel rgyas go rim brgyud pa dang 'phel rgyas go rim de'i khrod kyi 'gyur ldog gal chen thengs re re tshang ma rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin rang ngo'i 'phel rgyas dang sgos su brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas dang 'brel ba dam po yod/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal gom gang sngon spos ngang gong du 'phel ba dang bstun nas 104

bshad mkhan gyi rnam par yang rgyun mi chad par 'gyur ldog 'byung srid/ rang rgyal gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan de dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab dang bsdur na byung ba cung 'byi zhing / rang rgyal gyi dril bsgrags sgrig srol gyi dbang gis bab bstun ngang bshad pa dang gleng mol tshul du bshad pa'i rnam pa de snga rabs kyi gsar 'gyur dang ched sgrig le tshan khrod shin tu nyung / rtsom sgrig byas pa'i ma yis ltar sgrog 'don byed pa ni bshad stangs gtso bo red/bcos sgyur sgo 'byed rjes su rang rgyal gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don bya 'phur ba ltar 'phel rgyas byung / le tshan gyi sgrub stangs nyin rer phun tshogs su gyur pa dang bshad stangs kyang rgyun mi chad par legs bcos dang gong 'phel byung ste/ rigs mi gcig pa dang khyad chos mi mtshungs pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin byung / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin dang de'i bshad mkhan gnyis ni phan tshun brten zhing 'brel ba red/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par gar stegs 'don sprod byas la/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyis smyan byed 'di la sngar las lhag par rang gi gshis nus 'don spel byed du bcug rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las khungs ni sde tshan mang po dang ched las mi sna rigs sna tshogs/ sgrig chas dang 'phrul chas 'bor chen gyis grub pa'i rnyog 'dzing gi sde khag cig red/ rtsom sgrig pa dang gsar 'god pa dang 'dra bar rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin khang gi le tshan gtong ba'i khrod med du mi rung ba'i bya ba byed mkhan red/ brgyud gtong gi thad nas bshad na/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bskyed pa'i nus pa de rgyu rkyen gzhan las lhag par gal che/105

de yang le tshan gyi brgyud gtong rnam pa mi 'dra ba ltar/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod bskyed pa'i nus pa'i che chung mi 'dra na'ang spyi khog nas bltas na/ las gnas 'di'i gal chen rang bzhin la snang med gtan nas byed mi rung / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i nus pa gtso bo gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' nas mtshon pa yin/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni rlung 'phrin las khungs dang brnyan 'phrin khang gi snang brnyan bye brag ngang mtshon mkhan yin/ nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis rlung 'phrin las khungs dang brnyan 'phrin khang la lta stangs ji lta bu zhig 'dzin rgyu ni gtso bo de'i le tshan brgyud nas byung ba red/ de yang nyin re rer le tshan khrod nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la ngo 'phrad pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la bzhag pa'i tshor ba ni ches zab cing ches thad kur red/ spyir btang gi mi'i mig nang du nyin rer nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la ngo 'phrad pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang gi 'thus tshab dang mtshon rtags red/ phul du byung ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ rang nyid la mi rnams kyi bsngags brjod thob par ma zad/ dus mtshungs su de nyid gtogs pa'i rlung 'phrin khang ngam brnyan 'phrin khang la mtshan snyan grags 'thob par byed pa dang le tshan la nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan je mang du gtong nges/ de las ldog ste/ tshul ldan min pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la sun snang skyes su bcug nas las khungs la gnod pa skyel srid/ der brten/ rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang so sos thabs brgya jus stong sgos 'os shing 'tsham pa'i 106

bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa gdam sases byed kyin yod/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni le tshan gyi 'thus tshab red/ le tshan brgyud gtong byed stangs rgyun mi chad par legs bcos byas pa dang bstun nas/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin khrod kyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan bar bar thag sngar las nye ba'i tshul du kha brda byed pa'i byed stangs spyod kyin yod/ rnam pa dang bshad stangs 'di rigs kyis le tshan gyi bden dngos rang bzhin dang snying nye tshul je drag tu btang bas/ sngar las lhag par nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis dang len byed sla zhing / nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis shes ma shes bar nas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams le tshan 'di'i bdag por brtsis nas thad kur le tshan de bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa dang mnyam du sbrel ba red/ le tshan legs po zhig la 'os shing 'tsham pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'os shing 'tsham pa'i 'bo 'dzin pa bkod sgrig bya rgyu ni/ kun gyi mgrin gcig gi lta tshul du gyur 'dugabashad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni le tshan rtsa 'dzugs mnyam sprul byed mkhan red/ rlung 'phrin dang yang na brnyan 'phrin cha tshang ba'i le tshan zhig ni rtag par tshan pa dang le tshan chung ngu mang pos grub pa red/ le tshan chung ngu dang le tshan gyi tshan pa dum bu mang po rnams phan tshun sbrel skabs/ byed thabs sna tshogs bkol chog mod/ yin yang spyir btang du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan rtsa 'dzugs dang mnyam sbrel byas na ches stabs bde ba dang ches phan 'bras ldan/brnyan 'phrin dang rlung 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni le 107

tshan gyi rtsom sgrig la zhugs mkhan red/ sngon chad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dag gi bya ba gtso bo ni com sgrig byas zin pa'i ma yig sgrog 'don byed pa las/ thad kur le tshan gyi rtsom sgrig sogs la zhugs pa shin tu nyung / las rigs dang le tshan khrod gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa/ sgrig sbyor ba bcas las bgos kyang shin tu gsal/ da lta le tshan gyi nang don phun tshogs su gyur pa dang le tshan gyi rnam pa dang sgrig stangs kyang rnam pa sna tshogs su gyur pa dang bstun nas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mang po dngos su le tshan gyi bcar 'dri dang rtsom sgrig sgrig sbyor bcas la zhugs nas/ le tshan bshad mkhan tsam du ma zad/ le tshan 'god mkhan yang red/ der brten rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las khungs nang dang le tshan khrod bskyed pa'i nus pa ni shin tu gal che zhing thun mong ma yin pa zhig red/ kho tshos rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang dang nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan bar dang / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan dang nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan bar zam pa lta bu'i nus pa bskyed kyin yod/gnyis/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rigs/bshad mkhan gyi las rigs 'di ni rlung 'phrin thog mar byung ba nas byung zhing de yang rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel rgyas dang bsdongs nas 'phel rgyas byung ba red/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan la mtshon 108

na/ thog ma'i dus skabs kyi brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyi byed las la brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal gyi tshod 'dzin thebs phyir/ bya ba'i byed stangs cung stabs bde red/ bshad mkhan gyi bya ba gtso bo brnyan 'phrin khang gi mgrin tshab pa'i cha nas lta mkhan la gsar 'gyur sgrog 'don dang yang na nang don mtshams sbyor byed pa tsam yin la/ skabs der mi rnams kyis brnyan ris yod pa'i rlung 'phrin zhes brjod/ de las skabs de'i brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan la rlung 'phrin bshad mkhan gyis shugs rkyen mngon gsal thebs pa ma zad/ rang gi khyad chos grub med pa mtshon/ bshad mkhan gyis gtso bo rang gi skad la brten nas brgyud bsgrags yo byad kyi nus pa bskyed pa las/ gzugs brnyan ni skad sgra'i zur gtogs tsam red/ brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal rgyun chad med par gong du 'phel ba dang le tshan gyi rnam pa dang le tshan gyi nang don rgyun chad med par phun tshogs su gyur pa dang bstun nas/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyi bya ba'i byed stangs dang bya ba'i khyab khongs kyang rgyun chad med par 'gyur ldog byung nas gzugs brnyan gyi cha nas 'don spel gang legs thob pa dang / bya ba'i khyab khongs kyang bshad pa kho na ma yin par/ le tshan gyi phab skrun go rim so sor khyab ste le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin par gyur/ da lta brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyis sgrub pa'i bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ le tshan la la'i khrod kho tshos bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i 'gan khur bar ma zad/bshad mkhan la las da dung le tshan gyi jus 'god dang bcar 'dri/ rtsom sgrig bcas kyi 'gan yang 'khur bzhin yod/ srol rgyun gyi bshad mkhan gyi byed las dang bsdur na/ kho tsho'i bya ba'i byed stangs la 'gyur ldog chen po byung 'dug yin na'ang spyir btang gi nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis 'gyur ldog de 109

rigs gsal po zhig 'byed mi srid par/ kho tshos rtag par phyi ngos nas bshad mkhan kho nar ngos 'dzin pa red/ da lta'i brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan ni thog ma'i dus dang 'dra bar/ skad snyan mo zhig dang ngo gdong yag po zhig gis mi chog par le tshan gyi rigs mang ba dang bstun nas lta mkhan rnams kyis blang bya'ang je mtho nas je mtho yin zhing / le tshan la las bshad mkhan la blang bya shin tu mthon po 'don nges/ le tshan gyi nang don ltar rags tsam dbye na/bshad mkhan yang gsham gyi rigs 'gar dbye chogagasar 'gyur bshad mkhan dang gsar 'gyur 'go 'dzin pa/ gtso bo brnyan 'phrin dang rlung 'phrin khang so so'i nyin re'i gsar 'gyur sna tshogs bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin bya dgos/ de ni rtag par rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang gi dus gal chen du bkod sgrig byed pa'i le tshan gal chen red/ gsar 'gyur le tshan 'di rigs dus tshod cung ring ba dang nang don gyi khyab rgya che ba'i khar/ le tshan 'di rigs la lta mkhan mang ba dang thad kur rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang gi mtshan snyan la shugs rkyen bzo ba yin phyir/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i ched las chu tshad thad blang bya ha cang mtho/ gsar 'gyur le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams dngos su gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri la zhugs dgos pa'i nges pa med/ yin yang gsar 'gyur don rkyen der cha rgyus zab mo yod dgos/ gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par gzugs byad legs po dang skad ngag snyan mo zhig yod dgos pa dang skad cha'i mtshon nus legs po yod dgos par ma zad/ da dung gsar 'gyur don rkyen la rgyus lon dang dbye zhib zab mo byed pa'i nus pa ldan dgos/ thad gtong gi blang bya dang mthun ched/ da dung 110

brtan brling gi sems khams dang bab bstun gyi blo rig myur mo zhig kyang dgos pa red/gsar 'gyur rigs kyi ched don le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa/ gsar 'gyur rigs kyi ched don le tshan zhes pa ni nang don sna mang ma yin par dmigs bya rang bzhin ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur ched don le tshan rigs la bstan pa yin/ le tshan 'di rigs kyis kyang gsar 'gyur cha 'phrin mkho 'don byed cing / dus mtshangs su cha 'phrin la gting zab ngang dbye zhib dang dpyad gtam brjod pa yin pas/ sgrig bkod thad gang la gang 'tsham zhig yin/ le tshan 'di rigs la dus thog gsar 'gyur bzhin dus kyi blang bya mthon po med pas mang che shos sngon la brnyan phab sgra len byas nas gtong ba'i byed thabs bkol gyin yod/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bshad stangs kyang gang la gang 'tsham dang cung lhod sha ldan pa dang / sngon la bkod sgrig byas pa'i gleng gzhi las gzhan/ skabs la lar skabs dang bstun nas bshad pa'ang yod/shes bya rang bzhin gyi ched sgrig le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi rnam pa mang zhing nang don phun sum tshogs la/le tshan gyi khyad chos kyang rnam pa sna tshogs red/ bshad stangs kyi khyad chos thad nas nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis lhag par dang len byed sla ba'i gleng mol tshul gyi bshad stangs spyod pa yin/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa spyir btang du le tshan gyi jus 'god dang rtsom sgrig sogs la ma zhugs kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang / da lta bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa sngar las mang po thad kur le tshan 'di rigs kyi jus 'god dang bcar 'dri rtsom 111

sgrig sogs la zhugs kyin yod/rig rtsal le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'tho 'dzin pa/ brnyan 'phrin la mtshon nas bshad na/ brnyan 'phrin khrod kyi rig rtsal le tshan gyi rigs la rig rtsal gyi ched sgrig le tshan dang rig rtsal dgong tshogs/ phyogs bsdus sgyu rtsal le tshan sogs rnam pa mang po yod/ rig rtsal ched sgrig le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa'i las 'gan ni rig rtsal le tshan sna tshogs mtshams sbyor byas te/ le tshan gyi mgo mjug bar gsum bstar la brgyus pa'i nus pa bskyed dgos pa de red/ le tshan khrod kyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa de 'khrab ston pa min yang 'go 'dzin khyad chos thad nas rig rtsal le tshan bshad pa dang 'bo 'dzin bya rgyu de gsar 'gyur dang shes bya rang bzhin gyi ched sgrig le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa dang mi mtshungs par khyad par mngon gsal yod pa red/ rig rtsal le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed stangs de rnam pa gson nyams ldan pa dang khyad chos spro bag ldan pa/ skad cha bag 'tsher la le tshan hril bo rol rtsed kyi shas che ba bcas yin/ rig rtsal dgong tshogs yul dngos nas 'go 'dzin byed pa ni dmigs bsal gyi 'go 'dzin rnam pa zhig red/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi 'go 'dzin pa'i las 'gan ni le tshan gzhan pa'i 'go 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar le tshan gyi mgo mjug bar gsum mthud sgrig byed pa yin yang / mthud sgrig 'di rigs ni le tshan 'khyab yul dngos nas byed pa yin zhing / 'go 'dzin pa ni mtshams sbyor pa yin la/ dgong tshogs kyi mi sna zhig kyang yin/ 'go 'dzin byed stangs sngar las gson nyams ldan pa dang 'go 'dzin pas skad cha las gzhan/ da dung lus po'i 'gul stangs sna tshogs bkol chog112

song du bshad pa'i le tshan gyi 'bo 'dzin pa de dag las gzhan/ da dung byis pa'i le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa dang bcar 'dri gleng mol le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa/ lus rtsal le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa sogs kyang rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyi gras su gtogs/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi sna kha je mang du song ba dang bstun nas le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i rigs gsar ba da dung mu mthud du 'byung nges red/gsum/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams rigs mi 'dra ba so sor dbye chog cing / rigs mi 'dra ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i nus pa'i cha rkyen yang kha kha red/ dper na/brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyi gzugs byad dang skad ngag la cung brjid nyams ldan tshe/ da gzod gsar 'gyur gyi yid rton rang bzhin je drag tu gtong thub/ rig rtsal le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i blang bya ni bag lhod ldan pa dang spro nyams che la/ 'tsher bag ldan pa de red/ bye brag gi le tshan gyi rigs dang bye brag gi nang don la ma bltas par/ nga tshos bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par cha rkyen ji 'dra ldan na da gzod bya ba legs sgrub byed thub pa'i gtan khel byed dka'/ le tshan mi 'dra bas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par le tshan gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i dmigs bsal gyi blang bya 'don srid/ de'i rkyen gyis nga tshos bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa yod do 113

cog dang mthun pa'i gcig gyur gyi blang bya zhig gtan khel byed dka'/ rang gi le tshan legs sgrub bya dgos tshe/ thog mar le tshan de'i le tshan gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i dmigs bsal gyi cha la rgyus lon dgos/ de yang las rigs 'dir gsar du zhugs mkhan rnams la mtshon na/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rigs sna tshogs la 'phrod pa'i gzhi rtsa'i blang bya shes par bya rgyu ni sngar bzhin ha cang gal che ba red/ des kho tshor ches ma mtha'i dmigs yul zhig yod par byas nas kho tsho bde blag ngang bshad mkhan gyi las rigs su 'jug par rogs byed thub/de yang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/thog mar gzugs byad dang skad ngag gi cha rkyen 'dzoms dgos/ brnyan 'phrin ni brnyan ris dang skad sgrar brten nas cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byed pa'i deng rabs can gyi brgyud bsgrags yo byad cig red/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi skad dang gzugs byad la brten nas le tshan gyi nang don mtshon par byed pa red/ der brten skad ngag dang gzugs byad legs po zhig ni brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bya ba bsgrub par med du mi rung ba'i gzhi rtsa'i cha rkyen red/ skad ngag legs po zhes pa ni lhan skyes kyi skad gdangs yag po dang skad ngag snyan mo tsam kho nar bstan pa ma yin par/ skad ngag dang skad gdangs de las thon pa'i skad cha'i mtshon nus legs po zhig la bstan pa red/ skad cha'i mtshon nus de yang yig thog gi klog 'don nus pa kho nas ma tshad par skad ngag gi mtshon nus dang 'gyur khugs la brten nas le tshan gyi nang don legs por mtshon pa'i nus pa zhig dang bab bstun gyi bshad rtsal zhig la'ang bstan pa red/ de bzhin 114

bzugs byad legs po zhes pa de yang ngo gdong mdzes pa kho nar bstan pa ma yin par/ skyes gzugs dang nyams 'gyur/ nang yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i phyi'i gzi nyams dang spobs pa sogs phyogs bsdus kyi mtshon byed nus pa zhig la bstan pa yin/ gal te ngo gdong mdzes na'ang nyams 'gyur gyis mi phyug pa 'i gzugs byad rengs po zhig la lta mkhan gyis dga' zhen byed mi srid/shes bya'i rgya yangs pa ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen gzhan zhig red/ bshad mkhan gyis bshad rtsom sna tshogs bshad skabs/bshad bya'i rtsom gyi nang don ma nor bar rang gi skad dang skad cha'i mtshon nus la brten nas mtshon dgos/ nus pa 'di rigs ni bshad mkhan gyi shes bya'i chu tshad la 'brel ba dam po yod/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nyin re rer cha 'phrin gsar ba dang shes bya gsar bar 'brel 'dris bya dgos/ shes bya'i rgya yangs po zhig med tshe/ cha 'phrin gsar ba dang shes bya gsar ba 'di dag nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la brgyud bsgrags byed mi nus/ shes bya'i chu tshad kyis tshod 'dzin thebs nas nam rgyun bshad nas nor ba dang tha na bshad rtsom khrod kyi tshig gi gcod mtshams sogs nor bas mtshon bya'i nang don 'gyur ba'i gnad don rtag tu 'byung bzhin yod/ gnad don tshabs che na/gzhan gyis 'phya yul du 'gyur bar ma zad/ da dung sel thabs med pa'i shugs rkyen bzos nas las khungs kyi mtshan snyan la'ang gnod pa red/ mi mang po zhig gi snang ngor rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas gzhan gyis bris pa'i ma yig 'don thub pa tsam gyi chog ste/ de la rig gnas chu tshad mthon po mi dgos snyam zhing / bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa bsdu len dang bkol spyod byed skabs/ mtha' gcig tu ngo gdong 115

dang gzugs byad kyi mdzes pa kho na gtso bor 'dzin pa las/ de'i rig gnas chu tshad sogs la de 'dra'i gags 'dzin mi byed/ 'dod tshul 'di lta bu ni brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan gyi 'go khrid pa'i gras su'ang gnas te/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las la cha rgyus zab mo med pa'i skyon no/ /de ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs yong ba'i gegs su 'gyur bar ma zad/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rgyu spus la'ang ngan shugs thebs srid/ rig gnas dang 'brel ba'i las rigs sang zhig yin yang / de'i sgrub mkhan la rig gnas rmang gzhi nges can gyi rgyab rten med tshe/thog ma'i mgo rtsom sa'i gnas mi mtho ba dang phyis su yar thon gyi 'gros dal ba ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/ de yang rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa yang de las ma 'das te/ le tshan gyi nang don khyab che zhing rnam pa sna tshogs yin phyir/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa tsho nyin re rer shes bya sna tshogs dang 'phrad srid/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las 'gan ni ne tsos mi skad sbyong ba bzhin yig ngor bltas nas 'don pa tsam ma yin par/ thog mar ma yig gi nang don phyogs yongs nas rang gis byang chub par rtogs dgos shing / de nas rang gi bshad rtsal la brten nas gzhan la gsal por bshad mkhas dgos pa de red/ nam rgyun nga tshos le tshan la la'i khrod/ bshad mkhan la la'i skad snyan zhing ngag bde ba 'dra yang rnam shes gtad cing rna ba gtad nas ma nyan tshe ci bshad pa go rgyu med pa dang / le tshan la lar rnam shes gtad nas ma nyan rung bshad mkhan gyis ci bshad pa de khyod kyi rna bar lhang nger lhung 'ong ba red/ de ni mthar gtugs nas bshad na bshad mkhan re re'i bshad rtsal la rag las shing chu tshad la rag las pa red/116

rig gnas chu tshad nges can zhig med tshe/ shes bya sna tshogs la go ba dbyis phyin pa len dka' zhing / de gzhan la bshad pa'i rtsal lhag par zhan/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi le tshan spyir btang ba zhig phul du byung ba'i bshad mkhan zhig gi bshad rtsal brgyud rjes/ le tshan de yang cung legs po zhig tu 'gyur ba dang / le tshan legs po zhig spyir btang gi bshad mkhan zhig gis bshad rjes/ le tshan de yang spyir btang can zhig tu 'gyur srid/ de ni bshad mkhan gyi rig gnas chu tshad dang des rmang gzhi byas pa'i bshad rtsal mi 'dra ba las byung ba'i 'bras bu red/ der brten tshad ldan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig bya dgos na nges par du rig gnas chu tshad nges can ldan dgos/de ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen gtso bo red/bab bstun gyi nus pa ni bshad mkhan dang sgos su thad kur gtong ba'i le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na lhag par gal che/le tshan thad kur gtong ba'i go rim khrod bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par rtag par sngon na tshod dpag byed mi thub pa dang bsam yul las 'das pa'i don dag dang 'phrad srid/ gal te don dag 'di dang phrad tshe/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas gang la gang 'tsham dang bab bstun ngang skad cha sogs la brten nas le tshan bde blag ngang byed par khag theg bya dgos/ gang la gang 'tsham dang bab bstun gyi nus pa de rigs rtag par yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed skabs kyang rgyun du bkol gyin yod/ bab bstun nus pa ldan pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bcar 'dri bya yul gyi tshig sne dang bstun nas 'dri tshig mi 'dra ba dris nas bcar 'dri'i nang don la tshod 'dzin byed 117

thub/ bab bstun nus pa med pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas sngon la gra sgrig byas pa'i 'dri tshig kho na las yol mi thub par/ gal te bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha rang gi 'dri gzhi las brgal na ci bya gtol med du 'gyur ba dang bcar 'dri bya yul de nyid rang gi 'dri bya'i nang du 'khrid pa phar zhogarang nyid bcar 'dri bya yul gyis drud nas bcar 'dri hril bor kha lo bsgyur mi thub la/ le tshan yang legs 'grub yong mi srid/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par da dung sems khams theg nus brtan po zhig yod dgos/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni mi rnams kyi mdun du mngon pa'i bya ba sgrub mkhan yin phyin/rtag par spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so so nas 'ongs pa'i sems khams kyi khag khur lci mo theg dgos/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par dus dang rnam pa kun tu bya ba ci yang legs sgrub byed pa'i lhag bsam zol med dang yid ches brtan po yod dbos pa dang / bya ba'i khrod 'phrad pa'i dka' ngal sna tshogs khyad du sel ba'i snying rus chen po yod dgos/ de ltar yin na/ da gzod bya ba sna tshogs legs sgrub byed thub/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas da dung rim pa so so'i lta mkhan gyi skyon brjod la lta tshul yang dag pa 'dzin dgos/ skyon brjod de dag skabs la lar yongs su yang dag pa dang bden drang zhig min yang srid mod/ yin yang nges par du rang gi bya bar phan pa'i skul lcag lta bur brtsi dgos/ phul du byung ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig gis da dung skad cha'i rigs dang mi sna sna tshogs/ bya dngos sna tshogs bcas la nyams tshor rnon po dang go ba gting zab len pa dang skad cha'i phugs kyi nang don la rgyus lon dang nyams tshor len mkhas pa/ mi sna sna tshogs kyi sems gyi 'gyur ba 118

rtogs mkhas pa/ bya dngos mi 'dra ba'i bar gyi phugs kyi 'brel bar ngos 'dzin byed mkhas pa bcas bya dgos/bzhi/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i sems khams kyi blo smyong /rlung 'phrin dang lhag par du brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rtag par mi mang po'i mdun sar bya ba sgrub mkhan yin pas/ brnyan len 'phrul chas mdun gyi bya spyod re re dang skad cha tshig re re tshang mar lta mkhan gyis dpyad bsdur bya yul du 'gyur nges/ lta mkhan gyi blor 'bab pa rnams la bsngags brjod thob nas spyi tshogs kyi gdeng 'jog legs po 'thob pa dang lta mkhan gyi blor mi 'bab pa rnams la skyon brjod byed pas/ de'i spyi tshogs kyi gdeng 'jog kyang de dang bstun nas je dma' ru 'gro ba red/skabs 'gar lta mkhan gyi bsngags brjod lan rer thob tshe/ thog mar bshad mkhan gyi las la zhugs pa'i na gzhon la lar nga rgyal gyi mgo 'bus te/ rang gi nus par dbye zhib yang dag pa byed mi thub pa dang / gzhan gyi skyon brjod 'ga' res kyang spobs pa nyams par byas nas/ bya bar yid ches med pa dang brtson sems nyams 'gro/ rlung 'phrin dang sgos su brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos kyis bya ba de sgrub mkhan rnams la nges par du sems khams kyi theg nus legs po yod dgos pa'i blang bya bton/ de'i nang ches gal che ba ni rang spobs ldan pa dang rang tshod zin pa/ skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa sogs red/119

1 rang spobs ldan pa/rang spobs ldan pa zhes pa ni rang nyid kyi nus pa khas len pa dang rang nyid kyi nus par yid ches kyis khengs pa zhig la bstan/ rang gis rang nyid khas len pa'i bsam pa 'di rigs kyis las 'gan yongs 'grub byed pa'i spobs sems rgyas par byas nas/ las 'gan cung lci mo legs 'grub byed par rogs byed thub/ rang spobs mi che na ma gzhir 'grub thub pa'i las 'gan yang yongs 'grub byed dka' bar 'gyur nges/ rang spobs ldan pa de ni bya ba ci bsgrub kyang med du mi rung ba zhig yin pa dang / rlung 'phrin dang khyad par du brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na de bas kyang gal che ba red/ rang spobs chung ba de yang rnam pa sna tshogs ngang mtshon thub/ dper na/ skad cha'i khrod du rang spobs mngon mi nus pa dang las 'gan la la dang len byed mi spobs pa/ yang na rnam 'gyur dang skad cha/skad gdangs sogs kyi thad nas 'tshub cha langs pa dang skrag snang skyes pa sogs phyir mngon pa lta bu red/ bya ba la la re zhig la rang spobs med pa des thad kur bya ba'i mjug 'bras la shugs rkyen thebs mi srid pas las 'gan bsgrub pa'i bo rim khrod du rim bzhin gnas tshul la rgyus lon byas nas rang spobs rgyas par byas te mthar las 'gan yongs 'grub byas chog yin yang bya ba la la ni sems khams dang bstun nas yongs 'grub bya dgos la/ rang spobs mi che tshe/ thad kur bya ba'i mjug 'bras khrod du mtshon nges/ bya ba 'di rigs khrod du rang spobs ldan min de lhag par gal che/ rlung 'phrin dang khyad par du brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bya ba ni bya ba de'i rigs la gtogs/ don snying nges can zhig gi thad nas bshad na/ rtag par 120

rang nyid kyi nus par dogs pa za ba dang rang spobs med pa 'i mi yis rlung 'phrin dang sgos su brnyan 'phrin gyi 'go 'dzin byed mi thub/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ rang spobs che min de gcig nas phyi'i nyams 'gyur gyi steng nas mngon pa ste/ rang spobs med tshe/ nyams 'gyur phyir mngon pa 'tshub cha ldan pa dang mig mdangs la dngangs skrag gis khengs nas/ lta mkhan dang ngang ngam shugs kyis gleng mol byed par shugs rkyen thebs srid/ lta mkhan gyis gdong la sdug gis khengs pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig la dga' bsu byed mi srid par/ kho tshos dga' bsu byed pa ni/ kha khog med cing lhag sems kyis khengs pa'i bshad mkhan dag red/ gnyis nas rang spobs che min de skad cha'i khrod mtshon nges/ mi'i sems khams gyi 'gyur ba de mtshon stangs mang po'i khrod nas phyir mngon srid/ skad cha'i tshig 'bru khrod du ma zad/ tshig 'bru 'di dag mtshon par byed pa'i skad gdangs khrod du'ang sems khams kyi 'gyur ba mang po mtshon gyin yod/ spobs sems mi che tshe/ skad cha'i skad gdangs la lhod sha mi 'dres pa dang 'tshub cha langs pa'i rkyen gyis skad gdangs je mthor 'gro ba dang skad bcir nas thon pa/ skad 'dar ba sogs gnas tshul 'byung srid/ gnas tshul 'di dag gis thad kur skad cha'i mtshon stangs mjug 'bras la gnod pa thebs nges rang spobs med pa de da dung skad cha'i tshig gi khrod du'ang mngon srid/ spobs sems med tshe mi'i klad pa'i bsam gzhig nus pa rid por gyur nas/ sngon na gra sgrig byas med cing skabs thog de nas bshad dgos pa'i skad cha'i khrod 'tshub cha langs drags pas skad char nor 'chug yang yang 'byung ba dang tshabs che dus skad cha'i mgo mjug nyog nas ci bshad 'di bshad mi shes par 121

'gyur nges/lus po'i nyams 'gyur dang 'gul stangs kyi thad nas kyang sems kyi 'gyur ba mngon srid/ rang spobs che ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni brnyan len 'phrul chas mdun du 'tshub snang med cing lhod sha ldan la/ lus po dang lus po'i yan lag sogs kyi 'gul stangs 'os shing rang nyams kyis khengs/ rang spobs med dus lus po'i nyams 'gyur rengs por 'gyur ba dang 'gul stangs la'ang lhod sha med par gzhan gyi mig la mi bde ba'i tshor snang zhig sbyin nges/ rang spobs med pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi zhan cha yongs su lta mkhan gyi mig mdun du mngon nas brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rgyu spus la gnod pa bzo ba red/ lhag par du thad gtong le tshan skabs su rang spobs mi che tshe/ le tshan gtong bar sngon dpag byed dka' ba'i dka' tshegs bzo srid/ bshad mkhan la las thad gtong bcar 'dri'i khrod/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi ming brjed pa dang yang na 'dri gzhi brjed nas re zhig la skad cha med par 'gyur ba sogs kyi gnas tshul 'byung nges/ de yang 'di lta bu'i gnas tshul ni rtag tu 'byung ba dang yang na mi re rer 'byung ba zhig min mod/yin na'ang bshad mkhan zhig la mtshon na/ nor 'chug 'di lta bu le tshan gal chen khrod du thengs gcig tsam la byung yang mdun lam la gnod pa 'byung srid/rang spobs mi che ba de skabs la lar rang gshis las byung ba zhig kyang yin/gshis ka gnyom pa rnams la 'gran rtsod kyi spobs pa zhan pa dang rtag par dka' ngal la yid tshod mthon po byas nas rang gi nus par dogs pa za zhing /kho tsho nam rgyun 'gran slong rang bzhin med pa'i bya bar spobs pa yod pa dang /rang la gsal cha de 'dra med pa'i bya bar phrad na sems khur chen po langs 122

bzhin yod/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi gsar gtod rang bzhin gyis le tshan re re tshang mar nang don gsar ba ldan pa'i blang bya 'don pa yin la/ le tshan thengs re rer 'tshol zhib dang sngon dpag byed dka' ba'i rgyu rkyen gsar ba gang mang 'dus/ don snying 'di'i thad nas bshad na/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyi las don de ni 'gran slong rang bzhin shin tu drag pa'i bya ba zhig red/ des gshis ka shin tu brtan po dang rang spobs ha cang chen po zhig la brten nas dus dang rnam pa kun tu gdong gtug dbos pa'i 'gran slong la kha ya bya dgos/ rang spobs mi che ba de yang gra sgrig gis mi 'dang ba'i rkyen yang yin/ bya ba ci zhig byed na'ang bya ba'i go rim yongs la gra sgrig nan tan byas nas sems su gdeng tshod yod par byas tshe/ bya ba de sgrub skabs yid ches kyis khengs pa dang gal te sngon la gra sgrig gang legs ma byas tshe/ sems la gdeng tshod med pas rtag par spobs pas mi 'dang ba dang rang spobs med par 'gyur nges/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas brtan brling dang ldan pa'i rang gshis shig gso skyong byas nas dka' ngal sna tshogs la 'gran 'dzugs phod pa bya dgos/ ngos 'dzin thad nas dka' ngal la skrag snang mi 'dzin pa dang dus mtshungs su mgo 'jom nga rgyal mi byed par bya ba'i go rim yongs kyi lhu tshigs re re tshang mar gra sgrig nan tan byas nas 'byung srid pa'i gnad don thams cad la kha ya byed pa'i gdeng tshod yod pa bya dgos/'tshub cha langs sla ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi sngon la rang gis rang la gsal 'debs dang skul lcag byed pa dang dbugs ring len byed pa/ lus sems lhod la phab pa sogs byas na sems kyi 'tshub cha sel thub/123

2 rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyi sems kyi theg nus legs po'i khrod du da dung rang sems la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i nus pa'ang 'dus/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa 'di rigs ni bshad mkhan gyis glo bur du byung ba'i gnas tshul 'gyur ldog gi mdun du brtan brling dang snying 'jags kyi sems khams shig rgyun 'dzin byed thub par bstan pa red/ brtan brling dang nying 'jags kyi sems khams ldan mkhan gyis da gzod de ma nyid nas kha ya byed thabs bkod de las tshan bde blag ngang byed par khag theg byed thub/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa 'di rigs la rang sems lhod la 'bab par byed pa'i nus pa'ang 'dus/ dper na/ lhag bsam che drag pa'i skabs su klad pa ngar ba dang sems khams la spro snang skyes drags par tshod 'dzin byas nas/ lus kyi nyams 'gyur tshad las brgal ba dang skad cha'i tshod mi zin pa sngon 'gog bya dgos/ snying 'jags kyi rnam pa dang lhag bsam dang spro ba mi che ba'i skabs su kun gyi spro ba dang 'dun par bskul nas le tshan gyi rnam pa hur bo ldan par bya dgos/ rlung 'phrin dang sgos su brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pas rang gi nyams 'gyur la shugs rkyen thebs pa ma zad/ tshad nges can zhig gi thad nas le tshan gyi mjug 'bras kyang thag gcod pa yin/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i ches mngon gsal gyi mtshon stangs ni glo bur du byung ba'i gnas tshul la kha ya byed pa'i nus pa de red/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan brnyan phab byed pa'i go rim khrod/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu blo yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul sna tshogs 'byung srid/ gal te le tshan de sngon la brnyan phab byed pa zhig yin tshe/ de la dag bcos byed pa'i go 124

skabs yod pa dang gnas tshul mang po brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi lta mkhan rnams kyis mthong mi srid/ yin na'ang thad gtong le tshan khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur sogs kun gyi mig mdun du mngon pas/ glo bur du byung ba'i gnas tshul la kha ya byed nus ji 'dra yin pa des thad kur lta mkhan gyi gdeng 'jog la shugs rkyen thebs nges bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul byung dus/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par skad cha dang nyams 'gyur sogs kyi thad rtog 'dzing thebs nas rang dbang med par skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs kha nas shor ba dang rang nyams 'dra min sna tshogs phyir ston sla/ skad cha 'dra min shod pa dang rang nyams 'dra min ston pa des skabs la lar bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rang ngo'i bsam tshul ngo ma phyir mngon nas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mang po dang tha na bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa grags can gyis lo mang ring 'bad brtson lhod med byas nas bskrun pa'i snang brnyan legs po de lta mkhan gyi sems nas skad cig nyid la brlag srid/nyams 'dra min sna tshogs ston pa de ni rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa zhan pa'i mtshon stangs shig red/ nyams 'dra min sna tshogs ston pa de yang gdong gi rnam 'gyur 'os min dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur 'os min phyogs gnyis 'dus/ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur de yang thad mar sems kyi 'gyur ba las byung ba red/ ngo gdong gi 'gyur ldog brgyud nas sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs rtogs thub/ rang sems la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i nus pa zhan mkhan zhig yin tshe/ ngo gdong gi 'gyur ldog de phyi rol gyi tshor snang mi 'dra ba ltar 'gyur ldog 125

'byung ba red/ 'gyur ldog de rigs skabs la lar rang dbang med pa zhig yin zhing / de ni phyi rol gyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas 'gyur ba red/ dper na/ dga' 'os pa'i don dang 'phrad dus gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs pa dang mi dga' ba'i don dang 'phrad dus smin ma bsdu ba sogs lta bu red/ rang sems ji ma ji bzhin du phyir mngon pa'i rang gshis drang mo 'di lta bu ni 'tsho ba'i khrod du dge mtshan zhig yin mod/ yin yang / brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ zhan cha chen po zhig yin yang srid/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas brnyan 'phrin nang mi sna tshogs dang gleng mol bya dgos/ 'go 'dzin pa yin pa'i cha nas bsam 'char sna tshogs la nyan dgos/ skabs 'gar bcar 'dri bya yul gyis gus zhabs kyi rnam pas 'go 'dzin par bstod pa chen po byed srid la/ skabs la lar bcar 'dri bya yul gyis khyod la skyon brjod byed kyang srid/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa drag pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas phyi rol las byung ba'i bstod smod la snang dogs byed mi rigs/ de ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas phyi yul la snang med bya dgos zer ba min par/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa ldan par byas nas dgos mkho med dus mi dga' ba dang khro ba/ yang na dga' drags pa'i rnam 'gyur dang nyams 'gyur mi mngon pa byed pa'i blang bya tsam red/ rang nyams 'dra min sna tshogs ston pa'i mtshon stangs gzhan zhig ni/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul byung skabs ci bya gtol med du 'gyur ba de red/ dper na/ 'go 'dzin byed skabs rkang ba 'dred pa dang / le tshan thad gtong byed pa'i sgang la glo bur du glog chad pa/ skad cha shod skabs skad dung lhung ba sogs don dag glo bur ba 126

'di lta bu ni thad gtong go rim khrod rtag tu 'byung ba red/ sngon dpag byed mi thub pa'i gnas tshul 'di dag gi mdun du la las ci zhig bshad dgos pa mi shes pa dang la lar 'tshub cha langs nas ci byed 'di byed med par skad cig nyid la bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i zhi zhing dul ba'i nyams 'gyur med par 'gyur srid/ gnas tshul de dag ji ma ji bzhin du brnyan 'phrin nang shar dus/ lta mkhan gyis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa gang dag la rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa drag pa dang gang dag la rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa mi ldan pa gsal por mthong nges/kha nas skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs shor ba yang rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa zhan pa'i mtshon stangs shig red/ kha nas skad cha 'dra min shor ba zer ba ni le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i go rim khrod/ shes ma shes bar nas bab skabs dang mi mthun pa dang mi la brtsi bkur med pa/ yang na spyir btang gi lta mkhan rnams la sun snang bskyed pa'i skad cha bshad pa la zer/sanas tshul 'di brnyan 'phrin le tshan dang sgos su bcar 'dri gleng mol le tshan khrod byung ba cung mang / skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs kha nas shor ba'i rgyu rkyen shin tu mang / la la ni mnyam ma bzhag par rang gi sems la dran yang kha nas bshad mi 'os pa'i skad cha shor ba dang / la la ni bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul byung dus ci bya btol med du gyur nas ci bshad 'di bshad mi shes pa dang rang dbang med par bshad mi thos pa'i skad cha kha nas shor ba de yin/skad cha bshad tshar rjes tha na rang gis kyang ci bshad pa mi shes/ yang la la ni sems khams kyi 'gyur ba'i rjes 'brangs te/ dga' ba dang khro ba'i skabs su rang sems la bdag byed ma thub par bshad mi 'os pa'i skad cha bshad pa de 127

red/ da dung snang tshul zhig yod pa ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas ming tshig la la'i nang don dpyis phyin pa zhig ma shes pa dang lhag par du dmigs bsal gyi nang don ldan pa'i ming tshig kha shas kyi nang don ngo ma ma rtogs par gang byung du bkol bas/ bshad mkhan dang nyan mkhan gyi go ba kha khar song ba de red/ ming tshig la la zhig yig ngo nas smad pa'i go don med na'ang / mi mang po'i skad cha'i goms phyogs kyis skabs skabs su bkol sa kha shas su smad pa'i go don 'byung ba yang yod pas/ yongs su cha rgyus med par gang byung du bkol na skad cha 'dra min la go don 'dra min 'byung sla bas/ mi nyung shas kyi gras su khyab pa dang go don rnyog 'dzing che ba'i ming tshig de dag nang don gsal thag mi chod dus nges par du gzab gzab bya dgos/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa ni skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs shor ba je nyung du gtong ba dang gtan 'gog byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i cha rkyen red/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa drag pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas gnas tshul ga 'dra'i 'og tu'ang sems khams kyi dogs zon mi 'dor bar rang gis bshad pa'i skad cha tshig re re tshang ma ma bshad sngon la klad pa'i nang zhib dag byas nas bshad 'os min la dbye zhib byed srid/ zhib dag dbye zhib 'di rigs kyi go rim shin tu thung bas/ bshad mkhan la nyams tshor len pa'i tshor ba rnon po dang bsam gzhig gtong stangs hur po/ shan 'byed nus pa drag po yod dgos/ sems kyi 'gyur ba shin tu drag dus kyang skad cha'i nyen srung la lhod g.yeng spu tsam yang byed mi rung / sems khams lhod drags pa'am sems khams 'tshub drags skabs skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs shor sla/ mi la las le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed dus dal la babs nas/ bltas tshod kyis lhod sha ldan pa 'dra yang / don dam pas blo rtse 128

dang klad pa'ang de bzhin lhod drags pa dang ngos 'dzin dang dbye zhib nus pa nyams zhan du gyur pas/ skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs shor srid/ dper na/gzhan gyi skad cha'i don gsal por ma go bar de'i lta tshul la skyon brjod byas nas cig shos dang lta mkhan mgo rmongs par byed pa dang gzhan gyis ka bshad na lan la kha btab nas kha brda go ldog tu 'gro ba lta bu red/ sems khams 'tshub drags tshe/ klad pa'i skad char dbye zhib byed pa'i dbang po rid par gyur nas skad char dbye zhib yang dag pa byed mi thub par skad cha 'dra min bshad srid/ le tshan brnyan len byed dus rang spobs mi che ba dang brnyan len byed skabs kyi bsam yul las 'das pa'i gnas tshul gyi phog thug sogs tshang mas sems khams la 'tshub cha bzo srid/ gal te 'tshub cha de rigs myur du sel mi thub tshe/ 'tshub cha'i khrod du nor 'chug bzos nas skad cha 'dra min shor sla/ dper na/ 'go 'dzin pa zhig gis le tshan la 'gro 'dzin byed dus glo bur du rkang ba dngos por thogs pa dang mnyam du rang dbang med par kha nas tshig mi snyan pa re shor na lta mkhan khrod shugs rkyen ngan pa bzo nges/ shin tu dza drag che ba dang 'tshub cha che ba'i skabs su mi'i tshor ba'i dbang po yang shin tu hur por gyur nas rgyun ldan las 'das pa'i tshor snang mngon par byed srid/gros gleng rang bzhin gyi le tshan khrod du thal drags pa'i tshor snang de rigs kyis phan tshun mi dga' ba'i skad cha'i rtsod pa 'byung bar byed la/ skad cha'i rtsod pa'i bar du skad cha 'dra min sna tshogs shor sla/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs cung stod 'jags kyi sems khams shig bzung tshe rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa je drag tu gtong thub/ nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang rang tshod 'dzin par sbyong brdar 129

bya dgos/ skad cha bsams nas bshad de rang gi skad cha 'os 'tsham yin min la dbye zhib bya dgos/ bsams nas bshad pas tshig lan sogs cung dal bar byed srid mod/ yin na'ang skad cha 'os 'tsham bkol ched bag tsam gyi ring la bsam blo gtong ba ni dgos nges shig red/ skad cha'i goms srol legs po chags pa dang bstun nas skad cha bshad pa'i zhor la bsam blo btang nas lta mkhan gyis de bar gyi skyon phra mo tsam yang mi tshor ba bya dgos/ rang tshod 'dzin pa'i nus pa ni mi'i gshes ka sogs la 'brel ba yod/ don snying nges can zhig nas bshad na/ de yang mi'i lhan skyes kyi rgyu rkyen kha shas dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa red/ yin yang rjes grub kyi sbyong pas sngar bzhin nus pa gal chen bskyed kyin yod/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu mi mang gi lta skul 'og tu gnas pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nges par du dus dang rnam pa kun tu skad cha bsams nas bshad dgos/ skad cha bsams nas byed dgos zer ba de yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lta mkhan gyi mdun du rang gi lta tshul dang rang gi brtse dung drang mor mtshon mi rung bar bstan pa min la/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par dus nam yang bar ma bar gyi rnam pa dang go gnas shig 'dzin dgos zhes pa'ang ma red/ skad cha bsams nas bshad pa'i dmigs yul ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs/ gnas tshul ga 'dra'i 'og tu'ang sems kyi nyen zon mi lhod par dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang gi sems khams legs sgrig byas nas rang gi skad cha dang bya spyod la tshod 'dzin bya dgos pa de red/3 skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa/brnyan 'phrin steng nas nga tshos bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnam pa 130

sna tshogs mthong thub/ la la kha yangs la skad cha mang ba dang de ma thag gzhan la kha brda byed par brel 'dug pa'i snang ba zhig sbyin la/ la la ngo 'khyags shing smra brjod nyung ba dang dal brel med par btsan gyis gzhan la kha brda byed du mngags pa lta bu'i snang ba sbyin/ rnam 'gyur rigs de gnyis kyis skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa'i khyad par phyir mngon pa yin/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi khrod kha brda byed pa'i 'dun pa drag pa'i mi dang kha brda byas tshe/ kha brda de yang 'cham mthun ngang lhugs por 'ong zhing / pha rol pa'i lhag bsam gyis khyod kyang bskul nas kha brda byed pa'i 'dun pa je drag tu 'gro ba dang / de las ldog ste/ skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa mi drag pa'i mi dang kha brda byas tshe/ pha rol pa la 'dun pa drag po med pa'i ngang tshul gyis khyod kyi skad cha'i yi ga'ang 'gags par gyur nas kha brda legs po byed mi thub/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bcar 'dri byed skabs/ skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa drag min des thad kur bcar 'dri bya yul la shugs rkyen thebs pa dang /lta mkhan la kha phyogs dus de'i skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pas lta mkhan gyi sems khams dang lhag bsam la'ang shugs rkyen thebs nges red/ le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa drag po bcangs pa ni le tshan legs 'grub yong ba'i dgos nges kyi cha rkyen red/ skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa drag po zhes pa ni/ don bya rnams lta mkhan la bshad pa dang yang na gzhan dang kha brda byed pa'i 'dun pa drag po zhig la bstan pa las/ skad cha dang sems khams kyi rnam pa hod rgyug cig la bstan pa min/ skad cha bshad pa'i 'dun pa yod tshe/ khyod kyi skad cha dang rnam 'gyur rnam dag yin pas/khyod kyi skad cha ni zhe bsam pa'i gting nas byung ba las bcos ma zhig min 131

pa'i snang ba sbyin nges/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa la las skad cha bshad tshe nyams kyis phyug pa dang spro bag gis khengs shing tshig la 'brel chags la go rim gsal bas nyan mkhan gyis thos pa tsam gyis don go ba dang / la la'i skad char nya nyog mang zhing bskyar bzlos yang bshad byed pa dang tshig gi snying bo mi gsal bas/ nyan mkhan gyis des ci bshad 'dod pa mi shes pa red/ de ni skad cha'i mtshon nus sam bshad rtsal la rag las pa yin/ skad cha'i mtshon nus bzang min dang bshad rtsal la mkhas min de yang bshad mkhan gyi skad cha'i nyams tshor gyi nus par rag las pa red/ skad cha'i nyams tshor gyi nus pa ni thog mar skad cha'i go don la go ba len tshul las mtshon/ skad cha'i go don la yang dag par go ba len pa ni skad cha'i mtshon nus kyi rmang gzhi yin/ ming tshig gcig la go don mang po yod pa dang skad cha'i go don gcig kyang ming tshig mi 'dra bar brten nas mtshon par byas chog skad cha'i khor yug mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis ming tshig de dag gi 'jug yul lam go don la khyad par mi 'dra ba yod/ de yang ming tshig dang ming tshig bar gyi go don mi 'dra ba dang ming tshig gi 'jug yul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yongs su rtogs tshe/ da gzod ming tshig de dag 'os shing 'tsham pa dang yang dag par bkol thub pa red/nyams kyis phyug pa dang spro bag ldan pa'i skad cha yis skad cha'i go don mtshon thub pa ma zad/ skad la'ang 'gyur khugs ldan zhing 'gyur ldog che la brtse dung gi nyams kyis phyug par byas nas 'gugs shugs drag po ldan par byed thub/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas skad char dbye zhib dang nyams tshor len pa'i nus pa je drag tu gtong bar do snang bya dgos/ de ltar byas na skad cha'i nyams tshor nus pa legs po chags par byas nas/ skad cha'i mtshon nus sam 132

skad cha'i bshad rtsal la gson nyams ldan zhing brtse dung gi nyams phun sum tshogs pa red/lnga/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad dang skad cha'i mtshon nus/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gang yin yang rung /tshang mas skad dang skad cha'i mtshon nus la brten nas le tshan brgyud bsgrags bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin la brnyan ris yod stabs/ lta mkhan gyis brnyan ris la brten nas cha 'phrin sngar las mang po 'thob par byed thub kyang de ni brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags khrod kyi skad cha'i nus pa je zhan du song ba ma red/gnas tshul mang po'i khrod/ brnyan ris kho nar brten na lta mkhan la mkho ba'i dgos mkho yod tshad skong mi nus/ dper na/ nga tsho'i brnyan 'phrin khrod rtse po ta la'i brnyan ris shar tshe/ bod rigs lta mkhan mang che shos kyis skad char ma nyan yang de ni po ta la yin pa shes srid/ de ni kho tsho'i sngar yod kyi shes bya las byung ba zhig yin/ gal te brnyan ris mang po bstud mur byung ba dang /yang na brnyan 'phrin nang sngon chad yongs su cha rgyus med pa'i grong khyer zhig shar tshe/ grong khyer de dag gang gi yin pa dang ming la ci zer ba/ bstud mur byung ba'i brnyan ris de dag gis yang snying ci zhig mtshon pa sogs ni brnyan ris kho nas mtshon mi nus par skad cha'i gsal 'debs la brten dgos/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ de'i skad cha'i mtshon nus ni gtso bo rang ngo'i skad cha'i mtshon nus dang brnyan ris dang sbyar 133

pa'i skad cha'i mtshon nus phyogs gnyis 'dus/ rang ngo'i skad cha'i mtshon nus zer ba ni bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan brnyan 'phrin las shar ba'i skad cha'i mtshon nus la bstan pa dang / brnyan ris dang sbyar pa'i skad cha'i mtshon nus zer ba ni/ bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa nyid kyi gzugs brnyan brnyan 'phrin las mi shar bar brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris gzhan dag la skad cha sbyar nas 'grel bshad byed par bstan pa red/skad cha'i mtshon stangs rigs 'di gnyis kur le tshan gyi nang don mi 'dra ba dang 'gyur ldog mang ba'i rkyen gyis skad cha'i mtshon stangs rnam pa'ang mang po yod/ yin na'ang le tshan gyi 'gyur ldog ji 'dra yin pa dang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad la khyad par ji 'dra che'ang gsham gyi blang bya ni med du mi rung ba red/ thog mar rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ nges par du smra lce dag dgos/ smra lce dag pa zhes pa ni yi ge'i sgra len stangs yang dag pa yin dgos par bstan pa yin/ smra lce dag pa'am yi ge'i sgra len stangs yang dag cing tshad ldan yin pa ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las rigs kyi ches ma mtha'i blang bya red/ de min da dung rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas skad kyi bkol stangs yang dag pa khong du chud par byas nas/ bya ba'i khrod dang le tshan bshad skabs/ snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i skad la brten nas lta mkhan dang nyan mkhan 'gugs dgos la/ skad dang skad cha'i bkol stangs thad kyi 'brel yod shes bya dang rtsa ba'i thabs rtsal la byang bar bya dgos/smi skad 'byin pa'i dbang po/skad bkol stangs yang dag pa byang du chub dgos na/ thog mar skad 134

thon par byed pa'i dbang por cha rgyus yod dgos/ mi lus ni sha khrag gdos bcos kyi phung po zhig yin la/ sha khrag gdos bcos kyi phung po 'di'i khrod du dbang po sna tshogs yod de/ dper na/ pho ba ni 'ju byed dbang po yin pa dang glo ba ni dbugs 'byin rngub kyi dbang po yin pa lta bu red/ dbang po 'di dag gi nus pa gtso bo ni mi'i skye lugs kyi dgos mkho bskang rgyu de red/ skad thon pa'i dbang po ni mi lus khrod skad 'byin pa'i bya 'gul la zhugs pa'i dbang po la bstan zhing / skad thon pa'i dbang po ni dmigs bsal gyi ma lag cig red/ pho ba dang glo ba sogs don lnga snod drug dang mi mtshungs par/ skad thon pa'i dbang po ni mi lus kyi skye lugs kyi dgos mkho bskang rgyu'i ched du ma yin par/ mi dang mi'i bar 'dris par byed pa'i spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho'i ched du red/ phyi ngos nas bltas na dgos mkho 'di rigs ni mi'i tshe srog gi rgyun skyong ba'i skye lugs kyi dgos mkho lta bu'i gal chen zhig min pa 'dra mod/yin na'ang de yang mi che'i 'tsho ba hril bo'i grub cha gal chen zhig red/ dbang po gzhan pa dang mi 'dra bar skad 'byin pa'i ma lag de ni don dngos thog mi lus kyi nus pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang po mang po mnyam 'dus kyis grub pa zhig red/ dper na/ skad 'byin pa'i dbang por grub pa'i glo ba ni ma gzhir dbugs 'byin rngub ma lag la gtogs pa dang so dang lce ni ma gzhir 'ju byed ma lag la gtogs pa lta bu red/ de tsho'i ma gzhi'i nus pa ni skad 'byin pa min/ mi lus kyi skad 'byin pa'i dbang po so sos skad 'byin skabs kyi nus pa'ang mi mtshungs/ glo ba gtso byas pa'i rtsib sha dang brang kha/ glo sbug sogs kyis skad 'byin par mkha' dbugs kyi sgul shugs ma lag bskrun pa dang glo ba'i nus pa ni rlung sgam zhig dang 'dra bar glo ba phyir brkyangs dus dbugs 135

nang du rngub pa dang glo ba nang du bskums dus dbugs phyir gtong ba'i nus pa bskyed pa yin/ nam rgyun nga tshos dbugs phyir gtong dus byung ba'i dbugs rgyun la brten nas skad thon par byed/ mgrin pa ni rnyog 'dzing gi dbang po zhig yin te/ mgrin pa'i gnas gnyis su yod pa'i smra lce 'byed zum gyis smra sgo zhig grub cing / smra sgo des dbugs kyi rgyu tshad la tshod 'dzin byed thub la/dbugs kyi rgyu bas smra lce bsgul nas skad thon par byed thub/ mgrin pa'i gnas mi gcig pa nas skad kyi mtho dma' dang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs mi 'dra ba 'byung ba dang / dbugs phyir gtong ba'i drag zhan dang ring thung gis skad gdangs che chung dang ring thung gi 'gyur ldog 'byung bar byed/ mchu to dang so/ lce/ rkan/ sna sogs kyis dbugs rgyun la tshod 'dzin byas nas yi ge'i sgra sna tshogs thon par byed thub pas/ de dag ni yi ge'i sgra thon par byed pa'i dbang po yin/ nang sgos su rtse yis yi ge'i sgra thon pa'i khrod nus pa gal chen bskyed pas/ yi ge'i sgra thon par byed pa'i srog shing lta bu red/2 yi ge'i sgra len stangs/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ thog mar smra lce dag pa'am yi ge'i sgra dag dgos/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gang yin yang yi ge'i sgra len stangs dang de'i thad kyi blang bya ni 'dra mtshungs red/ de yang brnyan 'phrin la brnyan ris yod pas na/ bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa'i rang ngo'i rnam 'gyur dang 'gul stangs yin na 'dra/ de min skad cha dang brnyan ris yin na'ang 'dra/ de dag tshang mas skad cha'i cha 'phrin gyi nang don la shugs snon pa dang yang na skad cha'i cha 'phrin la kha gsab byed srid/ de bas rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi yi ge'i sgra len 136

stangs la mi mtshungs sa'ang yod/ brnyan 'phrin gyi yi ge'i sgra len stangs kyi blang bya de mdor bsdus nas bshad na/ dag pa dang / gsal ba/ snyan pa/bcos min bcas su bsdus chog yi ge'i sgra dag pa ces pa ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i yi ge'i sgra len stangs dag cing tshad ldan yin dgos par bstan/ lung ba re na chu mgo re/ sa cha re na skad rigs re zer ba nang bzhin mi rigs gang dang gang yin yang / khyab yul dang sa phyogs mi 'dra bas mi rigs gcig gi nang khul du'ang skad cha la khyad par yod pa red/ nga tsho bod rigs kyang de las ma 'das/ a mdo skad la dpe bzhag na'ang sa cha so so'i skad cha la khyad par spu tsam yang med pa zhig ma red/ nga tsho'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams kyang phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas yong ba yin phyin/ yi ge'i sgra dag min gnyis ka yod/ khyad par du zhing las sa khul nas yong ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams la rtag par yi ge'i sgra mi dag pa'i gnas tshul yod de/ dper na/ sngon 'jug bi sgra mi gsal ba ste/ bkrag dang grags kyi sgra 'dra ba dang / sngon 'jug yi ge'i dbye ba mi gsal ba ste/ngag dang 'dang gi sgra mtshungs pa/ 'dogs can gyi dbye ba mi gsal ba ste/rtogs dang ltogs/ sna dang rna/ gna' sogs la khyad par med pa/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge sgra yongs su mi thon pa dang mi gsal ba ste/ thams cad la than cad zhes dang thab ka la tha ka zhes 'byung ba/ mchu yi 'gyur ldog la brten nas 'byung ba'i rjes 'jug ba dang ma can gnyis bstud mar mnyam du byung tshe/ de dag gi sgra yongs su thon mi thub pa dang yang na sgra gzhan du 'gyur bzhin yod de dper na/ sems khams lta bur mtshon na/ yi ge re re bzhin bton na sgra dag kyang skad cha'i khrod mnyam du bshad skabs/ rtag par sen khams dang 137

sems khan zhes pa'i sgrar 'gyur bzhin yod/ phyugs las sa khul nas yong ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa phal che bar de lta bu'i gnas tshul mi 'byung mod/ yin yang rang rang sa cha'i yul skad kyi shan shugs 'ga' re'ang med pa ma yin te/ yi ge la la'i sgra gdangs drag che bas mi snyan pa dang sgra 'gyur ba lta bu'i gnas tshul yod pa red/ dper na/ bcu gnyis zhes pa 'don skabs/ bcu yi sgra drag che bas/ yi ge rjes ma gnyis kyi sngon 'jug ga sngon ma'i yi ge bcu la sbyar nas bcag ces pa'i sgra 'byung ba lta bu red/ sgra 'di lta bu ni yi ge'i 'jug stangs dang sgra yi yong stangs 'grig min la mi dpyod kyang / rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin khrod du bkol na ma mtha' yang rnar mi snyan pas bkol mi 'os/yi ge'i sgra gsal ba zhes pa ni yi ge'i sgra len dus kha lce gsal po yin pa dang / bshad mkhan gyis bshad pa'i skad cha'i tshig 'bru gzhan kyis go sla bar bstan pa de red/ rol dbyangs dang yang na khor yug gi sgra sna tshogs khrod nas nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha gsal por go bar bya rgyu de yang skabs la lar de 'dra sla mo zhig ma red/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyis lag brda dang rnam 'gyur sogs la brten nas skad char kha gsab gsal 'debs byas chog la/ rlung 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyis skad kho nar brten dgos phyir/ yi ge'i sgra len stangs la blang bya shin tu mtho/ brnyan 'phrin gyi yul dngos kyi sgra de rtag par brnyan ris dang bsdebs nas 'byung bas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad char bar chad bzos nas skad sgra'i gsal tshad je zhan du gtong srid/ mi la las bltas na/ skad cha gsal dgos tshe/ skad je mtho dang sgra gdangs je cher btang bas 138

chog snyam/ don dngos su de 'dra ma red/ skad gdangs kyi che chung dang skad kyi mtho dma' de kha lce gsal min dang sgra'i len stangs gsal min la 'brel ba chen po med/ yi ge'i sgra len stangs 'os 'tsham la brten pa dang / ji ltar 'os shing 'tsham pa'i sgra len stangs bkol ba de yang nam rgyun gyi sbyong ba la rag las pa red/ yi ge'i sgra dag pa dang sgra snyan pa zer ba de yang skad cha'i spyi khog gi tshor ba zhig la brjod pa las yi ge re re kho nar bstan pa zhig min/ skad cha'i khor lug mi gcig pa dang skad cha'i nang don mi gcig pa ltar yi ge'i sgra len stangs kyang mi 'dra/ gsar 'gyur bshad pa dang yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed pa gnyis ni skad cha'i khor yug mi 'dra bar gtogs pas/ skad kyi bkol stangs dang yi ge'i sgra len stangs sogs la khyad par cung yod nges/gsar 'gyur bshad skabs kyang srid gzhung gi dngos gzhi'i yig cha dang spyir btang gi 'tsho ba'i skor gyi gsar 'gyur gnyis la yi ge'i sgra yi len stangs dang skad gdangs kyi drag zhan sogs thad nas khyad par yod pa yin/ yi ge dang ming tshig 'dra na yang skad cha'i khor lug mi 'dra ba nas sgra yi shugs kyi drag zhan dang skad gdangs kyi ring thung dang mtho dma' sogs mi 'dra bar gang la gang 'tsham ngang bkol shes pa dang bkol mkhas par bya dgos/ yi ge'i sgra snyan pa zhes pa ni yi ge sgra len stangs 'os 'tsham las byung ba'i sgra snyan 'jebs shig la bstan pa las/ skad ngag snyan mo kho nar bstan pa min/ spyir btang du yi ge'i sgra len stangs 'os 'tsham dang sgra'i gnas yang dag pa yin na/skad ngag kyang je snyan dang je dwangs su gtong thub/ nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan phal ba zhig gis lhan skyes kyi skad dag dang yi ge'i sgra len stangs kyi dbye ba so sor bgar mi nus/ yi ge'i sgra bcos min zhes pa ni yi ge'i sgra gdangs de 139

nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi kha brda'i gdangs dang phal cher 'dra bar lhod sha tshad dang ran pa zhig la bstan pa yin/ 'di ni brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par dmigs nas bstan pa zhig yin/ rlung 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha dang skad gdangs la'ang 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi skad cha dang bar thag nye dgos pa'i blang bya yod mod/ yin na'ang de la mig mdun du shar ba'i brnyan ris kyi ram 'degs med par skad kyi mtshon nus kho nar brten dgos phyir/ skad cha'i 'gan khur lci ba dang skad gdangs dang skad kyi shugs cung drag dgos/ brnyan 'phrin la brnyan ris kyi ram 'dregs yod pa dang / bshad mkhan gyi lag pa dang lus po'i 'gul stangs dang rnam 'gyur sogs kyis skad char ram 'degs byas chog pas/ skad cha'i 'gan khur de yang rlung 'phrin las yang ba yin/ der brten brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyis yi ge'i sgra gdangs dang sgra'i len stangs sogs tshad las 'das na/bshad mkhan gyi snang brnyan la gnod pa dang / 'bur dod che ba'i skad sgras da dung lta mkhan gyis brnyan ris la lta bar bar chad bzo nges/ rlung 'phrin gyi le tshan bshad skabs/ bshad rtsom gyi nang don gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang mtshon par byed pa dang skad cha'i mtshon nus la 'gugs shugs ldan pa'i ched du bshad mkhan mang che ba 'gul stangs sna tshogs la goms yod de/ la las ngo yi rnam 'gyur ram 'gul stangs dang mchu yi 'byed zum che drag pa dang / la las skad kyi mtho dma' dang bstun nas mgo yi 'degs 'jog dang tha na khog stod kyi 'gul stangs che drags pa sogs red/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod du rtag par bshad mkhan gyi ngo gdong gi gzugs brnyan 'char ba yin phyin/ mchu to'i 'byed zum che drags pa dang mgo yi 'gul stangs tshad las 'das na/ lta 140

mkhan la mi bde ba dang yang na dgod bro ba'i tshor snang 'byung srid/ nga tsho bshad mkhan mang po'i khrod du/ rtag par sgra mi dag pa dang sgra la shugs med pa'am sgra mi grim pa/ yang na yi ge'i sgra mi gsal bar ldab ldib yin pa sogs kyi gnad don 'byung bzhin yod/ lhag par du bshad mkhan gyi las la thog mar zhugs pa dang yang na las rigs de la byang med pa'i bshad mkhan gsar ba rnams la gnad don de dag 'byung sla/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gang yin rung tshang mas kha lce dang skad sogs la nyin rer sbyong ba bya dgos/ dus rgyun sgra dag mo mi thon pa'i yi ge'i skor yang dang yang du gyer 'don byed pa dang bshad rtsom 'ga' re gra sgrig byas nas dngos su sgra len pa dang brnyan phab byed pa nang bzhin yang yang bshad de sbyong ba bya dgos/ rab yin na sgra phab 'phrul chas las sgra blangs rjes rang gis yang yang nyan te/ rang si yi ge'i sgra len stangs dang skad dang dbugs kyi bkol stangs/ de min tshig gi yong phyogs dang tshig gi gcod mtshams/ skad cha'i mtshon stangs sogs 'grig min la dpyad tshe/ gnad don gang na yod pa shes pa dang / rang nyid kyi byed sgo'i chu tshad yar thon yong bar shin tu phan pa red/3 dbugs len stangs/dbugs 'byin rngub kyis skad dang sgra thon pa'i so rim khrod skul shugs 'don sprod byed pa'i nus pa bskyed kyin yod/ dbugs kyi len stangs 'os 'tsham min pa des kyang yi ge'i sgra yongs stangs dang skad bkol stangs la gnod pa bzo srid/ dbugs 'byin rngub thad kyi blang bya de yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bshad bya'i rigs la thad kur 'brel ba yod/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad skabs/ gsar 'gyur gyi bshad rtsom ni tshags dam 141

la mdor bsdus pa 'i gsar 'gyur skad cha yin pa dang / tshig cung ring zhing tshig bi sgrig stangs cung rnyos 'dzing yin pas/ bshad mkhan la dbugs rgyun brtan zhing drag pa dang dbugs sna cung ring po ldan dgos/ gsar 'gyur bshad skabs/ skad gdangs la mtho dma' chen po med pas dbugs phyir gtong dus brtan po yin dgos/ gal te dbugs rgyun lan rer che zhing lan rer chung tshe/ skad kyang tshod 'dzin bzang po byed mi thub par 'dar nges/bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur las gzhan da dung 'tsho ba'i rang bzhin gyi le tshan rnam pa sna tshogs bshad dbos shing / le tshan 'di rigs khrod skad cha'i ngag la 'gyur ldog che ba dang bshad tshul yang rnam pa sna tshogs red/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par skad cha'i khyad chos de rigs dang mthun pa'i gson nyams ldan zhing bab bstun gyi skad cha'i mtshon nus dang rnam pa mang ba'i dbugs kyi 'byin rngub byed stangs ldan dgos/ de yang bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin par dbugs kyi 'byin rngub byed stangs thad nus pa 'di 'dra ldan dgos pa ste/ dbugs rgyun cung che ba yod dgos pa dang gcig dbugs rgyun tshod 'dzin nus pa cung drag po yod dgos pa dang dbugs phyir gtong tshul brtan zhing dbugs sna ring dgos pa dang gnyis/ le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs dbugs len stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bab bstun ngang bkol shes pa dang gsum bcas red/ dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs la yang gsus chung las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa dang brang kha las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa/ brang kha dang gsus chung gnyis gas mnyam du dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa bcas sna gsum yod/ gsus chung las dbugs len stangs ni gsus sha 'gul stangs kyis glo ba brkyang bskum byed du bcug nas dbugs 142

dzub pa dang 'byin pa'i dbugs len stangs shig la zer/ dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di rigs kyis dbugs 'byin rngub byed skabs/ dbugs nang du rngub pa dang phyi ru gtong ba dang bstun nas gsus chung brkyang bskum byed pas de la gsus chung las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa zer/ gsus chung las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa ni mi'i rang shugs kyis dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs shig yin te/ skyes ma thag nas bzung dbugs 'byin rngub byed thabs 'di rigs shes la/ nga tshos spyir btang gi 'tsho ba'i skad cha'i khrod du dbugs 'byin rngub byed thabs 'di rigs rang shugs su bkol ba red/ dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di rigs kyis skad thon yun mi ring ba dang dbugs rgyun yang de 'dra mi brtan mod/ yin yang dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di'i dbugs kyi rgyu tshul lhod cing skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs phun sum tshogs pa dang gsus sha'i ldem shugs cung che la dbugs rgyun la 'gyur ldog cung chen po byed chog der brten gsus chung las dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di skad cha'i tshags mi dam zhing cung bag lhod yin pa'i le tshan khrod bkol bar rigs/ de yang le tshan bshad skabs bkol ba'i dbugs rgyun ni spyir btang gi 'tsho ba'i skad cha las cung che ba ni bshad ma dgos pa red/brang kha las dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs ni brang sha phyir brkyangs pa dang nang du bskums pa'i stobs kyis glo ba brkyang bskum byas te dbugs phyir 'byin pa dang nang du rngub pa'i dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs la zer/ brang kha las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa'i dbugs rgyun cung chung / spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og brang kha las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa de ni gsus chung las dbugs 'byin pa la kha gsab rgyag pa tsam yin/ gal te brang kha'i dbugs 143

'byin rngub byed stangs kho na byung tshe de ni rgyun ldan zhig min/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ brang kha las dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs gtso byed pa'i gnas tshul 'byung don ni 'tshub cha langs pa dang skrag snang skyes pa'i rkyen red/ sems kyi dngangs skrag sel te lus yongs glod pa ni brang kha las dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa las g.yol ba'i thabs gtso bo red/ 'tshub cha dang skrag snang las gzhan/ da dung zas rgyags pa zos pa dang dbugs rngub skabs gsus chung sdud drags pa/ lus ngo/'i 'dug stangs mi 'os pa sogs kyis kyang brang kha gtso byas pa'i dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs bzo srid/dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs de rigs da dung mi'i sems khams kyi 'gyur ldog drag po ste/ dga' ba dang skrag pa/ 'tshub pa sogs kyi skabs kyang 'byung nges/ gal te le tshan khrod sems khams kyi 'gyur ldog 'di rigs mtshon dgos tshe/ dmigs yul yod pa'i ngang brang kha'i dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di spyad de skad cha'i mtshon nus je drag tu btang chogagasus chung dang brang kha gnyis las mnyam du dbugs 'byin pa/ brang kha dang gsus chung gnyis ka mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa ni gsus sha'i ldem shugs dang brang sha brkyang bskum zung du sbrel ba'i dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs shig yin/ dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di rigs ni spyir btang 'tsho ba'i khrod rtag par bkol ba zhig min/ mi mang por mtshon na dbugs len stangs 'di rigs ni ched du sbyong brdar byas na da gzod bkol shes/ brang kha dang gsus chung mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs 'byin rngub byed pa 'dis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyis le tshan bshad skabs dbugs rgyun che dgos pa dang dbugs rngub tshad mgyogs pa/ skad 144

'byin yun ring dgos pa bcas kyi dgos mkho skong thub pas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas khong du chud dgos pa'i gzhi rtsa'i dbugs 'byin rngub byed thabs shig yin/ brang kha dang gsus chung gnyis mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs des ma gzhir gsus chung las dbugs rngub tshad che ba'i steng brang kha'i dbugs 'byin rngub gyis da dung dbugs rgyun la kha snon byed pa'i nus pa bed spyod pa zhig red/ de ltar byas na dbugs rngub tshad je mgyogs su gtong thub/ yi ge'i sgra len stangs myur dbos dus dbugs brje ba'i dus yun shin tu thung / 'di'i skabs su dbugs rngub tshad mgyogs pa'i byed thabs 'di rigs spyad tshe skad cha'i skad gdangs dang tshig gi rgyun mthud par phan pa yod/ dbugs rngub skabs tshod 'dzin byed stangs gnyis spyad chog dbugs rngub pa'i dus yun 'dang tshim pa yod dus/ sngon na gsus chung las dbugs rngub stangs spyod pa dang rjes su brang kha'i dbugs rngub stangs spyad chog dbugs rngub stangs 'di risas spyad na gsus chung cung lhod pa'i ngang yun gyis dbugs rngub pa dang gsus chung dbugs kyis cung 'gengs pa'i dus su brang sha brkyangs nas mu mthud du dbugs nang du rngub dgos/skabs der rtsib sha phyir brkyangs pa'i tshor ba bskyed/ nga tshos me tog gi dri zhim sogs la snom dus rtag par dbugs rngub thabs 'di rigs bkol ba yin/thabs gzhan zhig ni dbugs rngub skabs gsus chung cung nang du sdud pa dang brang shas mar mnan nas dbugs rngub dgos/ brang sha mar gnon dus brang sha brkyangs nas dbugs rngub par rogs byed srid pas gsus chung dang brang kha gnyis ka mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs rngub pa red/ dbugs rngub stangs 'di rigs tshod 'dzin byas pa legs na dus yun shin tu thung ngu'i nang dbugs 145
