cung mang po rngub thub/ dbugs rngub stangs 'di gnyis la go rim ltar dbugs rngub pa dang mnyam du dbugs rngub pa zhes zer/ dbugs rgyun cung che dbos pa/ dang skad cha cung dal dus nga tshos go rim ltar gyi dbugs rngub thabs bkol chos pa dang / skad cha cung mgyogs pa'i dus su nga tshos mnyam du dbugs rngub stangs spyad chog dbugs rngub stangs 'di gnyis ni skabs bab kyi dgos mkho ltar sang la gang 'tsham ngang spyod dgos/ le tshan bshad skabs bkol ba'i gsus chung dang brang kha gnyis mnyam 'brel sgos dbusas 'byin rngub byed stangs kyis dbugs rngub skabs/ gsus chung cung nang du sdud dgos pa las rbad de lhod pa zhig min/ gsus chung 'os 'tsham ngang nang du sdud pa de yang skad 'byin par gra sgrig byed pa red/ gsus chung dang brang kha gnyis mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs kyi dbugs phyir gtong ba'i go rim ni dbugs 'byin rngub gyi go rim hril bo'i gnad 'gag red/dbugs phyir gtong yun cung ring bo yod par khag theg dang dbugs rgyun brtan po 'don sprod byed ched/ nam rgyun dbugs phyir gtong dus nus pa kha kha yin pa'i lus sha'i grim shugs phyogs gnyis kyi khyad par la brten nas dbugs phyir gtong bar tshod 'dzin byed pa yin/ dbugs 'byin dus brang kha dang gsus pa'i bar gyi sha rgyud kyi ldem shugs la brten nas dbugs rgyun phyir btang yang chog yin na'ang dbugs phyir gtong thabs 'di rigs las byung ba'i dbugs rgyun brtan po min pa dang shugs gnyom pas/ skad 'byin dus tshod 'dzin byed dka' ba dang skad kyang mgo che ba dang mjug chung ba red/dbugs phyir gtong thabs gzhan zhig ni lus sha'i grim shugs mi 'dra bar tshod 'dzin byas nas dbugs phyir gtong bar tshod 'dzin bya rgyu de red/ thog 146

mar dbugs rngub dus gsus chung cung nang du bsdus te/ dbugs phyir gtong ba'i gra sgrigabya dgos/ gsus chung nang du sdud shugs ha cang chung dgos/sdud shugs che drags tshe dbugs rngub tshad je nyung du gtong srid/ dbugs 'byin skabs gsus chung nang du sdud shugs je cher btang nas dbugs phyir gtong dbos/ gsus chung sdud shugs kyi che chung la brten nas dbugs rgyun phyir gtong tshad la tshod 'dzin bya dgos/ brang sha brkyang bskum las kyang dbugs phyir gtong bar tshod 'dzin byed thub mod/ yin na yang brang kha'i dbugs 'byin rngub nus par tshad yod phyir/ gsus chung sdud shugs la tshod 'dzin byed pa lta bu'i phan 'bras de 'dra mngon gsal ma red/ dbugs 'byin rngub kyis lus sha'i sdud shugs dang ldem shugs mi 'dra bar tshod 'dzin byas nas dbugs phyir gtong ba de'i dbugs rgyun brtan zhing dbugs sna ring phyir/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyi dbugs 'byin rngub byed thabs gal chen zhig yin zhing / des bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas skad 'byin par rmang gzhi brtan po gtong thub/ gsus chung dang brang kha gnyis mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs de lus sha'i sdud shugs dang ldem shugs sogs la brten nas yongs 'grub bya dgos pas/ dus yun nges can zhig la sbyong brdar byas nas lus shar grim shugs nges can zhig 'dzoms rjes da gzod phan 'bras 'thob nges/ mnyam 'jog dgos pa zhig la/dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs 'di bkol skabs/ tshod 'dzin byed drags tshe/dbugs rgyun bkag nas skad cha'i mtshon nus je zhan du gtong srid/nam rgyun bshad mkhan gyis bshad pa'i go rim khrod du dbugs sna brje thabs la'ang do snang bya dgos/ dbugs sna brje thabs zhes pa ni skad 'byin 147

pa'i khrod du dbugs kyis mi 'dang ba'i skabs su tshig dang tshig gi bar du dbugs rngub pa la zer/ tshig dang tshig gi gcod mtshams bed spyad de dbugs sna rgyun ldan ngang brje ba dang / tshig gcig gi bar du yud tsam gyi khong gseng bed spyad nas dbugs sna lkog brje byed pa / de min dbugs rngub pa'i sgra bed spyad nas skad cha'i nang don mtshon par byed pa'i dbugs sna mngon brje bcas ni rgyun mthong gi dbugs sna brje stangs red/ skad 'byin pa'i go rim khrod kyi dbugs brje sa de la dbugs mtshams zhes brjod chog la/de ni skad 'byin pa'i go rim khrod skad cha'i nang don mthud pa'i tshags dam lhod dang skad cha'i nang don mtshon par mkho ba'i dbugs brje sa'i mtshams la bstan pa yin/ dbugs mtshams de yang rang byung gi tshig rkang re re bzhin yod pa zhig ma yin par skabs 'gar tshig thung 'ga' res grub pa'i tshig tshogs mang por dbugs mtshams gcig re las med cing skabs 'gar tshig gcig gi khrod du'ang dbugs mtshams 'ga' re yod nges/dbugs sna rgyun ldan ngang brje ba zer ba ni skad cha tshan pa gcig gi rjes dang tshig dang tshig bar gyi mtshams chen mo zhig gi bar du bag lhod ngang dbugs rngub pa la zer/ rtsom hril bo zhig dang yang na skad cha tshan pa zhig dbugs thengs gcig gis bshad tshar ba zhig min par rtag par dbugs rngub thengs 'ga' re bya dgos/ skad cha'i khrod kyi tshig mtshams chen po bed spyad de dbugs brje ba ni skad cha mtshon stangs khrod ches spyir btang gi dbugs brje thabs kyi rigs shig red/ rgyun ldan gyi dbugs brje stangs de skad cha'i tshig gi ring thung dang nang don gyi mtshon tshul/ skad gdangs kyi che chung sogs ltar dbugs rngub tshad gtan khel bya dgos/ gal te skad cha tshan pa zhig dang tshig 148

ma/tshams hril bo zhig tshar rjes/ dbugs sna'ang tshar te kha gsab rgyag dgos na tshig mtshams dang bstun nas dbugs brje tshe skad cha'i mtshon stangs dang dbugs kyi len mtshams 'os shing mthun pa yin/ rgyun ldan gyi dbugs brje ba'i skabs su rang gi nyams myong ltar rang shugs kyis dbugs rngub tshad legs sgrig byed pas ched dmigs kyis do snang byed mi dgos/ yin yang rgyun ldan gyi dbugs brje skabs dbugs rngub tshad mang drags na tshod 'dzin byed dka' ba dang dbugs rngub rjes khong du sdud drags mi rung / gnas tshul 'di gnyis gas skad sgo'i 'byed zum dam du bcug nas skad la lhod cha med par 'gyur nges/dbugs sna lkog brje zhes pa ni skad 'byin pa'i go rim khrod sgra mi 'byin par dbugs rgyun la kha gsab byed pa'i byed thabs rigs shig red/skad 'byin skabs tshig ring drags pa dang skad cha shin tu mgyogs dus/ spyir btang du rgyun ldan gyis dbugs brje thub pa'i tshig bar chen po yod mi srid/skabs der rtag par tshig bar gyi ming tshig dang ming tshig bar gyi mtshams thung ngu bed spyad de dbugs snar kha snon byed pa yin/ dbugs brje stangs 'di rigs la bar mtshams mngon gsal dang dbugs rngub pa'i sgra mngon gsal med/ dbugs sna lkog brje byed stangs de spyir btang du dbugs rgyun tshar la nye ba dang / rjes kyi skad cha mi mang ba'i skabs su bkol ba yin/ dbugs sna lkog brje byed stangs kyi dbugs mtshams de yang nam rgyun mthud mtshams de 'dra mi dam pa'i ming tshig dang ming tshig bar du 'jog pa yin/ de ltar byas tshe tshig 'brel la mi gnod pa dang nyan mkhan gyis kyang mi tshor ba red/dbugs sna lkog brje byed pa ni dbugs rgyun la kha gsab byed pa tsam yin pas 149

dbugs rngub tshad nyung / dbusas rngub skabs sgra mi 'byung bar byed ched dbugs rngub skabs skad sgo cung chen po 'bya dgos/dbugs sna mngon brje ni skad 'don skabs dbugs rngub sgra 'byin pa'i dbugs brje stangs shig yin/ skad cha'i 'gyur khugs mgyogs pa dang skad cha'i mtshon tshul dang skad gdangs cung drag skabs/ dbugs rgyun rgyu tshad shin tu che bas rtag par tshig dang tshig gi bar dang tshig bcig gi bar du mgyogs myur sgos dbugs rgyun la kha snon bya dgos/ mgyogs myur sgos dbugs rngub pa de dbugs rgyun skad lam nas rgyu dus dbugs rngub pa'i sgra 'byin srid cing / skad cha'i khrod 'dres pa'i dbugs rngub sgra yis bshad mkhan gyi dngangs 'tshab dang dza drag sogs brtse dung gi rnam pa mtshon te/skad cha'i mtshon nus lhag par mngon thub/ dbugs sna brje stangs 'di rigs rtag par brtse dung gi rnam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang skad cha gson nyams ldan pa'i khrod du bkol gyin yod/ dbugs sna mngon brje byed skabs dbugs rngub tshad mgyogs dgos/ dbugs rngub sgrar mnyam 'jog mi dgos pas/ skad sgo che ru 'byed mi dgos la dbugs rngub pa'i sgra de skad cha'i 'gyur khugs shig tu 'gyur bar byas tshe/ skad char shin tu rang nyams ldan nges/ dbugs mngon brje byed skabs dbugs rgyun gyi drag zhan dang che chung ni skabs de'i dgos mkho ltar bkol dgos/ gong du bshad pa'i dbugs brje stangs de dag tshang ma bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rgyun du bkol dgos pa red/ byed thabs 'di rigs byang chub pa'i ngang bkol mkhas par byed ched/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las rigs la gsar du zhugs mkhan rnams kyis thog mar bshad bya'i rtsom yig steng / dbugs 'byin rngub byed mtshams la 150

rtags brgyab nas sbyong ba byas chog nga tsho'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mang po dang nang sgos su skyes ma bshad ca/khan dang 'go 'dzin par dbugs sna thung ba dang skad gnyom pa'i gnad don 'byung bzhin yod/ de'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs yang dag pa min par gsus chung las dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs dang gsus chung dang brang kha mnyam 'brel sgos dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs ma bkol ba'i rkyen red/ dbugs phyir gtong skabs yi ge'i sgra len stangs la tshod 'dzin legs po byed mi thub pa dang dbugs rgyun yig mgo nas brlag pa mang ba/ de min skrag snang skyes pa dang 'tshub cha langs pa bcas kyis kyang gnad don 'di rigs 'byung bar byed srid/ bshad mkhan la lar da dung dbugs snas mi 'dang bar tshig rnga skyong dka' ba dang skad 'byin dka' ba'i gnad don byung nas rtag par skad cha'i tshig rnga chad la nye ba'i gnad don 'byung bzhin yod/ gnad don 'di rigs sel dgos na/ phyogs gcig nas dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs legs bcos byas nas dbugs rngub tshad je cher gtong dgos pa dang / phyogs gzhan gcig nas skad kyi rgyu spus la khag theg byed pa'i mtshungs su tshig mgo nas dbugs mang po mi bkol ba dang skad sgo 'byed tshad che drags mi rung ba/yig mtho dang yig rnga nas tshod 'dzin 'os 'tsham byas nas dbugs rgyun shor ba sngon 'gog bya dgos/4 skad kyi bkol tshul/skad ni skad cha grub pa'i rgyu cha gtso bo yin pa dang mgrin pa ni skad kyi gnas sgo gtso bo red/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni sgyu rtsal 'khrab ston pa min par/ rang gi thob thang dngos kyi thad nas brnyan 'phrin nang 'char 151

bas/ kho tsho'i skad la rang ngag dang rang nyams yod dgos pa las/ sgro 'dogs chen po byed mi dbos/ gzhan la lad zlos dang yang na mi sna gzhan zhig gi 'khrab ston pa de bas kyang byed mi 'os/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad ni snyan zhing 'gyur khugs ldan pa zhig yin na da gzod nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan bkug nas cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byed pa'i nus pa bskyed thub/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs yin zhing /le tshan mi 'dra bas skad kyi bkol tshul thad kyi blang bya'ang mi mtshungs pa red/'di ru bshad pa'i skad kyi bkol tshul ni skad kyi mtho dma' dang ngag gi 'gyur khugs/ skad bdangs kyi che chung sogs la bstan pa yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ skad kyi mtho dma' dang skad ngag skad gdangs kyi che chung sogs skad kyi gzhi rtsa'i rgyu cha 'di dag yang dag par bkol mkhas par bya dgos/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad gdangs mtho shos ni/ rang byon gyi skad mtho shos dang skad mthon po'i 'gyur ldog phyogs gnyis la bstan pa yin/ rang byon gyi skad mthon po ni brtse dung gi 'gyur ldog chen po med pa'i spyir btang gi skad cha'i khrod bkol ba'i skad gdangs mthon po zhig la bstan pa dang / skad gdangs mthon po'i 'gyur ldog ces pa ni gnas mtho shos las bton pa'i skad mtho shos la brten nas skad cha'i nang don dang brtse dung gi 'gyur ldog mtshon par byed par bstan pa yin/ mi re re'i skad ngag gi cha rkyen mi 'dra bas/ rang byon gyi skad mthon po'i gnas kyang mi 'dra ba red/rang byon gyi skad mtho shos bkol dus mgrin pa dang smra lce glod nas skad la lhod bag ldan pa red/ rang byon gyi skad mtho shos kyi gnas las brgal te/mgrin sgo dang smra rtse je dam du song na/ skad kyang cung btsir nas thon pa'i 152

snang ba ster nges/ nam rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod/ mi rnams kyis phan tshun kha brda byed skabs bkol ba ni rang shugs kyis thon pa'i skad mtho shos yin phyir/dmigs bsal gyi skad bkol ba'i gnad don yod mi srid/ yin na'ang rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyis le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs/ dmigs bsal gyi bya ba'i khor yug khrod du sems la 'tshub cha langs pa dang de min yi ge'i sgra len stangs dang dbugs 'byin rngub sogs kyi blang byas kyang mgrin sgo grim par gyur nas skad cha'i skad gdangs rang dbang med par je mtho dang je dma' ru 'gro ba'i gnad don 'byung ba red/ rang byon gyi skad mtho shos ni mi'i lhan skyes kyi skad 'byung gnas nas thon pa'i skad gdangs shig yin pa dang mi re re'i skad kyi gnas so sor mi 'dra bas rang byon gyi skad mtho shos de yang mi 'dra/ der brten skad kyi bya ba byed mkhan rnams dang nang sgos su rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang rang gi lhan skyes kyi cha rkyen ltar rang gi skad bkol ba las/ rang gi gnas tshul dang mi mthun par gzhan gyi skad la lad zlos dang slob sbyong bya mi 'os/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mang po'i skad bkol ba'i thad kyi gnad don mang che ba ni rang gi cha rkyen dngos dang mi bstun par/ thog ma'i slob sbyong gi dus su gzhan gyi skad la slob sbyong byas pa dang 'brel ba yod/ rang gi lhan skyes kyi skad mtho shos bkol shes par byed pa ni skad bkol stangs thad kyi bya rim gal chen zhig red/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bshad bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs shing rnam pa sna tshogs yin pas/ skad cha'i khrod gyi brtse dung gi 'gyur ba yang phun sum tshogs pa yin nges/ gal te khyod kyi skad la 'gyur ba med tshe/ skad cha'i mtshon stangs la 153

nyams mi ldan pa dang 'os shing legs pa'i sgo nas bshad bya'i nang don mtshon mi thub/ 'di ru skad kyi gnas zhes pa de yang skad cha mtshon par bya ba'i skad 'byung sa'i khongs la bstan pa yin/ skad kyi gnas cung yangs na skad cha'i mtshon nus phun sum tshogs pa yin pas/ thog mar sbyang mkhan rnams kyis skad kyi mtho gnas dang dma' gnas gnyis kur sbyong ba byas nas rang gi skad kyi gnas je yangs la gtong dgos/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni glu ba glu ma dang mi 'dra bar skad kyi mtho tshad de nges par du gtan khel gyi mtho tshad nges can gyi gnas shig la bsleb dgos pa min par/ skad mtho shos de la 'gyur ldog yod par byed thub pas chog der brten bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas skad sbyang dus skad mtho shos kho na mi steg par mtho dma' gnyis kur rgya bskyed tshe/ rjes su skad bkol ba dang dngos su le tshan bshad skabs skad mtho drags pa dang dma' drags pa'i gnas tshul 'byung mi srid/ skad bkol dus da dung skad mgo mas skad mtho dma' la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen la do snang bya dgos/ skad mgo ma zer ba ni skad cha'i ches thob ma'i skad sgra de la zer ba dang nga tshos le tshan bshad skabs kyi ches thog ma'i skad kyi mgo 'dzugs sar bstan pa yin/ skad mgo ma'i mtho dma' de bshad rtsom hril bo'i skad kyi mtho dma' la shugs rkyen mngon gsal thebs kyin yod pa dang bshad rtsom hril bo'i skad gdangs mtho dma' gtan khel byed kyin yod/ gal te skad kyi mtho dma' gtan khel byas rjes/ bshad rtsom hril bo'i skad gdangs mtho dma' gyi 'gyur ba tshang ma skad kyi mtho tshad de dang bstun nas yar 'degs mar phab bya dgos/ der brten bshad rtsom gyi skad mgo ma'i mtho dma' nges par du 'os 'tsham yin dgos shing bshad rtsom hril bo'i khrod kyi tshan pa re re'i 154

skad mgo ma'i 'gyur ldog la'ang ha cang mnyam 'jog dgos/skad kyi mtho dma' las gzhan/ mgrin pa'i skad sgo'i 'byed zum mi 'dra ba las ngas gi 'gyur khugs mi 'dra ba 'byung srid/ 'di ru brjod pa'i ngag gi 'gyur khugs ni skad cha'i nang don mi 'gyur ba'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs rigs shig ste/ ngag gi dwangs gsal dang ngag gi drag zhan/ ngag gi grim lhod kyi 'gyur ldog la bstan pa yin/ nga tshos skad 'byin skabs/ mgrin pa'i logs gnyis kyi smra lce'i 'byed zum byed skabs bar gseng med tshe/dbugs rgyun gyi bcir sgra mi 'byung bar skad dwangs mo thon thub pa dang gal te skad sgo che ru phye na smra lce 'gul stangs de 'dra mi che ba dang dus mtshungs su dbugs rgyun gyi btsir sgra 'dres nas skad ngag gnyom pa'am stong bar 'gyur nges/ skad sgo'i 'byed tshad kyis bzos pa'i skad ngag gi grim lhod drag gnyom gyi 'gyur ldog de ni bstud mar 'byung ba'i skad ngag gi 'gyur ldog gi go rim zhig yin pas/ bar mtshams gsal po med/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams kyis bkol bde bar byed ched/ skad ngag khrod dbugs rgyun bcir ba'i che chung dang skad sgo 'byed tshad ltar/ skad kyi dwangs gnyom drag stong gi skad ngag 'di rigs kyang drag grim gyi skad dang drag stong 'dres ma'i skad/ stong gnyom gyi skad/ dbugs skad bcas rigs bzhir dbye chog de'i so so'i khyad chos dbye na drag grim gyi skad ni skad sgo 'byed zum cung dam pa dang dbugs rgyun gyi bcir sgra med pa'i skad ngag dwangs mo'i rigs shig yin/ skad ngag 'di rigs kyis rtag par gzab nan dang brjid nyams kyi tshor ba sbyin nges/skad 'di rigs 'byin dus skad sgo thum pa dam pas/ dbugs rgyun gron chung byed thub/ dbugs rgyun 'dra ba la skad gdangs cung che ba dang dus yun cung 155

ring / yin na'ang skad 'byin skabs skad sgo dam por zum pas/ logs gnyis kyi smra lce 'gul ba'i 'gan khur je phyir btang ste/ bkol ba mang drags na smra lce la gnod pa bzo srid/ skad 'di rigs rtag par dngos gzhi'i yig cha sogs 'don pa'i thad bkol zhing / sgrog 'don dang gyer 'don gyi cha 'dres/drag stong 'dres ma'i skad ni skad 'byin skabs skad sgo lhod pa dang skad kyi khrod dbugs sna'i bcir sgra bag tsam 'dres shing / skad ngag snyan 'jam zhig yin/skad ngag 'di rigs thos tshor la lhod sha ldan pas mi ngo shes dang kha brda byed pa lta bu'i tshor ba sbyin/ skad 'di rigs 'byin skabs skad sgo grim zhing dam pa zhig min par dbugs rgyun nyung ngu 'dres pa dang smra lce'i 'gan khur cung yang /yin yang dbugs sna 'dra ba la skad gdangs dang dus yun tshang ma drag grim gyi skad la mi do ba red/ skad ngag 'di rigs ni nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod bkol ba'i skad ngag rigs shig yin/ der brten skad ngag 'di rigs ni gleng mol tshul gyi le tshan rigs so sor yongs khyab tu bkol la/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rgyun du bkol ba'i skad ngag red/ stong gnyom gyi skad ni skad sgo la bar gseng cung chen po yod pa dang smra lce 'gul tshad cung zhan pas skad kyi khrod dbugs rgyun gyi bcir sgra cung che ba de red/ skad ngag 'di rigs nyan na snying nye ba zhig gi tshor ba sbyin/ yin na'ang bkol spyod byas pa mi legs tshe bcos ma'i snang ba sbyin nges/ skad 'di rigs 'byin dus smra lce 'gul ba mi bzang ba dang dbugs rgyun 'dzad tshad cung mang phyir/ dbugs rgyun 'dra ba'i gnas tshul 'og skad gdangs cung chung ba dang dus yun thung / skad 'di rigs skabs la lar gnyom tshad dang snying nye tshad mang drags pas/ le tshan bshad skabs spyir btang du dmigs bsal gyi nang don ldan pa'i bshad rtsom 156

dang tshan pa'i nang ma gtogs bkol mi 'os shing / bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bkol ba'i skad ngag gtso bo ma red/ dbugs skad ces pa ni skad sgo la bar gseng cung che ba dang smra lce 'gul tshad cung zhan pa/ skad ngag khrod dbugs rgyun gyi bcir sgra gtso byed pa yin/ skad 'di rigs ni nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod rna rtsar gtad pa'i shub sgra lta bu yin/ skad 'di rigs bkol ba mi legs tshe/ bcos ma'i snang ba sbyin nges/ skad ngag 'di rigs dbugs rgyun gyi bcir sgrar brten pa dang / dbugs rgyu tshad mang bas/ rgyun ldan gyi dbugs 'byin rngub kyis dus yun ring bor rgyun skyong dka' zhing / dbugs 'byin rngub thad kyi las 'gan ha cang lci/ dbugs skad ni le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed dus dmigs bsal gyi dgos mkho'i tshan pa dang tshig kha shas khrod ma gtogs mi bkol/gong du bshad pa'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs rigs bzhi bo'i khrod/drag stong 'dres ma'i skad ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs gtso bo red/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs 'di rigs nyan na lhod sha ldan pa dang spyir btang gi mis nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod bkol ba'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs yin pas/ nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyis dang len byed sla/de min drag stong 'dres ma'i skad ngag thon pa'i gnas de ni bab bstun ngang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs bsgyur ba'i bar rim du yod pa ste/ skad sgo zum tshad cung dam na dwangs shing gsal la grim zhing drag pa'i skad thon pa dang / skad sgo cung phye tshe/ sngar las snyan zhing 'jam pa'i skad thon thub pas na/ skad ngag gi 'gyur ldog rang dbang thob pa dang / de'i khar skad 'di rigs kyis smra lce 157

la 'gan lci mo mi bzo bas bshad mkhan gsar ba rnams kyis thog mar skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs 'di rigs khong du chud dgos/ drag stong 'dres ma'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs 'di rigs khong du chud par byed na/ rang byon gyi skad mtho shos de lhod sha dang bcas bkol nas gzhogs 'degs bya dgos/de ltar byas na mgrin gnas cung lhod par 'gyur nges/ dbugs rngub dus lus po cung glod pa dang dbugs rngub rjes skad sgo bsdams nas dbugs yongs su khong du mi sdud par rngub pa'i tshul te/ skad sgo yongs su ma zum pa'i skabs su skad 'byin dgos/ skabs der 'byin pa'i skad ni cung snyan pa'i drag stong 'dres ma'i skad yin/ le tshan bshad skabs skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs bkol tshul dang skad gdangs kyi mtho dma' bkol tshul gnyis la 'dra ba'i cha yod/ bshad mkhan gyis le tshan bshad skabs/ skad ngag bi 'gyur khugs la 'gyur ldog yod dgos pas skad bkol dus drag stong 'dres ma ni skad kyi gtso bo red/ yin na'ang bye brag gi bshad rtsom dang bye brag gi le tshan khrod du drag grim gyi skad dang drag stong 'dres ma/ stong gnyom gyi skad/ tha na dbugs skad sogs rmang gzhi'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs mi 'dra ba yod par ma zad/ nang don dang brtse dung gi 'gyur ba ltar rmang gzhi'i skad ngag gi gtso byas da dung skad ngag gi gzhan pa'i 'gyur ldog kyang yod srid pas/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs ni nam yang mi 'gyur ba zhig yin mi srid/ skad mgo mas skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs kyi bkol tshul la shugs rkyen chen po bzo nges/ nga tshos skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs rigs shig bkol dus sngon la skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs gtan khel byas rjes/ da gzod skad mgo 'dzugs dgos/ gal te gdeng tshod chen po med na/ thog mar rang gi skad la tshod lta zhig byas nas 158

gdeng tshod yod par byas rjes skad mgo bzung chog dbugs 'byin rngub byed stangs kyis kyang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs la shugs rkyen bzo srid/ spyir bshad na dbugs sna thung ba dang dbugs rngub nas khong du bsdus rjes skad 'byin tshe/ skad mang che shos drag grim gyi skad yin pa dang dbugs rngub rjes skad sgo mi thum par mgrin pa cher phye nas skad bton na skad mang shos stong gnyom gyi skad yin/ skad 'don skabs dbugs rgyun dang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs bar phan tshun shugs rkyen thebs pa'i 'brel ba ltar/ dbugs 'byin rngub byas nas skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs legs sgrig byas chog sems khams kyi 'gyur ba dang theg nus kyis kyang skad kyi mtho dma' dang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs la shugs rkyen thebs nges/ sems la 'tshub cha langs na skad dam par 'gyur la/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs la 'gyur ldog med par 'gyur/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs la lhod sha ldan ched/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas sems kyi 'tshub cha sel mkhas par bya dgos/ dngos su ma bshad sngon la sems nas rang la gsal 'debs pa dang yang na phrag pa gnyis 'gul ba dang dbugs ring len byed pa sogs byas tshe sems kyi 'tshub cha sel thub/5 skad cha'i mtshon thabs/rlung 'phrin gyis skad cha kho nar brten nas bshad rtsom gyi nang don mtshon par bya dgos nga dang / brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa 'i skad cha'i mtshon stangs ni brnyan ris dang bsdebs nas 'byung ba yin/yin yang skad cha'i mtshon stangs kyi byed las thad nas bshad na gnyis gas thun mong gi rtsa don brtsi srung bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas spyir btang gi skad cha'i mtshon rtsal khong du chud dgos par ma 169

zad/ da dung brnyan 'phrin gyi khyad chos dang bstun nas thabs rtsal 'di rigs gang 'tsham ngang bkol mkhas par bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rgyun du bkol ba'i skad cha'i mtshon rtsal zhes pa ni gtso bo skad cha'i nang don dang brtse dung gi 'gyur ba mtshon pa'i nus pa la zer zhing / de las gtso bo tshig gi 'brel mthud dang / tshig mtshams gcod thabs/ tshig gi lci gnad khel gnas/ skad gdangs sogs 'dus/ tshig gi 'brel mthud ni bshad rtsom bshad skabs thog mar mnyam 'jog dgos pa zhig yin/ rtsom 'bri mkhan gyis rtag par rang gi goms phyogs mi 'dra ba ltar rtsom gyi khrod rdzogs tshig sogs rang gi 'dod mos ltar 'jog srid/ gal te yongs su rtsom gyi rdzogs tshig sogs ltar mtshams bcad de bshad tshe/ de 'brel chags la 'gyur khugs ldan pa zhig yin mi srid/ le tshan zhig bshad skabs de'i skad cha'i nang don dang tshig gi yong stangs ltar skad kyi mtho dma' dang skad ngag sogs kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas bshad na/ sha thor rus thor du song ba lta bu'i snang ba sbyin mi srid par rtsom hril bo 'brel chags la 'gyur khugs ldan srid/ tshig mtshams gcod thabs yang rgyun du bkol ba'i skad cha'i mtshon thabs shig yin/ skad cha'i khrod kyi mtshams zhes pa ni skad cha'i rgyun dang dbugs rgyun gnyis ka yongs su gcod pa ma yin la/ skad cha'i mtshams gcod pa kho na yang ma yin par skabs mang shes su skad kyi mtshams yud tsam la chad par snang yang dbugs sna mi chad par sngar bzhin sbrel ba yin/ tshig gi gcod mtshams la ring thung gnyis ka yod/ skad cha'i khrod kyi mtshams thung ngu ni tshig 'bru dang tshig 'bru bar du'ang yod cing / des nyan mkhan la gal che ba'i tshig la lar do snang byed par skul ba dang / mtshams ring bo ni phal cher 160

skad cha hril bo dang tshan pa'i bar du 'byung zhing des skad cha'i mtshon tshul dang skad ngag skad gdangs sogs nang don gyi 'phel rim dang 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas 'gyur bar byed cing / nyan mkhan la skad cha hril bo de dang yang na skad cha tshan pa der bsam gzhig byed par bskul nges/ gal te skad cha la mtshams med par chu bzhur bzhur byas na/ skad char 'gugs shugs med pa dang nyan mkhan la sun snang sbyin nges/ skad cha'i nang don mtshon thabs khrod da dung gal che ba ni skad cha'i gnad khel sa'am lci khel sa yang dag pa yin dgos pa de red/ gnad khel sa'am lci khel sa mi gsal ba'i skad cha ni zas la tshwa med pa nang bzhin bro ba med pa dang skad cha'i dmigs yul mi gsal bar gyur nas nyan mkhan gyis don mi go skad cha tshig gcig gi nang gnad khel sa'am lci khel sa mang drags na'ang skad cha'i dmigs yul dngos mi gsal bar byas nas de bzhin tshig mi snyan zhing nyan mkhan gyis don go dka' ba red/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs kyang skad cha'i nang don mtshon rtsal gyi rgyu cha gal chen red/ skad gdangs mtho dma' yi 'gyur ldog gis skad la khyad par mngon gsal bzo srid/ skad kyi mtho dma' dang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs sogs tshang ma skad gdangs kyi rgyu cha gal chen yin zhing / rgyu cha 'di dag las byung ba'i skad kyi 'gyur ldog bed spyod mkhas na skad cha sngar las gson nyams ldan par 'gyur thub/ skad cha'i nang don mtshon thabs khrod du da dung brtse dung gi mtshon rtsal la shugs snon dgos/ gson nyams ldan pa'i skad cha la da gzod 'gugs shugs ldan pa dang / gson nyams ldan pa'i skad char da gzod brtse dung gi 'gyur ba mngon du 'phags pa yin/spyir btang du skad cha'i khrod kyi brtse dung zhes pa ni bshad mkhan gyis 161

bshad bya de la rgyus lon tshad dang der bo ba len stangs dang go ba len tshad la rag las pa yin/ go ba len stangs dang go ba len tshad de yang yig ngos la go ba len pa tsam gyis mi chog par nang don dngos la rang gi bye brag gi bsam gzhig yod pa bya dgos shing / gzhan gyi skad cha der go ba zab mo len pa dang bsam gzhig zhib mo brgyud nas mthar rang gi skad cha nang bzhin gzhan la bshad dgos pa de red/ de ltar go ba zab mo dang bsam gzhig zhib mo las byung ba'i brtse dung de ni bshad bya'i nang don gyis rang sems bskul ba las ngang ngam shugs kyis byung ba'i brtse dung rnal ma zhig dang / rang gi rgyud nas byung ba'i brtse dung rnal ma de skad cha dang skad kyi mtshon nus la brten nas phyir mngon pa zhig yin pa las/ nang don la go ba zab mo ma blangs par thog ma nas brtse dung ni 'di'o zhes rdog rdog cig ston rgyu ga la yod/ nga tsho'i bshad mkhan mang po zhig gsar 'gyur las gzhan pa'i snyan ngag gi nyams kyis brgyan pa'i bshad rtsom la 'phrad dus de ma nyid nas brtse dung zhes nan nan byas nas bshad rtsom la go ba len tshad ji 'dra yin pa mi shes la/ brtse dung zer ba zhig gang nas khyer yong ba yang mi shes mod/ sngon la brtse dung zer ba zhig gtan khel byas rjes bshad bya'i nang don dang skad cha thams cad brtse dung zer ba de'i khongs su bcug ste/ dbugs cha ma chad dang skad 'da' ma 'dar du 'ongs pa zhig la brtse dung gi nyams su snang / 'o na skad cha'i brtse dung zhes pa ji lta bu zhig la zer zhe na/ mdor na brtse dung ni bshad bya'i bye brag gi nang don la go ba gting zab mo blangs pa'i mthus rang rgyud la sems 'gul thebs nas byung ba'i sems kyi 'gyur ba de skad cha dang skad la brten nas phyir mtshon pa'i rnam pa zhig la zer/ de yang rigs dang khyad chos mi 'dra 162

ba'i bye brag gi bshad rtsom dang skad kyi cha rkyen dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba'i bye brag gi bshad mkhan so so'i mtshon tshul yang mi 'dra ba red/ skad cha'i khor yug gi mtshon thabs de yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha'i mtshon rtsal khrod kyi gcig red/ de ni gnas yul mi 'dra ba dang bstun pa'i skad cha'i mtshon nus la zer ba yin la/ brgyud bsgrags bya yul mi 'dra ba dang skad cha'i khor yug mi 'dra bar skad cha'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba spyod pa'i skad cha'i mtshon nus shig la bstan pa yin/ 'di'i thad nas brnyan 'phrin gyis lhag par rlung 'phrin laso rgya che ba'i bar gseng zhig mkho sprod byas/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig nyin gcig gi nang du khor yug mi 'dra ba'i khrod du phyin nas skabs rer khang ba'i nang du bcar 'dri bya yul dang mnyam du bsdad de phan tshun kha brda'i tshul du bcar 'dri gleng mol byed pa dang / skabs rer phyi'i 'du 'dzi'i mi tshogs khrod du skad chen pos lta mkhan la gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi go rim bshad dgos/ nam rgyun de'i thad la sbyong ba mthar phyin pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ skad cha'i bab bstun gyi nus pa dang khor yug gi 'gyur ldog dang bstun pa'i nus pa ldan nges/skad cha'i bab bstun gyi nus pa 'di rigs ni skad kyi mtho dma' dang skad ngag gi 'gyur ldog kho nas 'grub pa zhig ma yin par/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bshad bya'i nang don la go ba gting zab len pa dang rang ngo'i bya ba dang rang gi go gnas la ngos zin yang dag byed pa/ de min skad cha'i nang don khong du chud par byed pa bcas la'ang rag las pa yin/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na da dung skad cha'i ram 'degs la lus po dang ngo gdong gi mtshon nus ldan dgos/ brnyan 'phrin nang du shar 163

ba'i bshad mkhan de ni mi gzugs rengs po zhig yin mi 'os par/ rgyab ljongs mi 'dra ba ltar bshad mkhan gyi gdong gi rnam 'gyur dang lag pa'i 'gul stangs la 'gyur ldog mngon gsal yod dgos/ 'gyur ldog 'di rigs bshad mkhan gyi skad cha'i drag zhan dang 'gyur khugs kyi 'gyur ldog dang gcig mthun yin dgos/ mgo dang lag pa/ lus po bcas kyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas skad char lhag par gson nyams ldan nges/gal te skad char 'gyur khugs ldan tshe/ lus kyi 'gul stangs kyis ram 'degs bya bde la/ skad char 'gyur khugs med tshe/ lus po'i 'gul stangs kyis ram 'degs byed thabs med phyir/ brnyan 'phrin nang gi bshad mkhan de rnam shes dbang po med pa'i mi rengs po zhig dang 'dra/ de yang lus kyi 'gul stangs kyang 'os shing 'tsham pa yin dgos/ 'gul stangs mang drags na bcos ma'i snang ba sbyin nges/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan mi shar ba'i brnyan ris kyi mtshams sbyor khrod du'ang skad cha'i 'gyur khugs shin tu gal che/brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris ni 'gyur zhing 'gro ba'i brnyan ris kyi tshan pa mang po phyogs gcig tu sgrig sbyor byas nas grub pa zhig yin/ 'gyur khugs kyi 'gyur ldog yod pa'i brnyan ris la 'gyur khugs kyi 'gyur ldog dang ldan pa'i skad chas gzhogs 'degs bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyi skad cha'i mtshon rtsal de ni skad cha'i nang don kho na las ma 'das pa zhig kyang min/brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rnam pa mang bas bshad mkhan gyis khor lug dang bar gseng / thob thang / 'gul stangs sogs rgyu rkyen gang mang la bsam blo gtong dgos/ rgyu rkyen gang mang la bsam blo btang ba dang kha lo bsgyur nas grub pa'i 164

skad cha'i mtshon rtsal gyis da gzod brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags dang spyir btang gi lta mkhan mang tshogs kyi re ba skong thub/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i khrod du skad kyi bkol stangs dang skad cha'i mtshon stangs thad kyi gnad don shin tu mang / de yang rang rang gi skad cha'i khyad chos dang gnas tshul dngos ltar dag bcos bya thos/cung yongs khyab rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnad don 'ga' logs su bkar nas bshad na/ skad kyi bkol stangs thad nas skad mtho drags pa dang skad bcir ba/ mgrin skad/ sna skad sogs kyi gnad don 'byung ba cung mang /skad mtho drags pa ni skad kyi mtho tshad de rgyun ldan gyi skad cha'i skad kyi mtho tshad las brgal nas nyan na lhod sha med pa de red/ gnad don 'di rigs ni thog mar slob mkhan rnams dang nang sgos su skyes ma bshad mkhan khrod du cung mang / skad mtho drags pa ni thog mar slob pa'i dus na yi ge'i sgra len shugs la shugs bsnan pa dang / skad gdangs je cher btang ba sogs las 'byung sla ba'i skad bkol ba'i thad kyi gnad don zhig red/ gnad don 'di rigs rang gis de 'dra gsal por mi rtogs tshe/ le tshan bshad skabs kyi skad mtho shos dang nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi skad mtho shos gnyis phan tshun gshib bsdur byas nas rang gis rang la zhib bsher byas chog gnad don 'di rigs yod tshe skad mgo ma'i skabs su nges par du skad mtho shos de gtan khel gsal po byas rjes/ da gzod skad 'byin pa dang mgrin gnas 'os 'tsham sgos gled pa dang dbugs rngub tshad mang du mi 'jug par 'os 'tsham zhig byas na gnad don 'di rigs sel bar rogs byed thub/ skad bcir ba'i gnad don ni le tshan bshad skabs mgrin sgo dam drags nas skad btsir nas 'byung ba dang /165

skad ngag mi snyan par rnar 'dzer ba'i snang ba sbyin pa de red/ skad mtho drags pa dang 'dra bar skad bcir nas 'byung ba de yang yi ge sgra len shugs dang dbugs 'byin rngub kyi tshad la shugs snon pa las 'byung sla/ yi ge sgra len dus mchu dang rkan sogs la shugs bkol che na mgrin sgo'ang rang shugs kyis sdom pa dang dbugs rngub tshad je cher btang tshe skad sgo dam du zum par byed/ 'di dag tshang mas skad bcir bar byed nges/ rang rang gi skad ngag gi khyad chos dang dbugs kyis mi 'dang ba sogs kyis kyang skad bcir ba'i gnad don 'byung ba red/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs thad thog mar dam chog la lhod kyang chog pa'i drag gnyom 'dres ma'i skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs gtso byas nas/skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs 'dir goms par byas rjes/ da gzod gang la gang 'tsham ngang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs gzhan bkol na legs/ mgrin skad zhes pa ni skad kyi gnas dma' drags nas skad mnan nas cung rtsub po'i ngang 'byung ba la zer zhing / rtag par tshig rnga nas 'byung sla ba dang skyes pa bshad mkhan khrod du 'byung ba mang / 'byung rkyen ni smra lce dam drags nas 'gul stangs mi legs pa de red/ tshig rnga nas skad dma' bas skad sgo sdud snga tshe skad 'di rigs 'byung sla/ dbugs kyis mi 'dang bas tshig rnga nas dbugs kyis mi lcogs tshe'ang skad sgo bsdams drags nas mgrin skad 'byung sla ba red/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa la lar sna skad grags che ba ni/ skad cha bshad skabs dang skad 'byin skabs rkan yar btegs pa mi 'dang bar skad sna khung las rgyu ba mang drags pa'i rkyen red/ skad 'byin skabs rkan 'os 'tsham sgos yar btegs na sna skad mi 'byung bar byed thub/gong du bshad pa'i skad kyi bkol stangs thad kyi gnad don las gzhan/166

nga tsho'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i khrod du skad cha'i mtshon stangs thad nas kyang gnad don sna tshogs 'byung bzhin yod/ de yang mi re re dang le tshan so so'i khrod bye brag tu gnas pa'i gnad don mi 'dra bar rnam pa sna tshogs yin mod/ yongs khyab rang bzhin ldan pa'i gnad don 'ga' dmigs su bkar nas bshad na/ tshig bi gnad sa'am lci khel sa yang mi dag pa dang yang na mi gsal ba dang / skad cha'i myur tshad 'os 'tsham min pa/ skad cha'i mtshon stangs la 'gyur ldog med pa sogs red/skad cha'i gnad khel sa'am skad cha'i lci khel sa yang mi dag pa dang yang na mi gsal ba ni bshad rtsom hril bo dang tshig dang tshan pa'i khrod du gnad sa mi gsal bas/ skad cha'i dmigs yul gsal bo min pa la zer/skad cha'i gnad sa ni skad cha je dal du gtong ba dang skad cha bshad shugs dang tshig dang yang na yi ge'i sgra len stangs la shugs snon pa sogs kyi byed thabs la brten nas 'bur du btod dgos/ gnad che sa'i tshig kyang bltas sa bltas 'jog gis spyir btang gi tshig las mngon du 'phags pa bya dgos/de yang gnad sa 'bur thon bya rgyu de yang bshad bya'i go don la go ba gting zab mo len pa dang dbye zhib dpyis phyin pa byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng 'gyur ldog mngon gsal gyis phyug pa'i skad la brten na da gzod mtshon thub pa red/myur tshad 'os 'tsham min pa ni le tshan bshad skabs le tshan gyi bye brag gi khyad chos la mi lta bar/ skad cha mgyogs drags pa dang yang na dal drags pa la zer/ skad cha'i myur tshad la gtan khel nan mo zhig med par mi'i go ba len tshad dang bye brag gi le tshan so so'i blang bya mi 'dra ba ltar gtan khel byas pa yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin 167

byed skabs/ sems kyi 'gyur bas skad cha'i myur tshad la shugs rkyen cung chen po thebs pa yin/ thog mar slob mkhan rnams 'tshub cha langs pa'i rkyen gyis sems kyi 'gyur ba je mgyogs su 'gro ba dang / brtan brling yin drags pa des kyang rgyun ldan gyi sems kyi 'gyur bar gtor brlag thebs nges/ bshad mkhan gyi rang snang gi tshor ba mi 'dra bas skad cha'i myur tshad mgyogs drags pa dang yang na dal drags pa'i gnad don 'byung srid/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lag len khrod sbyong brdar byas na sa rim bzhin rang gi sems kyi 'gyur ba rgyun ldan du gtong dgos/ de min skad cha mgyogs drags pa dang dal drags pa de da dung bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i nam rgyun gyi skad cha'i goms phyogs dang 'brel ba yod pas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin na nges par du rang gi nam rgyun gyi skad cha'i khrod kyi goms gshis mi legs pa rnams bcos sgyur byed par do snang bya dgos/skad cha'i mtshon stangs la 'gyur ldog med pa dang 'gyur khugs mi ldan pa ni bshad mkhan rnams kyis rang gi byed sgo'i chu tshad gom gang sngon spos sgos mthor 'degs byed skabs rgyun du 'byung ba'i gnad don red/ bshad mkhan rnams kyis brtse dung dang dbugs sna/ skad gsum gyi 'brel ba'i thad nas gnad don gyi 'byung rkyen 'tshol dgos/ spyir bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa thog mar bshad bya'i nang don la spro ba skye dgos pa dang der sems nas dung ba bskyed dgos shing / sems kyi dung ba de dbugs kyi rgyu tshul dang skad kyi 'gyur ldog la brten nas mtshon par bya dgos/ gal te dbugs sna dang skad la 'gyur ldog med tshe/ sems kyi dung ba ji ltar zab na'ang phyir mtshon mi thub/mi mang pos brtse dung dang skad bar gyi dbugs sna'i zam pa lta bu'i nus par 168

snang med byas nas/ nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i dbugs snas brtse dung gi 'gyur ba phun sum tshogs pa mtshon thabs byed/ de ltar byas na sems khams kyi 'gyur ba drag po dang 'gyur ldog med pa'i skad kyi mtshon stangs gnyis la khyad par chen po shor nas/ bshad rtsal gyi chu tshad sngar las je bzang du gtong bar gnod pa thebs nges/ de las gzhan skad dung dang sgra phab 'phrul chas sogs glog rdul sgrig chas kyis kyang skabs lan rer skad kyi mtshon nus je zhan du btang nas/ phra zhing zhib pa'i brtse dung gi 'gyur ba de mi gsal bar byed srid/ de yang skad cha'i mtshon stangs la 'gyur ldog med pa'i rgyu rkyen gras kyi gcig red/ skad cha'i gnad sa 'bur thon min pa dang tshig gi lci khel sa yang mi dag pa/ skad cha'i mtshon stangs la 'gyur ldog med pa sogs la da dung 'byung rkyen zhig yod pa ni bshad rtsom gyi go don la go ba gting zab mo len ma thub pa de red/ bshad mkhan gyis bshad rtsom lag tu thon rjes thog mar gra sgrig legs po byas nas bshad rtsom gyi don gyi snying bo de rang gis yongs su rtogs par ma zad/ rang gi sems nas bshad 'dod pa'i skad cha nang bzhin nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la bshad thub dgos/ gal te khyod kyis bshad rtsom gyi go don la go ba zab mo lon tshe/ khyod rang rtsom gyi nang don la sems phyogs pa dang / rtsom gyi nang don la sems phyogs tshe/ da gzod nang don gyi 'phel 'gyur ltar dung sems la'ang ngang ngam shugs kyis 'gyur ldog 'byung zhing /dung sems kyi 'gyur bas dbugs snar bskul ba'i mthus skad kyi 'gyur khugs kyang de bzhin phun sum tshogs par 'gyur nges/ bye brag gi le tshan gyi rigs dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba so so yin pa dang mi re re'i skad kyi khyad chos kyang mi 'dra bar rang rang red/ de bas bshad mkhan rnams kyis rang gi skad kyi khyad 169

chos dang bye brag gi le tshan gyi khyad chos gzhir bzung nas mtshon stangs gang la gang 'tsham bkol dbos pa las/ gzhan gyi lad bzlos byed mi 'os/ mi la las le tshan bshad skabs gtan 'jags kyi dbyangs shig chags nas le tshan ga 'dra yin yang rang gi gtan 'jags kyi dbyangs de'i nang du bcug ste/ mi brgya skad gcig nang bzhin le tshan la bro ba dang 'gugs shugs med par ma zad/ nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan la sun snang bzo nges/ tshig dang skad cha 'dra na'ang khyad chos mi 'dra ba'i le tshan khrod du de'i mtshon stangs kyang mi 'dra/ mi re re'i skad kyi cha rkyen mi 'dra bas mtshon thabs kyang 'dra mi srid/ spyir bye brag gi le tshan re re bshad pa'i lag len gyi nyams myong dang tshor snang de ni rang rang gi bya ba dngos kyi lag len khrod rang gcig pus sems kyis nyams su len pa las 'di'o zhes rdog ril spar mo gang ston rgyu med la/ 'di ni 'di ltar dang de ni de bzhin no zhes yongs su kha nas bshad nus pa zhig kyang ma red/ da snga rgya yig gi ched las dpe deb tu bkod pa rnams kyang spyi tsam brjod pa las zhib cing phra ba'i skor mang che shos rang gi lag len dngos kyi nyams myong dang rang gi shes rtogs kyi nus par brten dgos/drug bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i byed las/gong du bshad zin pa nang bzhin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan de mi mang po dang las rim mang po brgyud nas mtha' mar nyan mkhan dang lta mkhan gyi mdun du mngon par byed mkhan te le tshan gyi tshab byed mi sna yin phyin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi grub cha gal chen yin/ rlung 'phrin 170

dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan la gsar 'gyur gyi rigs dang ched sgrig le tshan gyi rigs/ rig rtsal gyi rigs sogs nang don dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba dang / khyad chos dang mtshon stangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod/ de min deng rabs kyi brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal bya 'phur ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang bstun nas khyad chos dang mtshon stangs mi 'dra ba'i le tshan gsar ba gang mang zhig byung dang 'byung mus su mchis/ de dag thams cad bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bshad rtsal la brten nas mtshon dgos/ de yang le tshan so so'i nang don dang blang bya/ khyad chos sogs mi 'dra bas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas kyang bye brag gi khyad chos gzhir bzung nas gang la gang 'tsham gyi bshad rtsal spyod dgos/ 'di ru cung tshab byed rang bzhin ldan pa'i le tshan 'ga'i bshad stangs spyi bshad tsam brnyan 'phrin dper bzhag nas rags tsam brjod par bya/1 brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed stangs/lta mkhan mang pos thog mar gsar 'gyur le tshan khrod bshad mkhan ngo shes pa red/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyi bab chags kyi gzugs byad legs pos lta mkhan mang por yid smon 'chor bar byas/ yin na'ang / brnyan 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan de brnyan len 'phrul chas mdun gyi gzugs byad mdzes pa'i ma yig sgrog 'don byed mkhan tsam du ngos bzung na yang dag pa zhig ma red/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi bshad mkhan tshad ldan zhig la mtshon na/ mig la mdzes pa'i gzugs byad legs po zhig dang rna la snyan pa'i skad ngag snyan mo zhig yod pa kho nas mi chog par/kun gyi mig lam du 'char ba'i brnyan len 'phrul chas mdun gyi gzugs 171

brnyan las gzhan/ da dung kun gyi mig gis mi zin pa'i nus pa mang po ldan dgos/ spyir rgyun du mthong ba'i gsar 'gyur gyi rnam pa la bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan shar nas thad kur bshad pa dang brnyan ris gsar 'gyur/yul dngos nas bsgrags pa'i gsar 'gyur/ gsar 'gyur dpyad gtam/ rgyang ring nas bcar 'dri byed pa sogs yod/ bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan shar nas thad kur lta mkhan la gdong phyogs nas bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur ni brnyan ris kyi rgyu cha phab ma thub pa dang brnyan ris kyi rgyu cha 'thob thabs med pa'i gnas tshul 'og gsar 'gyur myur du sgrog pa'i ches stabs bde ba'i byed stangs shig red/ de yang byed stangs 'di rigs brnyan ris kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i dpe mtshon rang bzhin gyi brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur zhig min yang /brnyan ris phab thabs med pa'i don rkyen glo bur ba bsgrags dus byed stangs 'di rigs la dge mtshan chen po ldan/ brnyan ris la gson nyams ldan pa'i ched du skabs la lar gsar 'gyur bshad stangs 'di rigs brnyan ris rgyu cha dang 'brel yod brnyan ris bar du'ang 'jug pa yin/ brnyan ris ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur ni yul dngos kyi rnam pa gzugs su bkod pa'i brnyan ris la brten nas gsar 'gyur don rkyen mtshon pa zhig yin/ brnyan ris ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur gyis bden pa bden drang dang don dngos ji ma ji bzhin ltar gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi go rim dang don rkyen gyi yul dngos kyi gnas tshul ngo ma mtshon pas na/ don dngos yin la cha 'phrin brgyud gtong byed tshad mang ba'i khyad chos ldan la/ brnyan 'phrin gyi khyad chos mngon par 'phags pa'i gsar 'gyur gyi mtshon stangs shig yin/ brgyud gtong dus tshod sogs rgyu rkyen gyi shugs rkyen thebs 'og brnyan ris ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur gyis yul dngos 172

nas phab pa'i sgra las gzhan/ da dung gsar 'god pa dang yang na bshad mkhan gyis brnyan ris las bstan pa'i gsar 'gyur nang don la kha gsab dang gsal bshad bya dgos/ yul dngos nas bsgrags pa'i gsar 'gyur ni brnyan 'phrin khang gi gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur don rkyen byung sa'i yul dngos nas gsar 'gyur spel ba zhig yin/ yul dngos nas bsgrags pa'i gsar 'gyur la'ang brnyan ris yod mod/ brnyan ris gtso bo ni don rkyen byung sa dngos na yod pa'i brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa red/ gsar 'god pas yul dngos nas don rkyen bshad pa yin pas/ spyir btang du mtha' ma'i skad sbyor byed mi dgos/ yul dngos nas spel ba'i gsar 'gyur la gsar 'god pas yul dngos nas byung ba'i gsar 'gyur don rkyen la 'grel bshad byas pas/ nus shugs sngar las mang po bton nas yul dngos su med pa'i 'brel yod rgyu cha brnyan len byed pa'i dgos mkho med phyin/ gsar 'gyur gyi dus thog rang bzhin mthor 'degs byas pa ma zad/ mtha' ma'i sgrig sbyor yang cung stabs bde yin/ skabs la lar yul dngos nas sgrig sbyor yongs 'grub byas chog der brten glo bur du byung ba'i gsar 'gyur don rkyen sna tshogs myur du spel bar 'phrod/ byed stangs 'di rigs dus thog rang bzhin la ha cang do snang byed pa'i brnyan 'phrin las rigs kyis yongs khyab tu lag len byed kyin yod/ brnyan 'phrin khang sogs nas bcar 'dri byed pa ni brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas khang ba'i nang nas dmigs bsal gyi mi snar bcar 'dri byed pa dang / bcar 'dri byed pa'i go rim thad kur gsar 'gyur le tshan khrod gtong ba zhig la zer/ bcar 'dri 'di rigs mang che ba ni ched mkhas pa dang rig gnas mkhas pa/ yang na srid 173

gzhung gi dpon rigs sogs la zhu 'dri byed pa yin la/ de'i dmigs yul ni kho tshor gsar 'gyur don rkyen la lar 'grel bshad byed du bcug nas lta mkhan rnams la gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi rgyab ljongs dang don snying sogs la rgyus lon byed rogs byed pa dang / skabs 'gar bcar 'dri bya yul gyi thob thang cung khyad par can yin pa dang yang na bcar 'dri bya yul gyis bshad pa'i nang don la gsar 'gyur gyi rin thang shin tu che bas/ bcar 'dri de nyid rang ngo nas bshad na yang gsar 'gyur zhig tu 'gyur nges/ brnyan 'phrin dpyad gtam brjod pa ni gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan dang yang na gsar 'gyur 'go 'dzin pas gsar 'gyur don rkyen dang yang na chab srid dang dpal 'byor/spyi tshogs gnad don thad lta ba brjod pa zhig yin/ lta ba 'di rigs dpyad gtam brjod mkhan de nyid kyi sger gyi lta ba yin par snyam chog mod/ yin na'ang / tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas brnyan 'phrin khang de'i tshab byed pa yin/rgyang ring bcar 'dri ni deng rabs kyi 'phrin skyel yo chas la brten nas/ gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan dang le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas brnyan 'phrin khang nas skabs thog tu sa cha gzhan dang yang na rgyal khab gzhan na yod pa'i brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa dang gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi gnas tshul la cha rgyus yod mkhan la bcar 'dri byed pa zhig la zer/ bcar 'dri 'di rigs la glo bur rang bzhin ldan phyin/ bcar 'dri bya yul la gra sgrig byed long med pas skabs thog de'i brnyan ris 'thob pa shin tu dka'/ brnyan 'phrin steng nas rtag par bshad mkhan dang le tshan 'go 'dzin pas rna gtad de nyan pa'i gzugs brnyan ma gtogs mi mthong / bcar 'dri bya yul gyi thob thang de yig 174

brnyan dang yang na dpyad gzhi'i brnyan par gyis mtshon pa yin/ gsar 'gyur gyi nang don gtso bo bcar 'dri bya yul gyi mtshams sbyor la brten dgos/ rtsis 'khor dra rgya gong 'phel song ba dang dra rgya'i 'phrin lam lag rtsal nyin rer dar rgyas dang byang chub tu song ba dang bstun nas phyi rgyal du da lta rgyang ring bcar 'dri la la rtsis 'khor gyi dra rgya la brten nas byed kyin yod/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi grub stangs de tshad nges can zhig gi thad nas bshad na brnyan 'phrin dang 'phrin skyel lag rtsal gyi song 'phel la rag las pa yin/ lag rtsal gsar ba rgyun chad med par byung ba des ma 'ongs pa'i brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur la dus thog rang bzhin lhag par drag pa dang rigs sna lhag par mang ba'i mtshon stangs shig 'don sprod byed thub/gong du bshad pa ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi grub stangs rnam pa dang mtshon stangs tsam yin/ de yang bshad stangs thad nas bshad na/ bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan kho na shar nas thad kur lta mkhan la gdong phyogs nas bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur dang brnyan ris ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur te/bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan mi shar bar gsar 'gyur yul dngos nas phab pa'i brnyan ris la bshad mkhan gyis skad sbyor ba ni nga tsho'i gsar 'gyur spel stangs ches gtso bo red/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur thad bkol ba ches snga ba'i rnam pa zhig yin/ le tshan phab skrun lag rtsal rgyun mi chad par yar thon byung ba dang bstun nas/gsar 'gyur sngar las mang po zhig yul dngos nas brnyan len byas pa'i brnyan ris la brten nas spel bzhin yod/ yin na'ang bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur la sngar bzhin rin thang ldan/ glo bur du byung 175

ba'i gsar 'gyur mang po zhig brnyan ris phab ma thub sngon du bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad de brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi dus thog rang bzhin mthor 'degs byas chog cing / gsar 'gyur la la'i nang don brnyan ris kyi rnam pa las mtshon thabs med tshe/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad 'os/ de las gzhan brnyan ris gsar 'gyur 'bor chen la 'bo brjod dus su bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad de gsar 'gyur hril bo'i nang don gsal 'debs byas chog pa red/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi bshad mkhan dang brnyan 'phrin lta mkhan bar brje res dang rgyus lon byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i rnam pa yin la/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i nus rtsal yin/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod bshad mkhan gyis thad kur lta mkhan la gdong phyogs pa dang brnyan 'phrin steng gi bshad mkhan gyi snang brnyan gyis thad kur lta mkhan gyi tshor bar shugs rkyen thebs srid/ bshad mkhan gyi brnyan 'phrin steng gi snang brnyan la gzugs byad dang rnam 'gyur khag gnyis 'dus/ gzugs byad ni gtso bo ngo gdong la bstan pa yin/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur gyi brjod bya gtso bo 'bur du dod ched/ bshad mkhan gyi snang brnyan de gtso bo ngo gdong du mtshon pa dang / lus stod dang yang na brang kha yan gyi brnyan gzugs gtsor byed pas/ ngo gdong sogs kyi zhan cha lhang nger phyir mngon nges/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan tshad ldan zhig yin tshe/ ngo gdong gi kha sna sogs la mngon gsal gyi zhan cha yod mi 'os/ de yang lta mkhan mang che bas blor 'bab dgos na/ lta mkhan la bcangs pa'i lhag sems rnam dag cig dgos pa ni smos ma dgos pa ste/ skabs la lar yid du 176

'ong ba'i ngo gdong mdzes po zhig las drang dngos bden thub dang lhag sems rnam dag cig gis lhag par mi sems 'gugs thub kyang srid/ bshad mkhan gyi rnam 'gyur de ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur dang lta mkhan bar gyi mig ltos mthong tshor gyi steng nas mtshon/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod bshad mkhan gyi gdong gi nyams 'gyur de gsar 'gyur ma yig gi nang don la 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur dang lta mkhan la bcangs pa'i ngos zin/de min rang gi thob thang de gnas ga 'dra zhig la 'jog pa las byung ba red/de gsum mnyam 'brel byas na bshad mkhan gyis nyams 'gyur la tshod 'dzin yang dag pa byed thub la/ de gsum so sor dbye na bshad mkhan gyi nyams 'gyur slad med cig min par lta mkhan la mi bde ba dang tha na ya mtshan pa zhig yin pa'i snang ba sbyin srid/ dper na/ mtsho sngon lho rgyud sa khul du bstud mar nyin 'gar kha ba bu yug 'tshub nas lo ngo bcu phrag ring la mthong dkon pa 'i khangs 'khyags kyi gnod pa tshabs chen thebs pa dang sgos su mgo log dang yul shul/ gdang la sa khul bcas kyi kha ba'i mthug tshad smis gcig la bslebs pas/ mi phyugs mang po grang 'khyags kyis mnar nas shi rmas byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/ ces pa lta bu'i gsar 'gyur zhig bshad skabs/ gal te/ bshad mkhan gyis bye brag gi nang don la mi lta bar mtha' gcig tu gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs nas bshad na lta mkhan gyis bshad mkhan de snying rje dang bral ba zhig yin snyam nas bshad mkhan gyi 'dzum des yid 'gugs pa dang de la dga' bsu byed pa phar zhog yid mi dga' bar gyur nas bshad mkhan der yang lta stangs legs po med pa dang phyis su des bshad pa'i le tshan la lta 'dod med par gyur nas rang nyid kyi snang brnyan la bsub thabs bral ba'i 177

gtor brlag thebs pa ma zad/ tha na gsar 'gyur le tshan la'ang shugs rkyen mi legs pa thebs srid/ gal te bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la do snang byas drags te/ rang nyid brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang spyi byings mi sna yin pa'i cha nas lhun chags dang brtan brling bi gshes ka rgyun 'dzin bya dgos pa brjed tshe/ gdong nas cung 'tshub snangazhig mngon yang srid pa dang / bshad mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi thob thang kho na bsams nas gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la bsam blo ma btang tshe/ de'i nyams 'gyur ji mi snyam pa dang gnam rdib kyang nga la 'brel ba med snyam pa lta bu'i ngo 'khyags shig mngon yang srid/ lta mkhan gyis dang len byed 'dod pa ni don de la do khur gyi bsam pa ldan yang brtan brling gi ngang tshul mi dor ba dang / dus mtshungs su lta mkhan la rnam dag gi bsam pa zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis mngon pa de yin/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi nang don ni rnam pa sna mang yin pa dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i phyogs so so dang 'dzam bu gling gi gru sne so sor khyab yod pas/ bshad mkhan gyis kyang de dag so sor mthun pa'i bshad rtsal dang tshor ba mi 'dra ba'i nyams 'gyur la brten nas lta mkhan gyi sems 'gugs pa dang yi rang par byed mkhas par bya rgyu gal che'o/ /gsar 'gyur ni spyir mang tshogs la cha 'phrin sna tshogs brgyud bsgrags byed pa gtso bo yin pa las/ brtse dung la brten nas lta mkhan 'gugs dgos pa zhig min/ der brten gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyi bzhin ras kyi nyams 'gyur de 'khrab ston pa zhig dang 'dra bar tshad las brgal ba dang sgro btags che mi rung bar/ bzhin ras kyi nyams 'gyur de rang gi thob thang dang mthun pa'i tshad thig cig tu tshod 'dzin bya dgos/ lta mkhan la 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur de yang lta mkhan dang mig 178

mdangs kyi 'brel 'dris khrod du mngon pa red/ 'di ni bshad mkhan gyi lus stod phyed kyi gzugs brnyan kho na shar nas bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod lhag tu sal che ba red/ bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur bshad skabs mig gis bsar 'gyur ma yig la blta dgos/ mgo skur nas ma yig la lta dus lta mkhan la mig mdangs las 'brel 'dris byed par bar chad bzo srid/ gal te bshad mkhan zhig gis gsar 'gyur mgo brtsams ma thag tu mgo skur nas ma yig la bltas na/ khyod kyi skad de lta mkhan gyi rna bar lhung yang khyod kyis kho tshor bshad pa min pa'i snang ba skyes nges/ bshad mkhan gyis mgo yar bkyags nas lta mkhan la gdong phyogs nas bshad dus/ lta mkhan la da gzod nga la bshad pa yin zhes pa'i tshor snang skyes srid/ der brten/ bshad mkhan kho na'i gzugs brnyan shar nas bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur de nges par du lta mkhan dang mig mdangs las 'brel 'dris bya dbos/ mig mdangs las 'brel 'dris byed tshul 'di rigs nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod dang 'dra bar phyogs gnyis gas phan tshun mthong thub pa zhig min yang / de'i nus pa ni 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mig mdangs brje res dang ha lam 'dra ba red/ lta mkhan gyis brnyan 'phrin steng nas bshad mkhan mthong ba dang bshad mkhan gyis brnyan len 'phrul chas las lta mkhan mthong mi thub/ des na ji ltar lta mkhan dang mig mdangs brje res bya dgos she na/ mig gi dbang po gtod yul dang sems kyi 'du shes gtod yul nas mtshon pa ste/ rang gi sems su mdun gyi brnyan len 'phrul chas de ni rnam shes dbang po med pa'i 'phrul chas shig tu mi brtsi bar skad cig tsam la'ang khyod kyi rnam 'gyur la brtag cing gdong la bgrad pa'i skad cha bshad yul mi gson po de yin pa'i 'du shes bcangs 179

dgos shing / don dam pas de ni sems kyis mthong dgos pa'i mi zhig tu brtsi dgos/ nga tsho'i nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du mi zhig dang kha gtug ngo gtug sgos kha brda byed dus sems rnal la mi phab pa dang rnam shes gzhan la 'chal na mig gis phan tshun bltas yod kyang khyod kyi sems su pha rol pa med pa dang pha rol pas kyang sems la khyod kyis kho rang mig nang du mi 'jog pa'i snang ba zhig 'gog med du skyes nges/ der brten bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur bshad skabs sems kyi 'du shes shin tu gal che/ sems kyi 'du shes kyis mig gi dbang po'i mdangs la bskul ba dang mig gi mdangs las sems kyi 'du shes ngang ngam shugs kyis mtshon thub/ bshad mkhan gyis brnyan len 'phrul chas mdun du dus nam yang lta mkhan gyis rang la bltas 'dug pa'i snang ba bcangs nas khyod kyis kyang rnam shes gtad de kho tsho'i gdong la lta bzhin pa'i 'du shes 'dzin dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod lta mkhan la bshad mkhan gyis nan tan ngang rang la gleng mol byed pa'i snang ba sbyin nges/ bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan kho na shar nas bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur bshad skabs mgo sgur nas ma yig la lta dus bar thag tho gnyis gsum re ma gtogs med pa dang mgo yar bkyags nas brnyan len 'phrul chas la lta ba'i bar thag smis 'ga' re yod srid/ maso yar 'degs mar sgur bar gyi ring thung gis rtag par ma yig rnyed dka' bar gyur nas skad char thogs 'dug 'byung ba yin/ de min bshad sa'i khang ba'i nang gi glog 'od shin tu gsal drag pas/ mig mdangs de brnyan len 'phrul chas las mar yig ngor lta dus glog 'od gsal min gyi khyad par shor nas mig gis rgyun mi chad par lta mkhan la lta bar bar chad bzo srid/ da lta brnyan 'phrin khang 180

phal che bas ma yig gsal ston 'phrul chas bsgrigs yod pas/ spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur bshad skabs mgo yar 'degs mar skur byed mi dgos/ yin yang ma yig lag tu bzung nas bshad pa de ni sngar bzhin brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyis nges par du khong du chud dgos pa'i rtsa ba'i thabs rtsal zhig red/ bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan kho na shar nas thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod du bshad mkhan gyis lta mkhan dang 'brel 'dris byed ched mgo yar btegs nas bshad pa'i dus yun je ring du gtong ci thub bya dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni mgo sgur yun ring drag tshe lta mkhan la kho tsho snang med du bzhag pa'i tshor ba sbyin srid pa de red/ mgo 'degs pa'i dus yun je ring du gtong ched/ bshad mkhan gyis ma yig la gra sgrig byed skabs nang don la la sems la 'dzin dgos/ nam rgyun gsar 'gyur gyi mgo brjod yid la gsal por nges par byas nas mig zur gyis bltas pa tsam gyis blor nges pa dang kha nas bshad thub pa bya dbos/ de ltar byas na gsar 'gyur re re'i mgo 'dzugs dus lta mkhan la bltas nas bshad chog de min tshig rngar sleb dus kyang mgo yar btegs nas lta mkhan la bltas nas bshad 'os/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur bshad skabs nang don mang shos blor nges pa bya dgos/ blor nges pa bya rgyu de yang mgo nas mjug bar yi ge gcig kyang ma lus par yongs su blor 'dzin dgos zer ba ma yin par/ tshor ba myur mo dang yid 'dzin drag por brten nas/ ma yig la gra sgrig legs po byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog mig zur gyis bltas pa tsam gyis gsar 'gyur ma yig gi tshig re dang yang na tshan pa re yid la bzung nas mgo yar bkyags te lta mkhan la phyogs nas bshad thub pa 181

la zer ba yin/ bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan shar nas thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod mgo 'degs pa ni lus po'i 'gul stangs ches che ba red/ bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan 'bud dus brang kha'i yan gyi lus stod kho na shar ba yin phyin/ gdong sga nyams 'gyur dang maso yi 'gul stangs tshang ma lta mkhan gyi mdun du gsal lhang nger 'char bas na/ bshad mkhan gyis gsham gyi nyams 'gyur dang 'gul stangs la do snang byed 'os/ gcig nas mgo yar 'degs mar skur gyi tshad che drags mi rung ba ste/ mgo yi 'gul stangs che drags na bzo lta sgyid lugs su snang ba yin/ ma yig rang gi mdun du bar thag cung yod sar bzhag nas mgo skur dus de 'dra dma' mi dgos pa bya dgos pa dang / gnyis nas mabo par 'dregs dus yar yongs su btegs te lta mkhan la drang thad kyis lta ba las/ mgo cung tsam btegs nas/ lta mkhan la lta dus mig gis 'og lta byed mi 'os/ mgo yar 'degs tshad mtho drags na nga che dang nga rgyal gyi snang ba sbyin srid pas/ mgo yi 'degs sgur tshad dang ran pa yin dgos/ gsum nas mgo yar 'degs mar sgur byed dus mgyogs drags mi rung la/ dal drags na'ang mi 'os/ nang dgos su mar skur dus mgyogs che na brel 'tshub kyi snang ba sbyin pa ma zad/ da dung gzhan la gsham gyi nang don ma shes pas myur du ma yig ngos nas 'tshol bar rem pa'i tshor ba zhig sbyin srid/ de bas skad cha'i tshig mtshams gcod sa nas mgo 'degs skur byas te/ skad cha'i 'gyur khugs dang gcig gyur yong ba bya dgos/ bzhi nas mgo 'degs skur byed skabs nyams 'gyur la 'gyur ldog che mi rung ba ste/ mgo yar btegs nas lta mkhan la lta dus 'dzum gyis khengs pa dang / mgo mar sgur nas ma yig la lta dus smin ma bsdus nas gdong nas 182

sdug mdog ston mi rung / lta mkhan gyis khyod rang mgo skur dus kyang khyod kyi gdong gi nyams 'gyur mthong srid pas/ mgo 'degs skur skabs su gdong gi nyams 'gyur la do snang bya dgos/ lnga nas bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur thad kur bshad skabs maso 'degs skur byed pa las gzhan/ da dung skad cha'i nyams dang bstun nas mgo yi 'gul stangs gzhan yang 'byung srid pa ste/dper na/ mgo cung tsam ldem pa dang yang na zur g.yo cung re byas chog yin na'ang phrag pa g.yo 'gul byed mi 'os/ phrag zung g.yo 'gul byas tshe/ brnyan ris g.yo ba lta bu'i snang ba mi bde ba sbyin pas/ mgo 'os 'tsham gyis 'gul pa las/ lus po g.yo 'gul byed mi 'os/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod rtag par bshad mkhan pho mo gnyis mnyam du bsdad de res mos ngang bshad pa yin/ dus yun cung ring ba'i gsar 'gyur le tshan khrod du rnam pa 'di rigs rgyun du mthong / mi gnyis kyis mnyam du bshad pa la phan tshun ram 'degs legs po bya dgos/ nang don ltar skabs la lar bshad mkhan gnyis ka mnyam du brnyan 'phrin las 'char ba dang skabs la lar res mos ngang 'char ba red/ gnyis ka mnyam du brnyan 'phrin nang 'char dus gnyis ku'i mig gis lta phyogs gnas gcig la 'bab dgos/gcig gis bshad skabs/ gzhan gcig gis der nyan pa'i tshul gyis gzhogs 'degs bya dgos la/ nyams 'gyur la 'gyur ldog chen po yod mi 'os/ nyams 'gyur ci yang med par mig kyang deb mi shes shing dbang po med pa lta bu yin mi rung / lhag par du cig shos kyis gsar 'gyur gyi nang don thad brtse dung gi cha cung drag pa'i rigs bshad skabs/ gzhan zhig la tshor snang spu tsam yang med par ngo gnag ger bsdad tshe/ lta mkhan gyis de la mi sems mi shes pa 183

zhig red snyam nas sun snang skyes srid/ nyams 'gyur ji lta bu 'dzin pa de bshad mkhan re res rang gi lag len gyi nyams myong brgyud na da gzod yang dag par tshod 'dzin byed thub/ bshad mkhan la lar nyams 'gyur ci yang med pa dang la lar mtha' gcig tu gdong la 'dzum gyis khengs/ spyir bshad na nang don dang bral ba dang thog mtha' kun tu 'gyur rgyu med pa'i nyams 'gyur tshang mar lta mkhan gyis yi rang byed mi srid/ bshad mkhan la las nyams 'gyur 'os min mi 'byung ba byed ched/ mgo sgur nas lag gi ma yig la bltas nas 'dug pa yin/ byed stangs de rigs kyis kyang lta mkhan la khyod kyis bshad mkhan gzhan par kha ya mi byed par rang kho na las mi bsams pa'i tshor snang sbyin nges/ mi gnyis kyis mnyam du bshad pa de yang thad gtong le tshan las gzhan/ spyir btang gi gsar 'gyur khrod du gsar 'gyur gyi nang don mdor bsdus dang gsar 'gyur gnad bsdus sogs dus yun thung ngu'i ring la ma gtogs med pas gzhogs 'degs byed dka' ba zhig min/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan zhig la mtshon nas bshad na bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod kyi gzugs brnyan shin tu gal che/ cher bskyed pa'i brnyan gzugs kyis snang brnyan dang nyams 'gyur gyi skyon phran bu dag kyang rgya bskyed de kun gyi mdun du lhang nger mngon pas/ sems khur chen po bzo srid/ yin yang des skad cha'i gal chen rang bzhin je zhan du btang ba red zer ba min/ don dngos thog brnyan 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan mi nyung ba zhig gis skad cha'i gnad don thag bcad pa mi bzang bas da gzod rang 'khri'i bya ba legs sgrub byed ma thub pa red/bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod kyi blang bya'i 184

skor rags tsam gleng na/ gcig nas skad char 'brel chags dgos la lhod sha ldan dgos/ nga tshos bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur brgyud nas don rkyen gyi nang don lta mkhan la bshad dus thog mar lta mkhan la bshad mkhan kyis gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la yongs su cha rgyus gting zab mo blangs yod pa'i snang ba ster dgos/ spyir btang gi skad char brten nas gsar 'gyur gyi nang don lta mkhan la bshad dgos pa las/ ne tsos ma ṇi 'don pa bzhin yig 'bru re re ma lus par sgrog 'don bya dgos pa min/ tshig la 'brel chags pa dang skad char lhod bag ldan pa yong ched/ bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur ma yig gi nang don gtso bo sems la nges par bya dgos pa las/ yig 'bru gcig mthong rjes da gzod kha gdangs nas skad phyung ba zhig min par bshad pa'i skabs su kha las mig mgyogs pa bya dgos pa dang klad pa'i nang gsar 'gyur gyi spyi khog gi nang don nges pa bya dgos/ gnyis nas skad char yid rton thub pa bya dgos/ gsar 'gyur gyis don dngos gzhi 'dzin sa byed pas/ bshad mkhan gyis rang gi bshad rtsal la brten nas lta mkhan gyis yid ches par bya dgos/ lta mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur zhig la yid ches min de gtso bo gsar 'gyur de don dngos yin min la rag las pa yin mod/ yin na'ang bshad mkhan gyi bshad stangs kyis kyang lta mkhan gyi yid ches tshad la shugs rkyen thebs srid/ nyams myong dang ldan pa'i bshad mkhan gyi gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la go ba yang dag pa blangs nas bcos ma min pa'i skad gdangs rnam dag cig gis lta mkhan la bshad nus/ nyams myong med pa'i bshad mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur ma yig khrod kyi rang la cha rgyus med pa'i bya dngos la rang gi gu dog pa'i shes rtogs tsam la brten nas go ba 185

blangs nas/ rtag par sgro btags kyi shas che phyin/ rnam dag min pa'i skad gdangs sogs kyis lta mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur gyi nang don dang bshad mkhan la yid mi ches par byed nges/ deng skabs brnyan 'phrin khang mang pos gzugs byad spyir btang can gyi gsar 'god pa de gsar 'gyur le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par bkol 'dod pa las/ skyes gzugs legs shing skad ngag snyan pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'khyab ston pa bkol mi 'dod pa red/ rgyu mtshan ni gsar 'god par gsar 'gyur bya ba'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa yod pa dang shes bya'i rgya yangs pa/ skad cha'i nang don zab cing 'gugs shugs ldan pa'i rkyen red/ gsum nas skad char 'gugs shugs ldan dgos/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur gyis don bya dngos brgyud bsgrags byed dgos par ma zad/ da dung bshad mkhan gyi rnam 'gyur yang mtshon dgos/ thog mar bshad mkhan rang nyid bshad rtsom gyi nang don la spro ba ldan dgos pa dang rang gis bshad pa'i nang don la do khur bya dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod gson nyams dang 'gugs shugs ldan nges/de las gzhan bshad mkhan gyis da dung skad cha'i khrod skad gdangs dang myur tshad/ skad kyi mtho dma'/ skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs sogs la brten nas rang gi tshor ba mtshon par bya dgos shing / tshor ba de yang gsar 'gyur gyi nang don dang spyir btang gi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i tshad gzhi dang mthun dgos pa ste/dper na/ nyam chung la snying rje mtshon pa dang ngan spyod la kha rdung gtong ba/byas rjes la rten 'brel zhu ba sogs mtshon par bya dgos/ do snang bya dgos pa zhig ni lta mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur la lta dus bshad mkhan la lta ba'i dus mtshungs su gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la nyan pa yin pas/ skad cha'i khrod kyi 186

brtse dung gi cha de bshad mkhan gyi gdong gi nyams 'gyur dang mnyam du brgyud bsgrags byed pa yin pas ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur de skad cha'i khrod kyi brtse dung gi cha dang gcig gyur yong ba bya dgos/ de ltar byas na skad cha'i 'gugs shugs je drag tu gtong thub/ gal te rlung 'phrin gsar 'gyur dang brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gnyis bsdur tshe/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi myur tshad cung mgyogs pa dang 'gyur khugs kyang cung drag pa red/ de ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur la brnyan ris yod pa'i rkyen red/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod lta mkhan gyis bshad mkhan gyi mchu'i 'gul stangs las skad cha'i cha 'phrin khag cig sngon na shes thub pas/ gsar 'gyur nang don la go ba len sla/ de'i phyir bshad mkhan gyi skad cha'i myur tshad 'os 'tsham sgos je mgyogs su btang chog le tshan bshad skabs mgo sogs thos 'tsham gyis 'gul bas kyang skad cha'i 'gyur khugs mngon gsal che bar byed srid/ bshad mkhan re rer rang la goms pa'i 'gul stangs re yod cing /skad cha'i 'gyur khugs kyang rang rang so so red/ 'on kyang 'gyur khugs 'di dag tshang ma gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la gnod mi skyel ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og tshod 'dzin bya dgos pa las/ bsam bzhin du skad cha'i 'gyur khugs la mnyam 'jog byas drags tshe/ skad cha'i nang don la gnod par ma zad/ nyams 'gyur dang 'gul stangs gnyis 'os shing 'tsham par mthun sbyor yong bar shugs rkyen thebs nges/ bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod bshad mkhan gyi ngo gdong gi gzugs brnyan shin tu che bas/ nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod de 'dra do snang mi byed pa'i zhib phra'i rigs kyang mngon gsal che bar 'gyur ba red/ dper na/ skra yi slas stangs dang gyon gos/ rgyan cha/ ngo 187

gdong la skag byug tshul sogs kyi gnad don lhag par kun gyi mig mdun du lhang nger mngon srid pas/ gsham nas de'i thad la do snang bya dgos pa kha shas bshad par bya/ skra yi slas stangs la lta mkhan gyis ha cang do snang byed sla/brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan rnams nyin re rer brnyan 'phrin las 'char dgos pas/ skra slas stangs dang shad stangs nyin re rer mi 'dra ba byas tshe/ lta mkhan gyi snang ngor chags zin pa'i snang brnyan la gtor brlag thebs sla/ der brten skra yi shad stangs de rang nyid kyi thob thang dang gzugs byad kyi khyad chos dang bstun dgos la gang byung du 'gyur mi 'os/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyi gyon gos bab chags dang stabs bde gtso che dgos pa las/ de 'dra 'phyor sgeg yin mi dgos/ gyon gos kyi kha dog gis brnyan 'phrin steng rgyan spras kyi nus pa thon pas bshad mkhan gyis rang gi thob thang dang khyad chos la mi lta bar gyon gos kyi kha dog gdam mi 'os/ gal te rgyan spras kho na bsams nas gyon gos de dang 'brel ba'i bshad mkhan gyi thob thang dang spyi tshogs kyi cha 'phrin la do snang ma byas tshe/ lta mkhan gyi sems su snga mo nas yod pa'i bshad mkhan gyi snang brnyan la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs srid/brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyis rgyan cha 'dogs dus gzab 'phyor dang rgyas shom che mi 'os/ dus chen sogs dus khyad par can gyi skabs su ma gtogs/ gyon gos dang rgyan cha gang yin yang nam rgyun 'tsho ba dang bstun dgos pa las tshad las brgal mi 'os/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad skabs bshad mkhan gyi ngo gdong gi gzugs brnyan shin tu gsal bas/nam rgyun kun gyis do snang mi byed pa'i zhan cha dag kyang lhang nger mngon srid/snang brnyan legs po zhig srung 'dzin byed ched/ brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur 188

bshad mkhan gyis ngo gdong la dgos nges kyi skag byug chog yin na'ang skag 'byug dus nges par du 'os shing 'tsham pa yin dgos pa las/ 'khrab ston pa dang 'dra bar tshad las brgal ba'i mdzes spras byed mi 'os/ rgyu mtshan ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan gyi las 'gan ni gsar 'gyur cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags bya rgyu de yin pa las/ mdzes pa'i gzugs byad la brten nas lta mkhan 'gugs dgos pa ma yin/brnyan ris can gyi gsar 'gyur/ brnyan ris ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pas brnyan len dang rtsom sgrig byas rjes gtong bar bya ba'i rnam pa mang ba'i brnyan ris kyi gsar 'gyur de la zer/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur la skad sbyar rjes gsar 'gyur le tshan hril po'i khrod bsabs nas bkol chog brnyan ris gsar 'gyur de yul dngos nas brnyan len byed skabs gsar 'gyur yul dngos kyi sgra sna tshogs te rgyab ljongs kyi sgra sna tshogs dang mi sna'i skad cha'i sgra sogs dus mnyam du phab yod pa yin/ sgra 'di dag ni gsar 'gyur gyi dgos dbang ltar 'dor len byas chog sgra la la gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la 'brel ba med la/ bshad mkhan gyi 'grel bshad dang brnyan ris la gnod skyel bas ma bkol na legs/ nga tshos gsar 'gyur la lta dus gsar 'gyur la la brnyan ris dang bshad mkhan gyi 'grel bshad kyi skad las rgyab ljongs kyi sgra med pa dang / brnyan ris la la'i khrod mi sna dag gi skad cha bshad pa'i bzo lta mthong yang kho tsho'i skad thos rgyu med pa mthong ba yin/ gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la thad kur 'brel ba yod pa'i skad sgra la la dper na/ rnam pa mtshon byed kyi sgra dang bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha sogs brnyan ris dang dus mnyam du 'byung ba yin/ 'thab 'khrug dang 'brel ba'i 189

gsar 'gyur la mtshon na/ 'thab 'khrug gi brnyan ris dang mnyam du byung ba'i me mda' dang me skyogs kyi sgra yis 'thab 'dzing gi rnam pa dngos mtshon thub la/ lta mkhan gyis me skyogs sogs kyi sgra yi khrod 'thab 'dzing gi dza drag rtogs thub/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur la spyir btang du skad cha'i 'grel bshad byas nas gsar 'gyur don rkyen byung ba'i dus dang yul/ nang don/ mi sna sogs gzhi rtsa'i rgyu rkyen gsal bshad bya dgos/ yul dngos nas bsgrags pa'i brnyan ris gsar 'gyur la bcar 'dri gsar 'god pas yul dngos dang rtsom sgrig go rim khrod 'grel bshad byas nas brnyan ris dang mnyam sbyor byas chog mod/ yin yang brnyan ris gsar 'gyur 'bor chen ni rtsom sgrig pa dang gsar 'god pas 'grel bshad ma yig bris rjes/ bshad mkhan gyis bshad pa yin/ der brten brnyan ris gsar 'gyur la skad sbyor ba'am 'grel bshad byed pa ni brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i nyin rgyun bya ba'i nang don gal chen zhis red/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur la skad sbyor ba'am 'grel bshad byed pa la rnam pa gnyis yod/ gcig ni brnyan ris la bstun mi dgos par bshad mkhan gyis ma yig bstud mar bshad tshar bar byed pa de yin/ bshad stangs 'di rigs ni skad cha dang brnyan ris kyi 'brel ba de 'dra mi dam pa dang 'grel bshad kyi skad cha de dmigs gtad kyi brnyan ris dang gzhogs 'degs byed mi dgos pa'i gsar 'gyur rigs la bkol ba yin/rigs gzhan zhig ni skad cha brnyan ris dang bstun nas bshad dgos pa ste/skad cha dang brnyan ris la la dmigs gtad kyi 'brel ba yod pas/ skad cha sngon du shor mi rung la rjes su'ang lus mi rung bar bshad mkhan gyis skad sbyor dus ma yig dang brnyan ris gnyis kur bstun dgos pa yin/ brnyan ris 190

gsar 'gyur la skad sbyor ba de brtse dung gi cha la shin tu do snang bya dgos pa'i ched sgrig le tshan la skad sbyor ba dang mi mtshungs/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur khrod skad cha ni zur gtogs tsam ma yin par/ gsar 'gyur byung ba'i dus dang gnas/ mi sna'i thob thang sogs tshang ma skad chas gsal bshad bya dgos/brnyan ris gsar 'gyur mang po'i khrod brnyan ris ni skad char gzugs kyis ram 'desas byed pa tsam yin gshis/ bshad mkhan gyis brnyan ris gsar 'gyur bshad skabs lhod bag gi ched sgrig le tshan gyi bshad stangs mi bkol bar gsar 'gyur sgrog 'don gyi rnam pa spyod dgos/ de yang lta mkhan gyis brnyan ris lta ba la bar chad mi bzo ched sgrog 'don byed stangs thad bshad mkhan gyis thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur bshad stangs las skad sgra cung 'jam dgos/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur gyi sgrig sbyor go rim ni de 'dra'i rnyog 'dzing zhig min/ spyir btang du 'brel yod gsar 'gyur rgyu cha brnyan len byas rjes ma yig 'bri ba dang mtha' mjug rtsom sgrib byas tshar ba'i brnyan ris la 'grel bshad kyi skad sbyor ba de yin/ skad sbyor ba de bcar 'dri'i 'gan khur ba'i gsar 'god pas bshad chog la/ bshad mkhan gyis bshad na'ang chog brnyan ris gsar 'gyur gyi skad sbyor bya ba de yul dngos nas byas kyang chog ste/ gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri byas rjes/ de ma thag gsar 'gyur ma yig 'bri ba dang / de'i rjes brnyan len 'phrul chas la brten nas gsar 'gyur gyi nang don bshad dgos/ gsar 'gyur 'di rigs kyi mgo rnga gnyis kur yul dngos nas gsar 'gyur spel ba'i gsar 'god pa'i gzugs brnyan shar nas bshad cing / gnas yul gcig nas skad sbyar tshe/ gsar 'gyur 'grel bshad kyi skad gcig mtshungs yin pa dang skad la dngos snang ldan pa 191

yin/ skad sbyor stangs 'di rigs don dngos thog sngon na skad cha sgra blangs rjes/ phyis su skad cha ltar rtsom sgrig byas nas brnyan ris gsab pa zhig yin/gsar 'god pas yul dngos nas bshad pa'i thabs la brten nas brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur spel ba de rang re'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin thad da dung yongs khyab tu bkol bzhin med par brnyan ris gsar 'gyur mang che shos kyi skad sbyor bya ba bshad mkhan gyis bshad pa yin/ rtsom sgrig byas rjes skad sbyor ba ni da snga brnyan ris gsar 'gyur thad yongs khyab tu bkol ba'i skad sbyor stangs shig yin/ gnas tshul mang po'i 'og gsar 'god pas yul dngos nas gsar 'gyur ma yig 'bri mi thub/ gsar 'god pa mang shos kyis brnyan ris kyi rgyu cha brnyan len byas rjes/ dus yun nges can zhig la bsam gzhig btang nas gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la yang bskyar bkod sgrig byed pa yin/ rtsom sgrig byas rjes skad sbyor ba la'ang byed stangs gnyis yod/ gcig ni brnyan ris la lta mi dgos par bshad mkhan gyis thad kur gsar 'gyur ma yig sgrog bshad byed pa dang / rtsom sgrig pa dang yang na gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur ma yig gi ring thung ltar de dang mthun pa'i brnyan ris gsab pa de red/ skad sbyor stangs 'di rigs ni skad cha gtso yin pa'i gsar 'gyur khrod bkol ba mang / gsar 'gyur de rigs khrod brnyan ris kyis zur gtogs sam gzhogs 'degs kyi nus pa bskyed de/ gsar 'gyur gyi nang don la gzugs ris kyis gsal bshad byed pa yin phyin/ skad char skul rgyu med pa dang / brnyan ris ring chog la thung yang chog pa red/ gsar 'gyur 'di rigs mang che shos mdor bsdus rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur thad bkol ba ste/ dper na/ rgyun du mthong ba'i gros tshogs skor gyi gsar 'gyur dang dpal 'byor gnas tshul 192

bsgrags pa sogs kyi thad bkol ba yin/ brnyan ris dang bstun mi dgos pa 'i 'grel bshad byed stangs de yang bshad mkhan gyis brnyan ris kyi nang don la gtan nas bsam blo gtong mi dgos pa ma red/ bshad mkhan gyis nges par du brnyan ris gsar 'gyur gyi nang don dang yang na rtsom sgrig pa'i brnyan ris la gsal 'debs byas pa'i nang don ltar skad ngas gi 'gyur khugs dang skad kyi mtho dma' dang drag zhan/ skad cha'i 'gyur khugs sogs gtan khel bya dgos/bshad stangs gtan khel byed skabs gsham gyi gnad don 'gar do snang bya dgos/ gcig nas skad gdangs kyi drag zhan 'os 'tsham yin dgos/skad gdangs drag che na lta mkhan gyis gsar 'gyur brnyan ris lta ba la bar chad bzo srid pas bshad dus skad gdangs de brnyan ris dang 'dres thub pa bya dgos/ gnyis nas skad char dal myur gyi 'gyur khugs 'os 'tsham byed dbos/ skad cha'i mgyogs tshad la 'gyur ldog med pa dang yang na skad cha dal drags tshe/ skad cha ldib la lhung nges/ tshor snang de rigs skad cha kho nar nyan na de 'dra mi gsal yang brnyan ris dang zung 'brel byas rjes shin tu mngon gsal yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni gsar 'gyur gyi brnyan ris la spyir btang du sna rkyang gi brnyan ris ring po mi bkol bar rigs mi gcig pa'i brnyan ris thung ngu mang po mthud nas grub pa yin phyin/ brnyan ris la 'gyur khugs kyis phyug pa yin/ gsum nas skad cha dal drags mi rung / skabs la lar gsar 'gyur ma yig la dus kyis tshod 'dzin byas med pas/ bshad mkhan gyis skad cha'i mgyogs tshad je dal du btang nas tshig la la gnad la khel bar byed bsams/don dngos thog skad cha dang brnyan ris zung sgril byas rjes/ brnyan ris kyis 193

nang don zhib phra'i rigs la kha gsab byas nas lta mkhan gyi mig mdun du lhang nger bstan yod pas/ bshad mkhan gyis skad cha'i tshig la la je dal du gtong ba sogs thabs la brten nas 'bur du dod mi dgos/ de min skad cha dal drags tshe gsar 'gyur hril bo ldib la lhung nas 'gugs shugs med par ma zad/ da dung skabs 'gar brnyan ris kyis mi 'dang bar rtsom sgrig sogs thad la dka' ngal bzo nges/ brnyan ris la mi lta bar bshad pa de skabs 'gar dus tshod thad nas tshod 'dzin byed pa yin/ gsar 'gyur ma yig gcig dus yun skar ma ci tsam la bshad tshar dgos pa'i blang bya yod la/skabs 'gar dus tshod kyi blang bya de dus tshod skar cha 'ga'i nang du tshod 'dzin byed srid/ gnas tshul 'di 'dra'i 'og bshad mkhan gyis ma yig gra sgrig byed skabs/ dngos su chu tshod skar char brtags nas skad cha'i mgyogs tshad sems la nges par byas na legs/ chu tshod skar char bltas nas mgyogs tshad gtan khel byed skabs/ dngos su bshad pa nang bzhin skad phyung nas gyer 'don byed pa las/ skad mi phyung bar khog 'don bya mi 'os/ rgyu mtshan ni skad phyung nas gyer 'don byed pa dang skad mi phyung bar khog 'don byed pa gnyis la dbugs len stangs dang yi ge'i sgra len stangs/ skad bkol stangs sogs la khyad par yod pa dang khyad par de dag gis thad kur skad cha'i mgyogs tshad la shugs rkyen bzo srid pas/ skad phyung nas gyer 'don byed pa de khog 'don byed pa las mngon gsal gyis dal ba red/ de las gzhan gsar 'gyur ma yig gi yig grangs shin tu mang bas rgyun ldan gyi gsar 'gyur bshad skabs kyi skad cha'i mgyogs tshad ltar na gtan khel gyi dus yun nang mi shong tshe/ bshad mkhan gyis nges par du thabs sna tshogs la brten nas skad cha je mgyogs su 194
