gtong dgos/ skad cha'i mgyogs tshad la la rlung 'phrin rgyang bsgrags khrod nyan mkhan gyis thos tshor la gnod pa thebs srid kyang / brnyan 'phrin khrod brnyan ris kyi nang don la brten nas lta mkhan gyis dang len byed thub/ der brten brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang sgos su brnyan 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur bshad mkhan zhig yin tshe/ nges par du nam rgyun bya ba'i khrod gyer 'don gyi nus rtsal la byang bar byed dgos/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur gyi skad sbyor stangs gzhan zhig ni/ brnyan ris la bltas nas skad sbyor ba ste/ brnyan ris rtsom sgrig grub rjes skad sbyor ba de yin/ bshad mkhan gyis brnyan ris la bltas nas skad cha brnyan ris steng du sbyor ba dang skad cha brnyan ris dang bstun dgos pa las/rtsom sgrig byas zin pa'i brnyan ris mi sgul ba yin/ de ni skad chas brnyan ris la ram 'degs byed pa'i brnyan ris gsar 'gyur gyi mtshon byed rnam pa zhig yin/ brnyan ris la bltas nas skad sbyor ba'i bzang cha ni brnyan ris dang skad cha yang bskyar legs sgrig byed mi dgos pa de red/ brnyan ris la bltas nas bshad na bshad mkhan gyis brnyan ris kyi nang don la go ba len pa dang brnyan ris kyi 'gyur khugs la rgyus lon byed thub par byas nas skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs dang skad cha'i mgyogs tshad/ skad cha'i 'gyur khugs bcas ji lta bu gtan khel byed par rogs byed thub la/ bshad stangs 'os 'tsham spyad de skad cha dang brnyan ris 'dres shing mthun par byed thub/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur khrod brnyan ris dang bstun nas skad sbyor rgyu de yang skad cha re re brnyan ris re re dang bstun dgos pa zhig min/ brnyan ris gsar 'gyur mang che shos skad cha dang brnyan ris gnyis tshags dam po'i ngang mnyam du sprul dgos pa ma yin par/ spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og bshad mkhan gyise skad cha 195

brnyan ris steng sbyar nas brnyan ris dang skad cha kha khar ma gyur tshe chogayul dngos nas gsar 'gyur spel ba/ yul dngos nas bsgrags pa de yang brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur khrod rgyun du bkol ba'i rnam pa rigs shig red/ rnam pa 'di rigs phyi rgyal nas yongs khyab tu bkol spyod byed kyin yod/rang rgyal du yul dngos nas bsgrags pa'i gsar 'gyur rgyun du spel mod/yin na'ang rnam pa 'di gtso bo byed pa'i gsar 'gyur le tshan ha lam med/yul dngos nas gsar 'gyur spel mkhan ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa dang brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan gnyis kyi 'gan gcig lcogs su 'khur mkhan zhig yin/ de tshos gsar 'god pa nang bzhin gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri byed pa dang don rkyen gyi go rim la rgyus lon bya dgos la/ gsar 'gyur ma yig 'bri dgos par ma zad/ da dung bshad mkhan dang 'dra bar brnyan len 'phrul chas las lta mkhan gyi mdun du mngon te gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi nang don lta mkhan la mtshams sbyor bya dgos/ yul dngos nas spel ba'i gsar 'gyur la la ni gsar 'gyur don rkyen byung yul nas thad kur yongs 'grub byed pa ste/brnyan len 'phrul chas gnyis yan la brten na/ gsar 'gyur byung yul dngos nas brnyan ris phan tshun sgrig sbyor byas chog sgrig sbyor byed stangs 'di rigs la brten nas gsar 'gyur thad gtong byas te/ gsar 'gyur gyi dus thog rang bzhin mthor 'degs byed thub/ yin yang / gsar 'gyur yod tshad 'di ltar thad gtong byed thub pa zhig gtan nas min/ 'char gzhi zhib tshags bkod pa dang sngon na gra sgrig bya chog pa'i gsar 'gyur te/ dper na/ dus bcad bkod pa'i gros tshogs dang sngon la bkod sgrig byas pa'i bya 'gul sna tshogs sogs la gsar 'gyur thad gtong gi spel stangs 'di rigs spyad chog196

gsar 'gyur spel stangs 'di rigs ni mi gcig dang gnyis kyis 'grub pa zhig gtan nas min par/ sgra sdud phab dang glog 'od/ brnyan len sogs lag rtsal gyi phyogs so so'i mi snas ram 'degs bya dgos/ yul dngos nas spel ba'i gsar 'gyur mang che shos ni mi gnyis gsum gyis don rkyen byung yul nas gsar 'gyur gyi rgyu cha brnyan len byas rjes/ phyir las khungs su log nas rtsom sgrig byas tshe da gzod gsar 'gyur hril bo yongs 'grub byed thub/ gsar 'gyur yul dngos nas spel ba ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa dang gsar 'gyur le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i gzhi rtsa'i mthu rtsal red/ brnyan ris yod pa'i gsar 'gyur yul dngos nas spel ba ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa dang tshags par dang rlung 'phrin gyi gsar 'god pa'i bar gyi bya ba'i khyad par sal chen yin la/ brnyan 'phrin gyi gsar 'gyur 'go 'dzin pa'i ches thog ma'i bya ba'i skas rim lta bu red/ don snying nges can gyi steng nas bshad na/yul dngos nas gsar 'gyur spel ba de yang le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed pa'i rigs stabs bde zhig red/ phyi rgyal gyi brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi 'go 'dzin pa mang po yul dngos gsar 'gyur bsgrags pa nas mgo brtsams te rim bzhin gsar 'gyur le tshan hril bor kha lo bsgyur ba'i 'go 'dzin par gyur pa red/ mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu ba'i dus 'go nas bzung / le tshan la la'i khrod yul dngos nas spel ba'i rnam pa stabs bde can spyod 'go brtsams shing / jus 'grod dang bcar 'dri/ rtsom 'bri/ 'go 'dzin sogs 'gan gcig lcogs su 'khur mkhan yang byung /197

2 ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin byed stangs/brnyan 'phrin gyi ched sgrig le tshan la nang don mang po 'dus/ de'i gshis nus la bltas na/ ched sgrig le tshan ni shes bya'i rang bzhin dang slob gso rang bzhin/ zhabs phyi rang bzhin cung drag pa'i le tshan rigs shig red/sngon chad kyi ched sgrig le tshan mang che bas ched don brnyan ris kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan de bshad mkhan gyis mthud sgrig byed pa'i byed stangs bkol ba mang /da lta'i brnyan 'phrin gyi ched sgrig le tshan gyis yongs khyab ngang 'go 'dzin pa'i 'go 'dzin byed stangs spyod kyin yod/ 'go 'dzin pas skabs bab dang bstun nas gleng mol dang yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed pa/ de min sngon la brnyan len byas zin pa'i ched don brnyan ris tshan pa sogs cha tshang bar mnyam du sgrig pa zhig yin/ le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa mi 'dra bas/ 'go 'dzin pa rnams le tshan gyi nang du zhugs tshad kyang mi 'dra/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan la la'i khrod/ 'go 'dzin pas sngon la yongs 'grub byas zin pa'i le tshan gyi nang don de skad char brten nas mnyam gcig tu bsgrigs pa de yin/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi 'go 'dzin pa ni srol rgyun gyi bshad mkhan dang phal cher 'dra/ ched sgrig le tshan la la ni 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha dang snang brnyan la brten nas/ le tshan gyi rgyu cha rigs mang po mnyam du sbrel ba zhig yin/brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi rigs/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan la rigs shin tu mang bas le tshan gyi nang don ltar dbye na/ gsar 'gyur rigs dang slob gso'i rigs/ zhabs phyi'i rigs/ rig rtsal gyi rigs/ lus rtsal gyi rigs sogs yod/ le tshan gyi rnam pa'i steng nas dbye na/ sgrog 'don gyi rnam pa can dang gleng mol gyi rnam pa/ ched don brnyan ris kyi rnam pa can/198

phyogs bsdus kyi rnam pa can sogs yod/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi rnam pas thad kur bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bya ba'i byed stangs gtan khel byed kyin yod/ sgrog 'don gyi rnam pa'i brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan ni rnam pa cung stabs bde ba'i le tshan rigs shig yin/ le tshan 'di rigs yongs su sgrog 'don gyi rnam pa spyod pa dang yang na sgrog 'don byed skabs bar du brnyan ris kyi rgyu cha gsab pa'i rnam pa can zhig yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'gro 'dzin pas sngon la gra sgrig byas zin pa'i ma yig ltar bshad pas chog rnam pa 'di rigs ni brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan khrod dar ba ches snga ba'i rigs shig yin/ brnyan 'phrin sgrig sbyor lag rtsal shin tu dar che ba'i da lta'i dus 'dir yang rnam pa 'di rigs kyi le tshan sngar bzhin mthong thub/ sgrog 'don gyi rnam pa can gyi ched sgrig le tshan 'di rigs ni rtsom sgrig pas sngon la ma yig bris rjes bshad mkhan gyis ma yig ltar bshad pa'i rigs yod la/ le tshan la la ni 'go 'dzin pa le tshan rtsom sgrig gi go rim yongs su zhugs te/ rang gis ma yig 'bri ba'i rigs kyang yod/ yin na'ang / 'go 'dzin gyi khyad chos ni sngar bzhin ma yig ltar bshad pa gtso bo yin/ gleng mol gyi rnam pa'i brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyis brnyan 'phrin khang gi gtan khel gyi khang ba'i nang dang yang na yul dngos kyi bcar 'dri'i rigs nang don gtso bo byed pa yin/ le tshan khrod mtshams mtshams su 'brel yod brnyan ris rgyu cha gsab pa'ang yod/ gong gi sgrog 'don gyi rnam pa'i ched sgrig le tshan dang mi 'dra bar/ 'go 'dzin pas gleng mol kha brda'i rnam pa spyod cing / gleng mol gyi gleng gzhi'ang sngon la re re bzhin gra sgrig byed thub pa zhig min par gleng gzhi dang bstun nas gang la gang 'tsham ngang 'dri gzhi 'don dgos shing skad 199

cha yang 'dri gzhi dang bstun nas skabs thog tu sgrig dgos/ gleng mol gyi rnam pa'i brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa ni thad kur le tshan gyi gra sgrig go rim la zhugs dgos/ brnyan ris can gyi brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyis brnyan ris kyi ched sgrig le tshan gtong ba gtsor byed pa yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i nus pa ni ma yig la bltas nas bshad pa dang le tshan gyi mgo rnga nas mgo brjod dang phyogs sdom rang bzhin gyi skad cha 'ga' re bshad pa de yin/ phyogs bsdus kyi rnam pa'i brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan ni mig sngar rang rgyal nas mthong ba ches mang ba'i ched sgrig le tshan gyi rnam pa'i rigs shig red/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan 'di rigs kyis 'go 'dzin pa'i le tshan rtsa 'dzugs nus pa gang legs kyis 'don spel byas nas/ 'go 'dzin pa brgyud de 'grel bshad dang gleng mol/ brnyan ris tshan pa sogs le tshan rgyu cha rigs mang po phyogs bsdus byas nas cha tshang ba'i le tshan zhig tu grub pa de red/ le tshan gyi rgyu cha so sor dbye ba dang yang bskyar phyogs bsdus byed pa ni le tshan 'di rigs kyi khyad chos gal chen red/ le tshan khrod kyi 'grel bshad dang bcar 'dri tshang ma cung mdor bsdus shing / 'go 'dzin pas le tshan hril bo'i khrod phreng thag lta bu'i nus pa bskyed de/ rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i le tshan gyi rgyu cha 'di rigs bstar la brgyus nas/ le tshan gyi brjod bya gtso bo gcig la zhabs phyi bsgrub pa red/ phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi bsam gzhig thad cung rnyog 'dzing che ba dang le tshan gyi rgyu cha rigs mang po dang 'brel bas/ sgrig sbyor thad kyang dka' las cung che/yin na'ang le tshan 'di rigs kyi rnam par gson nyams ldan pa dang lta mkhan gang mang ngang gis 'gugs thub pas na/ brnyan 'phrin khang stobs ldan dag 200

bis le tshan 'di rigs bsgrub par mthong chen byed kyin yod/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi rgyu cha phun sum tshogs shing nang don mang po 'dus pas 'go 'dzin par blang bya'ang cung mthon po bton pa red/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi rigs dang rnam pa mi mtshungs pas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i blang bya'ang so sor mi 'dra/brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed stangs/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par nus pa ji lta bu ldan na da gzod brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed thub ce na/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi rigs mang ba dang nang don khyab che zhing / le tshan mi 'dra bar blang bya'ang mi 'dra bas/ tshad gzhi gcig gis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa yod do cog la tshad thig len dka'/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi khyad chos dang le tshan gyi blang bya ltar rang la 'phrod pa'i lam 'tshol dgos/ rags tsam dbye na brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin byed stangs dang blang bya bsham gyi rigs 'ga' yod de/ rigs dang po ni mgo rnga bshad pa'i rnam pa can/ 'go 'dzin byed stangs 'di rigs la blang bya chen po med pa dang 'go 'dzin pa le tshan gyi rtsom sgrig go rim yongs la ma zhugs kyang chog 'go 'dzin pa 'i las 'gan ni sgrig khrid pa'i blang bya ltar le tshan mnyam gcig tu bsdu rgyu de red/ mgo rnga'i tshig kyang sgrig khrid pas snga mo nas bris yod phyin/ 'go 'dzin pas de khong du chud par byas nas/ rang gi skad cha nang bzhin rang shugs kyis bshad pas chog rnam pa 'di rigs ni ma yig ltar 'grel bshad byed pa'i bshad mkhan dang khyad par chen po med cing / 'go 'dzin thad blang bya yang nan mo med pas/ thog mar 'go 'dzin pa'i las la 'jug mkhan dag 201

gis le tshan 'di rigs la 'go 'dzin byed pa nas rim bzhin mthor 'dregs bya chog rigs gnyis pa ni mthud sgrig rang bzhin can/ 'di yang sgrig sbyor go rim cung rtog 'dzing yin pa ma gtogs gong gi le tshan gyi rnam pa de dang phal cher 'dra/ 'go 'dzin pas brnyan ris rgyu cha tshan pa mang po mnyam gcig tu bstar la brgyus nas cha tshang ba'i le tshan zhig tu grub pa de red/ le tshan gyi dum bu snga phyi mthud byed skad cha'ang sngon la bris yod pas/ 'ego 'dzin pas de ltar bshad pas chog gong gi 'go 'dzin rnam pa de gnyis ni snga dus kyi brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan khrod shin tu rgyun ldan yin/rang re'i bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod du'ang de snga nas rnam pa 'di rigs mang du spyad cing / da lta da dung rnam pa 'di rigs spyod kyin yod/ yin na'ang brnyan 'phrin sgrig sbyor lag rtsal gong du 'phel ba dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgrub stangs phun sum tshogs pa/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgrub mkhan dpung sde'i chu tshad mthor 'degs byung ba sogs phyi nang kun gyi mthun rkyen je 'dzoms dang je rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i deng gi dus 'dir/rang re'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi le tshan yang rigs je mang dang nang don je rgyas/ spus tshad je legs bcas gong nas gong du 'phel bzhin mchis la 'phel kyang dgos pa red/ 'go 'dzin pa dang le tshan zung du sgril ba des brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin la rtsa ba nas 'gyur ldog byung /da lta'i brnyan 'phrin ched sgrib le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa ni cung gtan 'jags yin dgos pa dang / ched las shes bya dang rig gnas chu tshad nges can zhig ldan dgos/ 'go 'dzin pa ni le tshan rtsom sgrig hril bo'i khongs mi'i cha nas le tshan gyi jus 'god dang nang don bkod sgrig sogs kyi go rim yongs rdzogs la 202

zhugs dgos/ 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi dgos mkho ltar rang gi skad char brten nas le tshan gyi nang don phyogs gcig tu sbrel ba dang le tshan gyi nang don la la rang gis thag gcod dgos/ dper na/ yul dngos kyi bcar 'dri dang bcar 'dri'i rnam pa/ 'dri gzhi sogs rang gis gra sgrig bya dgos pa red/le tshan jus 'god dang rtsom sgrig sogs la zhugs pa'i 'go 'dzin par nus pa sngar las chen po ldan dgos pa ste/ 'os shing 'tsham pa'i phyi'i snang brnyan dang dwangs shing snyan pa'i skad ngag sogs mkho bar ma zad/ le tshan gyi nang don mtshon stangs phun sum tshogs pa'ang ldan dgos/ gal te/ 'go 'dzin pa'i skad char snying bo dang nang don med par lta mkhan la spro snang bskyed mi thub tshe/phyi'i gzugs byad ji 'dra yid du 'ong yang le tshan la 'bras bu legs po 'byung mi srid/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan mang che shos ni shes bya'i rigs dang zhabs phyi'i rigs yin zhing / lta mkhan gyis le tshan de dag las shes bya sna tshogs shes par byed pas/ de ni rol rtsed rigs kyi le tshan dang khyad par chen po yod pas/ 'go 'dzin par phyi'i gzugs byad kyi cha rkyen dgos la/ nang shes bya'i cha rkyen de bas kyang gal che ba red/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi rnam pa shin tu mang phyin/ tshad gzhi gcig gis 'go 'dzin pa yod tshad la blang bya 'don mi rung / spyir btang gi brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan la 'go 'dzin legs po byed par gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' la bsam blo zhib mo gtong dgos/thog mar khyod kyis rang nyid le tshan de'i rigs 'go 'dzin byed par 'phrod min la bsam blo gtong dgos/ khyod rang le tshan zhig gi 'go 'dzin par gtan khel byed dus khyod kyis rang nyid le tshan der 'phrod min la nan 203

tan gyis bsam blo gtong dgos/ gzhan gyis khyod bdams pa dang kho tshor sbo ba bskyed par byed pa ni khyod kyi dge mtshan la la zhig yin pa las/ khyod la yongs su cha rgyus yod pa dka' mo red/ blo gros can gyis don dag gang dag rang gis bsgrub thub pa dang gang dag rang gis nam yang bsgrub mi nus pa shin tu gsal/ rang gis bsgrub mi nus pa'i don dag btsan gyis sgrub tshe/ rang gi spyi byings kyi snang brnyan la gtor brlag thebs pa'i nyen kha yod/ gal te khyod kyis rang nyid la ji ltar gdeng 'jog bya dgos pa mi shes tshe/ gzugs byad snang brnyan dang skad cha'i khyad chos/ shes bya'i chu tshad bcas phyogs gsum kyi thad nas le tshan gyi blang bya dang bsdur dgos/ phyogs gsum gyi khrod nas phyogs gcig le tshan gyi blang bya dang mi mthun tshe/ le tshan legs sgrub bya rgyu ha cang dka'/ gzugs byad snang brnyan dang skad cha'i khyad chos de le tshan gyi blang bya dang mi mthun tshe/ lta mkhan gyi blor mi 'bab cing / gal te thog mar bzhag pa'i tshor snang mi legs na yun ring la bsgyur dka'/ mgo legs po zhig ma tshugs tshe rang gi yid ches dang spobs par shugs rkyen thebs srid pa dang / slar yang lta mkhan gyi lta stangs bsgyur rgyu de yang las sla mo zhig gtan nas min/ shes bya'i chu tshad mi mtho tshe le tshan thengs gcig gnyis re khrod du lta mkhan gyis tshor mi thub pas/ khyod kyis gra sgrig gang legs la brten nas rang gi shes byas dbul ba'i cha la kha skong byas chog mod/ nam zhig gi tshe/khyod la sngon la gra sgrig byed long med par le tshan la 'go 'dzin bya dgos byung na/ shes mi shes bar du rang gi mtshang gzhug phyir phud pa'i nyen kha ni sngar bzhin gnas yod/ spyir btang 'tsho ba'i khrod du rang mtshang phyir mngon yang khyab mi che med/ gal te lta mkhan gang sar khyab pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod 204

du shes bya'i thad kyi nor 'chug tshabs chen bzos tshe/ khyod la thebs pa'i gyong gun ni khyod kyi bsam yul las yongs su 'das nges red/ ched sgrig le tshan rigs gang la 'go 'dzin byed kyang gzhi rtsa'i nus rtsal la la ni med du mi rung bas/ 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe nges par du nus rtsal 'di rigs la shugs snon bya dgos/tshor ba rnon po/ le tshan la 'bo 'dzin byed skabs/ 'go 'dzin pa'i tshor ba rno zhing myur ba ni shin tu gal che ba red/ le tshan gyi rgyu cha sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bsdu ba dang yul dngos nas mi sna tshogs dang kha brda byed skabs gang yin yang 'go 'dzin pas dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'byung srid pa'i 'gyur ldog sna tshogs la dus thog tu kha ya bya dgos/ phyi'i nyams 'gyur dang skad cha sogs la the tshom phran bu re byung yang brnyan 'phrin nang shin tu gsal ba red/ mi la la'i gshis ka shin tu sems chung yin pas/ khor yug gi bya dngos la tshor snang rnon po med la/ skad cha dang 'gul skyod tshang ma rgyun ldan gyi mi las cung dal ba red/ mi 'di rigs 'go 'dzin pa byas tshe dka' khag shin tu che/ tshor ba rnon po de yang brel 'tshub ngang kha ya byed pa zhig gtan nas min/ 'go 'dzin pa la las le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs/ 'tshub snang chen po skyes nas/ gzhan dang gleng mol byed dus skad cha bshad ma tshar bong gzhan gyi skad cha mtshams gcod pa red/ tshad las 'das pa'i tshor snang rnon po 'di rigs kyang mi 'os/ skabs la lar tshor snang rno zhing myur ba de ni mig mdangs shig dang nyams 'gyur tsam las mtshon pa yin phyin/ nges par du skad cha las mtshon pa'i nges pa med/bab bstun gyi skad chas mtshon nus/ le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i 'gan 205

khur gtso bo ni skad cha bshad rgyu de yin/ da lta'i le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin par gzhan gyis bris pa'i ma yig de rang gi skad char bsgyur ba'i nus pa dgos par ma zad/ skabs thog tu le tshan gyi nang don mtshon par byed pa'i skad cha'i nus rtsal ldan pa ni de bas kyang gal che ba red/ skabs thog nas bshad pa'i skad cha'i khrod/ thos mar bsgrub dbos pa ni skad cha bshad rgyu yod dgos pa de red/skad cha bshad rgyu yod tshe/ da gzod le tshan gyi rgyun skyong thub/ de nas skad char nang don ldan par bya dbos/ go don gsar zhing don snying dang ldan tshe/ da gzod lta mkhan 'gugs thub/ mtha' mar skad char bag 'tsher ldan zhing nyams kyis phyug dgos/ bag 'tsher ldan zhing nyams kyis phyug na da gzod skad cha'i mtshon nus la yag thog yag brtsegs byed thub/ skabs thog nas bshad pa'i skad cha yang bab chags rnam dag gi khyad chos srung 'dzin bya dgos pa las/ rnam dag min zhing kha yag ngo dga'i skad cha rdzun ma rnams 'go 'dzin khrod gtan nas bshad mi rung / des le tshan gyi yid rton rang bzhin la gtor brlag thebs nges/ mi la las nyams kyis phyug pa'i skad cha ni rgyan tshig spungs pa dang sgro btags che ba'i skad cha'i rigs yin par snyam/ don dngos thog mi sems skul bar byed pa'i skad cha ni slad kyis ma gos pa'i sems khong gi skad cha dngos ma shig la zer ba yin/skad cha ma yin pa'i mtshon nus/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod 'go 'dzin pas bshad pa'i skad cha las gzhan/ da dung 'go 'dzin pa'i gzugs byad dang nyams 'gyur/ bzo lta sogs kyang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha dang bsdongs nas lta mkhan gyi mig mdun du mngon srid/ skad cha ma yin pa'i rgyu rkyen de dag gis kyang skad cha'i mtshon nus la shugs rkyen thebs pa yin/ brnyan 206

'phrin ched sgrig le tshan mi 'dra bas 'go 'dzin par bton pa'i blang bya'ang mi mtshungs/ gzugs byad dang bzo lta'i nyams 'gyur 'os 'tsham gyis skad cha'i mtshon nus je drag tu gtong thub/ gzugs byad dang bzo lta mi legs pas skad cha'i mtshon nus je zhan du gtong nges/ le tshan la la'i khrod 'go 'dzin pa yar langs nas 'dug dgos pa dang le tshan la la'i khrod 'go 'dzin pa rkub stegs sogs kyi steng du bsdad nas 'bo 'dzin byed dgos/ der brten 'go 'dzin pas 'dug stangs dang bzo lta legs po sna tshogs la byang bar byas nas/de dag bed spyad de lta mkhan la rang gis brgyud bsgrags byed 'dod pa'i cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byed mkhas par bya dgos/rang gshis khyad chos mtshon nus/ brnyan 'phrin las don gyi phyogs so so 'phel rgyus song ba dang bstun nas brnyan 'phrin le tshan bar gyi 'gran rtsod kyang nyin re las nyin rer je drag red/ kun las khyad du 'phags pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan la da gzod lta mkhan gyi do snang byed nges/ kun las khyad du 'phags pa'i le tshan la nang don dang sgrig bkod thad kun las khyad du 'phags dbos par ma zad/ 'go 'dzin pa'i rang gshis khyad chos kyang kun dang mi mtshungs pa zhig yin dgos/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ gal te kun las khyad du 'phags dgos na/ ches spyir btang gi 'go 'dzin thabs shes la byang dgos par ma zad/ da dung rang nyid kyi gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i rang gshes khyad chos la brten dgos/don dam pas bshad na/ mi re re tshang mar ma gzhi nas gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos yod mod/ yid phangs pa la mi mang pos slob sbyong khrod rang gi gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos de rigs zhan char brtsis nas 207

bcos sgyur byas pas/ khyad chos gcig mtshungs yin pa'i 'go 'dzin pa 'bor chen byung ba red/ 'gran rtsod dza drag khrod du kun la med pa'i khyad chos ldan na da gzod gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa dang / gzhan las bo skabs lhag par mang po ldan nges/ le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs rang gi skad cha dang nyams 'gyur sogs thad kyi rang gshis khyad chos la dbye zhib mi byed par med par gtong mi 'os/ rang gshis khyad chos la la ni zhan cha mngon gsal yin pas yo sung bya dgos mod/ rang gshis khyad chos la la zhig bcos sgyur 'os 'tsham re byas tshe/ le tshan gyi nang don mtshon par phan par ma bad/ da dung rang nyid la khyad du yod pa'i rtags mtshan dang dge mtshan du 'gyur srid pas rang gshis khyad chos 'di rigs srung 'dzin byed 'os pa yin/shes bya'i chu tshad kyis le tshan 'bo 'dzin la thebs pa'i shugs rkyen/rig gnas shes bya'i chu tshad ni rigs gang dang gang gi le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin par mtshon na'ang shin tu gal che ba ni smos ma dgos pa red/ de dag las kyang ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin par mtshon na shes bya'i gal chen rang bzhin de lhag par mngon gsal red/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan la ma gzhi nas shes bya'i rang bzhin dang zhabs phyi rang bzhin ldan la/ shes bya brgyud bsgrags bya rgyu ni de'i gshis nus gal chen red/ 'go 'dzin pas 'brel yod ched las shes bya shes tshe/ rgyun shes rang bzhin gyi nor 'chug mi bzo ba dang / 'go 'dzin pa de nyid le tshan gyi jus 'god rtsom sgrig sogs la 'jug dus kyang 'brel yod ched las shes byar cha rgyus yod dgos/ le tshan ji lta bu'i 'go 'dzin pa/ yin yang phyogs so so'i rgyun shes rang bzhin gyi shes bya la cha rgyus yod dgos shing / rtag par rang gi rgyun shes skor gyi shes byar kha 208

gsab byed par do snang bya dgos/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas gong 'phel byung ba dang tshan rig lag rtsal rgyun mi chad par dar rgyas byung ba dang bstun nas/ bya dngos gsar ba dang shes bya gsar ba'ang gang mang mang 'byung nges/ 'go 'dzin pas de ma thag le tshan khrod bya dngos gsar ba dang shes bya gsar ba de das lag len bya dgos pa'i nges pa med mod/ yin na'ang nges par du de dag la cha rgyus yod dgos/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan mang shos shig thad kur rig gnas lo rgyus dang tshan rig lag rtsal/ bca' khrims slob gso/ gso rig 'phrod brten sogs phyogs mang por 'brel ba yod/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi 'go 'dzin pas spyir btang gi spyi tshogs dang rang byung tshan rig thad kyi rgyun shes shes dgos par ma zad/ da dung 'brel yod kyi ched las shes bya mang po'ang shes dgos/ gal te 'brel yod ched las shes bya la cha rgyus med tshe/ le tshan khrod du dgod bro ba'i nor 'chug bzo srid/ 'go 'dzin rnams ched las mkhas par 'gyur dgos pa'i nges pa med/ ched las shes bya mang por 'phrad dus de'i skor gyi ched mkhas pa gdan drangs chog ched mkhas pa gdan drangs nas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed rogs byas na/ brnyan 'phrin 'go 'dzin par ched las shes byas mi 'dang ba'i gnad don sel thub/ yin yang lta mkhan la mtshon nas bshad na/ 'go 'dzin par bcangs pa'i blang bya de ched las shes bya kho na tsam ma yin par/ da dung skad cha dang snang brnyan sogs thad kyi blang bya'ang yod pa dang / ched mkhas pa mang che shas kyis de'i re ba skong mi thub pas/ 'go 'dzin pa'i tshab byed mi nus/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas spyir bshad na phyogs so so'i rig gnas shes bya khong du chud dgos par ma zad/ rang gis 'go 'dzin byed pa'i le tshan gyi nang don skor gyi 209

ched las shes bya la'ang cha rgyus yod dgos/ spyi tshogs dar rgyas mgyogs pa'i deng gi dus 'dir shes bya gsar ba rgyun mi chad par 'byung bas/ shes bya sna tshogs brgyud bsgrags byed pa'i ched sgrig le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin na/nges par du rang gi rmang gzhi'i shes bya brtan po srung 'dzin bya dgos par ma zad/ da dung rgyun mi chad par shes bya gsar ba sna tshogs sdud len bya dgos/le tshan gyi phab skrun go rim yongs la zhugs pa'i 'go 'dzin par mtshon na lhag par de ltar red/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan ni gsar 'gyur le tshan dang 'dra bar nyin re rer nang don gsar ba yod pa zhig yin mi srid/ khyab khongs nges can gyi shes bya kho nar brten pa dang yang na srol rgyun gyi shes bya'i rmang gzhi kho nar brten pa las shes bya gsar ba sdud len ma byas tshe/ le tshan ji lta bu yin yang yun ring bor mi brtan/ gal te shes bya gsar ba rgyun mi chad par sdud len byas tshe/ le tshan gyi nang don la dus nam yang 'gugs shugs ldan pas/ lta mkhan rgan gzhon mang po ngang gis 'gugs thub/ shes bya gsar bas le tshan la nang don gsar ba sbyin thub cing / le tshan gyi jus 'god pa dang 'go 'dzin pas rgyun mi chad par rig gnas shes bya gsar ba sdud len byed mkhas par byas tshe/ da gzod dus rabs kyi rjes chod pa dang le tshan yang lta mkhan gyi 'dod blo dang mthun pa red/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyogs bsdus nus pa'i gal chen rang bzhin/ yar sngon le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa phal che ba le tshan gyi jus 'god dang phab skrun sogs la zhugs mi dgos par/ le tshan jus 'god dang brnyan len/ sgrig sbyor bcas byas rjes/ le tshan rtsom sgrig pas bris pa'i ma yig 'go 'dzin par sprad de bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin bya dgos/210

phyogs bsdus nus pa can gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zer ba ni/ rang bis le tshan jus 'god dang rang gis ma yig rtsom pa/ rang gis le tshan sgrig sbyor byed pa/ rang gis bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par zer ba yin/ de yang phyogs bsdus nus pa can gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhes pa'i go don yang le tshan gyi brnyan len phab skrun go rim gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs rang gcig pus bsgrub dgos zhes pa min par/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa le tshan gyi sgrig sbyor bya bar cha rgyus yod pa dang dus dang rnam pa kun tu le tshan phab skrun gyi bye bras gi bya ba zhig la zhugs thub pa la zer/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan phab skrun la rnyog 'dzing che bas/le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa gtso snying yin pa'i le tshan zhig la mtshon na'ang /sngar bzhin mi gzhan pas ram 'degs bya dgos/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa le tshan gyi jus 'god dang rtsom sgrig sogs go rim la zhugs par 'bad pa byed pa'i dus mtshungs su/ gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa mang po'i kyang le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed pa'i tshod lta byed kyin yod/ de'i nang la lar legs 'grub 'byung srid/ nam rgyun mi mang po'i sems la bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i byed las de ni gzhan gyis bris zin pa'i ma yig 'don pa'am bshad pa tsam yin pas shin tu sla bar snyam/ dngos su tshod lta byas rjes/da gzod brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun dang skad dung mdun du le tshan zhig bshad rgyu de ni nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi spyir btang gi kha brda zhig dang mtshungs par de 'dra'i las sla mo zhig gtan nas min pa gzhi nas shes tshor byung / mi la las bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i cha rkyen du gyur ba'i skad cha dang skad sogs kyi cha rkyen zhan na'ang nang gi yon tan gyis phyi'i 211

cha rkyen gyi tshab byed thub la/ shes yon la brten nas zhan cha de dag la kha gsab byed thub snyam/ yin yang shes yon gyis kyang yod tshad kyi tshab byed thub pa zhig min/ gsar 'bod pa dang rtsom sgrig pa la la le tshan la la'i 'go 'dzin par 'gyur thub kyang srid la/ le tshan de dag khrod du le tshan gyi rtsom sgrig pa gtso bo yin pa'i cha nas le tshan gyi nang don dang go rim khong du chud cing tshod 'dzin byed par dmigs bsal gyi cha rkyen ldan srid/ 'on kyang tshad ldan gyi bshad mkhan zhig tu gtan nas 'gyur mi srid/ de ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i byed las kyi khyad par la rag las pa red/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i shes yon gyi chu tshad nan bshad byed pa de yang ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i rmang gzhi cha rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sngon 'gro'i 'og gi cha rkyen zhig yin pa smos ci dgos/ bod skad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi lo ngo lnga bcu lhag gi lag len khrod bltas na/ bshad mkhan gyi khrod nas yig sgyur ba dang rtsom sgrig pa/ gsar 'god pa sogs su gyur pa mang mod/ gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa/ yig sgyur ba sogs nas bshad mkhan du gyur pa ha cang nyung / de las bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa dag gis 'bad brtson lhod med byas nas rang gi phyogs so so'i nus pa mthor 'degs byas tshe/ ched sgrig le tshan sna tshogs khrod kyi gtso snying du 'gyur bar gzhan su la'ang med pa'i cha rkyen 'dzoms pa gsal bshad byas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na rang gi byed las kyi dbang gis sngon chad le tshan gyi rtsom sgrig sogs go rim la zhugs pa'i go skabs shin tu nyung bas/ thog ma nyid nas le tshan gyi jus 'god sogs go rim hril bo'i 'gon gcig rtsogs su 'khur rgyu de ni las sla mo zhig ma red/ der brten dang thog rtsom sgrig sogs nas sbyangs te/ rim bzhin 212

letshan gyi jus 'god sogs go rim hril bor rgya bskyed chog yig sgyur dang rtsom 'bri la zhugs na/ rang gi 'bri rtsal la sbyong brdar thob par ma zad/ da dung skad cha'i bshad rtsal mthor 'degs byed par yang shin tu phan la/ rtsom 'bri ba'i bo rim dang brnyan len gyi go rim khrod le tshan hril po'i jus 'god dang brjod byar bsam gzhig gtong dgos pas/ le tshan gyi go rim hril bo khong du chud pa dang de'i gsar rtsom la rim gyis 'jug par dbe mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed thub/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams phyogs bsdus nus pa can gyi phyogs su 'jug pa'i gegs su 'gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen la brtag na/le tshan sgrub stangs thad gyi rgyu rkyen yod la/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rang steng gi rgyu rkyen yang yod/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa la lar ming grags cung tsam re ldan pa na nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyi bsam pa skyes nas yar thon mi brtson pa dang / la las rang gi nus par yid ches med pa dang yang na dka' ngal la skrag nas rang la cha rgyus med pa'i bya dngos la tshod lta byed pa'i spobs pa dang bya ba gzhan la 'gran slong ba'i spobs pa med par 'khums nas sdod pas/ rang gi nus pa dang shes yon mthor 'degs dang rgya bskyed pa'i go skabs bzang po dang lo tshod legs po mig gis bltas bltas la 'chor bar byas/ de min la lar rang rlom che drags nas rang gi nus par gdeng tshod mtho drags te/ gzhan gyi nyams myong dang dgos nges kyi rmang gzhi'i shes byar khengs skyung ngang sbyangs pa mi bzang pas/ 'go legs po 'dzugs mi thub pa dang rmang gzhi brtan po 'dings ma thub pas/ phyis su yar thon chen po yong rgyu'ang shin tu dka'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi 'phel phyogs la bltas na/ nus 213

pa dang khyad chos sna mang 'dzoms pa'i phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi shes ldan mi sna sngar las mkho bas/ phugs sems rgya chen ldan pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams kyis dus skabs mi 'chor bar dus dang rnam pa kun tu rang gi phyogs so so'i nus pa mthor 'degs byas nas de'i phyogs su 'bad pa byed 'os/ rgya skad kyi le tshan la dpyad na/ le tshan gyi 'gan gcig lcogs su khur ba dang yang na le tshan gyi jus 'god pa gtso bo'i 'gan khur ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mang po med/ de ni brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi thog ma'i sgrub stangs la rag las pa red/ rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan la cha rkyen 'dzoms pa dang las rim cha tshang ba/ las bsos gsal ba sogs kyis de snga nas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams le tshan gyi go rim mang por zhugs mi dgos/da lta brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi lag rtsal dar rgyas byung ba dang rnam pa sna mang du gyur pa/ sgrub stangs phun tshogs su song ba dang bstun nas dang thog gi rnam pa la 'gyur ldog chen po byung nas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rnams kyang phyogs bsdus nus pa ldan pa'i phyogs la gong spel byed bzhin mchis/mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ de snga nas le tshan hril po'i jus 'god dang brnyan len phab skrun sogs mgo mjug tshang ma'i 'gan gcig lcogs su khur ba'i 'go 'dzin pa re gnyis byung yod/ 'di'i thad nas rgya skad las sngon du song ba red ces bshad chog de ni rang re'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin thog ma btsugs dus phyi dang nang gi khor lug cha rkyen dang dpal 'byor cha rkyen shin tu zhan pa dang mi sna'ang shin tu nyung phyin/ thog ma nyid nas mi mang pos las ka sna gnyis gsum re'i 'gan khur ba ste/ mi la las rtsom sgrig byed pa'i dus mtshungs su yig sgyur dang zhu dag bya ba bsgrub dgos la/214

mi la la bshad mkhan yin yang yig sgyur dang sgrig sbyor bya ba yang bsgrub dgos/de yang rig gnas gsar ba'i 'os 'gan phrag tu babs pa'i mi rnams kyi slad med kyi rgyud nas ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes pa'i mi rigs kyi brtson sems shig dang tshad yod kyi cha rkyen las tshad med kyi bya gzhag re sgrub pa'i re snyeg phran bu las byung ba'i ma skul dang blangs kyi bya spyod cig yin la/ nyam chung zhing stobs zhan pa'i bya gzhag gsar ba 'di'i gyar gyor gyi gom 'gros dang dga' la skyo ba'i dka' sdug gi brgyud rim dang bsdongs pa'i mi rabs shig gi bab chags kyi bsam blo'i kun slong las byung ba zhig red/ da lta le tshan gyi rnam pa je mang du song ba dang nang don dang sgrub stangs sna tshogs byung ba dang bstun nas le tshan hril bo'i 'gan gcig lcogs su khur ba'i 'go 'dzin pa'ang mang po byung dang 'byung mus su mchis/ de ni dga' 'os pa'i don bya zhig red/ de tsho la la ma gzhir gsar 'god pa yin la/ le tshan gyi dgos dbang gis 'go 'dzin pa'i 'gan gcig phyogs su khur ba dang / la la ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi jus 'god dang 'go 'dzin/ rtsom sgrig bcas kyi 'gan gcig lcogs su khur ba red/ rigs de gnyis kur rang rang gi khyad chos ldan/gsar 'god pas le tshan gyi 'gan gcig lcogs su khur ba des/ le tshan gyi go rim snga ma ste jus 'god dang le tshan gyi nang don gtan khel/ de min 'dri gzhi sogs thad nas cung byang cha ldan zhing gnad la khel ba red/ yin yang ltos sa ltos 'jog gis bshad na de dag mang che bar skad cha'i mtshon stangs dang gzugs brnyan dang nyams 'gyur mtshon stangs thad cung zhan pa dang /lus po'i nyams 'gyur dang skad cha la de 'dra'i lhod bag dang byang cha med par le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa dang rang nyid gnyis 'du shes kyi thad nas yongs su 215

chu dang 'o ma bzhin gzhi gcig tu 'dres mi thub par skad cha dang nyams 'gyur steng nas nga ni 'go 'dzin pa'o zhes pa'i nyams shig ngang ngam shugs kyis shar 'dug la/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bsgrub pa'i le tshan la spyi khog gi jus 'god dang brjod bya'i phugs don mtshon pa/ brnyan phab kyi lag thabs sogs phyogs nas cung zhan pa'ang yod/brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i bshad thabs/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma ni brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon byed rnam pa zhig dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rigs shig yin zhing / le tshan gyi nang don phun sum tshogs pa'i deng skabs/brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma de yang skabs mang shos su le tshan gyi rgyu cha byas nas/ mtshon stangs rnam pa gzhan dang mnyam sgril byas nas le tshan gzhan grub pa red/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma ni spyi tshogs dang rang byung khams kyi bya dngos yod do cog ji ma ji bzhin du brnyan ris su phab nas zin bris 'debs pa'i brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon byed rnam pa zhig red/ nang don drang dngos kyi cha nas de nyid brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur dang mtshungs sa yod med/yin na'ang de ni nye ba'i dus la byung ba'i don bya kho na brjod dgos pa zhig min la/ rang ngo'i gsar 'gyur rin thang kho nas tshod 'dzin thebs pa zhig kyang ma red/ gnas tshul 'god pa'i zhib 'bri'i tshad dang gnas tshul bsgrags pa'i khyab khongs kyi cha nas brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur las ches cher brgal 'dug pas/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i mtshon stangs rnam pa mang zhing nang don gyi cha nas kyang zhib cing phra tshegs ldan/ de'i 'grel bshad kyi thad nas gsar 'gyur dang khyad par shin tu che/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma 'grel bshad byed dus skad cha dang brnyan ris phan tshun gzhogs 'degs dam po bya 216

dgos/ skad cha'i mtshon stangs thad nas kyang brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur gyi bshad stangs dang khyad par ha cang chen po yod/ spyir btang gi don bya drang brjod kyi rnam pa las gzhan/ da dung brtse dung mtshon pa'i skad cha dang dpyad btam brjod pa'i skad cha yod cing / skad cha la brnyan ris dang bstun pa'i rol dbyangs kyi ram 'degs kyang yod/ drang brjod kyi brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur dang bsdur na/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i 'grel bshad la skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi cha lhag par mang ba red/ de'i bshad mkhan gyis skad cha gsal por bshad nas lta mkhan la brnyan ris nang don shes su 'jug dgos par ma zad/da dung brtse dung gi nyams thon par byed pa dang tha na skad kyi mdzes nyams kyang mtshon dgos/ der brten brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma bshad skabs/ ma bshad sngon gyi gra sgrig bya ba shin tu gal che/ gra sgrig gi thog ma'i bya ba ni brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i 'grel bshad ma yig gi nang don la go ba zab mo len rgyu de yin/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i 'grel bshad ma yig gra sgrig byed dus/ rtsom mkhan gyi rtsom gshis dang rtsom nyams/ skad cha'i khyad chos dang brtse dung gi khyad chos khong du chud par bya dgos/ 'grel bshad rtsom yig la go ba dpyis phyin pa blangs na/ skad gdangs dang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs/ skad dang skad cha'i mgyogs tshad dang 'gyur khugs sogs skad cha'i mtshon stangs 'os 'tsham gtan khel byed par phan pa shin tu che/ gra sgrig gi bya ba gnyis pa ni 'grel bshad ma yig la go ba zab mo blangs nas ma yig yongs rdzogs shar mar kha la byang bar byas rjes/ brnyan ris la bltas te 'grel bshad kyi tshig dang brnyan ris bstun mtshams sems la gsal por nges par byed pa dang 'grel bshad byed skabs skad gdangs dang skad ngag mgyogs tshad/ 'gyur 217

khugs ci lta bu bkol na 'os pa sems su nges pa bya dgos/ gal te brnyan ris la ma bltas par sgra blangs tshe/ brnyan ris la cha rgyus med pas/ rtag par brnyan ris dang skad cha gnyis phan tshun mi mthun par so so gyes nas le tshan gyi spus tshad la gnod skyon thebs nges/ nang sgos su nyams myong mang po med pa'i bshad mkhan la mtshon na/ lhag par de lta bu'i gnas tshul 'byung sla/thog mar bshad mkhan gyi las la zhugs pa rnams kyis brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma bshad skabs nges par du brnyan ris la zhib mor bltas nas gra sgrig bya rgyu ni med du mi rung ba'i bya ba zhig red/ brnyan ris dang bstun nas gra sgrig byed skabs/ brnyan ris cung thung ba dang skad cha cung mang pas skad cha mgyogs dgos tshe/ yang yang tshod lta byas nas mgyogs tshad 'os 'tsham sems su nges par bya dgos pa dang da dung rtags brgyab ste dngos su sgra len dus skad cha je mgyogs su gtong bar gsal 'debs bya dgos/ sngon la gra sgrig byas nas tshod ltas bshad dus nges par du skad phyung nas dngos su sgra len pa ji bzhin gra sgrig bya dgos/ bshad mkhan la las gra sgrig skabs su skad phyung nas bshad pa ma yin par khog 'don byed dus skad cha brnyan ris kyi rjes mi chod pa ma tshor yang / dngos su bshad dus skad cha brnyan ris nang mi shong ba'i gnas tshul 'byung / de'i rgyu mtshan ni ma yig gra sgrig byed skabs skad phyung nas bshad pa dang skad phyir mi phyung bar khog 'don byed pa'i mgyogs tshad mi 'dra ba ste/ skad phyir phyung tshe/ yi ge'i sgra 'byin stangs je dal du song nas dus yun je ring la 'gro srid/ der brten brnyan ris dang bstun nas gra sgrig byed skabs/ skad cher phyung nas bton na da gzod mgyogs tshad ngo ma shes thub/de min skad phyung nas gra sgrig byas tshe da dung skad la sbyong brdar 'thob pa dang 218

mchu dang lce sogs kyi brkyangs bskums la mnyes sbyang byas nas yi ge'i sgra 'byin par ha cang phan/ de ni le tshan gang la'ang 'phrod pa red/ gra sgrig byed skabs ma yig gi mtshams gang nas mgyogs dgos pa dang tshig gang gang kha la mi bde ba/ mtshams gang du skad gdangs drag dgos pa'am yang na 'jam dgos pa sogs phyogs so so nas gra sgrig byang chub pa zhig byas nas gnad don ci yang med par byas rjes/ da gzod dngos su sgra len chog gal te gra sgrig byas pa mi 'dang tshe/ dngos su sgra len dus yang yang 'chug nas le tshan hril po'i spus tshad la gnod pa thebs nges/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma ni brnyan ris re re mthud nas bsgrigs shing / brnyan ris bkod stangs mi 'dra ba dang brnyan ris kyi ring thung mi 'dra ba gang mang mnyam du mthud sbyor byas pa las brnyan ris kyi 'gyur ldog rnam pa sna tshogs mtshon/ brnyan ris kyi 'gyur ldog des thad kur 'grel bshad kyi skad cha'i 'gyur ldog la shugs rkyen thebs pa dang skad cha'i 'gyur ldog de yang 'grel bshad kyi tshig dang / brnyan ris kyi nang don dang 'gyur ldog de min de dang bsdebs pa'i rol dbyangs sogs kyis tshod 'dzin thebs pa yin la/ nang sgos su brnyan ris kyi nang don dang 'gyur khugs kyis 'grel bshad tshig gi skad char shugs rkyen thebs tshad lhag par du che ba red/bya ba byed stangs ltar dbye na/ 'grel bshad byed stangs la rigs gnyis yod de/ gcig ni brnyan ris dang bstun nas bshad pa dang gzhan gcig ni sngon la sgra len pa de red/ bshad stangs de gnyis por dge skyon gnyis ka ldan/ brnyan ris dang bstun nas bshad na bshad mkhan gyis thad kur brnyan ris mthong bas/ skad cha'i 'gyur khugs dang mgyogs tshad thad 219

brnyan ris dang gzhogs 'degs legs po byed thub la/ brnyan ris kyi nang don 'gyur ldog gis bshad mkhan gyi sems khams rang shugs su bskul thub/cide brtse dung gi 'gyur ldog cung che ba'i le tshan la lhag par gal che ba red/brnyan ris dang bstun pa'i bshad stangs kyi skyon ni 'grel bshad byed skabs dus dang rnam pa kun tu brnyan ris la do snang bya dgos phyin/ skabs la lar skad dang skad char dam lhod shor ba dang tshan pa dang tshan pa'i bar de 'dra do mi mnyam pa'i gnas tshul bzo nges/ sngon na sgra len pa'i bshad stangs de ni bshad mkhan gyis brnyan ris la bltas nas bshad mi dgos pas/ 'grel bshad skabs kyi skad cha'i mgyogs tshad dang 'gyur khugs/ brtse dung mtshon stangs tshang ma ma yig gi go don las nyams su len dgos pas/ brnyan ris la bltas nas bshad pa nang bzhin yongs su 'cham mthun zhig yong dka'/ yin yang 'grel bshad kyi ma yig gtso che ba dang brnyan ris kyi shugs rkyen chen po med pa'i brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i ma yig la bshad stangs 'di rigs bkol tshe/ rtsom gyi nyams thon pa dang skad gdangs dang skad cha'i snga phyi bar gsum gyi mtshon stangs 'cham mthun yong ba bcas la phan pa yod/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i 'grel bshad ni brnyan ris dang bstun pa'i skad cha'i mtshon byed rnam pa zhig red/ skad cha'i khag 'bur thon drags na lta mkhan gyis brnyan ris la lta bar gnod skyel srid/skad cha dang brnyan ris gzhogs 'degs byed tshul la bltas na/ skad cha dang brnyan ris kyi 'brel bar rigs gsum yod/ gcig ni brnyan ris gtso bo dang 'grel bshad phal ba yin pa dang / rigs gcig ni brnyan ris dang 'grel bshad gnyis kyi go gnas 'dra bas/ phan tshun ram 'degs kyi 220

tshul du snang ba/ da dung rigs gzhan gcig ni 'grel bshad gtso bo dang brnyan ris phal ba yin pa de red/ brnyan ris gtso bo dang 'grel bshad phal ba yin pa'i brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma de 'grel bshad la ma nyan yang brnyan ris las phal cher don go thub/ dper na/ mdzes ljongs mtshon pa'i brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma lta bu red/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan 'di rigs khrod kyi 'grel bshad ni brnyan ris kyi nang don la kha gsab byed pa de red/ de la brtse dung mtshon pa ste/ sems kyi dung ba dang 'gyur ba brjod pa shas che bas/bshad dus skad gdangs drag mi rung la mtho'ang mi 'os par snyan zhing 'jam la 'gyur ba dang ldan par bya dgos te/ mi zhig gis sems rnal la phab nas dngos po zhig la lta dus khyod kyis de'i rna 'gram nas skad dma' mos shub bur brjod pa dang mtshungs/ skad kyi drag zhan dang mtho dma' ji lta bu bkol 'os par bsam blo gtong dus skad dung gi bar thag ring thung gis skad la shugs rkyen ji lta bu bzo tshul shes dgos/ skad dung thag nye na skad kyi ches phra rigs kyi cha de yang gsal por phyir mngon nas nam rgyun rtogs mi thub pa'i skad kyi skyon phra mo'ang snyan 'jebs kyi skad ngag dang mnyam du phyir mngon nges/ de bas skad bkol skabs rang gi skad kyi khyad chos dang dge skyon gsal por shes par byed pa dang skad kyi cha so so bkol mkhas par byas nas dge 'don skyon spang byed dgos/ brnyan ris dang 'grel bshad kyi go gnas 'dra mnyam yin pa 'i gnas tshul de brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i 'grel bshad khrod rgyun du mthong thub/ don dag brjod pa dang mi sna dang dngos po mtshams sbyor byed pa sogs kyi brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma'i rigs rtag par 'grel bshad la brten nas/ brnyan ris kyis mtshon mi nus shing gzugs su phab thabs bral ba'i 221

nang don mtshon par byed pa red/ lta mkhan gyis le tshan 'di rigs lta dus/skad cha dang 'grel bshad la re ba bcol te/ kho tsho'i blo rtse de brnyan ris dang 'grel bshad gnyis kur gtad nas lta zhor dang nyan zhor byed srid/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma 'di rigs 'grel bshad byed dus skad gdangs la de 'dra tshod 'dzin mi byed par 'os 'tsham ngang phyir phyung chog skad gdangs gnyom drags pa dang dma' drags na skad cha'i nus shugs mtshon mi thub/'grel bshad gtso bo dang brnyan ris phal ba yin pa'i brnyan 'phren dngos bshu ma'i khrod kyi brnyan ris ni skad char ram 'degs byed pa zhig ste/ chab srid dang lo rgyus skor brjod pa'i brnyan 'phrin mang che ba 'di'i rigs la gtogs/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma 'di rigs kyi 'grel bshad tshig gi nang don gtso che bas/ 'grel bshad ma yig de yang rtsom yig cha tshang ba zhig yin phyin/ brnyan ris la ma bltas par 'grel bshad ma yig kho nar bltas na'ang nang don yongs su rtogs thub/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma 'di rigs bshad dus skad gdangs la tshod 'dzin mi byed par yongs su phyung chog brnyan ris dang 'grel bshad kyi gtso phal gyi 'brel ba de yang brjod bya dang nang don/mtshon thabs bcas mi 'dra ba bzhin phan tshun 'gyur ldog 'byung srid/ 'gyur ldog de rigs la mi blta bar 'grel bshad kyi tshig ni brnyan ris la ram 'degs byed pa'i rgyu rkyen phal ba sha stag yin bsams na/ 'grel bshad kyi skad cha'i mtshon stangs kyang sna rkyang du 'gyur bas 'gugs shugs ldan mi nus/'grel bshad kyi ma yig 'bri tshul rnam pa sna tshogs yin pas/ 'grel bshad dang brnyan ris bar gyi 'brel ba yang gong du bshad pa de tsam kho na ma yin pas/ gsar skrun la mkhas pa'i bshad mkhan zhig yin tshe/ de'i khrod kyi zhib 222

phra'i 'gyur ldog nyams su myangs nas/ skad kyi 'gyur ldog zhib tshags la brten nas brnyan ris dang gzhogs 'degs byas te/ nang don mi 'dra ba'i ched sgrig brnyan 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma sna tshogs la de dag dang 'tsham pa'i bshad stangs spyad nas/ brnyan ris dang 'grel bshad gnyis chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa lta bu'i rnam pa skrun thub/ brnyan 'phrin dngos bshu ma sogs kyi 'grel bshad ni tshod 'dzin thebs pa'i bshad stangs rigs shig yin la/ der brnyan ris kyi tshod 'dzin thebs pa yin/ bshad mkhan gyis skad cha dang brnyan ris/ rol dbyangs/ de min le tshan gyi 'brel yod skad sgra gzhan dag bar gyi gzhogs 'degs la rgyun mi chad par bsam blo gtong dgos/gzhogs 'degs byed skabs snang chung phran bu tsam gyis kyang le tshan gyi spyi khog gi phan 'bras la gnod pa thebs kyang srid/ 'grel bshad de yang gsar skrun rang bzhin gyis phyug pa'i bya ba zhig kyang yin te/ gang la gang 'tsham gyi skad cha dang skad ngag gi 'gyur khugs/ nyams kyis phyug pa 'i brtse dung gi 'gyur ldog thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rtsal dang khyad chos bcas tshang mas lta mkhan la bag chags zab mo 'jog nges/3 brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin byed stangs/rig rtsal le tshan gyis rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod bsdur tshad chen po zin yod/ brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas kyi kha phye ba na/ gsar 'gyur dang ched sgrig le tshan sna tshogs las gzhan/ dus tshod mang che ba'i skabs su mthong ba ni brnyan 'phrin zlos gar dang zlos gar rigs sna tshogs/ glu gar/rol mo le tshan sogs yin/ ngo bo'i steng nas bshad na de dag tshang ma rig rtsal le tshan gyi khongs su gtogs pa red/223

'go 'dzin pa'i cha nas bshad na/ rig rtsal le tshan yod do cog la bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mkho ba zhig ma red/ zlos gar dang glu gar/yang na rol mo le tshan la la gtong mgo rtsom dus le tshan gyi ming tsam yig byang gi rnam pas mtshon par byas rjes btang chog brnyan 'phrin khang chung ba dag gis rang la le tshan phab skrun byed pa'i stobs med na/ thad kur gzhan gyis brnyan len byas zin pa'i rig rtsal le tshan gtong ba yin/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyis kyang brgyud rim 'di brgyud pa yin te/ mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ dang thog mi sna dang nang sgos su 'phrul chas dang lag rtsal sogs thad kyi cha rkyen zhan pa'i dus su/ rgya skad brnyan 'phrin gyis phab skrun byas pa'i rig rtsal le tshan khrod gdam gses byas nas gtong ba'i thabs la brten pa red/ dga' 'os pa la dus yun shin tu ring po ma 'gor bar bod skad brnyan 'phrin rim gyis 'phel rgyas song ba dang bstun nas/mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la'ang rang gis le tshan brnyan phab byed pa'i cha rkyen dang nus pa yod par gyur nas/ da lta rigs sna tshogs dang rnam pa che 'bring bar gsum gyi rig rtsal le tshan sna tshogs rang rkya pher ba'i sgo nas brnyan len byed thub/spyir bshad na da lta sngon chad kyi rig rtsal le tshan gyi gtong tshul legs bcos byed kyin yod de/ sngon chad dang mi 'dra bar brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal mang po bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa brgyud nas lta mkhan la mtshams sbyor byed pa yin/ brnyan 'phrin rang ngo nas bshad na'ang rang la ched du yod pa'i rig rtsal le tshan yod de/ dper na/ brnyan 'phrin phyogs bsdus rig rtsal le tshan dang brnyan 'phrin rol rtsed le tshan/ shes bya'i rang bzhin dang blo rig 224

'gran bsdur rang bzhin gyi le tshan sogs yod cing / le tshan 'di dag tshang ma/ra 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi mgo nas mjug bar 'go 'dzin bya dgos/brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi rigs/ brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan yang brnyan 'phrin las don hril bo gong du 'phel ba dang bstun nas rim bzhin je mang du song ba dang nyin rer cha tshang bar gyur pa zhig yin/ brnyan phab lag rtsal nyin rer gong du 'phel ba des brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan rnam pa mang zhing mtshon stangs phun sum tshogs pa'i dus rabs la skul 'ded byas/ brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi sgrig sbyor byed stangs dang 'go 'dzin byed stangs thad nas brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal de yang rig rtsal le tshan brgyud gtong dang / mthud sgrig rang bzhin gyi rig rtsal le tshan/ ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan/ rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan bcas su dbye chogarig rtsal le tshan brgyud gtong zer ba ni/ thad gar gtong ba'i byed thabs bkol ba'i srol rgyun gyi brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi rnam pa zhig la zer/ skabs 'gar le tshan gyi rnam pa'i steng 'gyur ldog phran bu re bzos nas/brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas srol rgyun gyi 'khyab tshan bshad mkhan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i tshab byed pa dang / rgyab ljongs sogs kyi thad nas kyang zlos gar khang dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos mngon ci thub byed mod/ yin na'ang le tshan 'di rigs khrod/ 'go 'dzin pa ni zur gtogs sam ram 'degs tsam las nus pa chen po bskyed mi thub/ zlos gar khang dang yang na brnyan 'phrin khang gi 'khrab ston khang tshoms su 'khrab ston byed pa'i rig rtsal le tshan de brnyan 'phrin las thad kur brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi lta mkhan la brgyud gtong byed pa ni le tshan gtong stangs cung stabs bde zhig red/225

brnyan phab lag rtsal dar med pa'i dus su brgyud gtong byed thabs 'di rigs ni brnyan 'phrin gyi rig rtsal le tshan khrod du rgyun du bkol ba'i rnam pa zhig red/ dus der le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa med pas/ des brnyan 'phrin gyi khyad chos mngon du 'phags mi nus/ da lta rig rtsal le tshan brgyud gtong byed dus gtso bo brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi dgos mkhor bsam blo btang nas/ zlos gar khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang gang du yin rung brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas 'bo 'dzin byed kyin yod/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa de sngon chad kyi 'khrab ston sde khag gi 'khrab tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang mi 'dra bar brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas 'khrab ston gyi nang don mtshams sbyor bya dgos par ma zad/ da dung brnyan 'phrin khang gi tshab byas nas le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa/ 'khrab ston pa'i 'khrab stangs sogs la dpyad bsdur gdeng 'jog byas chog pa yin/ 'on kyang rig rtsal le tshan brgyud gtong byed pa de ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan dang mi mtshungs par lta mkhan gyis lhag par lta 'dod pa ni 'khrab ston le tshan yin phyin/ le tshan 'go 'dzin pa'i mtshams sbyor dang dpyad bsdur skor gyi skad cha mdor bsdus yin dgos/ zlos gar khang dang yang na brnyan 'phrin khang gi 'khrab gtong khang gi yul dngos nas 'go 'dzin byed dus/ 'go 'dzin pas kha phyogs yul ni yul dngos kyi lta mkhan dang brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi lta mkhan rigs gnyis ka 'dus pas/ 'go 'dzin pas skad kyi bkol stangs thad lta mkhan rnams 'go 'dzin pa rang nyid dang bar thag gom pa 'ga' las med bsams mi rung bar/ bar thag cung ring ba'i yul dngos kyi lta mkhan rnams kyi thos tshad kyang bsam dgos shing / 'go 'dzin pa'i mgrin sgo cung phye nas skad gdangs cung che 226

dgos/ 'go 'dzin pa'i las 'gan ni lta mkhan la le tshan mtshams sbyorabya rgyu de red/ yul dngos nas 'go 'dzin byed pa'i gzhi rtsa'i nang don thams cad blor nges su bcug ste/ yig byang sogs la ma bltas na 'os/ gal te mtshams sbyor byed mkhan gyis le tshan gyi kha byang dang 'khyab ston pa'i rus ming sogs bzhi rtsa'i nang don tsam la'ang cha rgyus med tshe/ le tshan gyi rjes su khyod kyis le tshan gyi dge mtshan dang snyan pa brjod nas gdeng 'jog ji lta bu byas kyang lta mkhan gyis snang ngor khyod kyis le tshan gyi nang don mi shes pa dang ma mtha' yang shes tshad shin tu nyung la/ ma shes shes khul byas nas kho tsho'i mgo g.yog pa red snyam nges/ der brten/ 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi kha byang dang 'khyab ston pa'i rus ming sogs yig byang du bris nas dngos su 'go 'dzin byed dus lta mkhan gyi mdun du yig byang la lta zhor dang 'go 'dzin byed zhor byed mi 'os/ thabs zad nas yig byang bkol dgos pa byung na'ang / lta mkhan gyi mi mthong sa nas bkol 'os/ brgyud gtong byed pa'i yul dngos su lta mkhan mang po yod pa de brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi lta mkhan kho nar kha phyogs pa dang mi mtshungs pas/ 'go 'dzin pa cung brtan brling yin dgos pa dang /skad cha dang nyams 'gyur sogs tshang ma 'os 'tsham yin dgos pa las bag lhod dang bag 'tsher che drags mi rung / 'go 'dzin pa'i 'gro 'dug thad kyang le tshan re re bzhin gar stegs steng 'ongs nas bshad tshar rjes phyir song yang chog la/ gar stegs kyi zur nas 'go 'dzin stegs bu zhig bzos te/ gal te 'go 'dzin pas skad cha bshad dus brnyan len 'phrul chas 'go 'dzin stegs bur gtad chog brnyan ris tshan pa brje tshad mgyogs pas/ 'go 'dzin pas le tshan re re'i mjug gi dus tshod shes dgos pa dang yang na brnyan 'phrin 227

brgyud gtong 'khrab khrid pa dang 'brel gtug legs po bya dgos/ de ltar min tshe/ brnyan len 'phrul chas 'go 'dzin par gtad dus/ 'go 'dzin pas ma tshor bar nyams mi 'os pa dag brnyan 'phrin du shar tshe/ lta mkhan khrod shugs rkyen mi legs pa bzo srid/ yul dngos kyi 'go 'dzin der bab bstun gyi 'go 'dzin byed stangs bkol chog pa ste/ 'khrab ston le tshan cung ring na 'go 'dzin pa gar stegs las mar song nas 'khyab ston le tshan mjug rdzogs la nye dus phyir 'go 'dzin stegs bur 'ong chog pa dang / 'khyab ston le tshan cung thung na 'go 'dzin pas kyang lta mkhan gyi tshul bzung nas spro snang dang bcas 'khrab ston la bltas chog de ltar byas tshe brnyan len 'phrul chas dus nam zhig la 'go 'dzin par gtad kyang 'go 'dzin pa'i nyams 'gyur mi 'os pa 'byung mi srid/ yul dngos nas 'go 'dzin byed dus skabs la lar 'go 'dzin pa gnyis re dang yang na 'ga' res mnyam du 'go 'dzin byed srid pas/'go 'dzin pa phan tshun bar gyi ram 'degs la shin tu 'dris par bya dgos/rab yin na sngon la sbyong ba byas te/ phan tshun gyi bshad mtshams dang phan tshun bar gyi mnyam 'brel la byang cha yod par byas na legs/ 'khrab ston le tshan gtso che ba'i yul dngos brgyud gtong le tshan khrod du 'go 'dzin pa'i byed las gtso bo ni le tshan mtshams sbyor bya rgyu de yin pa las 'khrab ston la mi zhugs/der brten 'go 'dzin pa 'ga' re yod kyang bshad yul ni sngar bzhin yul dngos kyi lta mkhan dang brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi lta mkhan yin pa las/ 'go 'dzin pa phan tshun bar kha brda byed pa gtso bo min/mthud sgrig rang bzhin gyi rig rtsal le tshan ni brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi khyad chos thog mar mtshon pa'i le tshan zhig yin/ rig rtsal le tshan 228

rigs sna tshogs le tshan so sor bkar rjes/ bab bstun gyi dgos mkho ltar bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pas de dag mthud nas sgrig pa de red/ bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pas le tshan 'di rigs khrod le tshan gyi tshan pa re re bstar la brgyus pa'i nus pa bskyed dgos/ 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi nang don dang 'khrab ston pa mtshams sbyor byed pa'i dus mtshungs su 'khrab ston le tshan la dpyad gtam brjod pa yin phyin/ 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha ni rtsom sgrig pas sngon na bris yod pa de kho nas mi chog par/ gnas bab dang bstun pa'i skabs thog gi skad cha bshad dgos shing / 'go 'dzin pa'i 'dug stangs kyang gnas gcig nas tsog pur 'dug pa dang 'greng nas 'dug pa sogs rnam pa sna tshogs yin la/ rgyab ljongs kyang khang ba'i nang dang khang ba'i phyi rol/ yang na rgyab ljongs dngos ma dang mi bzos glog rdul brnyan ris sogs rnam pa sna tshogs red/ mthud sgrig rang bzhin gyi rig rtsal le tshan la 'go 'dzin bya rgyu'i dmigs yul gtso bo sngar bzhin 'khrab ston le tshan mtshams sbyor byas nas lta mkhan gyis legs por blta thub par bya rgyu de red/ der brten/ 'go 'dzin pa'i dpyad gtam brjod dus ring drags mi rung la/ 'khrab ston le tshan gyi nang don dang 'brel ba med pa'i gleng gzhi skor gleng mi 'os/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi lta mkhan ni brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi phyogs so so'i lta mkhan yin pa las/ yul dngos kyi lta mkhan ma yin pas/ skad dang skad cha'i thad nas kyang le tshan dang lta mkhan dang bstun dgos la rang gi khyad chos ldan par bya dgos/ le tshan 'di rigs khrod du 'go 'dzin pa'i thob thang ni brnyan 'phrin khang gi tshab byed pa yin par ma zad/ da dung 'khrab ston le tshan der dga' zhen byed mkhan dang yang na de'i skor gyi ched mkhas pa lta bu red/ de 229

bas phyi'i nyams 'gyur dang nang gi yon tan/ skad dang skad cha sogs tshang ma'i thad nas le tshan dang bstun nas rang gi khyad chos yod dgos/ mthud sgrig rig rtsal le tshan ni brnyan 'phrin khrod rgyun du mthong ba'i rig rtsal le tshan gyi rnam pa zhig red/ le tshan 'di rigs khrod 'go 'dzin pa'i bya ba de 'dra kyi rgyu med pa dang dka' rgyu'ang med par ma zad/ thad gtong le tshan gyi rang bzhin yang min pas/ nor 'chug byung na dag bcos byed bde/ brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal gyi 'go 'dzin pa tshos thog mar le tshan 'di rigs nas 'go brtsams te rim bzhin nyams myong gsog chogached sgrig rig rtsal le tshan ni brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan khrod grangs ka dang sna kha ches mang ba'i le tshan gyi rnam pa zhig dang brnyan 'phrin sgrig sbyor byed stangs gang legs sgos bed spyad nas bsgrigs pa'i rig rtsal le tshan zhig yin/ le tshan 'di rigs phab stangs dang mtshon stangs kyi rnam pa mang bar ma zad/ ming 'dogs tshul yang rnam pa sna tshogs yin zhing / 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod du le tshan rtsa 'dzugs dang le tshan nang zhugs pa'i nus pa bskyed pa yin/ rags rim tsam dbye na le tshan 'di rigs gtso bo gleng mol dang bcar 'dri/ 'khyab ston bcas rnam pa gsum yod/ le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa sogs mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis rnam pa 'di gsum po'i bkol stangs kyang mi 'dra ba red/ le tshan la la gleng mol kho na las bcar 'dri dang 'khrab ston med la/ le tshan la lar rnam pa 'di gsum po mnyam du 'dzoms/ 'khrab ston las skad cha'i mtshams sbyor med pa'i ched sgrig le tshan shin tu nyung gshis/skad char brten nas mtshams sbyor dang 'grel bshad byed pa ni ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan gyi khyad chos gtso bo yin la/ 'go 'dzin pas ched sgrig rig rtsal 230

le tshan khrod nus pa gal chen bskyed kyin 'dug le tshan gyi sgrig sbyor byed stangs dang nang don ji lta bu yin yang rung 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod du nus pa ji lta bu bskyed pa'i thad nas bshad na/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig le tshan khrod 'go 'dzin pas skad cha mdor bsdus tsam la brten nas 'khrab ston le tshan mtshams sbyor byed pa dang le tshan gyi tshan pa re re mthud sgrig byed pa tsam min par mtshams sbyor dang 'grel bshad/ dpyad gtam brjod pa bcas sngar las mang po bya dgos/ 'go 'dzin byed stangs de yang gnas yul gcig nas mi gcig pus lta mkhan la phyogs nas bshad pa zhig min par yul dngos nas bcar 'dri gleng mol dang bzhugs mol/ bya dngos ngo ma mtshams sbyor sogs rnam pa gang mang mang yod/ le tshan 'di rigs khrod du lta mkhan gyi lta yul ni rig rtsal brtsams chos kho na ma yin par le tshan 'go 'dzin pa'i lta tshul la nyan pa dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rtsa 'dzugs nus par dpyad gtam brjod pa sogs phyogs mang po 'dus pa yin/ der brten brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan khrod 'go 'dzin pas gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' la shugs snon bya dgos/le tshan gyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i rang ngo'i nus pa/ lta mkhan gyis le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa zhig dang len byed pa de yun ring la ngo shes pa las byung ba min par/ dang thog gi le tshan 'ga' yis bzhag pa'i bag chags las byung ba yin/ lta mkhan gyis 'go 'dzin pa'i rang ngo'i cha rkyen dang nus par brtags nas de tshor gdeng 'jog byed pa red/ rang ngo'i cha rkyen dang nus pa mtshon byed de ni lta mkhan gyi mthong thos las 'thob pa'i skyes gzugs dang chas spras/ nyams 'gyur/ bya spyod/ skad/ skad cha'i bshad rtsal/ tshor snang 231

sogs red/ de'i nang la la ni lhan skyes kyi cha rkyen yin pa ste/ dper na/ skyes gzugs lta bu dang / la la ni mi'i sbyangs stobs las grub pa'i soms gshis te/bya spyod dang skad cha'i bshad rtsal/ nyams 'gyur sogs lta bu/ la la ni lhan skyes dang phyis sbyangs stobs zung du sbrel ba las byung ba ste/ tshor ba'i rno myur lta bu/ la la ni mis lag thabs las bzos pa ste/ mdzes spras lta bu bcas red/ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan de yang nang don dang rnam pa na 'dra bas 'go 'dzin pa'i cha rkyen gyi blang bya'ang mi 'dra/ 'go 'dzin pas rang nyid kyi cha rkyen ltar rang dang mthun pa'i le tshan gdam dgos/ de ltar byas na rang nyid kyi dge mtshan gang legs sgos 'don spel byed thub/ ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan mi 'dra bar rang gi le tshan gyi khyad chos blang bya yod pas/ 'go 'dzin pas rang gi khyad chos dang cha rkyen ltar rang gis le tshan de 'bo 'dzin legs po byed thub min la dbye zhib bya dgos/ cha rkyen mang po'i khrod skyes gzugs ni lhan skyes las grub pas de la 'gyur ldog chen po byed mi thub/ de min cha rkyen gzhan dag ni sbyong ba byas na mthor 'degs byed thub pa dang / cha rkyen la la da dung legs bcos chen po byed thub/ sbyong ba byas nas mthor 'degs dang legs bcos byed thub pa'i cha rkyen de dag gis tshad nges can zhig gi thad nas skyes gzugs thad kyi zhan char kha gsab byed thub phyin/ 'go 'dzin pas brtson pa bskyed de rgyun mi chad pa'i sbyong bar brten nas rang ngo'i cha rkyen legs bcos dang mthor 'degs byed par do snang bya dgos/phyogs mang po'i thad kyi skad cha'i mtshon nus/ ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe nges par du phyogs mang po'i skad cha'i mtshon nus ldan dgos/ nang sgos su ma yig lta sa med pa'i skabs thog gi skad cha'i 232

mtshon nus drag po ldan dgos/ ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod du rtag par mi sna dang brtsams chos kha shas cung gting zab ngang mtshams sbyor byed dgos pa dang / mi sna dang brtsams chos de dag la zhib phra'i ngang dpyad gtam brjod dgos/ de dag tshang mar cung cha tshang zhing brgyud rim ldan pa'i skabs thog gi skad cha ring mo'i bshad nus dgos pa las/ skad cha tshig gcig gnyis tsam gyis mi chog skabs thog gi skad cha ring mo bshad pa legs min de khyod kyi shes yon gyi chu tshad dang bsam gzhig gi yid 'dzin nus pa/ skad cha'i tshor ba'i nus pa sogs la rag las pa red/ shes yon gyi chu tshad kyis khyod kyi skad char nang don ldan min dang le tshan la cha rgyus med pa'i gtam shor min mtshon pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan ha cang mang por rang gi khyad par can gyi shes bya'i khyab khongs yod pa yin/ bsam gzhig gi yid 'dzin nus pas khyod kyi skad cha'i go rim gsal min dang sngon na gra sgrig byas pa'i nang don thams cad yid 'dzin la brten nas mtshon thub min thag gcod pa yin/ yid 'dzin nus pa zhan tshe 'go 'dzin gyi spus tshad la gnod pa byed srid/ ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan khrod/ bltas tshod kyis skabs thog nas bshad pa dang 'dra ba'i skad cha mang po don dngos thog sngon la gra sgrig byas pa'am yang na khag cig sngon la gra sgrig bya dbos pa red/ gal te sngon na gra sgrig byas pa thams cad brjed tshe/ sngon gyi las ka thams cad sar bsres pa lta bu red/ skad cha'i tshor ba'i rno myur gyis khyod kyis skad cha'i gleng gzhi bsgyur ba'am yang na bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod 'dri tshig 'phen dus tshor ba rno zhing blo rig grung po'i ngang tshul srung 'dzin byed thub/ skad cha'i tshor ba'i nus pa zhan tshe/ skad cha'i go rim nyog pa dang tshan pa re'i bar mtshams 233

ring drags par ma zad/ tha na skad cha dus thog tu shod mi nus/ skad cha gson nyams ldan pa dang brtse dung gi nyams kyis phyug pa de yang skad cha'i mtshon nus gal chen zhig red/skabs thog gi rtsa 'dzugs nus pa/ de ni le tshan brgyud gtong byed skabs/ le tshan gyi dgos mkho ltar bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi ring thung dang mgyogs tshad tshod 'dzin byed pa'i nus par bstan pa yin/ nus pa 'di rigs gtso bo yul dngos bcar 'dri'i khrod mtshon pa red/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol ni ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan khrod rgyun du mthong ba'i rnam pa zhig red/bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de sngon na bcar 'dri bya yul dang mnyam du sbyong ba byed mi 'os/ de min skad cha'i gson nyams la gnod pa thebs nges/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis ji ltar bshad pa dang ci zhig bya rgyu mi shes pa'i gnas tshul 'og 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha'i ring thung dang gleng mol gyi mgyogs tshad la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i nus pa ni lhag par gal che/ phul du byung ba'i 'go 'dzin pas shes ma shes bar nas 'dri tshig 'dri ba dang skad cha bar du gsab pa sogs la brten nas bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha de le tshan gyi dgos mkho'i phyogs su sne khrid byed thub/ rtsa 'dzugs nus pa zhan pa'i 'go 'dzin pas 'dri tshig dris pa 'os 'tsham min pa sogs kyis bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad char le tshan la mkho ba'i nang don med par byas pa dang / yang na le tshan la tshod 'dzin legs po byed ma nus pas mjug legs po sdud ma thub par rjes nas sgrig sbyor mang po bya dgos pa de red/ yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed skabs/ bcar 'dri bya yul la la tshod 'dzin byed sla ba dang bcar 'dri bya yul la las skad cha bshad dus mtshams 'jog mi shes par skad cha chu bzhur ba bzhin byung nas 234

'bo 'dzin par skad cha gsab dbang med pa red/ de lta bu'i skabs su 'go 'dzin pa'i skabs thog gi rtsa 'dzugs nus pa ni lhag par du gal che/'go 'dzin par thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan dgos/ de ni le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas khyad chos mi 'dra ba'i le tshan gyi dgos mkho de rang ngo'i khyad chos dang zung du sbrel nas grub pa'i le tshan gzhan pa'i 'go 'dzin pa dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos la zer/ khyad chos de rigs ni rang ngo'i shes yon gyi chu tshad dang skad cha'i mtshon stangs/ skabs thog gi rtsa 'dzugs nus pa sogs phyogs so so nas mtshon pa red/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan de sgyu rtsal gyi rigs gang mang la 'brel ba yod pa dang le tshan gyi grangs ka shin tu mang pas/ brnyan 'phrin khang gcig tu'ang rtag par rigs 'dra ba'i le tshan gang mang yod/ le tshan 'di dag yod tshad la mtshams sbyor byed pa dang dpyad gtam brjod pa/ brtsams chos gtong ba sogs le tshan gyi rgyu cha 'dra mtshungs yod phyir/ rnam pa gcig mtshungs su 'gyur sla ba red/ gnad don 'di thag gcod na le tshan gyi rnam pa'i stangs nas khyad par 'byed dgos par ma zad/ le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i mi sgor gyi khyad chos kyis kyang kun dang mi mtshungs pa'i phan 'bras thon par byed thub/ phul du byung ba'i 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ le tshan gzhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa gzhan par kun gyis dga' bsu dang bsngags brjod thob dus khengs skyung ngang de'i legs 'grub kyi rgyu rkyen la zhib 'jug byas nas de'i dge ba'i cha la slob sbyong bya rgyu ni ha cang dgos nges shig yin pa smos ma dgos pa red/ yin na'ang der lad zlos kho na byas nas rang nyid sger gyi khyad chos 'don spel byed par gegs byed mi 'os/le tshan gang dang 'go 'dzin pa su yin yang de nyid sgrub mkhan mi 'dra tshe/235

de'i mtshon stangs dang rnam pa sogs la khyad par yod pa kho thag yin te/ bya dngos gcig la mi re re'i mthong snang mi 'dra ba dang bsam gzhig gtong stangs mi 'dra bas mtshon stangs kyang 'dra mi srid la/ 'go 'dzin par mtshon na'ang mi re re'i rang ngo'i cha rkyen sna tshogs yongs su gcig mtshungs yin mi srid par mi re re'i dge cha dang zhan cha mi 'dra bar rang rang shā kun dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos re ldan pa red/ le tshan gyis khyod nyid le tshan de'i 'go 'dzin par bdams pa yang khyod kyi mi sger gyi khyad chos kha shas le tshan gyi dgos mkho dang mthun pa'i rkyen red/ der brten gzhan gyi khyad chos de khyod la 'tsham pa dang khyod kyis 'go 'dzin byed pa'i le tshan la 'tsham pa'i nges pa med/ 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ thog mar rang gi khyad chos dang le tshan gyi khyad chos ngos zin par byas nas lag len dngos kyi khrod dge 'don skyon spangs byed mkhas par bya dgos pa las/ yongs su gzhan gyi rjes su 'brang mi 'os/ brnyan 'phrin ched sgrig rig rtsal le tshan de spyir btang gi ched sgrig le tshan dang mi 'dra bar des le tshan khrod kyi rig rtsal brtsams chos brjod gzhi byed pas/ mtshams sbyor dang dpyad gtam brjod pa sogs tshang ma rig rtsal brtsams chos de las 'byung dgos/ le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa rab yin na le tshan jus 'god dang sgrig sbyor gyi go rim la zhugs na/ rig rtsal brtsams chos de dag gi dmigs bsal shes bya khong du chud nas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed dus skad cha'i mtshon stangs dang khyad chos bkol tshul la shin tu phan/rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan ni/ 'khyab ston pa dang yul dngos kyi lta mkhan/ le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa bcas mnyam du zhugs pa'i brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi rnam pa zhig red/ le tshan 'di rigs kyi rnam pa hur bo che 236

zhing bag yangs pa dang rol rtsed rang bzhin dang bag 'tsher rang bzhin cung drag pas/ brnyan 'phrin lta mkhan mang pos dga' bsu byed/ rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan yang 'khrab ston gyi rigs dang rtsed mo'i rigs gnyis su dbye chog 'khrab ston rigs kyi le tshan la'ang lta mkhan zhugs pa dang 'khrab ston pa dang 'go 'dzin pa'ang bar mtshams su zhugs nas skabs thog gi 'khrab ston sna tshogs byed pa yin mod/ yin na'ang de'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni le tshan khrod kyi 'khrab ston pa'i dngos gzhi'i 'khyab ston la lta rgyu de red/ le tshan 'di rigs la rig rtsal dgong tshogs kyi bro ba'ang yod pas/ la las de la rig rtsal dgong tshogs rigs kyi le tshan yang zer/ rol rtsed rigs kyi le tshan ni 'gran bsdur dmigs yul byed pa'i rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan zhig yin/da snga yod pa'i rgya skad kyi le tshan 'di rigs la bltas nas dpyad na/ rol rtsed rigs kyi le tshan de yang lus po'i 'gul skyod rang bzhin dang blo rig 'gran bsdur rigs gnyis su dbye chog rol rtsed rigs kyi le tshan gyis brnyan 'phrin lta mkhan gyis mi sna grags can shes 'dod kyi mtshar snang skong ched/rtag par 'khrab ston pa dang glu ba/ spyi tshogs kyi ming grags mi sna bcas gdan drangs nas le tshan la zhugs pa dang / lta mkhan 'gugs ched/ le tshan brnyan len byed pa'i yul dngos nas da dung lta mkhan gyi 'brel gtug kha par sogs bsgrigs nas spyir btang gi lta mkhan rnams rnam pa mi gcig pa'i ngang nas le tshan la 'jug par skul ma gtong ba red/ 'khrab ston rigs kyi rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i nus pa ni skad cha dang yang na 'khrab ston gyi cha cung tsam 'dus pa'i lus po'i nyams 'gyur la brten nas 'khrab tshan mi 'dra ba dag bstar la brgyus pa de red/ 'go 'dzin pas sngon na gra 237

sgrig byas pa'i ma yig dang skabs thog gi skad cha zung du sgril ba'i rnam pa rigs shig la brten nas le tshan gyi yul dngos gnas tshul ltar skabs bstun dang gang la gang 'tsham sgos le tshan la 'go 'dzin bya dgos/ 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha 'os 'tsham dang rnam 'gyur zhi zhing 'jam pa/ che tshugs med pa bcas yin dgos la/ bag 'tsher gyi nyams 'os 'tsham la brten nas le tshan gyi rnam pa bag lhod cing spro snang ldan par bya dgos/ 'go 'dzin par rang nyid gzhan las 'phags pa yin snyam pa'i bsam blo'i 'du shes yod mi rung ba dang che nyams btod mi rung / de ni le tshan khrod kho nar bstan pa ma yin par nam rgyun gyi bya spyod la'ang bstan pa yin/ gal te khyod kyi bsam pa'i rgyud nas nga che nga 'phags kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes de rigs yod tshe/ skad cha dang rnam 'gyur sogs las shes ma shes bar nas phyir mngon srid cing / mi gzhan pa dang lta mkhan gyis kyang de ma thag tshor nas khyod la lta stangs legs po mi 'dzin pa red/ spyir bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa su dang su yin yang nga che nga 'phags kyi bsam pa zhig skye dgos pa'i rgyu ci yang med de/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par lta mkhan khrod dang spyi tshogs steng ming tsam yod pa dang kun gyis shes pa ni/ rig gnas mkhas pa dang rtsom pa po grags can sogs grags can mi sna gzhan dang mi mtshungs par rang gi nus pa kho nar brten nas byung ba zhig min/ rgyu mtshan mang che ba'i thad nas bshad na de ni brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i stegs bu las byung ba yin/ gal te stegs bu 'di med pa dang yang na khyod rang stegs bu 'di las bral tshe/ khyod kyang ches spyir btang gi mi zhis las ma 'das pas bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa su dang su yin yang gzhan las 'phags pa'i rgyu ci yang med la/ nga che nga 'phags 238

kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes skye ba'i rgyu de las kyang med/ 'khrab ston rang bzhin gyi rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas skad cha las gzhan/ da dung stegs bu las lag brda dang nyams 'gyur mang po bkol dgos/ lag brda dang nyams 'gyur 'di rigs de 'dra'i rnyog 'dzing che mi rung ba dang nyams 'gyur la gus lugs dang ldan dgos/ 'khrab ston pa dang lta mkhan rnams skyel bsu byed dus 'os shing 'tsham pa'i lag brda yis skad cha las lhag pa'i don ston nus phyin/ 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod du lus po'i nyams 'gyur gyi skad brda'i nus pa bkol mkhas par bya dgos/ 'di'i thad la dmigs yul yod pa/'i ngang sbyong brdar byed 'os/ yin na'ang dngos su bkol dus lag brda dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur sogs tshad las brgal mi rung / gal te khyod kyi nyams 'gyur sogs tshad las brgal tshe lta mkhan gyis khyod kyi bsam pa rnam dag cig ma red snyam nges/rol rtsed rigs kyi rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa'ang rigs gnyis yod/ rigs gcig ni bshad rtsal gtso yin pa dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur cung nyung ba'i blo rig rtsed mo'i 'go 'dzin pa dang / gzhan zhig ni rkang lag tshang ma 'gul ba dang lus sems yongs su 'jug pa'i 'gul skyod rang bzhin gyi rtsed mo'i le tshan gyi 'gro 'dzin pa yin/ blo rig rtsed mo'i le tshan 'di rigs rang rgyal du slob 'bring gi slob mar kha phyogs pa'i le tshan nyung ngu las med/ blo rig rtsed mo'i le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod du 'gul skyod mang po byed mi dgos mod/ lag brda bkol tshad cung mang /'gul skyod rang bzhin gyi rtsed mo'i le tshan gyi nang don hur bo yin pa/ 'go 'dzin pa'ang de bzhin hur bo yin dgos/ 'go 'dzin pas bshad zhor dang 239

'gul zhor byas nas rgyun mi chad par le tshan la zhugs mkhan la bkod 'doms bya dgos pa dang rtsed mo'i rtsed stangs sogs 'khrid dgos shing / da dung dpyad gtam brjod pa dang skar ma rgyag pa sogs bya dgos/ phul du byung ba'i 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ rnyog 'dzing che ba'i yul dngos de tshags dam zhing bo rim ldan pa zhig tu tshod 'dzin byed thub/ 'gul skyod rang bzhin gyi rtsed mo'i le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa lhag bsam che zhing tshor ba rno ba dang blo rig grung la bde myur ldan pa zhig yin dgos/ rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed par skabs dang bstun dbos pa'i cha shin tu che bas/ 'go 'dzin byed stangs la gtan khel nges can zhig byed dka'/ 'go 'dzin pas rang gi snang brnyan dang rang bi khyad chos/ de min rang gi phyogs bsdus nus pa bcas la brten nas gang la gang 'tsham sgos le tshan hril bor kha lo bsgyur dgos/ blo rig grung po'i bag 'tsher gyi skad cha re re dang nyams kyis phyug sa'i lus po'i nyams 'gyur tshang ma 'go 'dzin pa'i rang ngo'i shes yon dang phyogs bsdus nus par rag las pa red/ rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan gyis 'go 'dzin par rang gi khyad chos dang nus rtsal mngon pa'i go skabs sngar las mang po sbyin/ de yang skabs thog tu skad cha bshad pa'i rang dbang che drags pas/skabs 'gar shes ma shes bar nas skad cha tshad las brgal ba dang le tshan la tshod 'dzin byed tshad lhod drags pa sogs kyi snang tshul 'byung sla/ mig sngar bod skad brnyan 'phrin la'ang le tshan gyi rnam pa gang mang yod mod/ yin na'ang lta mkhan dang phyogs so so'i mi sna zhugs pa'i rol rtsed kyi le tshan 'di rigs da dung med pa'am yang na dus gtan khel gyi le tshan zhig tu bsgrub thub kyin med/ phyis su phyi yul gyi cha rkyen 'dzoms dus lta mkhan dang las rigs so 240

mo'imi sna zhugs pa'i shes bya dang rol rtsed skor gyi le tshan 'di rigs bsgrub tshe/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi nang don phun tshogs su gtong thub par ma zad/ da dung rgya che'i lta mkhan dang bar thag je nye ru btang nas bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi mang tshogs rang bzhin je drag tu song ste/ lta mkhan sngar las mang po 'gugs thub/ rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan gyi 'bo 'dzin par phyogs mang po'i nus pa dbos pa ste/ 'tsho ba dang rig gnas shes bya phun sum tshogs pa dang tshor snang myur mo ldan dgos shing / skad cha'i bshad rtsal la mkhas shing blo rig grung po'i bag 'tsher nus pa yod dgos pa ma zad/ da dung 'khrab ston gyi nus pa'ang nges can zhig ldan dgos/ rigs sngon ma 'ga' yi le tshan 'go 'dzin pa dang mi mtshungs par rig rtsal phyogs bsdus le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas skad cha dang nyams 'gyur/ lag brda sogs nang don mtshon stangs su bkol dgos par ma zad/ da dung cung rnyog 'dzing gi lus po'i stangs stabs sna tshogs bkol dgos/ 'go 'dzin pa 'di rigs la bshad mkhan dang 'khrab ston pa gnyis zung du sbrel ba'i khyad chos ldan zhes bshad chog gong du bshad pa ni brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi sgrig sbyor byed stangs dang le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pa le tshan nang du zhugs pa'i rnam pa'i thad nas brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyi dbye ba bkar ba zhig yin/ gong gi de dag las gzhan/ da dung brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan kha shas rigs ga ge mo'i khongs su gtogs zhes kha tshon gcod dka'/ da lta nga tsho brnyan 'phrin las don bya 'phur ba ltar gong du 'phel ba'i dus su gnas pas/ brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal gsar ba rgyun mi chad par byung ba dang bstun nas/ brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan gyis kyang lta mkhan sngar las mang po 'gugs ched/ rnam pa dang mtshon 241

stangs rgyun mi chad par gsar du brje ba dang le tshan rigs gsar ba'ang rgyun mi chad par 'byung nges red/4 brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol ni rgyun du mthong ba'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rnam pa zhig red/ de ni brnyan 'phrin gsar 'god pa dang bshad mkhan/ yang na 'go 'dzin pas thad kur bcar 'dri bya yul la bcar 'dri byed pa zhig yin/ le tshan la la yongs su gleng mol las grub pas de la gleng mol le tshan zhes brjod/ le tshan la la'i khrod brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol bsabs nas brnyan ris kyi nang don la rgyas bshad byas te brnyan ris kyi mi 'dang sar kha gsab rgyag pa red/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan las don rkyen dngos su brgyud mkhan brgyud nas don rkyen gyi go rim ji ma ji bzhin du brjod chog pa dang rang gi ngos 'dzin dang lta tshul brjod chog pas/ gang sar brgyugs nas gnas tshul dngos brnyan len byed pa'i tshegs myang mi dgos par/ skad char brten nas myur du cha 'phrin thob par byas chog don rkyen skor gyi skad cha don rkyen dngos su brgyud mkhan gyi kha nas bshad pa yin phyin/ de la yid rton nus pa chen po ldan/ de ni yul dngos kyi brnyan ris brnyan len byed long ma byung ba dang don rkyen byung rjes/ brnyan 'phrin brnyan ris phab thabs med pa/ de min bsam blo'i ngos 'dzin dang lta tshul sogs dang 'brel bas brnyan ris las mtshon mi thub pa'i skabs su cung dngos bden ngang sanas tshul bsgrag pa'i byed stangs shig red/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de ni ha lam brnyan 'phrin le tshan rigs so so'i khrod bkol chog brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de tshags par gyi gsar 242
