'god pa dang rlung 'phrin gyi gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur spel ched bcar 'dri byed pa dang khyad par chen po yod/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi khyad chos skor/ bcar 'dri'i bo rim hril bo gsal por mthong thub pa ni brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi khyad chos gtso bo red/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod du bcar 'dri byed mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skyes gzugs dang bcar 'dri'i sa gnas/ gleng mol go rim tshang ma brnyan 'phrin las shar nas lta mkhan gyis rna bas gsal por thos pa dang mig gis gsal por mthong thub pa zhig red/ tshags par gyi gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri byed pa'i go rim ni yi be'i khrod du mthong mi thub cing / rlung 'phrin las skad thos thub kyang bshad mkhan gyi nyams 'gyur mthong mi thub/ mtshon stangs sna mang ldan pa ni brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi khyad chos gzhan zhig yin pa dang / nyams 'gyur la brten nas rang gi 'dod blo mtshon chog tshags par dang rlung 'phrin las nyams 'gyur de dag mtshon dka'/ dper na/ rlung 'phrin le tshan khrod du don zhig la 'thad pa'i brda la mgo bo gug gug byas tshe nyan mkhan gyis tshor mi srid/ brnyan 'phrin gleng mol khrod du bcar 'dri byed mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul phyogs gnyis gas rang gi lag brda dang nyams 'gyur/ lus po'i 'gul stangs sogs la brten nas rang gi tshor ba dang lta tshul mtshon par byas nas skad cha'i mi 'dang sar kha gsab byas te/ skad cha'i mtshon nus la shugs snon byas chog pa red/bcar 'dri yo byad mang ba dang go rim la rnyog 'dzing che ba'ang brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan gyi khyad chos shig yin/ brnyan 'phrin 243

bcar 'dri'i gleng mol la bcar 'dri byed mkhan las gzhan/ da dung brnyan len pa sogs kyis ram 'degs bya dbos shing / skabs la lar brnyan ris phun tshogs su gtong ched/ brnyan len 'phrul chas gnyis yan bkol dgos/de min da dung glog 'od dang gnas yul bkod sgrig sogs bya ba sna tshogs bsgrub dgos phyin/ sgrig chas dang mi sna mang pos ram 'degs bya dgos/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod gyi bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi skyes gzugs sogs shin tu mdzes pa zhig yin mi dgos mod/ yin na'ang / lta mkhan gyi mig la bde zhing blor 'bab pa zhig cis kyang yin dgos par ma zad/skad cha dag cing gsal ba dang nyams 'gyur lhod bag ldan pa zhig yin dgos pas/ gsar 'god pa yod do cog gis brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi 'gan len thub pa zhig min zhing / skad cha dang skyes gzugs tshad dang ldan pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa yin yang shes bya'i chu tshad nges can zhig med tshe brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi 'go 'dzin pa tshad ldan zhig byed dka' ba red/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rigs/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de brnyan 'phrin le tshan gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa ni/ de'i bcar 'dri'i go rim lta mkhan gyi mig mdun du mngon pa de yin/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de brnyan ris la skad sbyor ba dang mi 'dra la/ lta mkhan la gdong phyogs nas thad gar bshad pa dang yang mi 'dra bar/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi gleng mol bya yul gtso ba ni bcar 'dri bya yul red/ da lta rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan las brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rigs shin tu mang / brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol byed stangs la slob 244

sbyong byed pa'i thad nas bshad na/ nga tshos phyogs gsum nas brnyan 'phrin gleng mol gyi rigs bkar chog rigs mi 'dra ba'i gleng mol byed stangs la blang bya'ang mi 'dra ba yod pa red/ gleng mol gyi sa gnas dang gleng mol gyi nang don bkol yul mi 'dra ba ltar/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de yul dngos nas bcar 'dri dang khang ba'i nang nas gleng mol byed pa'i rigs chen po gnyis su dbye chog yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed pa ni gsar 'god pa dang bshad mkhan/ yang na le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas don rkyen gyi yul dngos nas don rkyen dang 'brel ba yod pa'i mi la bcar 'dri byed pa de yin/ bcar 'dri 'di rigs spyir btang du dus yun cung thung la/ gtso bo le tshan gyi rgyu cha byas nas le tshan gyi khag cig tu gyur pa red/ yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed pa de rtag par rtsom sgrig byas nas le tshan gyi sgrig khrid pa'i bsam gzhig dang lhag par mthun par byed srid/ gleng mol 'di rigs la dus tshod kyi tshod 'dzin nan mo yod pas/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi 'dri gzhi shin tu gal che/ gnad la mi khel ba'i 'dri gzhi la lan yang gsal zhing gnad la 'khel ba zhig mi thob pas/ rjes kyi rtsom sgrig la dka' khag bzo ba red/khang ba'i nang gi gleng mol ni rgyun du mthong ba'i brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rnam pa gzhan zhig red/ gleng sol 'di rigs ni mgo mjug tshang ma sems zhib mos gra sgrig byas pa zhig yin/ bcar 'dri'i go rim de skabs 'gar le tshan hril bo zhig yin pa dang / skabs 'gar le tshan khrod du le tshan gyi tshan pa chung ngu zhig tu brtsis nas bkol ba las/ yul dngos bcar 'dri phal mo che dang 'dra bar le tshan gyi rgyu cha byed pa min/ spyir btang du khang ba'i nang du gleng mol byed pa de dus yun la gtan khel gsal po yod/ dus yun 245

cung thung na bcar 'dri byed mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul tshang mas gleng mol gyi nang don tshod 'dzin byed sla ba dang / lta mkhan yang le tshan gyi rnam pa sna rkyang yin par sun snang skye mi srid/ dus yun ring yang gleng mol bya yul mang na mi rer cha snyoms dus yun mang po med pas kyang lta mkhan la sun snang sbyin mi srid/ da lta rgya skad kyi le tshan khrod khyab che ba'i bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan de rigs la rtag par dus kyi tshod 'dzin yod pas/ dus gtan khel las snga mi rung la 'phyi'ang mi rung / gleng mol le tshan phal che ba thad gtong le tshan min yang de'i sgrig sbyor go rim ni thad kur sgrig sbyor byed pa dang mtshungs/dus gtan khel nang du bag phab ngang gleng mol gyi myur tshad tshod 'dzin bya rgyu ni gleng mol la 'go 'dzin byed mkhan gyi rtsal la nyams sad theg pa zhig kyang yin/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan la sngon la 'char gzhi yod dgos la/ bcar 'dri gleng mol khrod du gleng mol gyi mgyogs tshad ltar gnas tshul dang bstun nas gang la gang 'tsham sgos 'char gzhi bkol mkhas par bya dgos/ thog ma nyid nas gleng gzhi'i gnad sa gleng nas skad cha'i mtho rlabs snga mo nas rdzogs na rjes kyi dus yun nang skad char don snying chen po med pa'am yang na gleng gzhir 'brel ba chen po med par 'gyur nges/ gal te thog mar skad cha yar mar mang drags na bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha gleng gzhi'i gnad la khel ba'i sgang la le tshan gyi mjug la bslebs pas/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis yongs su bshad ma tshar bar mtshams mi 'jog ga med yin phyin/ mgo mjug tshang ba zhig yong dka'/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol la la ni brnyan 'phrin khang gi gtan khel khang ba'i nang brnyan len byas pa ma yin par/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi khyim dang gzhung las khang / yang na lhas ra/ tha na don rkyen byung yul la 246

sogs nas brnyan len byas pa red/ yin yang de dag kyang le tshan hril bo zhig yin pa las le tshan gyi rgyu cha zhig tu brtsi ba min/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rigs dbye tshul la la ni dmigs yul ltar dbye ba de yin/ mi sna'i skor gyi gleng mol gyis lta mkhan la spyi tshogs steng gi ming grags mi sna dang yang na las rigs so so'i mi sna gal chen shes su bcug nas/ de tsho'i gzugs brnyan la lta ba dang de tsho'i skad char nyan nas kho tsho'i 'tsho ba dang bya bar rgyus lon byed pa de red/ gleng mol 'di rigs ni gtso bo lta mkhan gyi rgyus lon byed 'dod kyi 'dun pa skong ba'i ched du yin la/ gleng mol ni bag lhod cing dga' snang gi tshul du byas chog gleng mol 'di rigs la rol rtsed kyi shas kyang ldan pa red/ lta tshul brjod pa'i gleng mol ni lta mkhan la mi rnams kyi gnad don ga ge mor lta stangs ji 'dra 'dzin pa shes su 'jug pa de yin/ gleng mol 'di rigs khrod du mi rnams kyis rgyus lon bya yul ni bcar 'dri bya yul gyi mi min par des gnad don la bcangs pa'i lta tshul de red/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi 'dri gzhi 'don pa'i dmigs yul ni bcar 'dri bya yul la gang nus kyis rang gi lta tshul rgyas bshad byed du bcug nas lta mkhan la lta tshul de dag shes su 'jug rgyu de red/ lta stangs brjod pa'i bcar 'dri'i khrod/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis 'dri gzhi 'don dgos par ma zad/ da dung bcar 'dri bya yul dang gting zab ngang dbye zhib dang bgro gleng bya dgos/ mi sna'i skor gyi gleng mol dang lta stangs brjod pa'i gleng mol tshang ma mang che ba brnyan 'phrin khang gi gtan khel gyi khang ba'i nang brnyan len byed pa red/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol de da dung bcar 'dri bya yul gyi mang nyung ltar mi gcig gi gleng mol dang mi mang po'i gleng mol rigs gnyis su dbye chog mi gcig gi 247

gleng mol ni rgyun du mthong ba'i gleng mol rnam pa zhig yin/ bcar 'dri bya yul nyung ba'i rkyen gyis gleng sol gyi nang don gcig bsdus byas nas lta mkhan gyis bcar 'dri bya yul la cha rgyus gting zab mo len thub pa byas chog gal te lta stangs brjod pa'i gleng mol yin tshe/ bcar 'dri bya yul la rang gi lta tshul gang legs sgos brjod du bcug chog mi mang po'i gleng mol ni gleng mol gyi rigs gzhan zhig yin te/ bcar 'dri bya yul zhung mtha' yang mi gnyis kyi yan yod cing / bcar 'dri byed mkhan de yang don dngos thog gleng mol gyi 'go 'dzin pa red/ mi mang po'i gleng mol khrod du skabs 'gar mi sna'i skor yang yod de/zlos gar grags can gyi 'khrab khrid mi sna gtso bo dag dang grags can mi sna'i khyim tshang mtshams sbyor byed pa sogs yin/ yin na'ang mang che ba ni lta tshul mi 'dra bar rgyus lon byas te/ lta mkhan la lta tshul mi 'dra ba'i khrod du rang gi sdom tshig 'don du 'jug pa de yin/ lta ba mi gcig pa'i rkyen gyis mi mang po'i gleng mol la 'go 'dzin byed par 'go 'dzin nus pa drag po ldan na da gzod phyogs so sor tshod 'dzin legs po byas nas gleng mol la zhugs pa'i mi re res rang gi lta ba brjod thub par byed thub/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis lta ba mi gcig pa lta mkhan la shes su bcug rjes/ lta mkhan rang la dbye zhib byed du 'jug dgos/ lta ba mi gcig pa'i phyogs gcig la 'gebs srung dang yang na bkag gnon byed mi rung / brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi bcar 'dri bya yul ha cang khyab che ba dang nang don la khyad par che zhing /bcar 'dri gleng mol byed stangs kyang rnam pa sna tshogs red/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol byed stangs khong du chud sla bar byed ched/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi dmigs yul de don dngos shes par bya ba dang / lta ba la rgyus lon byed pa/248

lta mkhan la rol rtsed cig sbyin pa bcas rigs gsum du dbye chog don dngos shes par byed pa'i bcar 'dri'i gleng mol mang che ba gsar 'gyur rigs kyi bcar 'dri'i gleng mol thad bkol ba yin/ don rkyen dngos su brgyud mkhan dang yang na don rkyen gyi gnas tshul shes mkhan gyi ngag las don rkyen gyi 'byung rkyen sogs la rgyus lon byas nas lta mkhan la don dngos ngo ma shes su 'jug pa de red/ lta ba la rgyus lon byed pa ni bcar 'dri bya yul brgyud nas lta mkhan la mi so sos spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i phyogs so sor bcangs pa'i lta tshul shes su 'jug pa de yin/ lta mkhan la rol rtsed sbyin pa ni bcar 'dri bya yul gyi bag 'tsher zhing spro snang gis khengs pa'i skad cha dang nyams kyis phyug pa'i bzo lta sogs la brten nas lta mkhan spro snang 'phel bar byed pa de red/ gang ltar 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi gshis nus sogs la rgyus lon dpyis phyin pa byas nas bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rigs sna tshogs la ngos 'dzin gang legs bya dgos/ lag len dngos kyi khrod du le tshan gcig la mtha' gcig tu gshis nus gcig rkyang re ma gtogs med pa yin mi srid pas/rang gi lag len dngos la brten nas nyams su myang dgos/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gra sgrig byed stangs/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi go rim lta mkhan gyi mdun du lhang nger mngon nas/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi skad cha dang nyams 'gyur re re tshang ma brnyan len byed pa dang bcar 'dri byed mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul gnyis ga'i gleng mol nang don la gtan khel zhib phra med pas/ kha brda byed dus tshod 'dzin byed dka'/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod bcar 'dri bya yul la skad cha'i sne khrid bya dgos par ma zad/ da dung bcar 249

'dri'i gleng mol mgo ma brtsams sngon gyi gra sgrig gang legs bya dgos/ gcig nas gleng gzhi dang bcar 'dri bya yul gdam rgyur gtsigs 'dzin bya dgos/mi yod do cog gis do snang byed pa'i gleng gzhi yis lta mkhan mang po 'gugs thub/ 'os shing 'tsham pa'i bcar 'dri bya yul gyis khyod kyi gleng mol bde blag yong bar byed thub/ gal te khyod kyis gleng gzhi gang rung gdam chog pa yin tshe/sngon na bcar 'dri bya yul gtan khel byed pa dang rjes su bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gnas tshul ltar bcar 'dri'i gleng gzhi gtan khel byas chog la/ sngon la bcar 'dri'i gleng gzhi gtan khel byas rjes/ de dang mthun pa'i bcar 'dri bya yul gtan khel byas kyang chog pa red/ gleng gzhi gdam dus de la gleng mol byed rin yod med dang yang na gleng gzhi de ni mang tshogs kyis do khur byed pa'i gnad don yin min la bsam blo gtong dgos/ gal te khyod kyi le tshan gyi ring thung chu tshod skar ma nyi shu yin pa dang khyod gyi gleng gzhi de chu tshod skar ma bcu tsam las bshad rgyu med na/ lhag ma skar ma bcu'i ring la gleng gzhi dang 'brel ba de 'dra med pa'i nang don yin phyin/ lta mkhan la spro snang yod mi srid pa dang / gal te khyod kyi gleng gzhi de mi mang po'i do khur byed pa'i gnad don min tshe/ lta mkhan mang po yod mi srid/ de bas gleng gzhi gdam dus gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' la do snang byed 'os/ gcig nas mang tshogs kyis do khur byed pa ma zad/ de'i skor gyi gnas tshul sngar las mang po shes 'dod pa'i gleng gzhi gdam dgos pa dang / gnyis nas nang don gsar ba ldan pa'i gleng gzhi rnying ba gdam chog mod/ yin yang kun la cha rgyus yod pa dang mig sngar da dung nang don gsar ba med pa'i gleng gzhi mi gdam pa/ gsum nas mig sngar da dung 'grel bshad gsal po rgyag thabs med pa'i dka' gnad gdam 250

mi 'os pa ste/ mjug 'bras spu tsam yang med pa'i gleng mol gyis lta mkhan la dogs snang je cher gtong ba las mi 'ong / bzhi nas gleng gzhi la nang don bye brag ldan dgos/ gleng gzhi spyi bshad tsam yin tshe/ nang don gcig tu bsdu mi thub pa dang gleng mol gyi nang don gnad la 'khel mi thub/ lnga nas le tshan gyi ring thung la bltas nas gleng gzhi gtan khel bya dgos/ gleng gzhi la la'i nang don khyab che bas/ skad cha tshig 'ga' res gsal por bshad thub pa zhig min pas gleng gzhi'i nang don gsal zhing bye brag yin dgos/ bcar 'dri bya yul 'os 'tsham gdam rgyu de yang bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan gyi gra sgrig bya ba zhig red/ bcar 'dri bya yul la gleng gzhi dang 'brel ba'i bcar 'dri'i rin thang ldan dgos pa ma zad/ da dung gleng mol la byang ba zhig kyang yin dgos/mi la la nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod smra brjod la mkhas pa zhig min yang / rang gi ched las dang rang nyid spro ba skyes pa'i gnad don gleng dus skad cha mang zhing bshad par mkhas pa dang / mi la la 'bri rtsal la byang yang smra brjod la mi mkhas pa red/ gal te bcar 'dri bya yul la de 'dra'i cha rgyus med na/ bcar 'dri ma byas sngon du rab yin na bcar 'dri bya yul dang phrad nas rgyus lon byas na legs/ thog dang por brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri dang len byed mkhan mang che ba thog ma'i dus su glog 'od drag po 'phro ba dang sngun nas brnyan len 'phrul chas dang skad dung sogs gtad par shin tu mi lob par/ bcar 'dri 'di rigs khrod du smra brjod la mkhas pa'i mi mang po'ang 'tshub cha langs nas ci bya btol med du 'gyur nges/ der brten/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis bcar 'dri bya yul la sne khrid legs po byas nas bcar 'dri bya yul bag lhod du gtong dgos/ rab yin na sngon la sbyong ba zhig byas nas brnyan len byas te/251

bcar 'dri bya yul la lta ru 'jug pa dang mnyam du mnyam 'jog dbos pa'i skor gsal 'debs byas te spobs pa bskyed pa dang sne khrid bya dgos/bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi gra sgrig bya ba gnyis pa ni 'dri gzhi'i nang don gra sgrig gang legs bya dgos pa de yin/ brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rnam pa gtso bo ni 'go 'dzin pas dri ba 'don pa dang bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lan 'debs pa de yin/ dri bas bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi nang don dang 'phel phyogs gtan khel byed pa yin phyin/ 'go 'dzin pas nges par du 'dri tshig gi nang don gra sgrig gang legs bya dgos/ le tshan gcig la 'dri tshig ci tsam gra sgrig bya dgos pa de ni le tshan gyi ring thung dnga'adri gzhi dka' min la rag las pa yin/ de yang mi sna'i bcar 'dri dang lta stangs brjod pa'i bcar 'dri'i 'dri gzhi gnyis la'ang khyad par yod pas/ 'dri gzhi gra sgrig byed dus bye brag gi nang don dang bstun dgos/ 'dri gzhi'i gra sgrig skor ni gong du brjod pa'i gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i gra sgrig dang phal cher mtshungs pa red/ de yang dngos su bcar 'dri byed dus 'dri gzhi'i gtso phal dang 'dri gzhi'i mgo rnga sogs ji ltar bkod sgrig bya rgyu ni bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi rnam pa dang khyad chos/ de min de'i dus kyi tshod 'dzin sogs la bstun dgos/bcar 'dri bya yul gyis le tshan brnyan len ma byas sngon la ches do khur byed pa ni 'go 'dzin pas 'dri tshig ci zhig 'dri rgyu de red/ spyir gleng gzhi'i brjod bya gtso bo'i skor sngon la bcar 'dri bya yul la shes su bcug nas bcar 'dri bya yul gyis kyang de'i skor la bsam blo btang nas sems la gdeng tshod yod par byas na legs/ yin na'ang bye brag gi 'dri tshig ji lta bu 'dri rgyu de sngon na ma dris na legs/ sngon chad nga tshos gsar 'gyur dang ched sgrig le tshan yul 252

dngos nas bcar 'dri byed skabs/ thog dang por rgyus lon rang bzhin gyis 'dri dus bcar 'dri bya yul des spro snang ngang sems kyi skad cha rnal ma dang rnam 'gyur rnam dag cig gis lan 'debs nges/ yin yang nga tshos brnyan len 'phrul chas sogs bcar 'dri yo byad gra sgrig byas te dngos su bcar 'dri byed dus yang bskyar 'dri tshig de dag dris tshe/ rtag par bcar 'dri bya yul la dang thog gi spro snang de med pas/ skad cha de 'dra'i cha mi tshang ba dang rnam 'gyur yang de 'dra'i rnam dag cig min par thengs dang por dris pa lta bu'i phan 'bras legs po zhig thob mi thub/ de bas nga tshos kyang rtag par sngon la bcar 'dri bya yul la brjod bya'i kha phyogs tsam bstan nas dngos su bcar 'dri byed dus da gzod bye brag gi 'dri tshig thad gar dris pa yin/ de ltar byas tshe lhag par dngos snang ldan la phan 'bras legs/ skad cha'i gleng gzhi gcig yang bskyar bshad du bcug na bcar 'dri bya yul la'ang sun snang zhig dang bcos ma zhig gi snang ba sbyin la/ kho tshor sbyin pa'i bcos ma'i tshor snang de yang kho tsho'i skad cha dang rnam 'gyur las ngang gis phyir mngon 'ong / der brten bcar 'dri'i gleng mol yang rang bzhin de dang mtshungs par bye brag gi 'dri tshig dang de'i go rim sogs tshang ma sngon la bcar 'dri bya yul la bshad pa dang yang na bcar 'dri byed mkhan dang mnyam du sngon sbyong 'dra byas nas gra sgrig gang legs byas tshe/ le tshan brnyan len byed dus bde blag yin zhing phan tshun gyi dri ba dris lan yang chu bzhur ba ltar lhugs por 'grub srid mod/ bde blag dang lhugs por grol ba'i skad cha dang nyams 'gyur khrod du dngos snang gi bro ba'i cha zhan par gyur pa dang bcos ma'i snang ba zhig 'gog med du mngon 'dug bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi gra sgrig gzhan zhig ni gleng gzhi'i 'brel yod 253

rgyab ljongs gnas tshul dang bcar 'dri bya yul gyi rgyab ljongs gnas tshul la rgyus lon legs po bya rgyu de red/ rgyab ljongs la rgyus lon byas pa mang nyung gis skabs 'gar le tshan gyi spus tshad la shugs rkyen thebs kyin yod/ rgyab ljongs gnas tshul la rgyus lon byas pa mang na 'dri gzhi 'don par phan pa yod/bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod dus yun mang che ba'i skabs su gleng gzhi 'tshol ba yin pa las gleng gzhi re gnyis la gros bsdur byed pa min/ nang sgos su mi sna'i bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan de ltar red/ le tshan khrod du bcar 'dri byed mkhan la rang 'gul gyi go gnas ldan yang gleng mol khrod du gzhan dbang gi rnam par lhung ba'i gnas tshul mi 'byung ba byed pa'i thabs mchog ni gleng gzhi dang bcar 'dri bya yul gyi rgyab ljongs gnas tshul la rgyus lon bya rgyu de red/ gleng gzhi'i 'brel yod gnas tshul dang bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gnas tshul la rgyus lon legs po byas tshe/ nang don gting zab la gleng gzhi dang mi sna'i khyad chos 'dzin thub pa'i dri ba bton nas rang 'gul dbang cha dam por bzung chog par ma zad/ da dung gleng mol gyi mgyogs tshad tshod 'dzin byed chog pa dang gleng mol khrod byung ba'i nor 'chug yo srang byed chog gleng mol khrod du skabs la lar bcar 'dri bya yul la spro snang che drags pas rtag par 'dri gzhi gcig gi skor la skad cha mang drags nas mtshams 'jog mi shes tshe/bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis mgyogs myur sgos mtshams gcod dgos/ gal te khyod la gleng gzhi de'i nang don la cha rgyus zab mo yod tshe/ tshig sne dang bstun nas gleng gzhi gzhan pa'i steng bskor chog khyod la bcar 'dri bya yul gyis bshad pa'i skor la cha rgyus ci yang med na/ tshig sne khrid mi thub par/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha btsan gyis mtshams mi gcod ka med red/ de ltar byas 254

na bcar 'dri bya yul 'os med kyi gnas su gyar nas skad cha bshad pa'ikhro snye snang med par 'gyur srid/ de min 'brel yod rgyab ljongs la rgyus lon byas na da dung bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha dang lta stangs don dang mi mthun pa dang drang bzhag min pa/ yang na phyogs ris kyi lta tshul sogs yo srang byas chog brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyis bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha sngon la zhib bsher byed thabs med/ bcar 'dri bya yul gtan khel byed dus de'i chab srid rnam 'gyur dang rig gnas chu tshad/ skad cha'i mtshon nus/ gshis ku'i khyad chos sogs la bsam blo btang yang / de tshos bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod skad cha ji lta bu bshad srid par yongs su tshod dpag byed thabs med pas/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis gleng mol khrod skad cha don dngos dang mi mthun pa dang tshig 'bru la la bkol ba 'os 'tsham min pa/lta stangs la phyogs ris ldan pa sogs gnas tshul gang rung 'byung srid/skabs la lar de las kyang tshabs che ba'i gnas tshul 'byung yang srid pa red/gnad don 'di dag 'byung dus 'go 'dzin pas nges par du yo sung dang 'grel bshad bya dgos/ de ltar ma byas tshe/ 'go 'dzin pas kyang gnad don de dag las bzos pa'i shugs rkyen ngan par 'gan 'khur dgos/ gal te 'brel yod rgyab ljongs gnas tshul la cha rgyus med tshe/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha'i khrod kyi gnad don de dag mi shes pa dang yo srang byed mi thub pas/lta mkhan khrod du 'go 'dzin pa de nyid la lta tshul mi legs par ma zad/stabs ma legs tshe/ le tshan la mjug 'bras tshabs chen bzo'ang srid/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi go rim tshod 'dzin skor/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol legs po zhig la phra zhing zhib pa'i gra sgrig 255

dgos par ma zad/ da dung bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi bo rim hril bor sems zhib mos tshod 'dzin bya dgos/ de ltar byas na/ da gzod le tshan gyi kha phyogs la tshod 'dzin byas te/ sngon dpag gi phan 'bras len thub/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi le tshan bzang shos shig gis gcig nas bcar 'dri'i gleng mol kha phyogs dang mthun pa dang sngon dpag gi 'bras bu 'thob par byed cing /bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi gleng gzhi der lta mkhan spro snang ldan par khag theg bya dgos pa dang / gnyis nas le tshan ring thung dang le tshan gyi mgo rnga'i bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham yin min/ gleng mol gyi go rim bde blag yin min/ nang don gting zab cing gnad la 'khel min bcas kyi blang bya dang mthun dgos/nus pa de lta bu ldan dgos na/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan la bcar 'dri'i gleng mol la tshod 'dzin byed pa'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa dang nus pa chen po ldan dgos/ nyams myong dang nus pa de rigs ni nam rgyun gyi lag len las gzhan/ da dung dus rgyun slob pa'i brtson pa bskyed de shes bya mang po sdud len byed par do snang bya dgos/bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod du gleng mol skabs kyi khor lug dang 'dug stangs sogs la'ang shin tu do snang bya dgos/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi khor yug gis bcar 'dri bya yul gyi sems khams dang gleng mol byed pa'i spro snang la shugs rkyen chen po thebs nges/ bcar 'dri bya yul ni 'khrab ston pa ma yin par kho tsho tshang ma las rigs so so nas 'ongs pa'i mi spyir btang ba red/ kho tsho glog 'od drag po dang cha rgyus med pa'i khor yug tu 'tshub snang dang dogs snang skyes pa dang de min bcar 'dri yo byad dang tha na bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi 'dug stangs dang 'dri tshig 'dri stangs/ skad cha bshad stangs sogs la mi 256

goms pa dang dogs snang bzos nas gleng mol byed 'dod kyi sems khams la gnod pa skyel srid/ der brten/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan khrod gleng sol gyi khor yug bkod sgrig dang brnyan len 'phrul chas dang skad dung gi 'jog stangs/ bshad mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul gnyis ku'i 'dug stangs/ de min bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi 'dri tshig dang skad cha'i bshad stangs sogs tshang mar bsam blo zhib mo gtong dgos/ de yang bcar 'dri byed mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul gnyis kyi 'dug stangs sogs kyi thad nas bcar 'dri bya yul gyi sems khams la bsam blo gtong dgos par ma zad/ brnyan len 'phrul chas kyi brnyan len byed stangs dang lta mkhan gyi tshor snang sogs la'ang bsam blo gtong dgos/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan de yang mthar gtugs nas bshad na bcar 'dri'i rigs shig yin pa dang de yang dri ba dris lan gyi rnam pa zhig las ma 'das pas/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi 'dri gzhi dang 'dri tshig 'dri stangs/ tha na gdong gi rnam 'gyur dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur/ lag pa'i 'gul stangs/ skad cha'i yong stangs/ skad kyi 'gyur ldog sogs tshang mas bcar 'dri bya yul la sne khrid kyi nus pa ldan zhing shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa yin/ ji ltar 'dri gzhi gra sgrig byed pa dang 'dri tshig gnad la khel bar byed pa/ ji ltar bcar 'dri bya yul la sne khrid byed pa/ ji ltar bcar 'dri bya yul gyi lan cha tshang ba dang brjod bya gnad la khel bar byed pa/ ji ltar bshad 'dod med pa dang gleng mol la byang med pa'i bcar 'dri bya yul la skad cha shod du 'jug pa sogs ni bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi bcar 'dri'i thabs rtsal la rag las shing / 'di'i skor gong nas bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur 'god mkhan gyi bcar 'dri'i thabs rtsal dang phal cher 'dra ba yin/ bcar 'dri'i 257

gleng mol le tshan khrod du spyi khog nas bcar 'dri'i go rim hril bor tshod 'dzin legs po byed dgos par ma zad/ da dung zhib phra'i skor la'ang shin tu mnyam 'jog dgos/ zhib phra'i skor zhes pa ni dper na 'os 'tsham min pa'i skad cha dang 'os 'tsham ma yin pa'i nyams 'gyur lta bu red/ skabs 'gar le tshan khrod du zhib phra'i skor la 'os 'tsham min pa'i gnad don byung ba ni ngos zin mi 'dang ba las byung ba'i gnad don yin/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan khrod du gtso phal gyi 'brel ba mi gsal ba ni rgyun du 'byung ba'i gnad don red/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod du bcar 'dri byed mkhan ni sne khrid pa yin zhes pa de bcar 'dri byed mkhan ni gleng mol byed mkhan gtso bo yin zhes pa'i don ma red/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol le tshan ni mgron po'i skad cha dang mgron po'i lta tshul la nyan dgos pa yin pas/ dus tshod mgron por byin nas/mgron por rang gi bsam 'char gang legs sgos bshad du 'jug dgos/bcar 'dri byed mkhan la las mgron po dang 'dra mnyam byas nas bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod skad cha phrogs pa dang rang gi lta tshul bar med du brjod cing / tha na le tshan khrod kyi rang 'gul dbang cha bed spyad de rang gi lta ba btsan gyis bcar 'dri bya yul la mi 'dod bzhin du dang len byed du bcugabaltas tshod kyis gleng sol nang hur brtson gyis zhugs pa 'dra ba'i bya spyod des lta mkhan la zhen pa log par byed srid/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis nges par du shes dgos pa ni/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod du bcar 'dri bya yul gyis lta ba ji 'dra bzung yang rung de la skad cha mjug rdzogs su 'jug dgos/ bsam yul las 'das pa'i tshod 'dzin byed dka' ba'i rnam pa ma byung tshe/ rang gi lta ba brjod de bcar 'dri bya yul gyi rgyun ldan gyi skad cha mtshams gcod mi 'os/258

sal te/ khyod rang bcar 'dri bya yul las gal che na/ bcar 'dri bya yul brnyan 'phrin khang la gdan 'dren dgos don mi 'dug bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi las 'gan ni bcar 'dri bya yul la sne khrid bya rgyu de yin pa las de'i tshab bya rgyu de ma red/ le tshan khrod du bcar 'dri bya yul la kha yag ngo dga' byas na'ang lta mkhan sun snang skyes nges/ skabs la lar 'os 'tsham min pa'i kha yag gcig gis kyang lta mkhan la bag chags ngan pa 'jog nges/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis mi grags can la brtsi bkur dang yang na gus sems bcangs pa'i rnam 'gyur la kun gyis bsam shes byed srid/ yin yang gus sems de rigs kyis khyod kyis de dang 'dra mnyam sgos gleng mol byed par gnod pa med/ bcar 'dri'i gleng mol khrod du bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis lta mkhan gyi tshab byed pa yin la/ lta mkhan gyi tshab la dri ba 'don pa yin pas/zhum zhum bya rgyu mang drags na rang nyid kyi thob thang la gnod par ma zad/ lta mkhan gyi la rgya la'ang gnod pa red/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyis nges par du rang nyid nyam chung yang lta mkhan stobs che ba dang khyod kyis rang nyid kho na'i tshab byed pa ma yin par/ stobs dang ldan pa'i lta mkhan gyi tshab bya dgos pa shes dgos/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan gyi goms gshis la las kyang lta mkhan la sun snang sbyin nges/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan la las rang la goms phyogs kyis skad cha'i rjes su/ de red la/ yin na zhes pa sogs tshig lhag drud 'ong / de yang mang drags na lta mkhan la sun snang sbyin srid/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan la las da dung rang gis rnam shes gtad de nyan pa mtshon ched/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyis skad cha bshad dus/ de red/ red mod/ ces pa lta bu'i tshig gis ram 'degs byed/ de ni goms gshis mi legs pa zhig red/ de red ces 259

pas khyod kyis bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha gsal por don bo ba mtshon par ma zad/ da dung skabs la lar der bden kha ster ba dang 'thad pa yin pa'i nang don yang ldan pas na/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi lta bar sger gyi chags sdang bi shas che la de 'dra yang dag min pa dag la'ang khyod kyis tshig gis goms phyogs kyis de red/ red lags zhes pa lta bus tshig gis ram 'dregs byas tshe/lta mkhan dang bcar 'dri bya yul tshang mas khyod kyang lta ba de dag la 'thad pa yin pa'i go log thebs sla/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan la las rang gis sems gtad nas nyan pa'i brda la mgo bo gug gug byed kyin yod/ de yang gong gi de red ces pa dang mtshungs par go brda log sla ba red/ bcar 'dri'i khrod du khyod kyis gdong gi rnam 'gyur dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur las nan tan gyis nyan pa'i tshul bstan tshe chog pa red/brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol la da dung lag rtsal thad do snang bya dgos/ phab skrun spus legs kyi bcar 'dri'i gleng mol zhig ni yul dngos thad gtong nang bzhin gtan khel gyi dus yun nang bcar 'dri'i go rim rdzogs pa dang brnyan ris yul dngos nas sgrig sbyor byas nas rjes su rtsom sgrig byed mi dgos pa zhig yin dgos pa red/ de lta bu'i bcar 'dri'i gleng mol ni gnas tshul ngo ma'i dngos snang mtshon zhing yid rton thub pa red/ rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin bcar 'dri'i gleng mol mang che ba'i phab skrun go rim 'di ltar red/ yin na'ang gnas tshul mang po'i skabs su/ nang don legs sgrig dang dus tshod sogs kyi dbang gis bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi go rim yang bskyar rtsom sgrig byed pa'i thabs de yang med du mi rung ba zhig red/ bod skad kyi bcar 'dri gleng sol le tshan la mtshon na/ lag rtsal sogs cha rkyen gyi dbang 260

gis da snga da dung phab skrun go rim tshad de 'drar sleb med par/ sngon na bcar 'dri byas nas rjes su sgrig sbyor byed pa'i thabs lag len byed pa yin/de yang nang don dang brnyan ris 'dor len dang sgrig sbyor byed thabs 'os 'tsham dang bcar 'dri'i gleng mol gyi go rim zhib phra'i thad la do snang byas tshe/le tshan gyi go rim dang rgyu spus la shugs rkyen chen po med do/ /bdun/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan gyi skor/brnyan 'phrin ni brnyan ris dang skad sgra gnyis kur brten nas cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byed pa zhig yin la/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi skad dang skad char brten nas bshad bya mtshon dgos par ma zad/ da dung brnyan 'phrin las rang gi gzugs brnyan mngon dgos/brnyan 'phrin lta mkhan rnams kyis brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ra 'dzin pa'i lta stangs ni skad cha dang gzugs brnyan gnyis ku'i thad nas byung ba yin/ phyogs de gnyis ka 'os shing mthun pa'i ngang gcig gyur yong ba byas tshe da gzod lta mkhan gyis dga' bsu byed pa'i brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa tshad ldan zhig tu 'gyur srid/ der brten/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa yod do cog gis rang gi snang brnyan la ha cang do snang bya dgos/261

1 bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos/brnyan 'phrin gyi kha phye tshe/ nga tshos snang brnyan mi 'dra ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mthong thub la/ snang brnyan mi 'dra ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa 'di dag gis so sor nang don dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba'i le tshan khrod nas brtan brling gzab nan dang yang na bag lhod cing nyams kyis phyug pa/ yang na zhi zhing dul ba sogs kyi nyams 'gyur mang po mngon zhing / gzugs byad so sor mi 'dra bar ma zad/ lus kyi nyams 'gyur dang skad cha'i khyad chos la'ang khyad par chen po yod pa mthong / le tshan gyi rigs je mang du song ba dang bstun nas/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan yang rnam pa sna tshogs yod srid/ de yang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan de kho tsho'i phyi'i gzugs brnyan la rag las par ma zad/ skad cha'i nang don dang skad cha bshad stangs sogs la'ang 'brel ba yod pa dang / rtag par kho tshos bshad pa'i le tshan dang 'brel ba yod/ bye brag gi le tshan dang kha bral tshe/ bshad mkhan dang 'gro 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan la rin thang ci yang med/ mi la las bltas na/ ngo gdong mdzes pa kho na da gzod brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i cha rkyen kho na red bsam gyin yod/ don dngos thog de ni yang dag pa'i lta tshul zhig ma red/ bsam tshul 'di lta bu ni brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan dang 'go khrid pa kha shas khrod du'ang yod mod/ de ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las la rgyus med pa'i skyon du snang / skyes gzugs dang ngo gdong mdzes pa ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i cha rkyen gras kyi 262

gcig yin mod/ yin na'ang le tshan la la'i khrod bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i shin tu mdzes pa'i skyes gzugs dang ngo gdong de nye 'khor gyi mi sna dang khor yug dang khyad par che drags pas/ le tshan gyi phan 'bras la shugs rkyen mi legs pa bzo srid/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan de 'dra dar mi che ba'i skabs su mi rnams kyis skyes sgo mdzes min la bltas nas brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa 'dems la/ deng skabs mi rnams kyis le tshan gyi dgos mkho gzhir bzung nas skyes gzugs mi 'dra ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa gdam gses byed kyin yod/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi khyad chos ltar byed nus 'don dgos pas/ de la skyes gzugs kyi cha rkyen las gzhan/ da dung nyams 'gyur dang skad cha/ rig gnas yon tan/skad ngag sogs phyogs mang po'i cha rkyen ldan dgos/ brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan de la skad cha'i ram 'degs ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin mod/ yin yang mi zhig gi phyi'i rnam pa dang nyams 'gyur/lus kyi 'gul skyod sogs kyis rtag par lta mkhan rnams la mi de ji lta bu zhig yin pa'i bag chags zab mo 'jog srid/ de yang bye brag gi le tshan gyi khyad chos mi 'dra ba ltar/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan gyi khyad chos kyang mi 'dra/ gsar 'gyur le tshan zhig la mtshon na/ de'i nang don ni rgyal khab phyi nang gi don chen gtso che ste/ chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don sogs gzab nan gyi nang don dang ldan pa dang / rtag par srid gzhung dang khe grags sde khag gi tshab la yig cha gal chen sna tshogs spel dgos shing /gsar 'gyur ma yig phal che ba sngon na bris nas bshad mkhan gyis ma yig ltar 'don dgos phyin/ rang mos ngang skad cha sogs bcos mi rung bas/ bshad 263

mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa brtan brling dang gzab nan yin dgos pa dang/phyi'i nyams 'gyur dang lus po'i 'gul stangs la 'gyur ldog chen po yod mi 'os pa dang gyon chas dang rgyan cha sogs kyi cha nas kyang 'os 'tsham dang bab chags yin dgos/ nyams myong dang ldan pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rtag par nang don gyi 'gyur ldog ltar 'os 'tsham ngang gdong gi nyams 'gyur bsgyur ba dang skad cha'i 'gyur khugs bed spyad de mgo'i 'gul stangs 'os 'tsham re yod par byas na/ nyams 'gyur dang ngo gdong rings por mi 'gyur bar phan pa red/ gsar 'gyur gyi bshad mkhan 'di rigs la mtshon na/ lhag par skad cha gtso che la/ gzugs brnyan ni nang don gyi yid rton rung ba'i cha dang gzab nan rang bzhin la shugs snon pa tsam yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa la la ni gsar 'god pa dang 'dra bar gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi 'byung rkyen sogs la 'tshol zhib byed par ma zad / der rang gi lta ba brjod pa'i gsar 'gyur dang ched sgrig le tshan khrod 'byung ba mang / skabs de'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni brtag dpyad pa zhig gi tshul nas le tshan khrod du 'byung ba red/ kho tsho gsar 'god pa'i tshul gyis don rkyen byung yul du song nas bcar 'dri byed chog pa dang yang na 'go 'dzin pa'i tshul du khang ba'i nang du bsdad de rang gi lta tshul brjod chog kho tsho'i byed las ni gsar 'god pa dang bshad mkhan gnyis ka zung du sbrel ba zhig yin/ de lta bu'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig la gsar 'gyur bcar 'dri'i nus pa yod dgos par ma zad/ skad cha'i mtshon nus dang snang brnyan gyi mtshon nus kyang ldan dgos/ kho tshos bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i le tshan mang che ba'i nang don cung gzab nan yin/ spyir btang du bshad mkhan dang 'go 264

'dzin pa 'di rigs kyi phyi'i skyes gzugs la de 'dra'i blang bya mthon po med/yin na'ang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa 'di rigs la shes bya'i rgya cung yangs dgos pa dang tshor snang myur mo dang skabs thog nas bshad pa'i nus pa dang ldan dgos/ kho tshos yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed pa dang brnyan 'phrin khang nas 'go 'dzin byed dus gdong gi nyams 'gyur dang lus po'i 'gul stangs 'os 'tsham re bkol nas gsar 'gyur nang don dang rang gi rnam 'gyur la shugs snon byed chog mod/ nyams 'gyur dang 'gul stangs 'di rigs tshad las brgal mi rung / nyams 'gyur dang 'gul stangs tshad las brgal tshe/ le tshan gyi bden dngos rang bzhin la gtor brlag thebs nges/ de ni phyi'i gzugs kyi 'gul stangs la bstan pa ma zad/ skad cha'i khyad chos la 'ang bstan pa ste/ rgyan tshig spras che ba'i tshig dang sgro btags che ba'i skad bkol stangs sogs tshang mas le tshan gyi yid rton rang bzhin la gtor brlag thebs nges/ mi rnams kyi rgyun ldan 'tsho bar 'brel ba yod pa'i le tshan zhig dang yang na bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa dngos su le tshan brnyan phab bya yul du song nas bcar 'dri byed dus/ phyi'i rnam pa de 'dra'i gzab nan yin mi rung / skad cha'i cha nas yongs su rgyun ldan 'tsho ba'i skad cha'i tshul dang mthun dgos pa dang lus po'i 'gul stangs kyis 'os 'tsham ngang ram 'degs byed chog cing / de la grogs po'i tshul du kha brda bya dgos pa las/ che nyams btod pa dang yang na brjid tshugs ston che na/ lta mkhan gyi snang ngor bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa de'i snang brnyan legs po zhig mi 'khyongs shing / le tshan la'ang gnod pa thebs nges red/ gal te rtsed 'jo'i nang don shas che ba'i le tshan zhig yin tshe/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par bag lhod dang 265

bab bstun gyi nus pa yod dgos par ma zad/ da dung 'khrab ston rang bzhin gyi nus pa'ang cung ldan dgos la/ gsar 'gyur bshad skabs kyi gzab nan dang yongs su mi mtshungs par nyams 'gyur dang lus po'i 'gul stangs de skad cha'i 'gros dang yongs su bstun chog de dang de la sogs pa ni le tshan gyi khyad chos ltar grub pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan gyi blang bya dang sgyu rtsal rang bzhin red/ le tshan dang khyad chos mi 'dra ba ltar bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan thad kyi blang bya yang kha kha so so red/gsar 'gyur gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par skyes gzugs thad kyi blang bya ches mtho ba dang nyams 'gyur dang phyi'i rnam pa'i thad la'ang tshod 'dzin cung che ba las/ le tshan gzhan pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par skyes gzugs la blang bya de 'dra nan mo med pa/ dang nyams 'gyur thad nas kyang blang bya de 'dra gu dog po med par/ rang gi thob thang dang le tshan gyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og lus po'i 'gul stangs dang gdong gi nyams 'gyur sogs kyang cung rang mos ngang 'gyur ldog byed chog pa red/2 bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi'i nyams 'gyur/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi'i nyams ni de'i snang brnyan gyi grub cha gal chen zhig red/ phyi'i nyams ni nga tshos mi zhig la lta dus kyi ches thog mar gyur ba'i tshor snang yin/ mi rnams kyis phyi'i snang brnyan las mngon pa'i nyams 'gyur las mi de'i rig gnas yon tshad dang dga' phyogs/ gshis ga sems rgyud sogs la tshod dpag byas nas mi de'i yang snying ji lta bu zhig yin par shes rtogs byas te rang gi lta stangs bzung chog phyi'i nyams ni lus gzugs dang lus gzugs brgyan byed kyi gyon chas dang rgyan cha 266

sogs las grub pa'i phyi'i snang brnyan la zer/ lus gzugs la lhan skyes kyi lus khams kyis tshod 'dzin thebs phyin/ nam rgyun de la 'gyur ldog byed dka' ba ste/ lus gzugs kyi ring thung dang sbom phra/ ngo gdong sogs ni rang bi 'dod blo ltar bsgyur chog pa zhig min/ 'on kyang dmigs bsal gyi byed thabs khyad par can te/ dper na/ bzhin ras mdzes bcos dang skag byug pa sogs byed thabs la brten nas ma gzhi nas grub pa'i lhan skyes kyi skyes khams cha rkyen steng yun brtan rang bzhin dang gnas skabs rang bzhin gyis legs bcos byas nas rang dang gzhan gyi 'dod blo dang mthun par byas chog gyon chas dang rgyan cha sogs ni rang gi 'dod mos dang rang gi dgos mkho ltar dus dang rnam pa kun tu bsgyur chog ste/ gyon chas dang rgyan cha bsgyur ba la brten nas rang gi phyi nyams bsgyur te gzhan la snang brnyan legs po ston chog pa dang de min rang gi skra slas stangs sogs kyis rang nyid mdzes par byed chog par ma zad/ da dung gyon chas dang rgyan cha sogs la brten nas rang gi skyes gzugs kyi zhan cha bkab chog pa red/ phyi'i nyams 'gyur ni mi rnams kyis mi zhig la lta zhib byas pa las thob pa'i thog ma'i mthong snang red/ de ni rtag par gting zab pa zhig min la/ mthong snang de las thob pa'i lta stangs de yang yongs su blo gtad chog pa dang yongs su yid ches rung ba zhig min/ rim gyis bya spyod dngos la brtags nas mi rnams kyis phyi'i nyams 'gyur las thob pa'i thog ma'i mthong snang la slar yang dpyad zhib byas nas yang bskyar brdar sha gcod nges/ yang bskyar dbye zhib byas pa'i 'bras bu de skabs 'gar phyi'i nyams 'gyur las thob pa'i thog ma'i mthong snang dang 'dra ba dang skabs 'gar thog ma'i mthong snang dang rgyab 'gal du 'gro ba'ang yod/ gnas tshul 'di lta bu ni 267

nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod rgyun du mthong thub/ dper na/ mi mang 'dus sa zhig nas mi la la'i skyes gzugs mdzes shing phyi'i nyams 'gyur legs pas/ khyod la snang ba legs po zhig sbyin mod/ yin na'ang zhib tu 'grogs tshe/ mi de'i bya ba spyod pa'i thad nas gus zhabs mi shes pa dang skad cha'i thad nas che chung mi —shes pa sogs mthong rjes/ thog ma'i mthong snang de yang de ma thag nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon ltar yal nges/ phyi'i nyams 'gyur de brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhagadang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na lhag par gal che ba red/ phyi'i snang brnyan brgyud nas nang gi ngo bo mthong thub/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod lta mkhan gyis thog mar mthong ba ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa yin pa dang rtag par bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas thog mar kho tshor snang brnyan legs po zhig bzhag tshe/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa der dga' zhen yid smon byed pa dang bcas le tshan de la'ang spro zhing lta 'dod pa yin/ gal te bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas thog mar kho tshor snang ba legs po zhig ma bzhag par zhen pa log par byas na/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa des bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i le tshan de la'ang lta 'dod mi skye/ phyi nyams legs po zhig gis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan la dge mtshan bsnan nas gson nyams ldan par byed pa dang 'os shing 'tsham pa'i gyon gos rgyan cha dang mdzes spras kyis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bzhin ras dang skyes gzugs lhag par mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba byas nas/ le tshan la 'gugs shugs ldan par byed thub/ de yang 'os 'tsham min pa'i rgyan spras sogs kyis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i ma gzhir legs pa'i bzhin ras dang skyes gzugs mi legs par gtong srid/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi nyams de le 268

tshan gyi khyad chos dang ma mthun tshe/ le tshan la mjug 'bras mi legs pa 'khyer 'ong ste/ spro snang gis khengs pa'i rtsed 'jo'i le tshan zhig gi khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bzhin ras la 'dzum mdangs spu tsam yang med par gzab nan che drags na/ spro snang gis khengs pa'i le tshan gyi rnam pa dang ldog zlar gyur nas le tshan gyi 'gugs shugs je zhan du gtong nges red/ der brten/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi nyams 'os shing 'tsham pa yin min de thad kur le tshan la 'bras bu legs po 'byung min thag gcod byed pas/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi phyi nyams la do snang byed dus gsham gyi phyogs 'ga' la shin tu do snang bya dbos/phyi'i nyams 'gyur dang phyi'i rnam pa de rang gi cha rkyen dang mthun dgos/ rang nyid kyi cha rkyen zer ba de rang gi ngo gdong dang lus gzugs/gshis rgyud/ bzo lta'i khyad chos sogs la bstan pa red/ mi re re'i skyes gzugs mi 'dra bas na/ rang so sor 'os pa'i gyon gos kyi rnam pa sogs dang skyes ma rnams la mtshon na rang rang gi skra yi slas stangs sogs kyang mi 'dra/rang gi gshis ka dang skyes gzugs kyi khyad chos dang mi mthun pa'i gyon gos kyis rang la mdzes rgyan spras mi thub par ma zad/ de las ldog ste rang gi snang brnyan la gnod pa bskyal srid/ phyi'i nyams 'gyur de le tshan gyi blang bya dang mthun dgos/ le tshan gyi blang bya zer ba de le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa/khor yug sogs kyi blang bya la bstan pa yin/ le tshan gyi nang don cung gzab nan yin na/ phyi nyams kyang cung gzab nan yin dgos pa dang / le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa cung lhod g.yeng dang spro snang ldan tshe/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi'i nyams 'gyur yang dal lhod dang rang mos yin chog pa 269

red/ gal te rnam pa rgya che ba'i rig rtsal dgong tshogs shig la 'go 'dzin byed dus khyod kyis spyir btang gi gyon gos gyon pa dang yang na shin tu dbul ba'i 'bros phyogs dang zhing grong du bcar 'dri byed skabs/ khyod kyis g.yu byur gyi rgyan chas brgyan pa dang gos lwa sum kha ma sogs kyis gzab 'phyor spras tshe/ lta mkhan gyi snang ngor khyod ni mtho shing bcar 'dri bya yul dma' ba'i snang ba sbyin nas khyod la lta stangs legs po mi 'dzin pa dang / bcar 'dri bya yul yang khyod dang phyi'i rnam pa'i thad kyi khyad par che drags nas/ khyod dang 'dris mi thub pa dang yang na 'dris mi 'dod par 'gyur bas/ khyod ni le tshan dang le tshan gyi khor yug dang yongs su ldog zlar gyur te/ le tshan gyi blang bya dang mi mthun par ma zad/ le tshan la 'bras bu legs po 'byung mi thub pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa bzo srid/phyi nyams de kun dang mi mthun par ya ma gzugs yin mi rung / le tshan la lar mtshon na dmigs bsal gyi blang bya'i dbang gis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi nyams rgyun ldan min chog par ma gtogs/ spyir btang gi gnas tshul 'og tu brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i phyi nyams dang gyon chas/ rgyan cha sogs ya ma gzugs yin mi rung / phyi nyams ya ma gzugs zer ba de gyon gos ya mtshan can dang skra yi slas stangs dang bzo lta ya mtshan can/ gdong la skag byug pa tshad las brgal ba/ rgyan cha ya ma gzugs 'dogs pa sogs la bstan pa yin/ le tshan gyi nang don dang 'gal zlar gyur pa'i phyi'i rnam pa ya ma gzugs kyis lta mkhan la zhen pa log pa dang sun snang skyes su bcug nas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par gdengs 'jog legs po mi byed cing / ma mtha' yang lta mkhan gyi rnam shes de 270

bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos sogs phyi'i rnam pa ya mtshan can der 'khor nas le tshan gyi nang don la gyong gud bzo srid/ phyi'i nyams 'gyur des skad cha dang lus po'i bzo lta sogs la ram 'degs bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan de ni rnam shes dbang po med pa'i mdzes ma'i brnyan ris shig dang mi 'dra bar de ni kun la cha 'phrin sogs brgyud bsgrags byed pa'i mi gson po zhig yin phyin/ skad char gson nyams ldan pa dang bag 'tsher gyis phyug pa na phyi nyams kyang bag lhod ldan pa dang / gyon gos sogs kyang de dang mthun par brjid nyams rang bzhin yin mi dgos par bag lhod zor yangs can zhig yin chog cing / skyes ma rnams kyis da dung 'os shing 'tsham pa'i rgyan cha sna tshogs btags chogaphyi'i nyams 'gyur de brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris kyi khyad chos dang mthun dgos/ spyir btang du brnyan 'phrin gsar 'gyur le tshan mang che shos khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa'i lus stod ma gtogs mi mthong bas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas gtso bo lus stod kyi snang brnyan la do snang bya dgos/nang sgos su skra dang ngo gdong / lus stod du gyon pa'i lwa ba sogs la do snang bya dgos/ brnyan ris 'di lta bu'i khrod du lag brda dang lus po'i 'gul stangs la rtag par nus pa chen po med pa dang le tshan la la'i khrod bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i lus gzugs hril po mngon pa yin pas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas brnyan ris hril po'i khrod kyi rang nyid kyi gnas bab la cha rgyus zab mo yod pa byas nas brnyan ris mi 'dra ba'i khrod du so sor gyon gos rgyan cha dang lus dang gdong gi nyams 'gyur mi 'dra ba bkol mkhas pa bya dgos/de min le tshan mang por 'go 'dzin pa gnyis re dang yang na gnyis re yan 271

yod la/ le tshan de rigs khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i bar gyon gos dang nyams 'gyur sogs phan tshun gzhogs 'degs bya dgos pa las yongs su ldog zlar gyur pa byed mi rung / mdor na/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan ji ltar gsar bzhengs byed rgyu ni phyogs bsdus kyi sgyu rtsal zhig yin pa dang / le tshan legs 'grub 'byung min gyi 'gag rtsa yin pas/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs/ gyon chas ji lta bu gyon pa dang rgyan cha ji lta bu 'dogs rgyu sogs 'dus pa'i snang brnyan thad la rtag par bsam gzhig zhib mo gtong dgos/3 gdong gi nyams 'gyur/gdong gi nyams 'gyur zhes pa ni bzhin ras kyi 'gyur ldog la brten nas tshor snang dang rnam 'gyur mtshon pa la zer/ de ni mis rang gi sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs phyir mngon pa'i mtshon stangs gal chen zhig yin/ nga tshos rtag par gzhan gyi skad char nyan dgos par ma zad/ da dung de'i rnam 'gyur la brtags nas/ des bshad pa'i skad cha'i bden rdzun gyi dbye ba bgar dgos/ skabs 'gar ngo gdong gi rnam 'gyur las skad cha'i nang don mi bden pa shes thub pa ste/ dper na/ skabs la lar mi zhig gis gnas bab kyi dbang gis kha nas mi sa ge mor dga' snang brjod kyang / mis mdangs sogs las de la sun snang skyes pa'i mdangs shig ngang ngam shugs kyis shar 'dug pa na/ nga tshos kyang rang shugs kyis de'i kha nas bshad pa'i skad cha las lhag par de'i mig mdangs las mtshon pa'i rnam 'gyur dngos ma de la yid ches pa yin/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas gdong gi nyams 'gyur la 272

do snang byed pa de yang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las rigs de lta mkhan la kha gtad dgos pa kho na'i rkyen ma yin par/ de yang brnyan 'phrin ni mig gi mthong byar gyur pa'i smyan byed yin la/ bshad mkhan dang 'tho 'dzin pa'i gdong gi nyams 'gyur ma lus par brnyan 'phrin brgyud nas kun gyi mdun du mngon par ma zad/ brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris che chung nas tshod 'dzin thebs pas/ bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa'i ngo gdong gi brnyan ris gtso che ba'i rkyen yang yin/ ngo gdong ni kho tsho'i sems kyi 'gyur ba mtshon pa'i gnas gal chen red/ gdong gi nyams 'gyur gyi nus pa gtso bo ni brtse dung gi 'gyur ba mtshon pa de yin la/ dga' ba dang sdug pa/ ya mtshan pa/skras pa / zhen pa log pa dang spro ba skyes pa sogs mi'i sems kyi 'gyur ba ni phal cher mi'i gdong gi nyams 'gyur las shes rtogs byed thub/ rnam 'gyur 'di dag ni brtse dung gi cha mtshon pa'i ches spyir btang gi mtshon stangs red/rang gi brtse dung mngon gsal dod pos mtshon ched/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad ma/khan dang 'go 'dzin pas sems kyi brtse ba phyir mngon pa'i ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur 'di dag la tshod 'dzin legs po byed mkhas dgos/ nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod nga tsho'i gdong gi nyams 'gyur de las phyi'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas sems kyi brtse ba dang 'gyur ba sna tshogs mtshon pa'i nyams 'gyur sna tshogs 'byung srid/ brnyan 'phrin khrod du sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs mngon pa de yang nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod dang 'dra bar de 'dra'i drag pa dang mang ba zhig yin mi srid mod/ yin na'ang rnam pa cung bag lhod can gyi le tshan khrod du phun sum tshogs pa'i nyams 'gyur ni sngar bzhin med du mi rung ba zhig red/ gdong gi nyams 'gyur de yang gtso bo smin ma dang mig kha/ ngo 273

mdangs sogs la brten nas mtshon pa red/ 'tsho ba'i khrod du nyams 'gyur la la ni smin ma dang kha mig sogs tshang ma las mtshon la/ la la ni sna gcig re las mtshon pa ste/ gal te shin tu dga' ba dang yang na ha cang ya mtshan pa sogs sems kyi 'gyur ba drag po'i nyams 'gyur mtshon skabs kha mig dang — smin ma sogs yongs rdzogs mnyam du 'gyur ldog byed pa dang 'gyur ldog gi tshad kyang mngon gsal dod po yin la/ sems kyi 'gyur ba de 'dra mi drag tshe/gdong gi nyams 'gyur yang de 'dra mi drag par smin ma bsdu ba tsam dang yang na kha myur ba tsam sogs nyams 'gyur phran bu las mtshon par byed/gdong gi nyams 'gyur khrod du mig ni nyams 'gyur mtshon byed gtso bo red/ mi dang mi'i bar thag cung ring na phan tshun gyi phyi'i rnam pa spyi dang de'i bzo ltar lta la/ phyogs gnyis kyi bar thag cung nye na thog mar do snang byed sa ni mig zung yin/ mig mdangs ni mis spyi tshogs 'brel 'dris byed skabs bkol ba'i gzhogs 'degs kyi nus pa ldan pa'i byed thabs rigs shig yin/spyir btang du phan tshun kha brda sogs byed skabs phan tshun gyi ngo gdong la blta ba dang pha rol pa'i mig mdangs las 'brel 'dris byed pa ni pha rol par do snang byed pa'i mtshon rtags red/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i mig mdangs kyi 'brel 'dris de gnas tshul rigs gnyis la 'brel ba ste/ rigs gcig ni bshad mkhan kyis dngos su mi mthong ba'i lta mkhan dang / rigs gcig ni yul dngos kyi gleng mol bya yul de yin/ gleng sol bya yul de dag kyang yul dngos kyi lta mkhan yin srid la/ bcar 'dri bya yul dang yang na mnyam du le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed pa'i las grogs yin yang srid/ mig bis dngos su mi mthong ba'i lta mkhan dang mig mdangs kyis 274

'brel 'dris byed pa de ni sems kyi tshor snang zhig la brten nas byed pa las/dngos su phan tshun gyi mig mdangs mthong ba min/ lta mkhan gyis brnyan 'phrin brgyud nas bshad mkhan la 'go 'dzin pa mthong thub mod/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lta mkhan mi mthong / bshad mkhan gyis mdun gyi brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas la brten nas rang gi sems kyi snang ngo'i lta mkhan dang phan tshun mig mdangs brje res dang 'brel 'dris bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin lta mkhan gyis brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas kyi kha phye nas khyod kyi le tshan la lta dus don dngos thog khyod dang 'brel 'dris byed pa mtshon pa yin/ gal te bshad mkhan la de lta bu'i 'du shes med par brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas las lta mkhan dang mig mdangs brje res byed pa'i snang ba ma bzung tshe/ lta mkhan snang med du bzhag pa dang mtshungs la/ lta mkhan gyis khyod kyi mig mdangs dang mig gi nyams 'gyur las khyod kyi rnam 'gyur de shes tshor 'byung srid cing /de las khyod la lta stangs mi legs pa 'byung srid pa dang khyod kyis bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i le tshan la'ang lta 'dod med par 'gyur nges/ nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du khyod kyis mi gzhan la kha brda byed dus rnam shes gtad cing mig zung gis kha brda bya yul gyi mig zung la bgrad de blo gcig sems gcig ngang bshad skabs/ pha rol pas mig gis yar lta mar lta byed bzhin khyod la lan 'debs 'dod mi 'dod byas tshe/ khyod kyang dang thog gi dga' snang dang spro bag de med par 'gyur bar ma zad/ yid kyang mi dga' bar 'gyur nges/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa rang ngo nas lta mkhan la snang med byed mi srid mod/ yin yang brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags kyi khyad chos la cha rgyus med pa las mjug 'bras de 'dra bzo'ang srid/ de bas 275

brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nges par du brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas brgyud nas lta mkhan dang mig mdangs brje res byed mkhas par 0bya dgos/ mig bis lta sa gang du babs na ches 'os pa sogs la tshod lta byed/ pa dang bya ba dngos kyi khrod rtag par rang gi mig mdangs las lta mkhan dang —'brel 'dris byed thub kyin yod med dang lta mkhan dang mig mdangs brje res byed thub kyin yod med la do snang bya dgos/ lta mkhan dang mig mdang brje res byed pa de yang lta thengs gcig gis chog pa zhis ma red/ nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i kha brda'i khrod rang gis kha brda byed 'dod mkhan zhig dang kha brda —byed dus/ des do snang byed pa'i ched du kha brda byed skabs de la lta thengs cung mang ba dang / gal te rang gis dga' snang de 'dra mi byed pa'i mi dang kha brda byed dus/ de la mig gis de 'dra mang po lta mi srid/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan bshad skabs kyang gnas lugs thad nas de dang 'dra ba ste/ bshad mkhan kyis lta mkhan la do snang byed pa mtshon ched/ lta mkhan dang mig mdangs brje res byed pa de yang ci nus kyis lta mkhan la lta thengs mang ba dang lta yun ring ba bya dgos/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas brnyan 'phrin khang dang yang na don rkyen gyi yul dngos nas bcar 'dri bya yul dang gleng mol byed dus/bcar 'dri bya yul gyi thob thang mi 'dra bas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur dang mig mdangs brje res byed stangs kyang mi 'dra/ spyir btang du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i mig mdangs thog mtha' kun tu bcar 'dri bya yul gyi gdong la cer nas 'dug mi 'os/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas mdun gyi lta mkhan dang mig mdangs brje res byed skabs/ thog mtha' kun tu lta mkhan la bltas kyang lta mkhan la 276

dogs mi bde ba'i snang ba sbyin mi srid/ de ni bshad mkhan gyi gzugs brnyan brnyan 'phrin las shar ba las mi dngos min pas/ lta mkhan la 'tshub snang mi skye pa red/ bcar 'dri bya yul dang ngo gtug nas gleng mol byed dus/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas mig mdangs brje res byed stangs 'os 'tsham bkol tshe/ phyogs gnyis gas bag lhod ngang gleng mol byed thub/ mig gis mtha' gcig tu bcar 'dri bya yul la bltas nas lhag bsam che drags na/bcar 'dri bya yul dogs mi bde ba dang 'tshub snang skye srid pa/ gal te bcar 'dri bya yul la mig gis gtan nas ma bltas na/ bcar 'dri bya yul la snang med byed pa'i tshor ba skye sla ba red/ mig mdangs brje res kyis brtse dung gi rnam pa zhig dang sems kyi 'gyur ba zhig mtshon par ma zad/ skabs la lar da dung dmigs bsal gyi cha 'phrin yang brgyud bsgrags byed thub/ gleng mol byed skabs nga tshos rtag par mig mdangs las rang gis skad cha bshad 'dod pa'i cha 'phrin sgrog pa dang / skad cha bshad bzhin pa'i mi des kyang khyod kyi mig mdangs las khyod kyi don rtogs thub/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig la mtshon na/ mig mdangs la brten nas cig shos kyi skad cha'i mtshams gcod pa dang cig shos kyi skad cha'i bar du rang gi skad cha gsab mkhas par bya dgos/ des gleng mol gyi nang don la tshod 'dzin byed pa dang gleng gzhi gsar ba gleng ba/ bcar 'dri dang le tshan gyi dus yun yang dag par tshod 'dzin byed pa bcas la nus pa gal chen bskyed thub/ der brten bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas bye brag gi le tshan re re'i khrod/ gang la gang 'tsham ngang mig mdangs brje res byed stangs 'os 'tsham bkol rgyu ni shin tu gal che zhing / bya ba dngos kyi lag len las rang gis myong tshor len dgos pa zhig 277

red/mig mdangs dang 'brel ba'i gnad don gzhan zhig ni mig deb pa de red/ mig deb pa dang mig deb tshad mgyogs min de ni mi re re'i goms phyogs dang bsam gzhig gi dal myur la 'brel ba yod pa zhig red/ nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du mig deb pa der sus kyang de 'dra do snang mi byed/ yin na'ang brnyan 'phrin steng du 'char ba'i gzugs brnyan las bshad mkhan gyi mig deb tshul de yang shin tu gsal bas/ mig deb tshad mang na lta mkhan gyi do snang bya yul la gtor brlag byed srid pas/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan gyis mig rdeb tshul 'os 'tsham sgos tshod 'dzin bya dgos/ lta zhib byas nas shes pa ltar na/ mis gnad don zhig la bsam gzhig gtong skabs mig mi rdeb pa dang / gnad don zhig la bsam blo btang tshar rjes da gzod mig deb pa red/ skad cha bshad dus spyir btang du tshig rnga nas da gzod mig deb pa red/ chos nyid 'di dag las brtag na/ bshad mkhan gyis thog mar mig deb tshad la tshod 'dzin dgos pa dang / de min tshig rnga nas da gzod mig rdeb dgos/ gzhan gyis skad char nyan dus mig deb tshad mang na khyod kyi sems rnal la phab med par gzhan gyis bshad pa la bsam blo gtong gi med pa mtshon pa dang / rang gi skad cha bshad dus kyang mig deb tshad mang drags mi 'os/mig deb mang drags na gzhan gyis khyod kyis bshad pa'i skad char khyod rang gis kyang bsam blo zhib mo ma btang bar snyam nges red/mig mdangs las sems kyi 'char snang mtshon thub/ mi zhig gi sems sdug pa dang yid skyo ba/ khong khro langs pa sogs tshang ma ngo mdangs las phyir mngon pa dang nang sgos su mig mdangs las phyir gsal por mngon pa red/278

mig mdangs kyis mi'i sems kyi 'gyur ba ji bzhin du mtshon mod/ yin na'ang ngo mdangs kyi rnam 'gyur ni tshod 'dzin byed thub pa zhig red/ nga tshos nam rgyun rang gi sems kyi 'gyur ba ngo ma sbas nas ngo mdangs las phyir mi mngon pa dang skabs la lar rang gi ngo yi nyams 'gyur la sgro 'dogs pa dang yang na ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur la brten nas rang gi tshor ba je che je chung la btang nas gzhan la bstan chog pa red/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod nang don la la ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas dga' zhen byed min mi shes/ yin na'ang le tshan gyi dgos mkho'i ched du rang gi ngo mdangs kyi nyams 'gyur las le tshan gyi nang don la spro ba skyes pa'i tshor ba mngon dgos pa las/ de la mi dga' ba'i tshor ba mngon mi rung / bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas le tshan khrod du dga' skyo chags sdang gi don rkyen dang bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen rgyun du 'byung srid/ dga' skyo chags sdang gi don rkyen de dag gleng mol byed dus skabs la lar rang gi sems kyi 'char snang ngo ma drang mor mngon dgos la/ skabs la lar rang gi sems kyi 'gyur ba sba gsang byas nas lta mkhan gyi re ba dang gcig mthun yong ba bya dgos shing /bsam yul las 'das pa'i don rkyen sna tshogs mdun du'ang bab bstun gyi tshor snang rnon po zhig dang rang gi sems kyi mi legs pa'i tshor snang sna tshogs sba gsang byed pa'i nus pa drag po zhig ldan dgos/4 brngo lta dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas spyir btang du skad cha dang ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur la brten nas cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byed pa las/ lus po'i nyams 'gyur dang bzo ltar brten nas le tshan gyi nang don 279

mtshon dgos pa zhig min/ 'di'i steng nas bshad mkhan gyi las rigs de skad cha dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur gnyis kur brten pa'i sgyu rtsal las rigs dag dang mi mtshungs/ sgyu rtsal las rigs khrod du/ lus po'i nyams 'gyur kho nar brten nas nang don mtshon par byed pa ni ha cang rgyun ldan red/ yin na'ang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ lus po'i nyams 'gyur dang bzo lta ni skad char ram 'degs byed pa tsam yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i nyams 'gyur dang bzo lta las sngar bzhin sems kyi 'gyur ba dang gshis ku'i khyad chos/ rig gnas chu tshad sogs ngang ngam shugs kyis phyir mngon nges/ mi yi lus po'i nyams 'gyur de don snying nges can zhig gi thad nas bshad na srol rgyun rig gnas kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa red/ mi'i 'gro 'dug spyod gsum la rang rang mi rigs kyi bag chags thebs rkyen spyi yongs kyi brtsi bya dang 'dzem bya yod pa red/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan gyi dbos mkho mi gcig pa ltar rang bi lus po'i nyams 'gyur yang mi 'dra ba bkol dgos/ dper na/ byis pa'i le tshan gyi 'go 'dzin pas byis pa'i gshis ka dang khyad chos dang mthun pa'i nyams 'gyur sna tshogs bkol chog pa dang / gsar 'gyur le tshan dang 'khyab ston gyi cha mi dgos pa'i ched sgrig le tshan sna tshogs khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa tsog pur bsdad nas 'bo 'dzin byas chog phyi rol gyi yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed dus dang yang na lus po'i 'gul skyod dang lag brda sna tshogs bkol dgos pa'i rol rtsed rang bzhin gyi le tshan la langs nas 'go 'dzin bya dbos/le tshan gyi rigs kho nar dmigs nas bshad na/ bshad mkhan dang 280

'bo 'dzin pa'i 'dug stangs nyams 'gyur ji lta bu bkol dgos pa gcig gyur gyis gtan khel byed dka'/ le tshan la dgos mkho yod tshe/ le tshan ji lta bur yang langs nas 'bo 'dzin byas chog la tsog pur bsdad nas 'go 'dzin byas kyang chog lus po dang mdun cos gi rigs dang / brnyan len 'phrul chas kyi kha phyogs mi gcig pa dang le tshan gyi nang don dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba sogs ltar 'dug stangs dang nyams 'gyur yang rnam pa sna tshogs bkol chog tsog pur 'dug stangs gang yin yang thog mar bag lhod cing lhun chags yin dgos/ de yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas 'dug stangs mi 'dra ba dang mdun cog dang 'dug stegs mi 'dra ba ltar lus po'i yan lag gi 'jog stangs dang 'gul stangs sogs la'ang shin tu do snang bya dgos/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rgyun du bkol ba'i lus po'i nyams 'gyur gzhan zhig ni langs nas 'dug pa de red/ le tshan 'go 'dzin byed dus langs nas bsdad tshe bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lus po'i 'gul skyod byed bde zhing / langs nas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed dus lus po dang lus po'i cha lag la 'gul skyod mang ba dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur yang rgyun mi chad par 'gyur ba zhig yin/ lus po'i 'gul skyod dang 'dug stangs la 'gyur ldog byed dus bcos ma'i snang tshul yod mi 'os pa dang / 'tshub cha dang dogs snang yod mi 'os par brtan brling bab chags yin dgos/ spyir lus po'i 'dug stangs ni cung gtan 'jags kyi phyi'i rnam pa zhig yin pa dang lus po'i yan lag dang cha lag sogs kyi bzo lta'i nyams 'gyur ni 'gul zhing 'gyur ba'i rnam pa zhig yin zhing / lus po'i yan lag sogs kyi nyams 'gyur gyis nang don gang mang mtshon thub/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 281

'dzin pa'i phyi'i lus po'i 'gul stangs der gtso bo mgo dang las zung bcas lus po'i cha shas kyi 'gul stangs dang lus hril po'i 'gul stangs 'dus pa red/ ngo gdong gi nyams 'gyur de yang lus po'i 'gul stangs kyi rigs gcig la brtsi chog mgo yi 'gul stangs la mgo ldem pa dang mgo g.yug pa/mgo yar 'degs pa sogs yod pa dang lag pa'i 'gul stangs cung rnyog 'dzing che ba ste lag brda sna tshogs yod/ lag brda la mi rigs rig gnas kyi goms srol 'dus la/ mi sger gyi rgyu rkyen gang mang yang 'dus pa red/ lus po'i 'gul stangs ni lus po'i brkyangs bskums dang dgye skur/ 'gro 'dug sogs la bstan pa yin/ brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris kyi che chung la tshad yod phyin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i 'gul stangs ni mgo yi 'gul stangs dang lag brda gtso che ba red/ lus po'i 'gul stangs la nang don gsal por mtshon pa dang / skad cha'i nang don la 'grel bshad byed pa/ 'brel 'dris dang brje res kyi 'brel ba legs sgrig byed pa/ rang gi brtse dung gi rnam 'gyur mtshon pa bcas kyi nus pa ldan/ nang don gsal po mtshon par byed pa'i 'gul stangs de la khyab khongs nges can khrod du mi mang che ba dang yang na kun gyis shes pa'i don snying ldan pa ste/ dper na/ mgo bo nang du ldem pa ni 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur dang mgo bo 'phred du g.yug pa ni mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon pa lta bu red/ 'gul stangs sam rnam 'gyur 'di rigs ni snga mo nas nga tsho'i nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod yongs su 'dres nas nam rgyun nga tshos de'i don snying la do snang de 'dra byed mi srid/ yin na'ang brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod don snying gsal po ldan pa'i 'gul stangs dang rnam 'gyur 'di rigs kyis skad cha dang 'dra bar cha 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byed pa yin pas/ 'gul stangs dang 282

rnam 'gyur thad nor 'chug byung na'ang skad cha nor 'chug byung ba dang 'dra ba'i shugs rkyen ngan pa bzo srid/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa zhig yin tshe/ don snying mngon gsal yod pa'i 'gul stangs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyis mtshon pa'i bye brag gi nang don la cha rgyus yod par byas nas/ le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs de dag 'os shing 'tsham pa 'i ngang bkol shes par bya dbos/ rig gnas srol rgyun dang rig gnas kyi rgyab ljongs mi mtshungs pas/ 'gul stangs bzo lta dang nyams 'gyur gcig mtshungs yin yang/ mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i khrod du mtshon pa'i go don mi 'dra ba red/ der brten rig gnas dang rig gnas bar gyi khyad par la cha rgyus med tshe/ lus po dang lus po'i yan lag gi nyams sna tshogs las ming don go ldog 'byung srid/ lus po'i nyams 'gyur la da dung skad cha'i nang don la 'grel bshad byed pa'i nus pa ldan/ nga tsho'i le tshan khrod rtag par mi dang dngos po sogs la 'brel ba'i skad cha bshad dus bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lag brda'i ram 'degs byas nas skad char lhag par gson nyams ldan par byas chogalus po'i nyams 'gyur gyi gshis nus gzhan zhig ni skad cha brje res byed skabs kyi phan tshun gyi 'brel ba mthun sgrig byed pa de red/ 'di ni mi mang pos mnyam du le tshan gcig la 'go 'dzin byed pa dang thad kur mi gzhan dang gleng mol byed pa'i le tshan khrod du lhag par gal che/ le tshan 'di dag khrod nang don mang po sngon la gra sgrig byas pa min pas/ skabs thog nas gleng mol byed skabs/ gang nas mgo rtsom pa dang mtshams gang nas skad cha'i gleng gzhi brje ba/ dus nam la skad cha'i mjug sgril ba sogs gleng mol byed mkhan 283

phyogs gnyis kur 'brel ba'i gnad don 'di dag spyir skad char brten nas mtshon par byas chog mod/ yin na'ang nyams myong can gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rtag par drang thad dang 'os min gyi byed stangs mi bkol bar lus po'i nyams dang rnam 'gyur la brten nas pha rol par brda ston pa red/pha rol pa'i skad cha bshad dus su khyod kyis mgo bo yar 'degs pa dang yang na mig bis de'i ngo la bltas nas ngo gdong las khyod kyis skad cha bshad rgyu'i nyams bstan tshe/ pha rol pas kyang khyod kyi nyams de las khyod kyi sems pa rtogs te/ khyod la skad cha gsab pa'i bar gseng 'jog nges/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa mang pos le tshan mjug sgril la nye yang bcar 'dri bya yul gyis skad cha mtshams 'jog rtsis med par mu mthud du bar med du bshad dus ci bya btol med du gyur nas pha rol pa'i skad cha btsan gyis gcod pa yin/de ltar byas tshe bcar 'dri bya yul dogs mi bde bar gtong la le tshan gyi mjug 'bras kyang mi legs/ nyams myong can gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan mjug sgril la nye dus lag brda phran bu re dang yang na lus po dang gdong gi nyams 'gyur re la brten nas le tshan mjug rdzogs la nye bas skad cha mtshams 'jog ran zhes pa'i brda mtshon par byed/ de dus bcar 'dri bya yul gyis kyang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i brda yi don go nas rang shugs kyis skad cha'i mjug bsdu nges/ de ltar byas tshe/ bcar 'dri bya yul gyi skad cha'ang mgo rnga tshang la le tshan hril bo phun sum tshogs pa dang lhun gyis 'grub nges/ lag brda dang nyams 'gyur ji lta bu bkol rgyu'i thad la 'di lta bu dang de lta bu zhes gtan khel gsal po zhig byed mi nus shing byed thabs kyang med/ mi re rer rang rang gi nyams dang brda mi mtshungs pa sna tshogs yod srid 284

la/ nyams dang brda de dag gzhan gyis kyang shin tu rtogs sla phyir/ bye brag gi le tshan khrod nyams ji lta bu bkol na 'os pa ni bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa re re'i rtsal la rag las shing / lag len dngos kyi khrod rang ris nyams su len dbos pa zhig red/lus rtse'i nyams 'gyur la da dung sems kyi brtse dung gi rnam pa mtshon pa'i nus pa ldan/ nga tshos nam rgyun skad cha'i khrod lag brda dang lus po'i nyams 'gyur la brten nas sems kyi brtse dung gi rnam pa zhig mtshon par byed/brtse dung gi rnam pa de dag skabs la lar skad cha dang gcig mthun yin pa dang / skabs la lar skad cha dang gcig mthun min pa red/ brtse dung gi rnam pa mtshon pa la rgyun du bkol ba ni lag brda red/ lag pa'i brda mi 'dra bas sems kyi 'gyur ba mi 'dra ba mtshon nges/ lus po'i nyams dang sadong gi rnam 'gyur/ lag brda sogs gzhogs 'dregs byas pa las/ mig bi snang yul brnyan ris cha tshang ba zhig ngang bis 'grub nges/ las brda las gzhan/ som pa'i 'degs 'jog la'ang nyams 'gyur mngon gsal ldan nges/ lta mkhan gyis bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs kyi som pa 'i stangs stabs la bltas nas de'i gshis ka dang chu tshad/ sems khams sogs la thog ma'i dbye zhib byed srid/ gom stabs yang zhing bde myur can las sems khams dwangs pa dang / gom pa'i 'degs 'jog brtan cing brjid pa las sems khams brtan brling ldan pa/ gom stabs dogs snang dang brel 'tshub che ba las sems la 'tshub cha langs pa bcas mtshon/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs lus po'i nyams 'gyur ji ltar mang na de ltar legs pa zhig min/ gshis nus thad nas bshad 285

na/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skad cha'i mtshon nus lhag par gal che/spyir btang bi gnas tshul 'og tu/ lus po'i nyams 'gyur gyis ram 'degs kyi nus pa bskyed pa tsam yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i lus po'i nyams 'gyur dang nang sgos su mgo dang lag pa'i 'gul stangs 'os shing 'tsham pa yin dgos pa las tshad las gtan nas brgal mi rung / gal te 'gul stangs mang drags nas mgo bo ḍa ru bzhin du g.yug pa dang lag pa dgung nas phyar tshe/ lta mkhan gyis de ni skyon zhig tu brtsis nas sun snang skye nges yin/ khyad par du bzo lta gcig mtshungs kyi 'gul stangs yang dang bskyar du yod mi 'os/ mi la las dus nam yang mgo bo phyogs gcig kho nar g.yug pa dang mi la las lag brda sna gcig kho na ston rgyur goms 'duganyams 'gyur de dag tshang ma mig bltas su mjug 'bras legs po med/ thog mar las la zhugs pa'i brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lhag par du rang gi lus po'i nyams 'gyur la dang dod bya dgos/ mi mang por nam rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod rang snang gi nyams 'gyur dang bzo lta gang mang goms 'dug nyams 'gyur de dag gis skabs la lar bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs la/ shugs rkyen ngan pa de dag yongs su rang nyid kyis rtogs thub pa zhig ma red/5 brnyan 'phrin bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rgyan chas/brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs/ gyon chas gang 'dra gyon pa dang rgyan cha ji lta bu 'dogs rgyu ni rtag par bsam gzhig gtong dgos pa'i gnad don zhig red/ lhag par du skyes ma bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas de'i skor la 286

bsam blo mang po gtong ba red/ mi la las gyon gos dang rgyan cha'i nus pa ni rang nyid la mdzes chas spras pa kho na red snyam nas le tshan gyi nang don dang khyad chos la mi lta bar rang gi gang 'dod ltar gyon gos kyi kha dog dang tshugs ka 'dra min sna tshogs bdams nas gyon pa dang rgyan cha gang yin sna tshogs bdams nas btags pas/ rang gi snang brnyan la gnod pa thebs par ma zad/ le tshan gyi 'gugs shugs la'ang shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs pa red/spyir gyon chas ni gyon gos dang rgyan cha phyogs gnyis la bstan pa yin/gyon gos ni mi lus sgrib byed dang rgyan cha ni mi'i lus po dang lwa ba'i steng brgyan pa'i rgyan cha'i dngos po dag la zer te/ dper na/ rna lung dang ske rgyan/sor gdub/ lag gdub sogs red/ deng rabs spyi tshogs khrod du gyon gos dang rgyan cha ni mi'i lus po sgrib byed dang mi'i gzugs brnyan mdzes par spras pa tsam du ma zad/ de la nang don sngar las mang po ldan te/ de yang gyon gos la mi'i lus po sgrib pa dang lus drod srung ba/ rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags/dpal 'byor go gnas kyi mtshon byed sogs kyi nus pa ldan/ mi yi lus po sgrib pa ni gyon gos kyi ches thog ma'i nus pa yin zhing / gyon gos kyi nus pa gzhan zhig ni lus drod bsrungs nas mi'i lus phung la srung skyob bya rgyu de red/ mi rnams kyis rang byung khor yug gi drod grang ltar gyon gos gyon chog cing / nam zla'i drod grang dang dus kyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas gyon gos gyon pa ni 'tsho ba'i rgyun shes tsam red/ rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags dang dpal 'byor go gnas mtshon pa ni gyon gos kyi ches rin thang ldan pa dang ha cang gcigs 'dzin bya dgos pa'i gshis nus red/ mi zhig la mtshon na kha rgyab kyi gnad don sel nas phyi'i gyon gos thad 'gro song gtong ba'i nus pa yod pa'i dus su 287

gshis nus 'di lhag pa ra gal che/brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin par mtshon na/ le tshan bshad pa dang 'bo 'dzin byed skabs kyi gyon gos 'dems dus thog mar de'i rig gnas mtshon rtags la do snang bya dgos/ gyon gos de rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags byed pa ni deng rabs spyi tshogs khrod dar ba zhig red/ nang don dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i 'du tshogs sogs kyi skabs dang yang na gnas bab mi 'dra ba'i skabs su skabs de'i khor lus dang mthun pa'i gyon gos gyon dbos shing / nam rgyun kun gyis mi zhig gi gyon gos thad nas mi de'i thob thang dang dga' phyogs/ rig gnas yon tan sogs la brtag pa red/ mi sger gyi cha nas bshad na/ gyon gos dang rgyan chas dpal 'byor go gnas kyang mtshon pa ste/ rang re'i bod rigs shig la mtshon na/ gos tsha ru'i rgyas shom dang g.yu byur gser dngul gyi rgyan cha'i bzang ngan dang mang nyung gis mi de'i khyim tshang gi 'byor phyug dang dpal 'byor go gnas mtshon gyin yod/ yin na'ang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ bye brag gi le tshan mi 'dra ba'i nang don gyi dgos dbang dang bstun nas gyon gos dang rgyan cha gdam dgos pa las/ sgor gyi dpal 'byor go sanas ngom byed ma red/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos mi 'dra bas rtag par bsam bzhin dang yang na bsam bzhin ma yin par mtshon bya'i nang don mi 'dra ba'i cha 'phrin kun la brgyud bsgrags byed kyin yod pas/ do snang legs po ma byas tshe/ gyon gos gyon stangs shig gi steng nas kyang chab srid dang 'brel ba'i don rkyen bzo'ang srid/ der brten le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs gyon gos ji ltar 'dems pa la'ang brtsi bya'i rtsa don dang do snang bya dgos sa mang 288

po mchis/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod gyon bos gyon dus lus po'i cha phyir mngon drags na lta mkhan gyis khyod la lta stangs legs po 'dzin mi srid/ nang sgos su skyes ma bshad mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pas lhag par de'i skor la do snang bya dgos/ rig gnas srol rgyun mi 'dra bas mi'i lus po'i cha rjen por phyir mngon pa dang de dang len byed thub pa'i 'du shes kyi tshad this kyang so sor mi 'dra bas/ nga tshos 'di nas bye brag gi tshad thig cig gtan khel byed dka'/yin yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas le tshan khrod du gyon gos 'dems dus rgya che'i lta mkhan dang rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang goms srol gshis lugs la brtsi srung bya dgos pa las/ rang snang gang shar dang yang na rang gi 'du shes de tshad gzhir 'dzin mi rung / brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas mtshon pa ni khyod rang nyid gcig pu'i snang brnyan ma yin par/ gtso bo mi rigs shig gi snang brnyan red/ brnyan 'phrin khang gi brnyan phab khang du glog sgron mang po'i tsha 'od kyis khengs nas dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi khyad par mi tshor mod/ yin na'ang le tshan khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos la dus kyi dbye ba med kyang chog pa zhig ma red/nga tsho bod rigs sa char mtshon na dbyar dgun gyi drod grang la khyad par shin tu che bas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas dus tshigs kyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas gyon gos kyang 'os 'tsham ngang gdam dgos/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos de le tshan gyi nang don dang rang gi thob thang dang gcig gyur bya dgos/ gyon chas kyis skabs la lar le tshan gyi nang don dang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i thob thang la shugs rkyen thebs srid/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon chas ni lta mkhan la 289

ston pa zhig yin mod/ mi la las gyon gos de 'khrab ston byed spyad kyi yo byad lta bur brtsi bzhin yod pa de ni nor 'khrul zhig red/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon chas ni kho tsho'i snang brnyan gyi cha shas su gyur nas gyon mkhan gyi rig gnas blo sbyong gi chu tshad cig mtshon pa yin/ rig gnas blo sbyong gi chu tshad de'i nang kho tsho'i mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba dang/ 'tsho ba'i rnam 'gyur/dga' phyogs 'dun pa sogs 'dus/ der brten nyams myong ldan zhing las la byang ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi nam rgyun gyi gyon chas thad gcig gyur gyi khyad chos rang bzhin la do snang byas nas/ de ring dang sang nyin gyi khyad chos yongs su ldog zlar gyur ba'i gyon gos gyon mi srid/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las la zhugs pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas thog ma nas rang gi khyad chos dang le tshan gyi blang bya ltar gyon chas 'dems dus ha cang gzab gzab bya dgos/thog mar brnyan 'phrin las 'bud dus lta mkhan gyis khyod la rgyus lon byed pa'i skabs yin phyin/ khyod kyi nyams 'gyur dang gyon chas spras lugs la shin tu do snang byed srid/ dang thog khyod kyis snang brnyan legs po zhig ma bzhag tshe/ rjes su lta stangs bsgyur rgyu ni las sla mo zhig gtan nas min zhing /de la dus yun dang sems shugs ldab 'gyur bkol dgos/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa la las thog mar le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs/bsam gzhig btang ba ma 'dang ba dang yang na stabs ma legs par lta mkhan la snang ba mi legs pa sbyin tshe/ de tsho'i gtan gyi las ku'i mdun lam la gnod pa thebs kyang srid/ der brten ches thog mar le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed skabs nges par du bsam blo zhib tshags btang nas nor 290
