'chug phran bu yang 'byung mi 'os/ lta mkhan gyis khyod rang dang len byas rjes/rim bzhin khyod la 'dzin pa'i blang bya'ang je lhod du gtong srid/ gyon chas dang mdzes spras kyi 'du shes gnyis rtag par mnyam du sbrel 'dug bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas kyang gyon chas thad nas mdzes pa la snyeg mod/yin yang mdzes pa de rigs ni skyes gzugs dang kha dog kho nar bsnyegs pa min par/ khor yug dang mthun pa dang le tshan gyi nang don dang rang sger gyi khyad chos gnyis 'os mthun yong bar byed pa'ang de'i cha zhig yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas mi sgor gyi mdzes pa rkyang rkyang bsnyegs na/ khor lug gi phyogs bsdus mdzes nyams dang le tshan gyi khyad chos dang 'gal zlar 'gyur nges la/ gzhan da dung gyon chas ya ma gzugs sna tshogs la dogs zon bya dgos/ gyon chas gyon pa'i goms srol des dmigs bsal gyi phyogs la la nas mi'i sems khams kyi gnas tshul mtshon pa yin/ kun dang mi mthun pa'i gyon chas gyon lugs kyis phyogs gcig nas da yod 'tsho ba las yar thon brtson pa'i bsam pa mtshon la/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi phal mo che'i shes rtogs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mtshon pa red/ gal te khyod rang spyir btang gi lta mkhan dang so sor gyes mi 'dod tshe/ kun dang mi mthun pa'i byon chas ya ma gzugs kyi rigs la gzab gzab byas na legs/ spyir btang du mi phal mo che yi snang ngor nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod gyon chas ya ma gzugs gyon mkhan dag gi sems khams la skyon gyis gos pa red snyam/ lta tshul de ni phyogs ris can zhig yin min gang yang rung ste/ mi phal che ba'i lta tshul la nga tshos nges par du gcigs mthong bya dgos/ spyir btang du nyin re rer bsgrags pa'i gsar 'gyur le tshan dang yang na dus gtan khel gyi le tshan khrod du bshad 291

mkhan dang 'bo 'dzin pa'i gyon bos dang rgyan cha'i thad de 'dra'i gzab 'phyor che mi dbos shing / thengs re rer gsar ba gsar rkyang zhig kyang yin mi dbos pa ra/ bab chags shing gra das la le tshan gyi khyad chos dang mthun pa zhig yin tshe chog pa red/ lo sasar dus ston skabs kyi dgong tshogs lta bu'i le tshan khrod du le tshan gyi nang don dang khyad chos dang bstun nas bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos dang rgyan cha sogs kyang gzab 'phyor dang rgyas shom che 'os la/ le tshan gcig gi khrod du gyon gos dang rgyan cha sogs yang yang brje nas gyon chog ste/ gyon gos dang rgyan cha'i steng nas dgong tshogs kyi spro snang dang dus ston gyi gzab rgyas rnam pa mtshon thub pa bya dgos/ nam rgyun gzhi rim du song nas le tshan phab yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed skabs gra dag cing cung stabs bde ba'i gyon gos gyon nas mang tshogs kyi nyin rgyun 'tsho ba dang mthun par byas na legs/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos kyis mi rigs rang gi khyad chos mtshon par byed dgos/ brnyan 'phrin gyis lta mkhan mang tshogs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes la shugs rkyen ha cang chen po thebs pa dang mi rigs rig gnas la'ang shugs rkyen bzang ngan gnyis ka thebs kyin yod pas/ nga tshos brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgrub skabs/ thog mtha' kun tu de la do snang bya 'os/ de bzhin brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa ni spyi byings kyi snang brnyan du gyur pa'i cha nas kho tsho'i gyon gos dang rgyan cha sogs kyis mang tshogs khrod shugs rkyen chen po thebs srid/ nye ba'i lo la bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi rgya je cher song ba dang bstun nas bod rigs mang tshogs khrod thebs pa'i shugs rkyen yang nyin re bzhin je che red/ dper na/ brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud 292

bsgrags thabs lam 'di la brten nas thag ring thung mi 'dra ba'i sa cha so so nas bsdus pa'i 'du tshogs sna tshogs myur du kun gyi mig lam du bskyal ba dang de las kyang sa cha che chung kun gyi 'du tshogs che chung so sor med du mi rung ba lta bur gyur pa'i shom gos ngom pa'am gyon gos 'khrab ston zhes pa'i bya 'gul de rigs brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags byas pa dang bstun nas bod khul sa cha so sor gcig rjes gcig 'brangs sgos lo re rer rgya je che nas je cher gyur nas rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshosas khrod shugs rkyen chen po bzos te/ mi rigs rang gi bod lwa dang rgyan char lhag par gtsigs mthong che bar gyur pas/sngon chad bod lwa stabs mi bde bar bsams nas dga' snang mi byed pa'i las byed pa dang mang tshogs khrod yongs khyab tu bod lwa sgrig pa dang gyon par spro snang ldan par gyur/ des rang re'i rgyal khab tu ma zad/ 'dzam bu gling gi mi rigs yod do cog gi gyon chas khrod du khyad chos mngon du 'phags shing dge mtshan du mas phyug pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs kyi gyon chas 'di nyid kun kyi mig gi longs spyod du phul nas grags pa'i ba dan gnam gyi mtha' ru khyab par byas pa ma zad/ bod kha ba can gyi gyon gos 'di nyid rang mi rigs khrod nam yang mi nyams par dar rgyas gong 'phel du gtong bar skul 'ded kyi nus pa dpag tu med pa bskyed pa ni smos ma dgos pa red/ yin na'ang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ brnyan 'phrin sogs kyis dril bsgrags byas drags pa'i mthus sa gnas so so'i shom gos 'gran pa'am gyon chas 'khrab ston zhes pa de yang rang mi rigs kyi gyon gos dang rgyan cha'i ma gzhi nas yod pa'i mdzes nyams dang dge mtshan rnal ma dag ngom pa las ches cher brgal 'dug la/mang tshogs khrod du thebs pa'i shugs rkyen de yang mtha' gcig tu dge mtshan 293

ldan nga/ kho na zhis gtan nas ma red/ dper na/ bod khams phyogs kyi skyes ma'i thod kyi spos shel de ni 'tsho ba'i khrod du gcig re dang gsum re/ ches mang na'ang lnga re las mi dgos mod/ shom gos ngom pa'am gyon gos 'khyab ston zhes pa las bud med gcis gi steng du bcu phrag re spungs pa dang spyir btang 'tsho ba'i khrod du ma ṇi bgrang byed kyi ba so phreng ba de yang rgyu shed ngom byed du gyur nas mi gcig gi lus steng du bcu phrag re dpyangs pa/ a mdo'i zhing las sa khul gyi skyes ma tsho'i skra rgyan skra long zhes pa de yang ma gzhir skra long leb ma byu rus brgyan pa gnyis kyi bar du dngul gyi me tog gis brgyan pa'i ral shub re 'dogs la/ de la 'tsho ba dngos kyi khrod du skra yi slas stangs dang 'dogs chas sgrig stangs la rang rang gi go gnas sam mtshon byed nang don ldan par ma zad/ mdzes dpyod kyi thad nas bshad na'ang byu ru dang dngul sogs rin po che'i rin thang ngom pa tsam ma yin par/ zhing las sa khul gyi skyes ma tsho'i zhib cing rtser son pa'i brtsegs grub kyi rtsal dang cha 'grig cing mig bltas la mdzes pa'i mdzes rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig mtshon pa red/ yin yang sa cha la la'i shom gos ngom pa'am gyon gos 'khyab ston zhes pa las byu ru'i rgyu shed ngom ched/ dkyil gyi ral shub dor nas skra long leb rgan ma gsum re rgyab nas leb se mar dpyangs pas/ de'i ma gzhi nas yod pa'i gyon chas rig gnas kyi go don zab mor gtor brlag bzos/ gzhan da dung shom gos 'gran pa'am gyon chas 'khrab ston zhes pa mang shos las gser dngul g.yu byur gyi rgyan chas lus kyi cha shas tsam yang ma lus par g.yogs te/ skyes pa rnams kyis kyang lus kyi stod smad kun tu byu ru btags nas phyo lo lo mo chas spras 'dug pa dang 'dra/ de ni 'khrab ston gyi rigs shig yin pas na sgro 294

btags kyi cha 'dres chog ces kha g.yar sa zhig sbyin kyang mi chog rgyu med mod/don dngos thog des mi rigs gzhan la re zhig bi mtshar snang re bskyed srid pa tsam las rang mi rigs kyi gyon gos dang rgyan cha'i khyad chos rnal ma zhig mtshon mi thub pa dang byon gos dang rgyan cha'i rig gnas kyi sngar yod kyi go don la sator brlab bzos/ de las kyang tshabs che ba ni shugs rkyen de 'dra'i 'og zhing grong dang 'brog sde mang che shos su gyon bos dang rgyan cha sogs 'gran bsdur byas nas sum gyi che chung 'gran pa dang byu ru'i mang nyung 'gran zhing /bser dngul gyi lci tshad 'gran te/ mi mang pos mi gras su tshud chad khyim gang ngo 'i am thag chad kyin seng ge'i rjes su wa mo nang bzhin kun gyi rjes mi 'brang thabs med/ der yang rgyu rkyen du ma yod mod/ brnyan 'phrin brgyud bsgrags kyi shugs rkyen ni rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig red snyam/ de dang de bzhin kun gyis mig ltos su gyur ba'i brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas rang gi gyon gos dang rgyan char shin tu do snang ma byas tshe/ rgya che'i lta mkhan khrod shugs rkyen ngan pa bzo nges/ gyon gos las gzhan/ lus steng gi ske rgyan dang rna long sogs la'ang snang med byed mi rung / rang re'i kha ba ri bo'i mi rigs 'di la gna' nas bzung rgyan cha sna tshogs 'dogs pa'i srol yod phyin/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nam rgyun le tshan la 'go 'dzin byed skabs ske rgyan dang rna long / lag gdub/ sor gdub sogs btags chog mod/ yin na'ang rgyan chas spras lugs kyang gong gi gyon gos kyi blang bya dang 'dra bar rang gi khyad chos dang nang sgos su le tshan gyi nang don dang khyad chos/ khor yug sogs dang bstun dbos/ nyin re'i gsar 'gyur dang yang na spyir btang gi le tshan khrod du rgyan cha 'os 'tsham re 'dogs 295

pa las/ shin tu gzab 'phyor che mi dbos/ gal te dmigs bsal gyi le tshan gzab chen dang yang na dus ston sogs kyi skabs su rgyan cha yang gyon gos dang le tshan gyi rnam pa dang bstun nas cung 'phyor can yin 'os/le tshan khrod du nges par du rang mi rigs kyi gyon bos gyon dgos / mi rigs shig gi khyad chos la rig gnas skad rigs dang 'tsho ba'i goms gshis sogs phyogs mang po'i nang don 'dus la/ gyon gos kyang mi rigs de'i khyad chos gtso bo gras kyi gcig red/ mi rigs rig gnas dar spel gtong ba'i sge'u khung lta bur gyur ba'i brnyan 'phrin las rigs la mi rigs rang gi skad rigs rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel gtong ba'i 'os 'gan yod pa ma zad/ rang mi rigs kyi dge mtshan dang ldan pa'i khyad chos rgyud 'dzin dang je legs je rgyas su gtong ba'i 'os 'gan yang yod pa red/ der brten/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi mtshon byed du gyur ba'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nges par du le tshan khrod du rang mi rigs kyi gyon gos gyon dgos/ de ni mi rigs skad cha'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi dgos dbang red/ rgyu mtshan ni mi rigs gang dang gang gi brnyan 'phrin le tshan ni mi rigs de dang de'i rig gnas kyi mtshon byed yin pas mi rigs de'i khyad chos mtshon par byed rgyu ni smos ma dgos pa'i cha rkyen red/ der brten/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa dag gis nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod mi rigs gang gi gyon gos gyon pa ni rang gi 'dod blo yin mod/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod du cis kyang mi rigs rang gi gyon bos gyon nas mi rigs rang bi khyad chos mngon dgos/de yang rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na'ang / le tshan la la'i nang don dang brjod bya de mi rigs gang dang gang la 296

'brel ba dam po yod pa'i dmigs bsal le tshan la la'i khrod/ dmigs bsal gyi dgos dbang gis mi rigs de'i gyon gos gyon pa ma gtogs/ rgyun ldan gyi le tshan khrod mi rigs gzhan pa'i gyon gos gyon mi srid pa red/ rang re'i brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa la las nyin rer gyon gos brje ba sogs kyi dka' tshegs la 'dzems pa dang stabs bder dmigs nas le tshan khrod rgya rigs kyi gyon gos gyon pa dang nang sgos su gzhi rim zhing sde dang 'brog phyogs su song nas bcar 'dri byed skabs rgya lu gyon pa'i gnas tshul rgyun du 'byung bzhin yod/ sngon chad rang nyid la'ang de lta bu'i bslab bya mang po yod/ der khor lug cha rkyen sogs kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs yod mod/ spyir bshad na/ le tshan khrod du dka' las ci 'dra myang dgos pa dang dka' tshegs ci 'dra che ba/ cha rkyen ci 'dra zhan pa dang stabs ci 'dra mi bde rung / khyod kyi sdug yus de rgya che'i lta mkhan gyis gu yangs mi byed pas/ le tshan khrod du khyod kyi skad cha tshig gcig dang bya spyod phran bu re yang khyod rang nyid mtshon pa ma yin par/ le tshan hril po dang le tshan des mtshon pa'i mi rigs de yi mtshon byed yin pas na/ lta mkhan gyi mig mdun du mngon dgos pa ni/ khyod kyi ches legs pa'i gzugs dang ches bzang pa'i nyams 'gyur yin dgos/ der brten/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i gyon gos dang rgyan cha'i skor ni mdzes spras kyi sgyu rtsal rigs shig yin par ma zad/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos mtshon pa'i rig gzhung rig gnas shig kyang yin phyir/bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa tshang mas le tshan khrod kyi gyon gos dang rgyan cha de rang nyid mdzes byed kho nar ngos bzung nas snang chung gtan nas mi byed par lag len dngos kyi khrod zhib 'jug nan mo byas na gcig nas rang gi 297

gzugs brnyan je legs su gtong ba dang gnyis nas le tshan gyi rgyu spus je legs su gtong ba/ gsum nas mi rigs kyi khyad chos rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel gtong bar shin tu dge mtshan ldan no/ /gang ltar gyon gos gyon lugs dang rgyan cha'i 'dogs tshul de yang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas nyin rgyun gyi le tshan khrod le tshan gyi nang don dang khor yug gnas bab/ rang gi khyad chos sogs phyogs mang po dang bstun nas 'os shing 'tsham pa bya dgos/mdor na gyon gos dang rgyan cha yis brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengs byed skabs nus pa gal chen thon bzhin mchis pas/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas der snang chung gtan nas byed mi rung /6 brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i mtshes spras/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i las thog ma ba rnams kyis brnyan 'phrin las rang gi gzugs brnyan mthong dus/ rang nyid ngo ma dang mi mtshungs pa'i tshor ba skyes nges/ brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan len lag rtsal rgyun mi chad par yar thon byung yang / mi'i mig gis bltas pa nang bzhin dngos gzugs kyi kha dog dang rgyu spus/ bar gseng gi che chung / 'od kyi 'gyur ldog sogs phra zhing zhib pa'i ngang mtshon mi nus par brnyan len 'phrul chas kyis blangs pa'i brnyan ris dang mig gis dngos su mthong ba'i dngos gzugs gnyis la khyad par nges can zhig ldan/ mi zhig la mtshon na khyad par 'di dag gis mi la la'i brnyan 'phrin gyi gzugs brnyan de mi rang nyid las legs pa dang / mi la la'i gzugs brnyan mi rang nyid la mi do ba red/ gzugs byad 298

shin tu mdzes pa zhig yin yang zhan cha spu tsam yang med pa'i dpe mi srid/mdzes spras 'os 'tsham re byas na zhan cha la la mi gsal bar byed thub/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas skab byug pa de zlos gar 'khyab ston pas skag byug tshul dang mi 'dra/ zlos gar 'khrab ston pas skag byug tshul ni rang nyid kyi gzugs brnyan yongs su bsgyur nas ched du gtan khel byas pa'i 'khrab gzhung nang gi mi sna gzhan zhig la bsgyur ba de red/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas skag byug pa ni rang gi ngo gdong la mdzes spras 'os 'tsham re byas te/ zhan cha la la 'gebs pa dang mdzes pa'i cha kha shas 'bur du btod pa tsam yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'gro 'dzin pa'i brnyan 'phrin las mngon pa ni gtso bo ngo gdong yin pas na/ skag 'byug skabs spyir btang du gdong la byug rdzas sogs nyung ngu 'byug pa de yin/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa su dang su yin yang phal che bas rang sga ngo gdong la skag byugs nas mdzes spras 'os 'tsham re bya dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni glog 'od shin tu drag po'i 'og tu khyod kyi ngo mdog skya bor gyur nas gson shugs med par 'gyur nges/ der brten mi re res ngo la skag 'byug dgos/mi la las mgo skra shad pa dang ngo la skag rtsis cung tsam byugs nas mdzes spras cung nyung re byed pa dang / la las mgo skra legs por shad pa dang ngo gdong la skag rtsi byugs pa las gzhan/ da dung smin ma dang mig ris 'bri ba dang mchu la skag rtsi byug pa bcas mdzes spras cung mang po byed nges/phyi rol gyi yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed dus skag 'byug mi dgos te/ phyi yul du gcig nas glog 'od drag po med pa dang gnyis nas khyod nyid phyi rol tu gnas pas mgo skra sogs rlung gis 'dzings par byas kyang lta mkhan 299

gyis de la dogs snang byed mi srid/ yin yang khyod rang glog 'od lam mer spro zhing bkod sgrig zhib tshags byas pa'i khang ba'i nang du bsdad de bshad dus/khyod kyis mgo skra legs por mi shad par 'dzings pa dang ngo gdong mdzes spras ma byas tshe/ lta mkhan gyis khyod la dga' snang bcang mi srid/ mgo skra'i skor la skyes pa zhig yin tshe tshegs de 'dra med/ skyes ma rnams kyi skra yi slas stangs rnam pa sna tshogs yin chog pas/ mi re res rang dang bstun nas gdam dgos/skra yi slas stangs gdam dus kyang rgyu rkyen 'ga' la do snang bya dgos pa ste/ thog mar le tshan gyi rnam pa dang nang don la bstun dgos/ rol rtsed rang bzhin dang nang don hur po yin tshe/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i skra yi slas stangs kyang cung rang snang yin chog la/ nang don gzab nan che ba'i le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed dus mtho skra'i slas stangs kyang rang snang che mi rung / gang ltar skra yi slas stangs de yang le tshan gyi khyad chos dang bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i thob thang dang mthun dbos/ de min skra yi slas stangs de bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i rang ngo'i snang brnyan gyi khyad chos dang zung 'brel bya dgos/ gal te ngo gdong gi dbyibs cung ring ba can gyis skra yi gzengs mtho na ngo gdong sngar las je ring la 'gro srid pas/ bltas tshod kyis mig la mi bde ba'i snang ba zhig sbyin nges/ mi la las tshegs la 'dzems nas skra thams cad gzhug phyogs su dam por shad nas mdun nas bltas tshe mgo'i zur gnyis dang klad thog gi skra shin tu srab pa'i tshor ba sbyin la/ mgo hril bo dam cig cig tu snang ste/ rang la mdzes rgyan spras pa par zhog rang steng gi zhan cha kha shas lhag par mngon gsal dod po byed pa ste/ dper na/khyod kyi rna'i dbyibs mi legs par che drags pa dang chung drags pa gang yin 300

yang lhang nger phyir mngon srid/ nga tsho bod skad kyi bshad mkhan skyes ma mang che bar skra slas stangs kyi skyon 'di rigs snang ba red/ rtag par brnyan 'phrin khrod du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i mdun phyogs gzugs ris dang nang sgos su ngo gdong las mi mthong bas/ skra slas dus nges par du brnyan 'phrin gyi brnyan ris kyi khyad chos la bsam blo gtong dgos/ ngo gdong ni brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas mdzes spras byed yul gtso bo yin/ ngo gdong gi mdzes spras la ngo gdong legs bcos dang ngo gdong la skag rtsi byug pa/mig dang smin ma/ mchu bcas la mdzes bcos byed pa bcas yin/ ngo gdong legs bcos zer ba ni ngor rang gi ngo mdangs kyi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i skag rtsi byugs nas ngo sha'i steng gi nag khra dang yang na rma shul 'ba' 'bur sogs bkab ste/ ngo mdangs hril po'i mdangs gcig mtshungs byed pa de yin/de min skag rtsi 'os 'tsham re byugs na ngo mdangs dwangs shing gtsang ma'i snang ba sbyin thub/ yin na'ang skag rtsi byug dus nges par du skag rtsi yi kha dog rang gi sha mdangs dang mthun dgos pa dang srab 'thug 'os 'tsham yin dgos/mi la las rang gi ngo mdangs cung smug shos che bar bsams nas skag rtsi dkar shos che ba byugs pa dang skag rtsi stug po byugs nas rang gi ngo mdangs je dkar dang je dwangs su gtong bsams/ de ltar byas na rang gi ngo mdangs dang skag rtsi gnyis ldog zlar gyur nas skag rtsi ngo mdangs su thim mi thub pa dang skag rtsi stug drags pas ma gzhi'i sha mdog yongs su bkab nas mdangs nyams te gzhan gyis mthong tshe ngo gdong bcos ma zhig dang snang ba mi bde ba zhig sbyin nges/ ngo gdong gi cha kha shas la skag rtsi kha dog mi gcig pa byugs na ngo dbyibs la legs bcos phran bu re byed thub/ glog 'od rgyag phyogs kyis ngo 301

tshugs bsgyur srid la/ skag rtsi'i kha dogami 'dra bas kyang ngo tshugs 'gyur bar byed thub/ dper na/ dmar shos che ba'i skag rtsi mkhur tshos steng byugs tshe ngo sha bkang ba'i snang ba sbyin pa dang dmar shos che ba'i skag rtsi mkhur tshos kyi 'gram gnyis nas yar byugs tshe ngo tshugs cung skam pa'i snang ba sbyin thub/'gyur ldog 'di rigs de 'dra'i mngon gsal zhig min yang tshad nges can gyi thad nas ngo tshugs je legs su gtong thub/ smin ma yang ngo gdong mdzes spras byed yul gal chen red/ mi la la'i smin ma srab pas/ glog 'od drag po'i khrod lhag par thar thor yin pa'i snang ba sbyin/ smin mar mdzes spras 'os 'tsham byas na/ ngo gdong la lhag par gson nyams ldan par byed thub/smin ma 'bri skabs smin ris ltar rim bzhin srab pa nas stug por 'bri dgos pa las/ smin ma'i ma gzhi'i skyes dbyibs las brgal ba dang yang na thog ma nas bris pa shin tu stug mi 'os/ thog ma nas bris pa stug pa dang yang na bris pa tshad las brgal na bcos ma'i snang ba ster nges/ mi la la'i smin ma cung stug pa dang smin ma skyes tshad gra dag min tshe/ ched las mdzes spras mi sna gdan drangs nas legs bcos byas chog mig ni mi'i bzhin ras kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin/ mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i mig zung gis mi'i bzhin ras mdzes sdug rnam par bkra bar byed/ der brten mig zung gi mdzes spras la brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa tshang mas ha cang gtsigs su 'dzin/ lhag par du bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa skyes ma rnams kyis lhag par gcigs 'dzin byed pa yin/ mig la mdzes spras byed pa de yang mig dkyus 'bri ba dang mig skag byug pa/ rdzi ma sbyor ba bcas byas chog mig dkyus 'bri ba ni mig dbyibs ltar mig rtsibs steng du kha dog cung 302

nas pa'i thig yang mo zhig bris tshe/ mig je che dang je dwangs yin pa'i snang ba zhig sbyin thub/ yin yang bris pa mi legs tshe mig zung cha mi mnyam pa dang yang na mig bltas la mi bde ba'i bcos ma'i tshor ba 'byung srid pas/ mig dkyus 'bri dus nges par du 'os shing 'tsham pa bya dgos/ mig skag byug pa ni mig skyi'i klad dang mig dong bar du byugs nas mig skag gi kha dog 'gyur ba las mig dang mig dong gi rim pa gsal bar byed pa de yin/ mi la la'i mig zung 'bur tshigs su yod tshe/ mig skag byugs nas snyom sgrig byas chog mig skag byug dus rang gi mig gi gnas tshul dngos dang bstun nas 'os 'tsham sgos 'byug dgos pa las/ rang snang gang shar gyis 'byug mi rung / gal te mig skag byugs pa 'os 'tsham min tshe/ khyod kyi ngo gdong hril bo'i mdzes pa la gnod pa thebs srid/ rdzi ma ring na mig la lhag par mdzes nyams ldan/ nam rgyun glu dbyangs len mkhan sogs 'khrab ston pas 'khrab ston byed skabs rang gi gar stegs steng gi snang brnyan mdzes par byed ched rtag par rdzi ma bcos ma sbyor ba yin mod/ yin na'ang brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas dmigs bsal gyi le tshan te/ gzab rgyas che ba'i rig rtsal dbong tshogs sogs la 'go 'dzin byed dus dgong tshogs kyi gzab rgyas che ba'i rnam pa dang mthun par byed ched/ gyon gos dang rgyan cha sogs cung gzab 'phyor ldan par byed pa dang de dang bstun nas ngo gdong gi mdzes spras kyang nam rgyun las cung sgeg nyams ldan par byas nas rdzi ma bcos ma'ang sbyar chog pa ma gtogs spyir btang gi le tshan khrod du rdzi ma bcos ma sbyor mi 'os/ glog 'od shin tu drag pa'i khang ba'i nang du ngo mdangs skya bor 'gyur ba dang de bzhin du mchu'i mdog kyang skya bor 'gyur bas/ de la'ang dmar rtsi 'os 'tsham byugs nas je 303

gsal du gtong dgos/ dmar rtsi byugs na da dung mchu dbyibs legs bcos byed thub/ mchu dbyibs la dmar rtsi byug tshul gyis mchu'i 'thug srab dang kha'i che chung sogs legs bcos byas nas mchu dbyibs kyi zhan cha 'gebs pa'i nus pa bskyed thub/ brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ skag byug pa ni mdzes spras kho na'i ched du ma yin par/ de ni le tshan gyi blang bya dang mthun pa'i bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i snang brnyan gsar bzheng byed pa'i go rim zhig kyang yin/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas lag len byed pa'i le tshan mi gcig pas/ snang brnyan thad kyi blang bya'ang so sor mi 'dra/ gsar 'gyur rigs kyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pas mdzes spras mang po byed mi 'os/ mdzes spras mang drags tshe gsar 'gyur gyi bden dngos nang don dang mi mthun par gyur nas lta mkhan la tshor ba mi legs pa sbyin nges/ khang ba'i phyi dang yul dngos nas bcar 'dri byed dus rab yin na nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod dang 'dra bar skag mi 'byug pa dang yang na nyung ngu tsam las ma byugs na legs/304

lnga pa/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin thad kyi bsam gzhig thor bu/rang rgyal du rgya skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin de ni phyi yul gyi cha rkyen dang khor yug gi cha rkyen sogs dang bstun nas da lta gzhi khyon dang chu tshad/ grangs ka sogs phyogs yongs nas 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod cing /mig sngar rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas so sor rlung 'phrin khang dang brnyan 'phrin khang che 'bring chung gsum mang po yod/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ni rig gnas tshan khag gsar ba zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ rgyal yongs kyi slob grwa chen mo mi nyung ba na rgya skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi ched las tshan khag btsugs yod cing / lo mang ring gi 'tshol zhib dang lag len/ slob khrid nyams myong bcas brgyud nas da lta rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi ma lag cung cha tshang bar gyur te/ de'i thad kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs skor gyi dpe deb dang dpyad rtsom/ khrid rgyun sogs 'bor chen yod par ma zad/ da dung rgyun mi chad par legs bcos dang 'thus tshang du gtong mus su mchis/rigs gzhung tshan khag dang yang na bya dngos gsar ba gang dang gang yin rung tshang mas lo rgyus kyi dus rim nges can zhig gi nang du spyi tshogs kyi lag len yang yang brgyud nas rim bzhin 'thus tshang du gyur pa red/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs nyi shu pa'i dus mgor byung ba nas ha lam lo ngo brgya phrag ring gi 'phel rgyas bzhud lam ring mo brgyud de rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin der 305

yang gnam sa bla 'og gi 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin yod/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa sleb la nye ba'i dus su/ srol rgyun gyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin la 'gyur ldog gsar ba byung nas sa khongs las brgal nas brgyud bsgrags byed pa dang smyan byed las brgal nas gong du spel ba/ rig gnas las brgal nas brje res byed pa'i deng rabs kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi dus rabs gsar ba bsus 'ongs/ bod skad rlung 'phrin gyis dus rabs phyed ka lhag gi brgyud rim brgyud pa dang bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyis kyang ha lam lo ngo sum cu'i bzhud lam brgyud nas/ da lta bod khul gyi sa cha so so nas rang mi rigs kyi le tshan sna tshogs la lta thub/yin na yang bod skad brnyan 'phrin la dmigs nas bshad na/ rgyu rkyen gang mang gis tshod 'dzin thebs nas deng rabs brnyan 'phrin gyi chu tshad dang bsdur na da dung bar thag cung ring bo zhig yod/ nye ba'i lo 'ga' la bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi phyi yul gyi cha rkyen cung je legs su song ba dang phyogs so so'i bya ba'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa dang bstun nas le tshan gyi sgrig bkod dang le tshan gyi grangs ka dang rgyu spus/ las byed mi sna'i byed sgo'i byang tshad sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas mthor 'degs mngon gsal byung nas dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras blangs shing spyi tshogs kyi phyogs so so dang rim pa so so'i rgya che'i lta mkhan rnams kyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog kyang bar med du gtor/bod skad brnyan 'phrin dbu brnyes pa'i nyin de nas bzung / 'phel rgyas kyi dus skabs so so'i gyar byor gyi gom pa'i 'degs 'jog re re'i khrod rgan rabs pa mang po'i dka' spyad kyi rngul chu 'dres yod pa dang dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras re re'i phugs na mi mang po'i dga' la skyo ba'i mchi mas brlan 306

'dug de yang dang thog gi kun gyis rtogs dka' ba'i dka' spyad kyi khul chu dang skyo sdug gi mchi mas ma bskyangs na/ da lta'i g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bu dang bsngags brjod kyi me tog de rigs ji ltar 'byung / der brten da lta'i gnas bab legs po 'di gces 'dzin byed pa dang sngon rabs pa'i srol rgyun bzang po rgyun 'dzin byas nas bod skad kyi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin skyon bral ngang je rgyas je legs su gtong rgyu ni bod skad rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi las byed mi sna re re'i 'dor du med pa'i lo rgyus kyi las 'gan red/bod skad brnyan 'phrin 'di nyid lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi 'phel rim brgyud nas da lta 'phel rgyas mdun ljongs shin tu legs po ldan/ yin na'ang mdun ljongs legs po 'di nyid kyi mjug legs por skyong bar da dung myur du mthor 'degs dang legs bcos bya dgos pa'i phyogs shin tu mang la las 'gan yang ha cang lci ba red/ de yang las byed dpung sde'i spyi khog gi byang tshad dang chu tshad mthor 'degs dang le tshan gyi sgrig bkod 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang spus tshad mthor 'degs byed pa sogs ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi mdun du lhags pa'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gnad don red/gcig las byed dpung sde'i spyi khog gi chu tshad mthor 'jigs byed pa'i gal chen rang bzhin/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ni rig gnas brgyud bsgrags yo byad gsar ba zhig yin pa'i cha nas/ der spyi tshogs 'dzugs skrun dang rig gnas 'dzugs skrun/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun thad kyi bye brag gi gshis nus ldan 307

pa red/ rig gnas 'dzugs skrun thad nas bshad na/ des mi'i rigs kyi shes rig brgyud bsgrags byed pa dang sngon thon gyi rig gnas gsar ba gsar gtod byed par ma zad/ da dung rig gnas slob gso dang rig gnas rol rtsed/ rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa 'i spyi tshogs kyi gshis nus gal chen 'don spel byed pa yin/ rig gnas gsar ba zhig yin pa'i cha nas de la'ang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i nang don ldan/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyi brgyud bsgrags lag rtsal dang le tshan brgyud gtong gi phyi'i cha rkyen dang byed thabs ni rgyal khab so so dang mi rigs so so 'dra mtshungs red/ mi 'dra ba ni brgyud bsgrags kyi yo byad 'di la brten nas mtshon pa'i rig gnas kyi nang don red/ mi rigs gang dang gang gi rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin yin yang mi rigs de dang de yi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rtsa bar zug na da gzod de'i tshe srog la gson shugs drag po rgyas nges/der brten brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan zhig yin na brnyan 'phrin ched las shes byar byang dgos par ma zad/ rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas rmang gzhi nges can zhig yod dgos/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi mi sna phal che ba mi rigs slob grwa'i bod yig ched las 'dzin grwa nas mthar phyin pa dang / brnyan 'phrin las rigs kyi byed sgo la cha rgyus med pas/ las gnas su zhugs rjes rgan rabs pa'i rjes 'brangs nas slob zhor du sgrub pa dang sgrub zhor du slob pa red/ rgan rabs pa rnams kyis kyang bya ba dngos kyi lag len khrod 'tshol zhib byas te/ nyams myong mang po bsags yod na'ang / mun nag tu lag nyob byed pa lta bu'i 'tshol zhib khrod lam thag ring mo brgyud pa dang tha na bskor lam yang mang po brgyud phyin/ gong 'phel dang yar thon gyi 'gros dal ba red/ mi 308

mang che bas sngon na lag len gyi nyams myong brgyud nas da gzod brnyan 'phrin shes bya mang po ngos zin pa yin la/ ngos zin de dag kyang rang rang gi 'tshol zhib las thob pa'i nyams myong zhig yin pa'i cha nas de 'dra'i rgyud rim ldan pa dang de 'dra cha tshang ba zhig yin mi srid/ nyams myong la la lag len dngos su 'debs kyin yod kyang gzhung lugs su grub med pas yongs khyab rang bzhin chen po med/ da lta spyi yongs nas bshad na brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal la gnam sa bla 'og sga 'gyur ldog byung ba dang de dang bstun nas brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi sgrub stangs dang rnam pa sogs la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po 'byung bzhin yod cing / bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi gnas bab la'ang rtsa ba nas 'gyur ldog byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pas/ byed sgo mi snar ched las gso sbyong bya rgyu dang las byed dpung sde'i spyi khog gi chu tshad mthor 'degs bya rgyu ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi 'phel rgyas hril bor rag las pa'i gnad don shin tu gal che ba zhig red/las byed mi sna'i spyi khog bi chu tshad zer ba der go don phyogs gnyis nas bstan chog ste/ gcig ni dpung sde hril bo'i spyi'i chu tshad dang gzhan gcig ni las byed mi sna re re'i bye brag gi chu tshad phyogs gnyis 'dus/ dpung sde hril bo'i spyi'i chu tshad zer ba de ni las byed dpung sde'i chab srid rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad dang byed sgo'i chu tshad/ rig gnas yon tan gyi chu tshad/ bya ba'i kun spyod kyi chu tshad/ bya ba'i phyogs bsdus nus pa/ 'go khrid rim pa'i do dam nus pa sogs phyogs yongs kyi chu tshad rigs shig la bstan pa yin/ dpung sde hril bo'i spyi'i chu tshad de yang mthar gtugs nas bshad na las byed mi sna re re'i bye brag gi chu tshad las grub pa ni bshad ma dgos la/309

dpung sde'i gtso shugs kyi cha la bstan pa zhig yin/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi las byed dpung sde khrod kyi las byed mi sna mang che ba'i phyogs yongs kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs byung na/ da gzod dpung sde'i spyi khog gi chu tshad la mthor 'degs 'byung ba dang / gal te las byed mi sna mang che ba'i phyogs yongs kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs ma byas na nyung shos kyi chu tshad ji 'dra mtho yang spyi khog gi tshab byed mi nus/ las byed dpung sde'i spyi khog gi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed par 'go khrid rim pa'i bsam gzhig dang ngos 'dzin stangs ni gnad 'gag yin/spyi khog gi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed par yang phyogs gnyis nas 'dzin dgos/ gcig nas 'go khrid rim pas thog ma nas mi sdud len byed dus de'i rig gnas chu tshad dang nang sgos su rang mi rigs skad yig gi chu tshad de cha rkyen gtso bor brtsis nas bsam blo gtong dgos shing / nam rgyun bya ba'i khrod du'ang dus dang rnam pa kun tu las byed mi snas chab srid gzhung lugs skor gyi shes byar slob pa dang kun spyod blo sbyong la do snang / sgos su rig gnas shes bya'i chu tshad rgyun mi chad par mthor 'degs byed par gcigs 'dzin byas te/ las byed mi sna re rer rig gnas shes bya ni le tshan legs sgrub byed pa'i rmang gzhi dang gnad 'gag yin pa'i 'du shes chags su 'jug dgos par ma zad/ bye brag gi byed thabs sna tshogs spyad de 'du shes de rigs gong 'og bar gsum gyi mi yod do cog gi bsam pa'i rgyud la goms pa'i rang rtogs kyi bya spyod dang bya ba dngos kyi khrod du rang shugs su thim pa'i goms srol dang 'du shes brtan po zhig tu chags par bya dgos/gnyis nas nam rgyun bya ba'i khrod las byed mi sna rang nyid kyi sbyang 310

stobs la brten nas rang sbyong byed par skul ma gtong ba las gzhan/ da dung gso sbyong 'dzin grwa sna tshogs bsgrub pa dang rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin las rigs khrod kyi ched las mkhas pa gdan drangs nas dus thung slob khrid byed pa/ de min 'char gzhi yod pa dang dmigs yul yod pa/ gdam gses yod pa'i ngang las byed mi sna la la rgya skad kyi ched las slob grwa dang yang na krung dbyang brnyan 'phrin khang sogs spun zla brnyan 'phrin khang che gras la dus yun thung ngu'i ring gi ched las slob sbyong la mngags nas/ deng rabs brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal gyi mtshon thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la nang byan chud par bya dgos/bod skad rlung 'phrin la mtshon na/ rgyu rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis mi mang po ched las slob gyur skyel nas gso sbyong bya rgyu ni shin tu dka' mo zhig red/ gtso bo nam rgyun gyi bya ba'i khrod du sngon mas rjes ma khrid pa'i srol rgyun gyi thabs la brten dgos pa dang mi re re'i rang sbyong gi rtsal la brten dgos shing / de'i zhor du rtsa 'dzugs yod pa'i nang khul gyi gso sbyong la brten dgos pa ni smos ma dgos pa red/ yin na'ang 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi sna kha shas ched las slob grwa sogs nas dus yun thung ngu'i gso sbyong bya rgyu de yang shin tu dgos gal che ba zhig red/ da lta brnyan 'phrin gyi lag rtsal dang le tshan gyi rnam pa nyin ltar gong du 'phel ba dang de'i khar bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi gzhi khyon je cher song ba dang bstun nas le tshan gyi sna kha je mang du song ba dang mi sna'ang je mang du song nas 'phel rgyas kyi lam gsar bar 'jug bzhin pas na/ched las mi snar gso sbyong dang ched las mi sna'i byed sgo'i chu tshad mthor 'degs byed rgyu'i thad kyi dgos gal lhag par che ba red/ der brten thabs brgya jus stong sgos rgyang ring gi 'char gzhi 'then te lo rer mi gcig gnyis re 311

ched las slob grwar mngags nas sbyang bya'i nang don dang lag rtsal mi 'dra ba ltar dus nges can la slob sbyong byed pa dang sbyang bya'i nang don thad kyang dmigs yul yod pa ste/ so sor brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi sgrig sbyor lag rtsal dang yang na de'i thad kyi 'phrul chas rigs kyi bkol stangs dang le tshan sna tshogs kyi 'khrab khrid jus bkod thabs rtsal sogs le tshan phab skrun gyi phyogs so sor mi sna bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham byed pa/ mi mngags skabs kyang lo na gzhon zhing rig gnas rmang gzhi bzang ba dang sbyang stobs che zhing sbyangs nas phyir log rjes bya ba dngos kyi thad bkol mkhas par ma zad/ mi gzhan la sne khrid byed thub pa'i mi sna 'jon thang can gdam gses byas nas mngags pa bcas byas na/ las byed dpung sde'i spyi khog gi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed par nus pa gal chen bskyed thub snyam/ rig gnas chu tshad ni mi zhig gi byed sgo'i chu tshad dang phyogs bsdus nus pa sogs phyogs yongs kyi chu tshad mthor 'degs byed pa dang rjes phyogs gong 'phel gyi rmang gzhi yin pas/ rig gnas chu tshad nges can zhig yod na da gzod rjes phyogs kyi bya ba'i khrod yar thon gyi gnas bab mtho ba red/ mi rigs skad rigs kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan zhig yin tshe/ brnyan 'phrin gyi thabs shes yod do cog tshang ma mi rigs kyi skad rigs rig gnas rmang gzhi byas pa'i steng mtshon dgos la/ brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal gyi mtshon thabs dang mi rigs skad rigs rig gnas gnyis zung du sbrel ba'i brnyan 'phrin brtsams chos la da gzod mi rigs kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan zhes brjod chog rig gnas rmang gzhi legs po ldan pa dang brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon thabs sna tshogs khong du chud na nang don gyi phugs zab pa dang spus tshad legs pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan sna tshogs sgrub thub/ brnyan 'phrin las rigs 312

kyi bya ba ni rig gnas las rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar nying 'jags kyi khor yug cig tu gnas gcig tu bsdad de mtha' gcig tu dpe cha klog sbyang byed pa'i khor yug mi ldan par/ rtag par phyi'i zang zing gi 'du 'dzi'i bya 'gul khrod du yar rgyug mar rgyug bya dgos pa dang las ku'i grub cha rnyog 'dzing yin la/ thog mtha' kun tu spyi tshogs kyi rim pa so sos do snang bya yul du 'gyur ba'i bya ba'i khyad chos kyis bar chad thebs pas/ rig gnas slob sbyong la do snang bya rgyur rang ngo nas snying rus bskyed dgos par ma zad/ gong 'og bar gsum nas mthong chen bya dgos/ sngon chad mi la las brnyan 'phrin ni brnyan ris gtso yin pa dang brnyan 'phrin lag rtsal gtso che bas rig gnas chu tshad dang nang sgos su rang mi rigs kyi skad rigs rig gnas kyis de'i khrod du nus pa chen po bskyed mi thub par snyam la/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan zhig bsgrubs dus kyang de'i mtshon stangs dang brnyan ris kyi jus bkod sogs gtso che ba las de'i yig thog dang skad char nus pa chen po med par snyam/ rgya skad dang rgya yig la brten pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan bsgrubs nas der phung che ba'i rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin las rigs gtso che ba dang rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin mkhas pa gtso che ba'i bya 'gul rigs sna tshogs khrod bya dga' 'thob par brtson rgyu de ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi bya ba byed mkhan dang bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi chu tshad la gdeng 'jog byed pa'i tshad gzhi gcig pur brtsi ba lta bur snang /don dam pas bshad na/ bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan la mtshon na/ rim pa so so'i rgya skad kyi le tshan dpyad bsdur khrod mtshan snyan brtson thub pa'i rgya skad la brten nas rang mi rigs kyi brjod bya mtshon pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan spus legs shig phab skrun bya rgyu de ni las sla mo zhig min 313

la/ mi re re'i nus pas lcogs pa zhig de las kyang yin mi srid/ le tshan de rigs kyis phyogs kha shas nas bshad na/ mi sger dang bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi thun mong gi chu tshad ngom pa dang bod skad brnyan 'phrin dang bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas yul ljongs sogs gzhan la dril bsgrags byed par dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa thon pas/ mi su dang su yin yang de'i nus pa dang dge mtshan khas len dgos la/ rjes phyogs su'ang skabs skabs su ched du mi sna rtsa 'dzugs byas nas dmigs yul yod pa'i ngang de lta bu'i le tshan re gnyis bsgrub 'os/ rang nyid dril bsgrags byed pa dar che ba'i da lta'i dus 'dir/mgo skur skur byas nas las shes pa kho nas mi chog par kha mdong mdong byas nas bshad mkhas pa zhig kyang mkho ba 'dra/ yin na'ang le tshan de lta bu ni bod skad rlung 'phrin gyi bya ba'i snying bo ma red/ rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi lta mkhan ni rim pa so so'i rgya che ba'i bod rigs mang tshogs yin la/ de'i nang du bod skad dang bod yig la mkhas shing rgya skad dang rgya yig kyang shes pa'i rig gnas pa yod par ma zad/ rig gnas yon tan med pa dang rgya skad dang rgya yig mi shes pa'i spyir btang gi gzhi rim mang tshogs kyang 'dus la/ des da dung nga tsho'i lta mkhan khrod bsdur tshad chen po zin/ de bas nga tsho'i le tshan gyi gdong phyogs yul ni rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs red/rim pa mtho sa nas mtshan snyan dang bya dga' thob pa'i bod kyi brjod bya'i rgya skad kyi le tshan zhig gis nga tsho rang gi rgya che'i bod rigs lta mkhan khrod du shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa'i nges pa med/ bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin la gal che ba ni mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang sa gnas kyi khyad chos ldan la/ rang mi rigs kyi lta mkhan gyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i rang gi skad rigs kyi le tshan 314

sna tshogs legs sgrub byed pa de yin/ des na brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon thabs shes dgos par ma zad/ mtshon thabs de rigs la brten nas mtshon par bya ba'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas la de bas kyang byang dgos/ gal te bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan sgrub mkhan zhig la rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas rmang gzhi nges can zhig med pa dang rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas lo rgyus sogs la cha rgyus zab mo med par/ brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon thabs kho nar mkhas pa tsam gyis nang don gting zab la go don rgya che ba'i le tshan legs po sgrub pa'i nus pa ldan mi srid/las byed mi sna'i bye brag gi chu tshad de yang spyi khog gi chu tshad kyi grub cha yin pas/ de yang nang don gyi cha nas de gnyis gcig mtshungs yin te/ spyi khog gi chu tshad ni mi sna'i bye brag gi chu tshad 'dra min mnyam gcig tu 'dus nas mtshon pa'i thun mong gi cha snyoms kyi chu tshad cig la zer ba yin/ mi re rer mtshon na kho tsho'i bya ba'i nus pa dang byed sgo'i chu tshad/ rig gnas yon tshad sogs 'dra mnyam yin mi srid kyang blang bya ni tshang ma 'dra ba yin/ brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi byed las grub cha'i khrod las bgos mi 'dra ba mang ba ltar/las byed mi sna'i las bgos kyang gsar 'god pa dang sgrig sbyor ba/ bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa sogs dang le tshan gyi nang don gyi cha nas yang gsar 'gyur dang spyi tshogs slob gso/ rig rtsal bcas le tshan so sor mi 'dra ba red/de bas las byed mi snas rang rang gi bye brag gi byed sgo'i thabs rtsal khong du chud par bya dgos/ dus mtshungs su rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas shes bya'i chu tshad mthor 'degs bya rgyu ni las bgos khag gang yin yang tshang mar gal che/gsar 'god pa zhig la dpe bzhag nas bshad na/ rig gnas rmang gzhi'i 315

rdzong stug na da gzod spyir btang gi gsar 'gyur gnas tshul thung ngu'i rigs spel thub par ma zad/ nang don gting zab cing shugs rkyen cung chen po bzo thub la yi ge 'bri rtsal la shin tu byang dgos pa'i ched sgrig gsar 'gyur dang dpyad gtam brjod pa'i gsar 'gyur rigs spel nus pa dang / bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin par mtshon na/ rig gnas rmang gzhi bzang ba dang shes bya'i rgya yangs na/ le tshan bshad pa dang 'go 'dzin byed pa'i dus mtshungs su rang nyid dngos su le tshan gyi phab skrun go rim yongs la zhugs pa dang le tshan sna tshogs kyi bcar 'dri dang rtsom sgrig 'go 'dzin sogs kyi 'gan gcig lcogs su khur te/ phyogs bsdus nus pa can du gyur tshe/ rang nyid la mtshon na rang gi bya gzhag gi mdun ljongs yangs par ma zad/ rang mi rigs kyi brnyan 'phrin las don la'ang rang gi yod 'os pa'i byas rjes 'jog thub/ ma 'ongs pa'i brnyan 'phrin las don gyi 'phel phyogs la bltas na/ phyogs bsdus nus pa mthor 'dregs bya rgyu ni las byed mi sna'i gong spel kha phyogs yin la/ phyogs bsdus nus pa mthor 'degs byed na lhag par du rig gnas shes bya'i rgyab skyor la brten dgos/gnyis/ le tshan gyi sgrig bkod 'thus tshang du gtong ba dang me tshan gyi spus tshad mthor 'degs bya dgos/bod skad brnyan 'phrin legs sgrub byed na/ gtso bo bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi le tshan sna tshogs legs sgrub bya dgos/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin rim 316

bzhin rgya je cher song ba dang bstun nas bod skad le tshan gyi sna kha je mang du 'gro bzhin pa dang spus tshad kyang je legs su 'gro bzhin yod/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ le tshan gyi rigs ji 'dra yin yang / rang mi rigs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu ni dmigs yul gtso bo yin pa dang / mi rigs dang sa gnas kyi khyad chos mngon par 'phags par bya rgyu ni de'i tshe srog gi 'phar rtsa lta bu red/ mi mang pos lo mang ring la 'bad brtson byas pa brgyud/ da lta bod skad brnyan 'phrin la gsar 'gyur rigs kyi mtshon stangs rnam pa sna tshogs dang spyi tshogs slob gso thad kyi ched sgrig le tshan sna tshogs/ rig rtsal rigs kyi le tshan rnam pa sna tshogs yod cing / le tshan de dag gi brjod bya'i nang don dang rjod byed kyi rnam pa/ brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon stangs sogs tshang ma'ang nyin rer je zhib dang je legs su 'gro bzhin yod/ de yang mthar gtugs nas bshad na bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho red/ sngon chad bod skad le tshan thad nas/ phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi khyad chos gtso byas nas spyi tshogs slob gso'i ched sgrig le tshan dang rig rtsal rigs kyi ched sgrig le tshan sogs gang yin yang che phyogs kyi dbye mtshams 'byed pa las nang don la bye brag gi zhib cha shin tu gsal po byas med par/ nang don sna mang dang phyogs mang po'i brjod bya bkol bde bar byas yod/ de ni gcig nas skabs der le tshan gyi sna kha mi mang phyin/ le tshan gcig gis phyogs mang po'i nang don dang brjod bya sdud thub par bsam blo btang ba dang gnyis nas bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi skabs de'i phyi nang gi cha rkyen gyis tshod 'dzin thebs pa sogs rgyu rkyen gang mang yod la skabs de'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi gnas bab kyi dgos dbang red/317

mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ phun tshogs me long dang rma 'bri'i rlabs kyi zegs ma sogs ches thog mar rang gis phab skrun byas pa'i le tshan dang yang na ches thog ma'i dus kyi sgyur sgrig rang bzhin gyi le tshan te/gsar 'gyur le tshan dang mi rigs rig rtsal do ra/ 'dzam gling gi lus rtsal nga srog chags kyi zhing khams zer ba sogs dus nges gtan gyi le tshan/ de las gzhan thang bod gna' lam zhes pa dang nub rgyud kyi glu dbyangs/ krung go'i dpal mchog ces pa sogs bye brag gi le tshan bsgyur ma mang pos skabs de'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin la dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed cing / de re res mtsho sngon bod skad rlung 'phrin rim bzhin gong du 'phel ba'i gom pa'i 'degs 'jog re re mtshon/de yang brjod dgos pa zhig la/ nga tshos 'das par phyi mig lta ba'i dmigs yul ni nyams myong phyogs sdom byas nas sngar las yangs pa'i bzhud lam ded nas ma 'ongs par bskyod rgyu de yin pa las 'das pa khyad du gsod pa'i ched du min/ 'das pa khyad du bsad na lo rgyus khyad du bsad pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/ bya gzhag ci yin yang de'i lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi chu klung chen mo'i khrod du mi ni de las 'phyo ba'i rba rlabs kyi zegs ma 'thor bu tsam du snang bas/ mi yi rkyen gyis lo rgyus kyi don dngos khyad gsod dang yang na lo rgyus kyi don dngos zol bcos byed mi rung zhing / nga tshos 'das par phyi mig lta ba dang nyams myong phyogs sdom byed skabs/ da lta'i gnas bab dang da lta'i cha rkyen gyis skabs der blang bya 'don mi 'os la/ skabs de'i tshad gzhi la brten nas da lta'i yod tshad la tshad thig kyang len mi rung bar/ dngos thog bden 'tshol dang yo gzur med cing phyogs ris dang bral ba'i lo rgyus kyi lta ba 318

rnam dag cig 'dzin rgyu ni shin tu gal che'o/ / rgyu mtshan ni slad kyis ma skyon zhing dri mas ma gos pa'i lo rgyus kyi ngo gdong dngos ma nyid ji ma ji bzhin du zin thor 'debs rgyu ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi bya ba byed mkhan re re'i las 'gan red/sngon chad kyi bod skad brnyan 'phrin dang bsdur na/ da lta bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi sna kha je mang du song ba dang brjod bya'i nang don je zhib tu song zhing le tshan gyi spus tshad kyang mthor 'degs chen po byung yod/yin na yang nga tsho sngon chad dang bsdur bzhin yid tshim nas 'dug mi 'os par bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi 'phel tshul dang bstun nas da yod le tshan gyi grub stangs dang sgrub stangs 'thus tshang dang spus tshad mthor 'degs bya dgos/bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan gang yin yang rang mi rigs dang rang sa gnas la rkang tshugs pa dang mi rigs rang gi khyad chos dang sa gnas rang gi khyad chos gzhir bzung nas mi rigs rang gi 'phel rgyas gnas tshul dang rig gnas goms srol/ gshis rgyud dang sems khams sogs mtshon par byas na da gzod rtsa ba brtan po zug nas kho lag rab tu rgyas nges/ da lta bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi le tshan la gsar 'gyur rigs dang spyi tshogs slob gso rigs kyi ched sgrig le tshan sna tshogs/ nang don dang mtshon stangs/ rnam pa sogs mi 'dra ba'i rig rtsal gyi le tshan sna tshogs yod cing nang don dang mtshon stangs sogs kyi thad nas bshad na'ang zhib phra'i cha la 'bad brtson byed kyin yod/bod skad brnyan 'phrin de yang dus rabs kyi rjes snyeg dgos na da dung phyogs gang mang nas 'bad brtson bya dgos/ le tshan gyi sgrig bkod thad nas bshad na'ang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos sa da dung mang po mchis/ de 319

la'ang rgyu rkyen gang mang gi dbang gis la la ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi da snga'i phyi yul gyi cha rkyen dang mthun rkyen la rag las pas mi shugs kyis lcogs pa zhig ma red/ yin na'ang la la ni da yod kyi cha rkyen 'og legs bcos dang 'thus tshang du gtong thub pa zhig red/ thog mar gsar 'gyur thad nas bltas na/ da snga rang re'i gsar 'gyur bya ba byed mkhan rnams kyis bod yig dang bod skad kyis bcar 'dri byas nas spel ba'i nus pa ches cher mthor 'degs byung yod/ zhib phra'i steng nas bltas tshe/ de yang spyir btang gi gsar 'gyur yin na 'dra/ brjod bya dang rnam pa cung che ba'i gsar 'gyur bya 'gul dang bstud mur spel ba'i mu 'brel gsar 'gyur yin na'ang 'dra/ tshang ma brnyan ris la sbyar ba'i thabs kyis gnas tshul spel ba'i gsar 'gyur mtshon stangs gtso che bas/ mtshon stangs thad nas de 'dra'i phun sum tshogs pa zhig min par/ ched don rang bzhin gyi gsar 'gyur dang yang na bcar 'dri'i nus pa shas che ba'i skabs thog gi dpyad gtam brjod pa'i tshul gyi gsar 'gyur gyi rigs shin tu nyung ba dang / gsar 'god pas yul dngos nas dngos su rang gi skad char brten nas gsar 'gyur spel ba'i rigs shin tu nyung / gsar 'gyur ni dus thog rang bzhin ha cang drag pa dang ring thung la tshad yod pa'i gnas tshul spel stangs shig yin la/ gsar 'gyur ni rgya che'i lta mkhan rnams kyi nye 'khor du byung ba dang kho cho'i 'tsho ba'i phyogs so so dang 'brel ba dam pas/ rgya che'i lta mkhan rnams la de'i thad kyi shes 'dod kyi re ba'ang shin tu drag pa red/ der brten gsar 'gyur gyis lhag par yongs khyab rang bzhin gyi don snying ldan pa'i gsar 'gyur don rkyen dang yang na spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul/ de min kun gyis do snang byed pa'i gnad don sogs la 320

bsam 'char dang lta tshul brjod pa dang rgya che'i lta mkhan la dril bsgrags dang mtshams sbyor byed pa sogs kyi las 'gan khur yod pas/ dus nges gtan med par dgos mkho'i skabs su dpyad gtam brjod pa'i tshul gyi gsar 'gyur dang ched don gsar 'gyur spel na/ gsar 'gyur don rkyen de nang don gting zab cing rgya che ba'i ngang spel chog la/ rgya che'i lta mkhan khrod shugs rkyen chen po bzos nas gsar 'gyur gyi 'gugs shugs dang nus shugs je drag tu gtong thub/ dpyad gtam brjod pa'i tshul gyi gsar 'gyur spel stangs ni gsar 'gyur rigs kyi le tshan gyi grub cha gal chen zhig red/ de yang dpyad gtam brjod pa'i gsar 'gyur gyi nang don dang rnam pa/ sgrub stangs sogs shin tu mang ste/ nga tshos rang gi gnas tshul dang bstun nas gang la gang 'tsham dang nus pas lcogs tshad kyis sgrub chog pa dang thog mar dpyad gtam thung ngu dang gsar 'gyur rjes kyi rtsom sgrig pa'i dpyad gtam thung ngu brjod pa dang yang na 'brel yod mi sna gdan drangs nas gleng mol byed pa sogs rnam pa 'os 'tsham spyad chog dper na/ lo re'i dmangs 'thus tshogs chen dang srid gros tshogs chen/ de min bya 'gul gal chen gzhan dag skabs su ched dmigs kyi spel stangs bkol nas ched don gsar 'gyur rtsa 'dzugs byas na/ gsar 'gyur gyi nang don gting je zab dang gsar 'gyur gyi mtshon stangs phun tshogs su phyin nas gsar 'gyur gyi 'gugs shugs je drag tu gtong thub/ nga tsho'i mig snga'i bod skad gsar 'gyur khrod gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur brnyan ris la ram 'degs byed pa'i bcar 'dri thung ngu re rgyun du mthong mod/yin na'ang yul dngos nas dngos su gsar 'gyur don rkyen thad kur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur rigs dang yul dngos nas thad kur brnyan len 'phrul chas 321

las gsar 'gyur bshad thub pa'i gsar 'god pa shin tu nyung / gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur don rkyen rgyab ljongs byas nas thad kur brnyan len 'phrul chas brgyud nas gsar 'gyur bshad pa'i gsar 'gyur spel stangs de ni spyir btang gi gnas tshul bsgrags pa dang ched don gsar 'gyur/ dpyad gtam brjod pa'i gsar 'gyur sogs gang du'ang bkol chog pa dang / gsar 'gyur gyi mgo brjod kyi tshul du bkol ba dang / yang na gsar 'gyur gyi bar dang mjug tu bkol na'ang chog pa red/ gsar 'god pas yul dngos nas thad mar brnyan len 'phrul chas brgyud nas gsar 'gyur bshad na/ gsar 'gyur gyi bden dngos rang bzhin mthor 'degs byed thub/ gsar 'god pas gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi yul dngos nas lta mkhan la gdong phyogs te brnyan len 'phrul chas las gsar 'gyur don rkyen mtshams sbyor byed pa dang 'brel/ brnyan ris la brten nas gsar 'gyur don rkyen gyi yul dngos kyi gnas tshul bsgrags rjes/ mjug tu slar yang gsar 'god pas don rkyen la spyi bsdoms mdor bsdus dang yang na dpyad gtam thung ngu re brjod tshe / lta mkhan gyi snang ngor gsar 'gyur 'di rigs sngar las yid rton thub pa dang sngar las bden pa bden dngos yin pa'i tshor ba sbyin thub la/ gsar 'gyur gyi yul dngos kyi tshor ba je drag tu btang nas lta mkhan la don rkyen dngos kyi khrod zhugs pa'i snang ba sbyin nas gsar 'gyur gyi 'gugs shugs je drag tu gtong thub pa ma zad / brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon shugs je legs su btang nas lta mkhan la bag chags zab mo 'jog thub/ gsar 'gyur de rigs spel ba'i gsar 'god par ma gzhir yod dgos pa'i gsar 'god pa'i thun mong gi blang bya las gzhan/ da dung phra zhing zhib pa'i lta zhib nus pa dang skad cha'i 322

mtshon nus legs po ldan dgos shing / de min gyon chas sogs kyang rang snang gang shar yin mi rung bar brnyan 'phrin las bshad skabs kyi rang gi snang brnyan la do snang bya dgos pa sogs kyi dmigs bsal gyi cha rkyen ldan dgos/da lta bod skad brnyan 'phrin la spyi tshogs slob gso'i ched sgrig le tshan gyi rigs mi nyung ba yod pa dang / nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas sgrub stangs dang khyad chos thad mthor 'degs chen po byung dang 'byung bzhin mchis/ nga tsho bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi spyi tshogs slob gso'i ched sgrig le tshan de yang le tshan ci zhig bsgrubs kyang le tshan gyi thog ma'i jus bkod dang / nang don dang brjod bya'i mtshon stangs gtan la phab tshul/ bcar 'dri'i nang don dang brjod bya'i thad kyi rgyu cha dang gleng gzhi gra sgrig sogs le tshan ma phab sngon gyi gra sgrig bya ba sna tshogs legs sgrub byas na da gzod nang don zab cing spus legs pa'i le tshan phab skrun byed thub/ de ni le tshan sgrub dus nges par du bsgrub dgos pa'i ma mtha'i cha rkyen zhig red/ yin yang dang thog nga tsho bod skad brnyan 'phrin la phyogs so so'i cha rkyen shin tu zhan zhing dgos nges kyi mthun rkyen yang mi 'dzoms pa sogs kyis rkyen byas le tshan sgrub dus ma mtha'i cha rkyen de rigs kyang sgrub mi thub pa dang ci yang na sgrub par goms med pas/ thad mar le tshan gyi spus tshad la shugs rkyen thebs kyin yod/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin 'phel rgyas byung ba dang phyogs so so'i cha rkyen dang mthun rkyen je legs su song ba'i da lta'i dus su brjod bya gtan khel sogs kyi thad nas mthor 'degs mngon gsal byung yod kyang /da dung de 'dra'i 'thus tshang dang don thog la 'khyol ba zhig min par/ spyir btang rang bzhin gyi le tshan mang ba las nang don gyi phugs zab cing rgya che la 323

don gril ba'i le tshan spus legs mang po med cing / le tshan dang le tshan bar gyi nang don dang khyad chos de 'dra mi gsal bar le tshan la la kha byang mi 'dra yang don dngos su le tshan gyi nang don dang le tshan gyi khyad chos/ phyi'i rnam pa/yang na mtshon stangs sogs phyogs ga ge mo'i thad nas khyad par chen po med par phan tshun 'dra mtshungs yin phyin rang rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos med pa sogs kyi gnad don gnas yod/ gnad don de dag ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi spus tshad mthor 'degs byed pa'i gnad 'gag red/de las gzhan bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi da yod le tshan khrod da lta'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul mtshon pa'i le tshan mang la/ don dam pas bod mi rigs kyi bla srog lta bu'i srol rgyun rig gnas mtshon pa'i le tshan shin tu nyung bas/phyis de'i thad nas shugs snon bya dgos/rig rtsal le tshan ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi grub cha gal chen yin pas/ lo 'di 'ga'i ring bod skad brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal gyis bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin nang don phun tshogs su gtong ba dang bod rigs mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba phun tshogs su gtong bar nus pa gal chen bskyed/ mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin thog ma btsugs nas cang ma 'gor bar rim bzhin rig rtsal le tshan gyi mabo brtsams 4pa dang thog ma'i stabs bde'i rnam pa nas mi mang pos lo mang ring 'bad brtson byas pa'i mthus da lta brnyan 'phrin gyi khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos/ sa gnas kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon zhing bye brag gi nang don mang pos brgyan pa'i rig rtsal le tshan gyi rnam pa mang po me tog chun po re re bzhin bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi sa gshin du rnam par bkra nas dga' 'os pa'i grub 324

'bras blangs/ nang sgos su lo re'i dmangs khrod lo sar dgong tshogs sogs kyis dmangs khrod kyi nyams mus su 'gro bzhin pa'i bod kyi gna' bo'i rig gnas shul bzhag mang po dang gna' bo'i sgyu rtsal mang po myur skyob dang sngog 'don/ gong spel rgyud 'dzin sogs byed pa'i thad grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas ni rgya mtsho'i 'jing ltar gting dpag dka' la de'i 'byams klas pa'i nang don dang 'od du 'tsher ba'i khyad chos kyis bod skad brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal la 'dzad mtha' med pa'i 'o bcud sbyin pas/ ji ltar bsgrub rgyu'i mthu rtsal 'dzoms na ci zhig bsgrub rgyu'i 'dang rgyag yod mi srid/ nga tshos bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyis blangs zin pa'i grub 'bras la phyi mig lta ba'i dus mtshungs su ma 'ongs pa'i bzhud lam ring mo'ang mthong dgos/ da lta'i le tshan gyi grub stangs la bltas na/ rig rtsal dgong tshogs dang yang na skabs thog gi le tshan che rigs mang che shos dang tha na dus nges gtan gyi ched sgrig le tshan khrod du'ang gar stegs rig rtsal gyi rnam pa cung mang ba red/ rjes phyogs su brnyan 'phrin gyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i rig rtsal gyi rnam pa'i thad la shugs snon bya rgyur do snang bya dgos/ de yang bod kyi dmangs khrod rig gnas sgyu rtsal dang mi rigs kyi phul byung rig gnas sgyu rtsal dag kyang dgong tshogs kyi rnam pa la brten nas myur skyob dang rgyud 'dzin/dar spel bcas byed par do snang chen po byas kyang dus nges gtan gyi ched sgrig le tshan gyi rnam pas bsgrub pa mi 'dang snyam/ de ni brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal le tshan sgrub mkhan kho na'i las 'gan ma yin par bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi gong 'og bar gsum tshang mas bsam blo gtong dgos pa'i gnad don red/ de las gzhan da yod kyi rig rtsal le tshan khrod rol rtsed kyi rnam pa'i le tshan dang 325

nang sgos su lta mkhan thad kur le tshan la zhugs pa'i rol rtsed rigs kyi le tshan dkon/ rol rtsed rang bzhin gyi le tshan ni lta mkhan gyis ha cang dga' bsu byed pa'i le tshan rigs shig red/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi da lta'i cha rkyen la bltas na/ der rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyi tshod 'dzin thebs mod/ nga tshos thog mar rnam pa sogs thad nas rang gi gnas tshul dang bstun nas bsgrub tshe/bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi 'gugs shugs je drag tu gtong thub par gdon mi za/gsum/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan dgos/rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin ni mi rigs rig gnas kyi khag cig yin la/ rig gnas brgyud bsgrags bya rgyu ni de'i gshis nus mang po gras kyi gcig red/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin gyis lta mkhan gyi 'du shes dang bya spyod la shugs rkyen gting zab cing rgya chen po thebs kyin yod pas/ ha lam rgyal khab yod do cog tshang mas tshags par dang rlung 'phrin/ brnyan 'phrin sogs spyi byings kyi brgyud bsgrags spyan byed la bca' khrims dang kun spyod kyi tshad gzhi gtan khel byas yod/ rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin la mi rigs rig gnas rgyud 'dzin dang de phun tshogs su gtong ba/ dar spel byed pa/ gsar gtod byed pa bcas kyi las 'gan yod/ rig gnas phan tshun 'dres pa dang rig gnas phan tshun la shan shugs chen po thebs pa'i da lta'i dus 'dir/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyis kyang 'dzam gling gi phul byung rig gnas kyi dge ba'i cha hur thag gis sdud len byed zhor du mi rigs rang gi rig gnas kyi thun mong 326

ma yin pa'i khyad chos mngon par 'phags par byed pa dang mi rigs rang gi rig gnas la rgyun mi chad par rnam pa dang nang don gsar ba sbyin te/ rgyun mi chad par gsar gtod khrod du rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel byed thub pa bya dgos/ rig gnas shig la mtshon na/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos ni rig gnas de'i bla srog yin la/ rig gnas de yi rin thang mtshon sa'ang yin/ rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom thad nas bshad na/ ches gtsigs mthong byed pa ni gzhan dang mi mtshungs shing thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos yin la/ khyad chos de'i rtsa ba tshugs yul ni rdzong stug pa'i mi rigs rig gnas kyi gshin sa red/ mi rigs rig gnas kyi sreg bcad brdar gsum las btso sbyang yang yang thob pa'i rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal gyi brtsams chos kyis da gzod 'dzam gling gi rig gnas la gson shugs snon thub pa dang 'dzam gling gi mi rnams kyi yid dbang 'gugs nus/ der brten nga tsho'i rlung 'phrin dang brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyis thog mtha' kun tu rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas khyad chos rgyud 'dzin dang dar spel bya rgyu de rang gi 'dor du med pa'i las 'gan du brtsis nas brjod bya dang nang don/ rnam pa/ khyad chos/ mtshon stangs sogs phyogs so so nas mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi gshis rgyud mngon par 'phags par byas na da gzod 'dzam gling gi sna mang rig gnas khrod rkang brtan po tshugs thub/1 le tshan la rang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan dgos/de yang gsar 'gyur dang rig rtsal/ spyi tshogs slob gso skor gyi le tshan gang yin yang tshang mar rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'tsho ba mtshon par byed pa dang rang gi khyad chos ldan pa bya dgos/ rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 327

'tsho ba mtshon pa dang rang gi khyad chos ldan par byed na/ nges par du rang gi skad dang yi ge la brten pa dang rang mi rigs dang rang gi sa gnas kyi 'tsho bar zab zhugs byas nas rang gis bcar 'dri brnyan len bya dgos/ sal te mi rigs gzhan gyis brnyan len byas pa'i le tshan yig sgyur byed par brten na/de la mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod mi srid la/ rang mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba'ang mtshon mi nus/ bod kyi brjod bya'i le tshan zhig yin pa'i dbang du btang na yang / mi rigs gzhan pas skad rigs gzhan la brten nas brnyan phab byas tshe/ de yang yongs su bod kyi khyad chos 'dzoms pa zhig yin mi srid/ rgyu mtshan ni le tshan brnyan phab mkhan dang sgrig khrid pa'i bsam blo'i 'du shes dang rig gnas 'du shes/ le tshan gyi lta mkhan 'du shes sogs tha dad du gyur pas/ le tshan las mtshon pa'i khyad chos kyang sgrig khrid pa'i bsam blo dang rig gnas 'du shes de rigs rmang gzhi byas pa'i bsam gzhig las mngon pa'i khyad chos shig yin pa las bod kyi khyad chos rnal ma zhig yin mi srid/ de ni rig gnas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la rag pa red/ rgya mi rigs dang yang na mi rigs gzhan pas brnyan len byas pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas/ yul srol goms gshis sogs mtshon pa'i brnyan 'phrin le tshan khrod/ le tshan brnyan len byed mkhan la bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dang yul srol goms gshis sogs thad cha rgyus zab mo med pas/ bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dang bod kyi yul srol goms gshis dang mi mthun pa'i rang snang gang shar du brjod pa'i nang don dang skad cha mang po mthong / der brten bod skad brnyan 'phrin le tshan la mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan dgos na/ nges par du rang gis brnyan len byas pa'i le tshan je mang du gtong dgos/ dper na/ gsar 'gyur phyogs su rang 328

gis bcar 'dri byed pa'i bsdur tshad je mang du btang nas bod rigs mang tshogs kyi thon skyed dang 'tsho bar 'brel ba dam po yod pa'i tshan rig lag rtsal dang rig gnas slob gso/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun sogs phyogs kyi dril bsgrags la shugs bsnan tshe/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin la rgya che'i lta mkhan gyis dga' bsu byed la rang gi khyad chos kyang ldan nges/2 bod skad brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan gyi mi rigs rang gi skad yig gi 'bri rtsal mthor 'degs byed par mthong chen byas nas brnyan 'phrin gyi skad char rang mi rigs kyi skad cha'i nyams thon par bya dgos/de yang dmigs su bkar nas bshad dgos pa zhig la/ rang gis le tshan brnyan phab byed pa la rtsom sgrig pa dang gsar 'god par chab srid bsam blo rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi chu tshad nges can ldan pa dang brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon thabs lag rtsal sna tshogs khong du chud pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog nges par du rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas chu tshad nges can zhig gis rmang bzhi byas na/ da gzod le tshan gyi spus tshad la 'gan len byed thub/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin las rigs ni bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa'i sge'u khung lta bu yin pa dang bod skad dang bod yig la brten pa'i dril bsgrags spyan byed sde khag cig yin pas/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi mgo khrid rim pa nas nges par du dus dang rnam pa/ kun tu rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas skad yig bkol spyod byed par ha cang mthong chen bya dgos te/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi bya ba byed mkhan yongs la bod yig dang bod skad kyis le tshan brnyan phab byed pa'i nus pa mthor 'degs byed par skul ma gtong ba dang mthong chen bya dgos/ de 329

yang nam rgyun gyi bya ba'i khrod du gcigs su bzung nas gong 'og bar gsum gyi khor yug kun tu bod yig dang bod skad kyi dri ma stug pos khyab par bya dgos pa ma zad/ gnad 'gag gi skabs su don du 'khyol ba byas te/ bya spyod dngos kyi steng nas mtshon thub par bya dgos/ dper na/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi rten 'brel bya 'gul sogs kyi skabs su bya 'gul ci zhig yin yang rgya yig gi rnam pa yod dus nges par du bod yig kyang dgos pa ste/ ched bkol tshags par sogs spel dus/ rgya yig kho nas mi spel par bod rgya yi ge gnyis gas spel te/ rgya yig gi 'bri rtsal la mkhas pas rgya yig gi lam nas 'bri ba dang bod yig gi 'bri rtsal la byang bas bod yig gi lam nas bris na ma mtha' yang rang gzhan kun gyis 'dra mnyam gyi lta stangs shig 'dzin par skul 'ded byed thub cing / bod skad brnyan 'phrin bya ba byed mkhan rnams dang khyad par du bod skad le tshan gyi gsar 'god pa dang rtsom sgrig pa dag gis bod yig gi 'bri rtsal mthor 'degs byed par skul ma gtong thub/ rgya yig dang rgya skad sogs rgya'i rig gnas kyi shan shugs ha cang che ba'i dus 'dir rang gis rang la mthong chen bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che'o/ /de ltar byas na da gzod tshang mas bod yig gi 'bri rtsal mthor 'degs byas nas le tshan che chung gang yin yang de la chu tshad cung mtho zhing mi rigs rang gi yig rigs skad cha'i nyams thon pa'i rtsom yig 'bri thub cing /sgyur rtsom dag la'ang rgya yig ma yig gi nang don la go ba zab mo lon pa dang rgya yig ma yig gi rtsom gshis sor 'jog byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng rang mi rigs kyi skad rigs goms gshis dang mthun zhing rang mi rigs kyi skad cha'i nyams thon thub pas/ mtshon byed bod yig dang bod skad yin pa 'dra'ang skad cha'i 330

yong stangs dang skad cha'i nyams rgya yig dang rgya skad yin pa 'dra ba'i ra ma lug lta bu'i skad cha mi 'byung bar phan pa red/ bod skad brnyan 'phrin la rgya yig dang rgya skad la byang ba dang rgya yig gi 'bri rtsal la byang ba'i mi sna mkho la/brnyan 'phrin gyi mtshon thabs lag rtsal sna tshogs khong du chud cing bod yig gi 'bri rtsal la byang ba'i mi sna lhag par du mkho ba red/ rgyu mtshan ci zhe na nga tsho ni bod skad brnyan 'phrin yin pas phyir ro/ /3 bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi skur sgrig le tshan gyi nang don dang skad cha de rang mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba dang skad cha'i goms srol dang mthun par bya dgos/bod skad brnyan 'phrin la mtshon na/ dang thog nas bzung rgya skad kyi le tshan bsgyur ba nas mgo brtsams pa dang da lta rang gis brnyan len byed pa'i nus pa je cher song nas rang bsgrigs le tshan je mang du song na'ang / rgya skad kyi le tshan nas tshur bsgyur ba'i le tshan ni sngar bzhin bod skad le tshan gyi khag cig yin la/ rjes phyogs su mu mthud du le tshan la la rgya skad nas bsgyur bar brten dgos/ lhag par du brnyan 'phrin zlos gar ni mang che ba rgya skad las bsgyur ba la brten dgos pa ni ldog tu med pa'i don dngos red/ des na gcig nas rig gnas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang skad rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ dmangs srol mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sogs kyis des mtshon pa'i nang don gyi cha nas yongs su mi rigs gzhan la mthun pa zhig yong rgyu ni shin tu dka' la/ nga tsho rgya che'i bod rigs lta mkhan gyis yongs su dang len byed thub pa'am yongs su dang len byed 'dod pa zhig yin mi srid pa dang tha na le tshan la las nga tsho rgya che'i lta mkhan mang tshogs kyi rig gnas 'du shes dang bsam 331

pa'i 'du shes sogs la shugs rkyen ngan pa bzo yang srid pa red/ gnyis nas rgya skad kyi le tshan dang sgos su rgya skad kyi brnyan 'phrin zlos gar de yang rgyu rkyen gang mang bi dbang gis nang don dang rgyu spus thad nas kyang bzang ngan gnyis ka yod pas na/ nga tshos thog mar nang don gyi gdam gses la gzab gzab bya dgos/ gdam gses byed skabs/ cha rkyen 'dzoms tshad kyis nang don thad nas yar brtson dang skyon bral ba dang dpe mtshon rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos gdam 'os/ rgya skad dang yang na mi rigs gzhan gyi dpe mtshon rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos shig yin na/ des mi rigs de yi phul byung rig gnas mtshon pas/ nga tsho'i lta mkhan la mtshams sbyor bya 'os/ ched sgrig le tshan thad nas phyogs so so'i shes bya rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos gdam chog bod skad brnyan 'phrin la rang mi rigs kyi phul byung srol rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa dang gzhan mi rigs kyi phul byung rig gnas sdud len byed pa'i las 'gan yod la/ gzhan gyi rig gnas goms gshis ngan pa'i shugs rkyen bkag 'gog byed pa'i las 'gan yang yod/mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi ched sgrig le tshan gyi sgyur sgrig thad nas bltas na/ lo 'ga'i ring la yig sgyur dang 'grel bshad kyi chu tshad dang /sgrig sbyor lag rtsal gyi zhib cha sogs tshang ma'i thad nas sngon chad las je zhan du gyur 'dug snyam/ de yang rgyu rkyen 'tshol na gcig nas nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la rang gis brnyan phab byed pa'i rtsom sgrig le tshan je mang du song ba dang bstun nas de la kun gyis gcigs mthong che bar gyur pa dang sgyur sgrig le tshan je nyung du gyur pa dang bstun nas gong 'og bar gsum nas de la mthong chen byas pa mi 'dang bar gyur cing / gnyis nas nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la na 332

gzhon mang po bya ba'i steng 'ongs nas yun ring ma 'bor bas byed sgo la de 'dra'i byang cha med pa'i khar mabo khrid rim pa dang rgan rabs pa rnams kyis de tshor bye brag bi khrid ston byas pa mi 'dang ba'i rkyen yang yin rgyu red snyam/rtsom sgrig dang sgyur sgrig gang yin yang tshang mas brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi yi ge dang skad cha'i chu tshad mtshon pa yin/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar mang che ba ni rgya skad nas bsgyur cing / mi rigs gzhan gyi skad cha'i brtsams chos shig yin tshe/de la nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba dang goms gshis dang mi mthun sa yod pa ni smos ma dgos pa red/ der brten skad cha sgyur dus de'i rtsom gshis dang skad cha'i khyad chos sor 'jog gam srung 'dzin byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng / rang mi rigs kyi skad cha'i goms gshis dang yang na skad cha'i thad nas mi rigs rang gi 'dzem bya dang brtsi bya la do snang bya dbos/ pho mo'i bar gyi brtse dung mtshon pa'i nang don ni phal cher glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin zlos gar gang du'ang yod pa red/ sgos su deng rabs kyi grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa dang na gzhon gyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin zlos gar nang du de ni za ma'i nang gi tshwa bzhin du med mi rung ba zhig tu snang / brnyan 'phrin de rigs sgyur dus pho mo'i brtse dung mtshon skabs/ skad cha'i khor yug dang mi rigs rang gi skad cha'i goms gshis dang mi rigs rang gi 'dzem bya dang brtsi bya'i goms srol/ de min brnyan 'phrin gyi spyi byings dang yongs khyab rang bzhin la bsam blo mi gtong bar/ mdza' brtses bcangs pa'i pho mo phan tshun bar gyi kha brda'i khrod nga khyod la dga'/ khyod nga la e dga' zhes pa lta bu'i skad cha dmar rjen bshad par ma zad/ ma bu dang ming sring bar du'ang nga'i dga' rogs/ khyod kyi 'grogs bzang / nga de la dga' gi zhes pa lta bu'i tshig 333

'byung bzhin yod pas/ mi gcig pus lta dus kyang skyi g.ya' ba dang lus kyi ba spu gzengs pa'i snang ba 'gog med du skyes/ brnyan 'phrin ni khrom sung gi glog brnyan ston sa dang mi 'dra bar de ni spyi byings dang yongs khyab rang bzhin gyi smyan byed cig yin pa dang / de ni dpe cha'i yig ngo dang mi 'dra bar mi gcig kho nas bltas chog pa zhig ma yin par mi mang pos mnyam du longs su spyod chog pa zhig yin zhing / da dung phal che ba khyim mi rgan gzhon gang bos mnyam du lta ba zhig red/ khyad par du nga tsho'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyi lta mkhan mang tshogs la mtshon na da snga khyim gcig gis brnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas 'ga' re bsgrigs nas lta ba'i chu tshad la thon med/ de lta bu'i chu tshad la bslebs yod pa'i dbang du btang na'ang / bod mi rigs kyi goms srol ltar na ma bu dang ming sring bar du skad cha dmar rjen de lta bu bshad pa'i dpe mi dar/ de yang bod mi rigs la pho mo'i brtse dung mi dar ba gtan nas ma red/ yin na yang mi rigs rig gnas dang mi rigs goms srol sogs mi 'dra bas/ de nyid mtshon stangs kyang mi 'dra ba red/ nga tsho'i nyin rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod du de'i thad kyi skad cha med pa ma yin te/ dper na/ pho mo'i bar du brtse dung mtshon dus/ khyod kyi sems na nga yod dam/ nga khyod la 'dang yod/ ngas kho mo blor 'bab ki zhes pa dang yang na khyod kyis gza' tshang zhig 'tshol ran/ khyod kyis mna' ma zhig btsal yod dam zhes brjod na skad cha'i nang don la 'gal ba med pa dang bod mi rigs kyi spyir btang gi bshad srol dang mthun pas/ pho mo'i brtse dung skor thams cad dga' ba dang dga' rogs sogs mtha' gcig tu dga' yig kho na bkol dgos pa'i nges pa med/ de dang de lta bu'i rang mi rigs kyi skad cha'i goms gshis dang mi rigs kyi goms srol rig gnas dang 334

mi mthun pa dang rgya yig dang rgya skad kyi shan zhugs drags pa'i skad cha ni da dung ha cang mang la/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar kyi skad cha kho na ma yin par/brnyan 'phrin le tshan gzhan dang / de min bod yig gi yig sgyur ram rig gnas sde khag yongs su tshad mi 'dra bar 'byung bzhin pas/ yig sgyur bya ba tshad ldan du gtong ba dang mi rigs rig gnas skad yig tshad ldan ngang bkol rgyu ni bod kyi rig gnas sde khag yongs dang rig gnas bya ba byed mkhan yongs kyis do snang bya dgos pa'i gnad don zhig tu gyur/4 bod skad brnyan 'phrin las rigs bar gyi rogs res la shugs snon bya dgos/da lta bod khul du bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon gyi sa cha so so dang / kun su'u yi kun lho dang dpa' ris/ si khron gyi rnga ba dang dkar mdzes/ yun nan gyi bde chen sogs su bod skad kyi brnyan 'phrin le tshan yod pas/ phan tshun bar gyi 'brel 'dris la shugs snon byas nas/ le tshan mnyam du bsgrub pa dang lo rer rogs res tshogs 'du bsdus te le tshan dpyad bsdur byed pa dang bya ba'i khrod byung ba'i thun mong rang bzhin gyi gnad don dag la mnyam du gros bsdur byas nas lta tshul dang nyams myong brje res byed cing / ched las skor kyi ming tshig dang lo rer gsar du byung ba'i phyogs so so'i ming tshig gsar ba sogs rang rang gi dus rgyun gyi bya ba'i lag len khrod phyogs bsdus 'tshol zhib byas rjes rogs res tshogs 'du'i steng mnyam du gros bsdur gcig gyur byas nas bkol ba bcas byas na/ byed sgo'i thad phan tshun gyi bzang cha la slob sbyong 335

dang zhan char kha gsab byed thub pa dang / le tshan gyi thon khungs thad nas kyang phan tshun la kha gsab rogs 'degs byed chog la/ phan tshun bar le tshan mnyam du bsgrubs pa brgyud phan tshun gyi byed sgo'i mi sna'i chu tshad 'thor 'degs byed par skul 'ded byed thub par ma zad/ lhag par du gal che ba ni dbus skad dang khams skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs mnyam du 'dris pa dang phan tshun soms par dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed thub/ spyir rgya skad kyi sa cha so so'i skad cha'i khyad par dang bsdur na/ bod skad kyi dbus skad dang a mdo'i skad/ khams skad bcas kyi bar la khyad par chen po mi 'dug ces bshad kyang mi chog rgyu med/ rgya skad kyi kong tung gi skad cha dang h+phu can gyi skad cha sogs kyis yi ge gcig gi sgra gdangs yongs su mi mtshungs pas mi rigs gcig dang yig rigs gcig gi skad cha red ces brjod na yid mi ches pa lta bu'i khyad par ha cang chen po 'dug pas/ gal te phan tshun skad chas 'brel gtug byed na kun gyis thun mong du bkol ba'i spyi skad cig nges par du yod dgos pa red/ rang re'i dbus skad dang khams skad / a mdo'i skad ni yi ge'i sgra len stangs la khyad par phran bu yod pa las/ sgra gdangs spyi la khyad par chen po med pas/ yi ge shes mkhan zhig yin na/ mnyam du 'grogs nas dus yun ring po mi dgos par phan tshun gyi skad cha phal cher go ba red/ nga tshos nam rgyun phan tshun bar gyi 'brel 'dris dang skad cha'i 'brel 'dris je mang du btang tshe/ phan tshun gyi skad cha'i brda 'phrod par tshegs chen po med/der brten nga tshos dbus skad dang khams skad/ a mdo'i skad kyi khyad par zhes ches cher bshad dgos don med la/ rang re'i bod kyi rig gnas la cha 336

rgyus med pa'i mi rigs gzhan la nga tsho'i skad cha'i khyad par che ba'i sgra cher sgrog dbos don de bas kyang med/ de yang sa cha'i dbang gis skad char khyad par cung tsam shor ba las de la gtso phal gyi khyad par yod pa gtan nas min/bod skad brnyan 'phrin yang de ltar yin te/ sa cha'icha rkyen sogs kyi dbang this le tshan gyi sna kha dang le tshan gyi ring thung sogs gzhi khyod che chung la khyad par yod pa ma gtogs su gtso bo yin pa dang su lte ba yin pa'i go gnas kyi khyad par gtan nas med/ de bzhin du nga tshos bya ba'i khrod du bod khul sa cha so so'i sa gnas kyi khyad chos dang bod kyi rig gnas dang chos lugs/ yul srol goms gshis kyi bye brag gi rnam pa dang snang tshul la la gzhir bzung nas a mdo'i rig gnas dang khams pa'i ris gnas/ dbus pa'i rig gnas zhes bod kyi rig gnas spyi la ma 'dus pa'i rig gnas gzhan zhig yod pa lta bu'i dril bsgrags cher bya dgos don lhag par mi 'dug ste/ khams phyogs dang a mdo/ dbus phyogs kyi rig gnas rnam pa sang yin yang tshang ma bod kyi rig gnas la ma 'dus pa zhig yod mi srid/ deng rabs can gyi dril bsgrags yo byad du gyur pa'i bod skad brnyan 'phrin dang rlung 'phrin gyis rang bi thun mong ma yin pa'i yongs khyab rang bzhin dang brgyud bsgrags khyad chos gang legs kyis bed spyad tshe/ rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs la dbus skad dang khams skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs la goms shing 'dris par byas nas bod kyi skad cha'i khyad par je chung du gtong bar nus pa gal chen bskyed thub/der brten/ bod khul yongs kyi bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyis phan tshun bar gyi rogs res dang mnyam las la shugs snon byas na/ bod skad brnyan 337

'phrin las don hril bo gong du 'phel bar skul 'ded byed thub par ma zad/da dung bod skad kyi khyad par je chung du gtong ba dang bod kyi rig gnas gcig gyur ngang gong du 'phel bar dge mtshan ldan pa'i nus pa bskyed thub/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la mtsho sngon bod skad brnyan 'phrin gyis de'i thad 'bad brtson byas nas/ bod rigs mang tshogs khrod shugs rkyen legs po bzos pas gong 'og bar gsum kun gyi bsngags brjod thob bo/ /

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur pa khros ma thar/mdun shog jus 'god pa lis can zhung /༄ga /bod skad rlung 'phrin brnyan 'phrin gyi bshad mkhan dang 'go 'dzin pa'i shes bya blo gsal mgul rgyan/rin chen skyid kyis brtsams/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin nyug hran hri shin par khang gis par btab/2008lo'i zla 8par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2008lo'i zla 8par par thengs dang po btab/1525 978—7—80057—979—075 11rin gong sgor/ 15 50
